name: Android CI
# Full Android validation remains available manually. For draft PRs,
# evaluate the configurable 50-Android-commit checkpoint automatically.
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'communication/**'
      - 'core/**'
      - 'diagnostic/**'
      - 'control/**'
      - 'mileageaudit/**'
      - 'storage/**'
      - 'third_party/**'
      - '**/*.gradle'
      - '**/*.gradle.kts'
      - 'gradle/**'
      - 'gradle.properties'
      - 'gradlew'
      - 'gradlew.bat'
      - 'version.properties'
      - '.github/workflows/android-ci.yml'

concurrency:
  group: android-debug-pr-${{ inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.target_ref || 'manual' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  evaluate-build-checkpoint:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      validated_sha: ${{ steps.resolve_revision.outputs.sha }}
      android_changed: ${{ steps.android_changes.outputs.android_changed }}
      current_android_changed: ${{ steps.android_changes.outputs.current_android_changed }}
      build_required: ${{ steps.checkpoint.outputs.build_required }}
      android_validation_applies: ${{ steps.checkpoint.outputs.validation_applies }}
      commits_since_build: ${{ steps.checkpoint.outputs.commits_since_build }}
      interval: ${{ steps.checkpoint.outputs.interval }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pull request history
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.target_ref || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Capture exact checked-out revision
        id: resolve_revision
        shell: bash
        run: echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Detect Android-relevant changes
        id: android_changes
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="${BASE_SHA:-$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)}"
          HEAD_SHA="${HEAD_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
          paths=(
            'app/**' 'core/**' 'diagnostic/**' 'communication/**'
            'control/**' 'mileageaudit/**' 'storage/**' 'third_party/**'
            'build.gradle' 'build.gradle.kts' 'settings.gradle' 'settings.gradle.kts'
            '*.gradle' '*.gradle.kts' 'gradle.properties' 'gradle/**'
            'gradlew' 'gradlew.bat' 'version.properties'
            '.github/workflows/android-ci.yml'
          )
          if git diff --quiet "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}"; then
            echo "android_changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "NOT APPLICABLE: no Android source, resource, module, or Gradle build changes."
          else
            echo "android_changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Android-relevant changes detected:"
            git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}"
          fi
          if git diff --quiet "$HEAD_SHA^" "$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}"; then
            echo "current_android_changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "current_android_changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Current commit contains Android-relevant changes."
          fi

      - name: Find last successful Android Debug validation attempt
        id: previous_build
        if: steps.android_changes.outputs.android_changed == 'true' && github.event.pull_request.draft
        uses: actions/github-script@v8
        with:
          script: |
            const pr = context.payload.pull_request;
            const runs = await github.paginate(github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRuns, {
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              workflow_id: 'android-ci.yml', branch: pr.head.ref,
              event: 'pull_request', status: 'completed', per_page: 100
            });
            const candidates = runs
              .filter(run => run.head_sha !== pr.head.sha &&
                (run.pull_requests || []).some(item => item.number === pr.number))
              .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at));
            let previous = null;
            for (const candidate of candidates) {
              const jobs = await github.rest.actions.listJobsForWorkflowRun({
                owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
                run_id: candidate.id, per_page: 100
              });
              if (jobs.data.jobs.some(job => job.name === 'test-and-build' && job.conclusion === 'success')) {
                previous = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            core.setOutput('sha', previous ? previous.head_sha : '');
            core.info(previous
              ? 'Last successful Android Debug validation attempt: ' + previous.head_sha
              : 'No previous successful Android Debug validation attempt; counting relevant commits from the PR base.');

      - name: Evaluate Android-only periodic build checkpoint
        id: checkpoint
        shell: bash
        env:
          BUILD_INTERVAL: ${{ vars.CAMARODIAG_DRAFT_BUILD_INTERVAL }}
          ANDROID_CHANGED: ${{ steps.android_changes.outputs.android_changed }}
          CURRENT_ANDROID_CHANGED: ${{ steps.android_changes.outputs.current_android_changed }}
          EVENT_ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHA: ${{ steps.previous_build.outputs.sha }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          IS_DRAFT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.draft }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="${BASE_SHA:-$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)}"
          HEAD_SHA="${HEAD_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
          configured="${BUILD_INTERVAL:-}"
          if [[ "$configured" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then interval="$configured"; else interval=50; fi
          echo "interval=$interval" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$ANDROID_CHANGED" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "validation_applies=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "commits_since_build=0" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "NOT APPLICABLE: this PR contains no Android-relevant changes."
            exit 0
          fi

          count_base="$BASE_SHA"
          if [[ -n "$PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHA" ]]; then count_base="$PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHA"; fi
          paths=(
            'app/**' 'core/**' 'diagnostic/**' 'communication/**'
            'control/**' 'mileageaudit/**' 'storage/**' 'third_party/**'
            'build.gradle' 'build.gradle.kts' 'settings.gradle' 'settings.gradle.kts'
            '*.gradle' '*.gradle.kts' 'gradle.properties' 'gradle/**'
            'gradlew' 'gradlew.bat' 'version.properties'
            '.github/workflows/android-ci.yml'
          )
          commits_since_build="$(git rev-list --count "$count_base..$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}")"
          echo "commits_since_build=$commits_since_build" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          # Manual dispatch is an explicit request for a complete validation, independent of the 50-commit draft checkpoint.
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Manual Android Debug validation explicitly requested."
          # Ready transition validates the PR scope; subsequent Ready synchronize events validate only files changed in that commit.
          elif [[ "$IS_DRAFT" == "true" ]]; then
            if [[ "$CURRENT_ANDROID_CHANGED" != "true" ]]; then
              echo "validation_applies=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "NOT APPLICABLE to this commit: no Android-relevant files changed."
            else
              echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              # An updater change affects public file storage, APK signing
              # validation and cleanup after package replacement. Always
              # compile and lint it immediately, irrespective of the normal
              # draft checkpoint used for ordinary Android edits.
              if ! git diff --quiet "$HEAD_SHA^" "$HEAD_SHA" -- \
                  'app/src/main/java/com/camarodiag/gen5/ui/UpdateManager.kt' \
                  'app/src/main/java/com/camarodiag/gen5/ui/CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.kt' \
                  'app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml' \
                  'app/src/main/res/xml/update_file_paths.xml' \
                  '.github/workflows/android-ci.yml'; then
                echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "APK updater or CI safety-critical change: full Android Debug validation required."
              elif (( commits_since_build >= interval )); then
                echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "Android Debug build due: $commits_since_build relevant commits (interval $interval)."
              else
                echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "Android Debug build deferred: $commits_since_build/$interval Android-relevant commits since the last completed attempt."
              fi
            fi
          else
            case "$EVENT_ACTION" in
              ready_for_review|opened|reopened)
                echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "Initial Ready-for-review validation: Android changes exist in the PR."
                ;;
              *)
                if [[ "$CURRENT_ANDROID_CHANGED" == "true" ]]; then
                  echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "Ready PR commit changes Android files: immediate Android Debug validation required."
                else
                  echo "validation_applies=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "NOT APPLICABLE to this Ready PR commit: no Android-relevant files changed."
                fi
                ;;
            esac
          fi
  test-and-build:

      - name: Require complete French and English resource coverage

FICHIER : .github/workflows/delete-merged-pr-branches.yml
SHA Git : b53b563aafa9c17e16eb7d6cbcc6e9d2c7ff9d91

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
name: Delete merged pull request branches

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types:
      - closed
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  delete-merged-pr-branches:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Delete head branches of merged pull requests
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const pullRequests = await github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.list, {
              owner,
              repo,
              state: "closed",
              per_page: 100
            });

            for (const pr of pullRequests) {
              if (!pr.merged_at) continue;
              if (!pr.head?.ref || pr.head.ref === "main") continue;
              if (pr.head.repo?.full_name !== `${owner}/${repo}`) continue;

              try {
                await github.rest.git.deleteRef({
                  owner,
                  repo,
                  ref: `heads/${pr.head.ref}`
                });
                core.info(`Deleted merged PR #${pr.number} branch: ${pr.head.ref}`);
              } catch (error) {
                if (error.status === 404 || error.status === 422) {
                  core.info(`Branch already absent: ${pr.head.ref}`);
                  continue;
                }
                throw error;
              }
            }

            '.github/workflows/pc-bridge-ci.yml'
          )
          if git diff --quiet "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}"; then
            echo "windows_changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "NOT APPLICABLE: no Windows bridge, shared .NET build, installer, or Windows CI workflow changes."
          else
            echo "windows_changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Windows-relevant changes detected:"
            git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}"
          fi
          if git diff --quiet "$HEAD_SHA^" "$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}"; then
            echo "current_windows_changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "current_windows_changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Current commit contains Windows-relevant changes."
          fi

      - name: Find last successful Windows Debug build
        id: previous_build
        if: steps.windows_changes.outputs.windows_changed == 'true' && github.event.pull_request.draft
        uses: actions/github-script@v8
        with:
          script: |
            const pr = context.payload.pull_request;
            const runs = await github.paginate(github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRuns, {
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              workflow_id: 'pc-bridge-ci.yml', branch: pr.head.ref,
              event: 'pull_request', status: 'completed', per_page: 100
            });
            const candidates = runs
              .filter(run => run.conclusion === 'success' && run.head_sha !== pr.head.sha &&
                (run.pull_requests || []).some(item => item.number === pr.number))
              .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at));
            let previous = null;
            for (const candidate of candidates) {
              const jobs = await github.rest.actions.listJobsForWorkflowRun({
                owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
                run_id: candidate.id, per_page: 100
              });
              if (jobs.data.jobs.some(job => job.name === 'build-windows-debug' && job.conclusion === 'success')) {
                previous = candidate;
                break;
              }
            }
            core.setOutput('sha', previous ? previous.head_sha : '');
            core.info(previous
              ? 'Last successful Windows Debug build: ' + previous.head_sha
              : 'No previous successful Windows Debug build; counting relevant commits from the PR base.');

      - name: Evaluate Windows-only periodic build checkpoint
        id: checkpoint
        shell: bash
        env:
          BUILD_INTERVAL: ${{ vars.CAMARODIAG_DRAFT_BUILD_INTERVAL }}
          WINDOWS_CHANGED: ${{ steps.windows_changes.outputs.windows_changed }}
          CURRENT_WINDOWS_CHANGED: ${{ steps.windows_changes.outputs.current_windows_changed }}
          EVENT_ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHA: ${{ steps.previous_build.outputs.sha }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          IS_DRAFT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.draft }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="${BASE_SHA:-$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)}"
          HEAD_SHA="${HEAD_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
          configured="${BUILD_INTERVAL:-}"
          if [[ "$configured" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then interval="$configured"; else interval=50; fi
          echo "interval=$interval" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "commits_since_build=0" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Explicit manual Windows validation runs regardless of diff thresholds."
            exit 0
          fi
          if [[ "$WINDOWS_CHANGED" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "validation_applies=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "commits_since_build=0" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "NOT APPLICABLE: this PR contains no Windows-relevant changes."
            exit 0
          fi

          count_base="$BASE_SHA"
          if [[ -n "$PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHA" ]]; then count_base="$PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHA"; fi
          paths=(
            'pc-bridge/**' 'global.json' '.editorconfig' '.github/actions/**' 'NuGet.Config' 'nuget.config'
            '**/Directory.Build.props' '**/Directory.Build.targets'
            '**/Directory.Packages.props' '**/Directory.Build.rsp' '**/MSBuild.rsp'
            '**/*.sln' '**/*.slnx' '**/*.props' '**/*.targets'
            '**/NuGet.Config' '**/nuget.config' '.config/dotnet-tools.json'
            '.github/workflows/pc-bridge-ci.yml'
          )
          commits_since_build="$(git rev-list --count "$count_base..$HEAD_SHA" -- "${paths[@]}")"
          echo "commits_since_build=$commits_since_build" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          # Ready transition validates the PR scope; subsequent Ready synchronize events validate only files changed in that commit.
          if [[ "$IS_DRAFT" == "true" ]]; then
            if [[ "$CURRENT_WINDOWS_CHANGED" != "true" ]]; then
              echo "validation_applies=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "NOT APPLICABLE to this commit: no Windows-relevant files changed."
            else
              echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              # Safety-critical J2534 transport and ECU memory readers require
              # immediate compile + protocol self-tests, independent of the
              # normal adjustable draft checkpoint for unrelated Windows work.
              if ! git diff --quiet "$HEAD_SHA^" "$HEAD_SHA" -- \
                  'pc-bridge/CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge/J2534Device.cs' \
                  'pc-bridge/CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge/J2534MemoryReadScope.cs' \
                  'pc-bridge/CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge/BridgeServer.cs' \
                  'pc-bridge/CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge/BridgeSelfTests.cs'; then
                echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "Safety-critical J2534 code changed: full bridge compilation required."
              elif git diff --quiet "$HEAD_SHA^" "$HEAD_SHA" -- '.github/workflows/pc-bridge-ci.yml'; then
                if (( commits_since_build >= interval )); then
                  echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "Windows Debug build due: $commits_since_build relevant commits (interval $interval)."
                else
                  echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "Windows Debug build deferred: $commits_since_build/$interval Windows-relevant commits."
                fi
              else
                echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "Windows Debug workflow changed in this commit: forcing validation."
              fi
            fi
          else
            case "$EVENT_ACTION" in
              ready_for_review|opened|reopened)
                echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "Initial Ready-for-review validation: Windows changes exist in the PR."
                ;;
              *)
                if [[ "$CURRENT_WINDOWS_CHANGED" == "true" ]]; then
                  echo "validation_applies=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "build_required=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "Ready PR commit changes Windows files: immediate Windows Debug validation required."
                else
                  echo "validation_applies=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "build_required=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  echo "NOT APPLICABLE to this Ready PR commit: no Windows-relevant files changed."
                fi
                ;;
            esac
          fi
  build-windows-debug:
    needs: evaluate-build-checkpoint
    if: always() && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.outputs.build_required == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pull request commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.outputs.validated_sha }}

      - name: Set up .NET 8
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: "8.0.x"

      - name: Build J2534 bridge in Debug configuration
        run: dotnet build .\pc-bridge\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.csproj --configuration Debug -warnaserror
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Verify compiled .NET bridge executable
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $exe = '.\pc-bridge\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge\bin\Debug\net8.0-windows\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe'
          if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { throw "Windows debug executable missing: $exe" }
          if ((Get-Item $exe).Length -lt 1024) { throw 'Windows bridge executable unexpectedly small' }

      - name: Run hardware-free bridge security and protocol self-tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          & '.\pc-bridge\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge\bin\Debug\net8.0-windows\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe' --self-test
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'J2534 bridge self-tests failed' }

      - name: Ensure Inno Setup is available
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $iscc = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath("ProgramFilesX86")) "Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe"
          if (-not (Test-Path $iscc)) {
            choco install innosetup --yes --no-progress
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Inno Setup installation failed." }
          } else {
            Write-Host "Inno Setup is already available: $iscc"
          }

      - name: Materialize CamaroDiag installer icon
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $encoded = (Get-Content ".\pc-bridge\installer\assets\CamaroDiag.ico.b64" -Raw).Trim()
          $bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($encoded)
          [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes(".\pc-bridge\installer\assets\CamaroDiag.ico", $bytes)

      - name: Publish and package Windows Debug installers
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number || 'manual' }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          $iscc = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath("ProgramFilesX86")) "Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe"
          if (-not (Test-Path $iscc)) { throw "Inno Setup compiler not found: $iscc" }

          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ".\dist" | Out-Null
          $variants = @(
            @{ Runtime = "win-x64"; Arch = "x64"; Name = "debug-win-x64" },
            @{ Runtime = "win-x86"; Arch = "x86"; Name = "debug-win-x86" }
          )

          foreach ($variant in $variants) {
            $output = Join-Path $PWD "publish\$($variant.Name)"
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $output | Out-Null

            dotnet publish .\pc-bridge\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.csproj --configuration Debug --runtime $variant.Runtime --self-contained true --output $output -warnaserror "-p:Version=0.0.0" "-p:AssemblyVersion=0.0.0.0" "-p:FileVersion=0.0.0.0"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dotnet publish failed for $($variant.Name)" }
            $publishedExe = Join-Path $output 'CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe'
            if (-not (Test-Path $publishedExe)) { throw "Bridge missing from $output" }
            & $publishedExe --self-test
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "$($variant.Arch) published bridge self-tests failed" }

            $outputName = "CamaroDiag-J2534-Bridge-Setup-debug-pr$env:PR_NUMBER-$($variant.Arch)"
            $installerLog = Join-Path $PWD "dist\$($variant.Name)-installer.log"
            $installerOutput = & $iscc "/DAppVersion=0.0.0" "/DBuildDir=$output" "/DChannel=debug" "/DArch=$($variant.Arch)" "/DOutputName=$outputName" ".\pc-bridge\installer\CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.iss" 2>&1
            $installerOutput | Tee-Object -FilePath $installerLog
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Inno Setup failed for $($variant.Name)" }
            if (($installerOutput | Out-String) -match '(?i)\bwarning\b') {
              throw "Inno Setup emitted a warning for $($variant.Name); warning-free Debug builds are mandatory. See $installerLog"
            }
          }

      - name: Verify both Windows installers exist
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number || 'manual' }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          foreach ($arch in @('x64', 'x86')) {
            $installer = Join-Path $PWD ("dist/CamaroDiag-J2534-Bridge-Setup-debug-pr{0}-{1}.exe" -f $env:PR_NUMBER, $arch)
            if (-not (Test-Path $installer)) { throw "Missing $arch Windows installer: $installer" }
            if ((Get-Item $installer).Length -lt 4096) { throw "Invalid $arch Windows installer size" }
          }

      - name: Upload Windows Debug installers for this PR commit
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: CamaroDiag-J2534-Bridge-debug-pr-${{ inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number || 'manual' }}-${{ inputs.target_ref || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: |
            dist/CamaroDiag-J2534-Bridge-Setup-debug-pr*-x64.exe
            dist/CamaroDiag-J2534-Bridge-Setup-debug-pr*-x86.exe
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  windows-debug-validation:
    needs: [evaluate-build-checkpoint, build-windows-debug]
    # Report an explicit result on PRs as well as manual executions.
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Report Windows Debug validation applicability
        env:
          EVALUATION_RESULT: ${{ needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.result }}
          WINDOWS_CHANGED: ${{ needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.outputs.windows_changed }}
          BUILD_REQUIRED: ${{ needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.outputs.build_required }}
          BUILD_RESULT: ${{ needs.build-windows-debug.result }}
          COMMITS_SINCE_BUILD: ${{ needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.outputs.commits_since_build }}
          BUILD_INTERVAL: ${{ needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.outputs.interval }}
          VALIDATION_APPLIES: ${{ needs.evaluate-build-checkpoint.outputs.windows_validation_applies }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$EVALUATION_RESULT" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Windows applicability/checkpoint evaluation did not succeed."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$VALIDATION_APPLIES" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "NOT APPLICABLE: this PR event/commit does not change Windows-relevant files."
            exit 0
          fi
          if [[ "$BUILD_REQUIRED" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "BUILD DEFERRED: $COMMITS_SINCE_BUILD/$BUILD_INTERVAL Windows-relevant commits."
            echo "This control is not a compilation and does not reset the checkpoint."
            exit 0
          fi
          if [[ "$BUILD_RESULT" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Windows Debug build was required but its result was $BUILD_RESULT."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "VALIDATED: Windows Debug build and x64/x86 installers completed successfully."

# Final PR54 checkpoint: Android APIs 29–36, protected-sector regression, Debug + Release.
# Each push to this file (only) dispatches all chains on the same immutable SHA.

# One-time checkpoint: changing THIS file is the only push that requests builds.

            -f target_ref="$TARGET_SHA"

          # Expose concrete run IDs to the PR, so the exact SHA can be checked
          # without pretending that dispatch equals a successful validation.

          for WORKFLOW in android-ci.yml pc-bridge-ci.yml pr35-release-preflight.yml; do

                --workflow "$WORKFLOW" --branch feat/flexfuel-lfx-2012 \
                --event workflow_dispatch --limit 30 \
                --json databaseId,headSha \
                --jq ".[] | select(.headSha == \"$TARGET_SHA\") | .databaseId" | head -n 1)"
              if [[ -n "$RUN_ID" ]]; then break; fi
              sleep 5
            done
            if [[ -n "$RUN_ID" ]]; then
              REPORT="$REPORT
          - $WORKFLOW: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$RUN_ID"
            else
              REPORT="$REPORT
          - $WORKFLOW: run not yet listed; check Actions manually"
            fi
          done
          REPORT="$REPORT
          
          Runs were dispatched, not yet confirmed successful. Inspect all jobs, lint warnings and test results before merging."

name: Release CamaroDiag

concurrency:

          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'J2534 Release self-tests failed' }

  release:
    needs: windows-preflight
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'push')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    outputs:
      release_tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
      version_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version_name }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: temurin

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.11.1'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
        with:
          cmdline-tools-version: 14742923
          packages: "platform-tools platforms;android-36 build-tools;36.0.0"

      - name: Determine next release version
        id: version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          VERSION_PREFIX="$(sed -n 's/^VERSION_PREFIX=//p' version.properties | head -n 1 | tr -d '\r')"
          VERSION_CODE_BASE="$(sed -n 's/^VERSION_CODE_BASE=//p' version.properties | head -n 1 | tr -d '\r')"

          if [[ ! "$VERSION_PREFIX" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "VERSION_PREFIX must use MAJOR.MINOR format (for example 1.6)." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! "$VERSION_CODE_BASE" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "VERSION_CODE_BASE must be a positive integer." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          PREFIX_PATTERN="${VERSION_PREFIX//./\\.}"
          LAST_PATCH="$(git tag --list "v${VERSION_PREFIX}.*" | sed -nE "s/^v${PREFIX_PATTERN}\.([0-9]+)$/\1/p" | sort -n | tail -n 1)"

          if [[ -z "$LAST_PATCH" ]]; then
            NEXT_PATCH=0
          else
            NEXT_PATCH=$((LAST_PATCH + 1))
          fi

          VERSION_CODE=$((VERSION_CODE_BASE + NEXT_PATCH))
          VERSION_NAME="${VERSION_PREFIX}.${NEXT_PATCH}"
          TAG_NAME="v${VERSION_NAME}"

          if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/${TAG_NAME}" >/dev/null; then
            echo "Tag ${TAG_NAME} already exists; refusing to overwrite a release." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "prefix=${VERSION_PREFIX}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "patch=${NEXT_PATCH}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version_name=${VERSION_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version_code=${VERSION_CODE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${TAG_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "Release: ${TAG_NAME} (versionCode ${VERSION_CODE})"

      - name: Decode signing keystore
        run: |
          mkdir -p app
          printf "%s" "${{ secrets.SIGNING_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" | base64 --decode > app/release.jks
          test -s app/release.jks

      - name: Generate Gradle wrapper, test and build release APK
        env:
          SIGNING_STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SIGNING_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS }}
          SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          RELEASE_PATCH: ${{ steps.version.outputs.patch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.11.1
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest -PreleasePatch="$RELEASE_PATCH" --stacktrace --warning-mode=fail
          ./gradlew lintDebug lintRelease -PreleasePatch="$RELEASE_PATCH" --stacktrace --warning-mode=fail
          ./gradlew app:assembleRelease -PreleasePatch="$RELEASE_PATCH" --stacktrace --warning-mode=fail

      - name: Report release APK size and largest packaged entries
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from zipfile import ZipFile
          apks = sorted(Path("app/build/outputs/apk/release").glob("*.apk"))
          if len(apks) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"Expected exactly one release APK, found {len(apks)}")
          apk = apks[0]
          print(f"Release APK: {apk.name} ({apk.stat().st_size / 1048576:.2f} MiB)")
          with ZipFile(apk) as archive:
              for item in sorted(archive.infolist(), key=lambda entry: entry.compress_size, reverse=True)[:20]:
                  print(f"{item.compress_size / 1048576:.2f} MiB  {item.filename}")
          PY

      - name: Reject Android lint errors and warnings in every release variant
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          from xml.etree import ElementTree
          modules = ("app", "core", "diagnostic", "communication", "storage", "control", "mileageaudit")
          failures = []
          for module in modules:
              for variant in ("debug", "release"):
                  report = Path(module) / f"build/reports/lint-results-{variant}.xml"
                  if not report.is_file():
                      failures.append(f"Missing {report}")
                      continue
                  for issue in ElementTree.parse(report).getroot().findall("issue"):
                      if issue.get("severity", "").lower() in {"warning", "error", "fatal"}:
                          failures.append(f"{report}: {issue.get('id')}: {issue.get('message')}")
          if failures:
              raise SystemExit("\\n".join(failures))
          print("Android Release/Debug lint: zero warnings or errors in all modules.")
          PY

      - name: Create Git tag
        env:
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "GitHub Actions Bot"
          git config user.email "actions@github.com"
          git tag "$TAG_NAME"
          git push origin "$TAG_NAME"

      - name: Publish release with Android APK
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          name: "CamaroDiag - Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}"
          body: |
            ## CamaroDiag • Chevrolet Camaro Gen 5 & Gen 6
            - Version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version_name }}
            - Android versionCode: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version_code }}
            - Signed Android release APK.
            - Windows J2534 Bridge release installers for x64 and x86.
            - VX Manager and the manufacturer's J2534 driver must be installed separately by an administrator when required.
            - GitHub may also show automatic source-code archives (zip/tar.gz); these are not Windows installers. Download the .exe Setup or Android .apk assets only.
          files: |
            app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  bridge-installers:

            @{ Runtime = "win-x64"; Arch = "x64"; Name = "release-win-x64" },
            @{ Runtime = "win-x86"; Arch = "x86"; Name = "release-win-x86" }
          )

            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $output | Out-Null

            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dotnet publish failed for $($variant.Name)" }
            $publishedExe = Join-Path $output 'CamaroDiag.J2534Bridge.exe'
            & $publishedExe --self-test
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Published $($variant.Arch) bridge self-tests failed" }

            $installerLog = Join-Path $PWD "dist\$($variant.Name)-installer.log"

            }
          }

        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.release.outputs.release_tag }}

            dist/CamaroDiag-J2534-Bridge-Setup-release-win-x86.exe

    needs: [release, bridge-installers]
    if: always() && needs.release.result == 'success' && needs.bridge-installers.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Keep only the newly published major release and tag
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          KEEP_TAG: ${{ needs.release.outputs.release_tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "Keeping ${KEEP_TAG}; removing all previous GitHub Releases."
          mapfile -t release_tags < <(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases?per_page=100" --jq '.[].tag_name')
          for tag in "${release_tags[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$tag" != "$KEEP_TAG" ]]; then
              echo "Deleting release and associated tag: $tag"
              gh release delete "$tag" --yes
            fi
          done

          echo "Removing any remaining Git tags other than ${KEEP_TAG}."
          mapfile -t tag_refs < <(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/refs/tags" --jq '.[].ref')
          for ref in "${tag_refs[@]}"; do
            tag="${ref#refs/tags/}"
            if [[ "$tag" != "$KEEP_TAG" ]]; then
              echo "Deleting tag: $tag"
              gh api --method DELETE "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/refs/tags/${tag}"
            fi
          done

          echo "Cleanup complete. Preserved release/tag: ${KEEP_TAG}"

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.db

import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DiagnosticAccountIsolationTest {
    private lateinit var database: DiagnosticDatabase

    @Before
    fun setup() {
        database = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(
            ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>(),
            DiagnosticDatabase::class.java
        ).build()
    }

    @After
    fun cleanup() {
        database.close()
    }

    @Test
    fun diagnosticHistoryIsSeparatedByFirebaseUid() = runBlocking {
        val dao = database.sessionDao()
        val accountA = sample("account-A", "VIN-ACCOUNT-A")
        val accountB = sample("account-B", "VIN-ACCOUNT-B")
        dao.insertSession(accountA)
        dao.insertSession(accountB)

        val rowsA = dao.observeSessionsForOwner("account-A").first()
        val rowsB = dao.observeSessionsForOwner("account-B").first()
        assertEquals(listOf("VIN-ACCOUNT-A"), rowsA.map { it.vin })
        assertEquals(listOf("VIN-ACCOUNT-B"), rowsB.map { it.vin })

        dao.deleteAllForOwner("account-A")
        assertTrue(dao.observeSessionsForOwner("account-A").first().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(listOf("VIN-ACCOUNT-B"),
            dao.observeSessionsForOwner("account-B").first().map { it.vin })
    }

    @Test
    fun importingUnassignedHistoryDoesNotStealAnotherAccountsRecords() = runBlocking {
        val dao = database.sessionDao()
        dao.insertSession(sample("", "OLD-VIN"))
        dao.insertSession(sample("account-B", "B-VIN"))
        assertEquals(1, dao.countUnassignedSessions())

        dao.claimUnassignedSessions("account-A")
        assertEquals(0, dao.countUnassignedSessions())
        assertEquals(listOf("OLD-VIN"),
            dao.observeSessionsForOwner("account-A").first().map { it.vin })
        assertEquals(listOf("B-VIN"),
            dao.observeSessionsForOwner("account-B").first().map { it.vin })
    }

    private fun sample(uid: String, vin: String) = SavedSessionEntity(
        timestamp = 1L,
        vehicleLabel = "Camaro",
        vin = vin,
        adapterName = "Test interface",
        dtcSummary = "0 DTC",
        mileageSummary = "Not read",
        hasMileageDiscrepancy = false,
        maxDeltaKm = 0.0,
        ownerUid = uid
    )
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.db

import android.content.Context
import android.content.ContentValues
import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DiagnosticDatabaseMigrationTest {
    @Test
    fun versionOneHistorySurvivesAccountOwnershipMigration(): Unit = runBlocking {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val name = "camarodiag-migration-test.db"
        context.deleteDatabase(name)
        try {
            context.openOrCreateDatabase(name, Context.MODE_PRIVATE, null).use { old ->
                old.execSQL(
                    """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS diagnostic_sessions (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
                        timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        vehicleLabel TEXT NOT NULL,
                        vin TEXT NOT NULL,
                        adapterName TEXT NOT NULL,
                        dtcSummary TEXT NOT NULL,
                        mileageSummary TEXT NOT NULL,
                        hasMileageDiscrepancy INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        maxDeltaKm REAL NOT NULL
                    )""".trimIndent()
                )
                old.insertOrThrow("diagnostic_sessions", null, ContentValues().apply {
                    put("timestamp", 1000L)
                    put("vehicleLabel", "2012 Camaro LFX")
                    put("vin", "LEGACY-VIN")
                    put("adapterName", "ELM327")
                    put("dtcSummary", "0 DTC")
                    put("mileageSummary", "Not read")
                    put("hasMileageDiscrepancy", 0)
                    put("maxDeltaKm", 0.0)
                })
                old.version = 1
            }
            val migrated = Room.databaseBuilder(context, DiagnosticDatabase::class.java, name)
                .addMigrations(DiagnosticDatabase.MIGRATION_1_2)
                .build()
            try {
                assertEquals(1, migrated.sessionDao().countUnassignedSessions())
                assertTrue(migrated.sessionDao().observeSessionsForOwner("account-A").first().isEmpty())
                migrated.sessionDao().claimUnassignedSessions("account-A")
                assertEquals(
                    listOf("LEGACY-VIN"),
                    migrated.sessionDao().observeSessionsForOwner("account-A").first().map { it.vin }
                )
            } finally {
                migrated.close()
            }
        } finally {
            context.deleteDatabase(name)
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.auth

import java.security.MessageDigest

/**
 * Keeps local account store identifiers stable and filesystem-safe without
 * disclosing the Firebase UID in a SharedPreferences filename.
 */
internal object AccountStorageKeys {
    fun garageName(uid: String?): String {
        if (uid.isNullOrBlank()) return "camarodiag_garage_no_account"
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(uid.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
        return "camarodiag_garage_$digest"
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.auth

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll

import com.google.firebase.FirebaseNetworkException
import androidx.credentials.ClearCredentialStateRequest
import androidx.credentials.CustomCredential
import androidx.credentials.GetCredentialRequest
import com.camarodiag.gen5.R
import com.google.android.libraries.identity.googleid.GetGoogleIdOption
import com.google.android.libraries.identity.googleid.GoogleIdTokenCredential

import com.google.firebase.auth.EmailAuthProvider
import com.google.firebase.auth.GoogleAuthProvider

import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalConfiguration

/**
 * Denies access to diagnostic screens until a Firebase session exists.
 * The authenticated user's session is persisted by the Firebase SDK.
 */
@Composable
fun CamaroAuthGate(
    onAccountChanged: (String?) -> Unit,
    onAccountDeleted: (String) -> Unit,
    content: @Composable (onOpenAccount: () -> Unit) -> Unit
) {
    val auth = remember { FirebaseAuth.getInstance() }
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val validationPrefs = remember(context) {
        context.getSharedPreferences("camarodiag_session_validation", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    }
    val signOut = rememberFirebaseSignOut(auth)
    var currentUser by remember { mutableStateOf(auth.currentUser) }
    // Recompose after an explicit Firebase email verification reload.
    var verificationRevision by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    DisposableEffect(auth) {
        val listener = FirebaseAuth.AuthStateListener { currentUser = it.currentUser }
        auth.addAuthStateListener(listener)
        onDispose { auth.removeAuthStateListener(listener) }
    }
    val user = currentUser
    var readyAccountUid by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var validatedAccountUid by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var validatedUser by remember { mutableStateOf<com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseUser?>(null) }
    var validationError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var retryValidation by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var validationGeneration by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val latestOnAccountChanged by rememberUpdatedState(onAccountChanged)
    // Delay diagnostic UI until the old user's active connection and transient
    // diagnostic results have been cleared by the ViewModel.
    // Reconfirm authorization periodically, even when the app remains open.
    // This also enforces the bounded offline grace without needing a restart.
    LaunchedEffect(user?.uid) {
        if (user == null) return@LaunchedEffect
        while (true) {
            delay(5L * 60L * 1000L)
            retryValidation++
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(user, retryValidation) {
        // A late callback from the previous FirebaseUser instance or retry may
        // never authenticate a different validation attempt with the same UID.
        val attempt = ++validationGeneration
        // Refreshing the current user's token must not unmount the diagnostic
        // screen every five minutes. Only an identity change hides old data.
        val identityChanged = readyAccountUid != user?.uid ||
            (validatedUser != null && validatedUser !== user)
        if (identityChanged) {
            readyAccountUid = null
            validatedAccountUid = null
            validatedUser = null
            latestOnAccountChanged(user?.uid)
            readyAccountUid = user?.uid
        }
        validationError = null
        if (user != null) {
            val targetUid = user.uid
            user.getIdToken(true).addOnCompleteListener { task ->
                if (auth.currentUser?.uid != targetUid || validationGeneration != attempt) {
                    return@addOnCompleteListener
                }
                if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    validationPrefs.edit {
                        putLong("verified_$targetUid", System.currentTimeMillis())
                    }
                    validatedAccountUid = targetUid
                    validatedUser = user
                    latestOnAccountChanged(targetUid)
                } else {
                    val lastValidated = validationPrefs.getLong("verified_$targetUid", 0L)
                    val offlineGrace = task.exception is FirebaseNetworkException &&
                        OfflineSessionPolicy.allowsOfflineAccess(
                            lastValidated, System.currentTimeMillis()
                        )
                    if (offlineGrace) {
                        validatedAccountUid = targetUid
                        validatedUser = user
                        latestOnAccountChanged(targetUid)
                    } else {
                        // Expired offline validation or a rejected Firebase token:
                        // revoke in-app access immediately and end OBD operations.
                        validatedAccountUid = null
                        validatedUser = null
                        latestOnAccountChanged(null)
                        validationError = if (task.exception is FirebaseNetworkException) {
                            "offline"
                        } else {
                            "invalid"
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (user == null) {
        CamaroLoginScreen(auth)
    } else if (user.providerData.any { it.providerId == "password" } &&
        !remember(user, verificationRevision) { user.isEmailVerified }
    ) {
        EmailVerificationScreen(auth, onVerified = { verificationRevision++ })
    } else if (readyAccountUid != user.uid || validatedAccountUid != user.uid ||
        validatedUser !== user
    ) {
        val french = LocalConfiguration.current.locales[0].language == "fr"
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
        ) {
            if (validationError == null) {
                CircularProgressIndicator()
            } else {
                Text(
                    if (validationError == "offline") {
                        if (french) "Connexion requise : la validation hors ligne a expiré."
                        else "Connect to the internet: offline validation has expired."
                    } else {
                        if (french) "Impossible de confirmer la session. Reconnectez-vous."
                        else "Session could not be verified. Sign in again."
                    }
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                TextButton(onClick = { retryValidation++ }) {
                    Text(if (french) "Réessayer" else "Retry")
                }
                TextButton(onClick = { signOut() }) {
                    Text(if (french) "Se déconnecter" else "Sign out")
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        var accountOpen by remember(user.uid) { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var deleteConfirm by remember(user.uid) { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var deleting by remember(user.uid) { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var deleteError by remember(user.uid) { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var linking by remember(user.uid) { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var linkPassword by remember(user.uid) { mutableStateOf("") }
        var linkMessage by remember(user.uid) { mutableStateOf("") }
        var accountRevision by remember(user.uid) { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
        val context = LocalContext.current
        val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
        val french = LocalConfiguration.current.locales[0].language == "fr"
        // Account action belongs to the app's TopAppBar; an overlay here would
        // overlap system bars and the title on narrow Android 15/16 devices.
        content { accountOpen = true }
        if (accountOpen) {
            val googleLinked = remember(user, accountRevision) {
                user.providerData.any { it.providerId == "google.com" }
            }
            val passwordLinked = remember(user, accountRevision) {
                user.providerData.any { it.providerId == "password" }
            }
            val provider = when {
                googleLinked && passwordLinked -> if (french) "Google et e-mail" else "Google and email"
                googleLinked -> "Google"
                passwordLinked -> if (french) "E-mail / mot de passe" else "Email / password"
                else -> if (french) "Autre fournisseur" else "Other provider"
            }
            AlertDialog(
                onDismissRequest = { accountOpen = false },
                title = { Text(if (french) "Mon compte" else "My account") },
                text = {
                    Column {
                        Text(user.email.orEmpty())
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            if (french) "Connexion : $provider" else "Signed in with: $provider",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                        if (passwordLinked && !googleLinked && user.isEmailVerified) {
                            TextButton(enabled = !linking, onClick = {
                                linking = true
                                linkMessage = ""
                                scope.launch {
                                    try {
                                        val option = GetGoogleIdOption.Builder()
                                            .setServerClientId(context.getString(R.string.default_web_client_id))
                                            .setFilterByAuthorizedAccounts(false)
                                            .build()
                                        val request = GetCredentialRequest.Builder()
                                            .addCredentialOption(option).build()
                                        val credential = CredentialManager.create(context)
                                            .getCredential(context, request).credential
                                        if (credential !is CustomCredential ||
                                            credential.type != GoogleIdTokenCredential.TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_CREDENTIAL
                                        ) {
                                            linking = false
                                            linkMessage = if (french) "Compte Google non reconnu." else "Google account not recognized."
                                        } else {
                                            val google = GoogleIdTokenCredential.createFrom(credential.data)
                                            if (!google.id.equals(user.email, ignoreCase = true)) {
                                                linking = false
                                                linkMessage = if (french) "L'adresse Google doit correspondre au compte existant."
                                                else "Google email must match the existing account."
                                            } else {
                                                user.linkWithCredential(
                                                    GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential(google.idToken, null)
                                                ).addOnCompleteListener { result ->
                                                    linking = false
                                                    if (result.isSuccessful) accountRevision++
                                                    linkMessage = if (result.isSuccessful) {
                                                        if (french) "Compte Google lié." else "Google account linked."
                                                    } else {
                                                        if (french) "Liaison refusée. Ce compte Google peut déjà être utilisé."
                                                        else "Could not link Google. This Google account may already be in use."
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } catch (_: NoCredentialException) {
                                        linking = false
                                        linkMessage = if (french) "Aucun compte Google disponible pour la liaison."
                                        else "No Google account available to link."
                                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                                        linking = false
                                        linkMessage = if (french) "Liaison Google annulée ou indisponible."
                                        else "Google account linking cancelled or unavailable."
                                    }
                                }
                            }) { Text(if (french) "Lier mon compte Google" else "Link my Google account") }
                        }
                        if (googleLinked && !passwordLinked && !user.email.isNullOrBlank()) {
                            OutlinedTextField(
                                value = linkPassword,
                                onValueChange = { linkPassword = it },
                                singleLine = true,
                                label = { Text(if (french) "Créer un mot de passe" else "Create a password") },
                                visualTransformation = PasswordVisualTransformation()
                            )
                            TextButton(enabled = !linking && linkPassword.length >= 6, onClick = {
                                linking = true
                                linkMessage = ""
                                val credential = EmailAuthProvider.getCredential(user.email!!, linkPassword)
                                user.linkWithCredential(credential).addOnCompleteListener { result ->
                                    linking = false
                                    linkPassword = ""
                                    if (result.isSuccessful) accountRevision++
                                    linkMessage = if (result.isSuccessful) {
                                        if (french) "Connexion e-mail ajoutée." else "Email sign-in added."
                                    } else {
                                        if (french) "Impossible d'ajouter ce mot de passe."
                                        else "Unable to add email password sign-in."
                                    }
                                }
                            }) { Text(if (french) "Ajouter la connexion e-mail" else "Add email sign-in") }
                        }
                        if (linkMessage.isNotEmpty()) Text(linkMessage)
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                        TextButton(enabled = !deleting && !linking, onClick = {
                            accountOpen = false
                            deleteConfirm = true
                        }) {
                            Text(if (french) "Supprimer mon compte" else "Delete my account")
                        }
                        if (deleteError) Text(
                            if (french) "Suppression impossible. Reconnectez-vous récemment, puis réessayez."
                            else "Account deletion failed. Sign in again recently, then retry.",
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
                        )
                    }
                },
                confirmButton = {
                    TextButton(onClick = {
                        accountOpen = false
                        signOut()
                    }) { Text(if (french) "Se déconnecter" else "Sign out") }
                },
                dismissButton = {
                    TextButton(onClick = { accountOpen = false }) {
                        Text(if (french) "Fermer" else "Close")
                    }
                }
            )
        }
        if (deleteConfirm) {
            AlertDialog(
                onDismissRequest = { if (!deleting) { deleteConfirm = false; accountOpen = true } },
                title = { Text(if (french) "Supprimer définitivement le compte ?" else "Permanently delete account?") },
                text = {
                    Text(
                        if (french)
                            "Le compte Firebase et les véhicules et diagnostics locaux associés seront supprimés. Exportez vos données avant de continuer."
                        else
                            "Your Firebase account and its local saved vehicles and diagnostic history will be deleted. Export important data before continuing."
                    )
                },
                confirmButton = {
                    TextButton(enabled = !deleting, onClick = {
                        deleting = true
                        val accountToDelete = user.uid
                        user.delete().addOnCompleteListener { result ->
                            deleting = false
                            if (result.isSuccessful) {
                                // The deleted account must not retain an offline
                                // authentication grace if it is later recreated.
                                validationPrefs.edit { remove("verified_$accountToDelete") }
                                onAccountDeleted(accountToDelete)
                                deleteConfirm = false
                                accountOpen = false
                                signOut()
                            } else {
                                deleteConfirm = false
                                accountOpen = true
                                deleteError = true
                            }
                        }
                    }) { Text(if (french) "Supprimer" else "Delete") }
                },
                dismissButton = {
                    TextButton(enabled = !deleting, onClick = {
                        deleteConfirm = false
                        accountOpen = true
                    }) {
                        Text(if (french) "Annuler" else "Cancel")
                    }
                }
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CamaroLoginScreen(auth: FirebaseAuth) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val french = LocalConfiguration.current.locales[0].language == "fr"
    var email by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var password by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var busy by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var message by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var register by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    fun finishError() {
        busy = false
        message = if (french) "Échec de l'authentification. Vérifiez vos informations et votre connexion."
        else "Authentication failed. Check your details and your connection."
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(24.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
    ) {
        Text("CamaroDiag", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineLarge)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Text(if (french) "Connectez-vous pour accéder au diagnostic" else "Sign in to access diagnostics")
        Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
        OutlinedTextField(value = email, onValueChange = { email = it }, singleLine = true,
            label = { Text(if (french) "Adresse e-mail" else "Email address") },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        OutlinedTextField(value = password, onValueChange = { password = it }, singleLine = true,
            visualTransformation = PasswordVisualTransformation(),
            label = { Text(if (french) "Mot de passe" else "Password") },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Button(
            enabled = !busy && email.isNotBlank() && password.isNotBlank(),
            onClick = {
                busy = true
                message = ""
                val normalizedEmail = email.trim()
                if (register) {
                    auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(normalizedEmail, password)
                        .addOnCompleteListener { task ->
                            busy = false
                            if (task.isSuccessful) {
                                val registeredUser = auth.currentUser
                                if (registeredUser == null) {
                                    finishError()
                                } else {
                                    // Do not claim the verification email was sent before
                                    // Firebase confirms the request actually succeeded.
                                    registeredUser.sendEmailVerification().addOnCompleteListener { sent ->
                                        if (auth.currentUser?.uid != registeredUser.uid) return@addOnCompleteListener
                                        message = if (sent.isSuccessful) {
                                            if (french) "Compte créé. Vérifiez votre boîte e-mail."
                                            else "Account created. Check your email for verification."
                                        } else {
                                            if (french) "Compte créé, mais l'envoi de l'e-mail a échoué. Réessayez depuis l'écran de vérification."
                                            else "Account created, but the verification email could not be sent. Retry from the verification screen."
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            } else finishError()
                        }
                } else {
                    auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(normalizedEmail, password)
                        .addOnCompleteListener { task ->
                            busy = false
                            if (!task.isSuccessful) finishError()
                        }
                }
            },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        ) { Text(if (register) { if (french) "Créer mon compte" else "Create account" }
                 else { if (french) "Se connecter" else "Sign in" }) }
        TextButton(enabled = !busy, onClick = { register = !register; message = "" }) {
            Text(if (register) { if (french) "J'ai déjà un compte" else "I already have an account" }
                 else { if (french) "Créer un compte e-mail" else "Create an email account" })
        }
        TextButton(enabled = !busy && email.isNotBlank(), onClick = {
            busy = true
            auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(email.trim()).addOnCompleteListener { task ->
                busy = false
                message = if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    if (french) "Si ce compte existe, un e-mail de réinitialisation a été envoyé."
                    else "If this account exists, a reset email was sent."
                } else {
                    if (french) "Impossible d'envoyer l'e-mail pour le moment."
                    else "Unable to send the email right now."
                }
            }
        }) { Text(if (french) "Mot de passe oublié ?" else "Forgot password?") }
        HorizontalDivider(Modifier.padding(vertical = 12.dp))
        OutlinedButton(
            enabled = !busy,
            onClick = {
                busy = true
                message = ""
                scope.launch {
                    try {
                        val googleIdOption = GetGoogleIdOption.Builder()
                            .setServerClientId(context.getString(R.string.default_web_client_id))
                            .setFilterByAuthorizedAccounts(false)
                            .build()
                        val request = GetCredentialRequest.Builder()
                            .addCredentialOption(googleIdOption)
                            .build()
                        val credential = CredentialManager.create(context)
                            .getCredential(context, request).credential
                        if (credential is CustomCredential &&
                            credential.type == GoogleIdTokenCredential.TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_CREDENTIAL) {
                            val idToken = GoogleIdTokenCredential.createFrom(credential.data).idToken
                            auth.signInWithCredential(GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential(idToken, null))
                                .addOnCompleteListener { task ->
                                    busy = false
                                    if (!task.isSuccessful) finishError()
                                }
                        } else {
                            busy = false
                            message = if (french) "Compte Google non reconnu." else "Google account not recognized."
                        }
                    } catch (_: NoCredentialException) {
                        busy = false
                        message = if (french) "Aucun compte Google disponible."
                        else "No Google account is available."
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                        busy = false
                        message = if (french) "Connexion Google annulée ou indisponible."
                                  else "Google sign-in cancelled or unavailable."
                    }
                }
            },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        ) { Text(if (french) "Continuer avec Google" else "Continue with Google") }
        if (message.isNotBlank()) {
            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
            Text(message, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun EmailVerificationScreen(auth: FirebaseAuth, onVerified: () -> Unit) {
    val signOut = rememberFirebaseSignOut(auth)
    val french = LocalConfiguration.current.locales[0].language == "fr"
    var message by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var busy by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
    ) {
        Text(if (french) "Vérifiez votre adresse e-mail" else "Verify your email address",
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
        Text(auth.currentUser?.email.orEmpty())
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Button(enabled = !busy, onClick = {
            val pendingUser = auth.currentUser ?: return@Button
            busy = true
            pendingUser.reload().addOnCompleteListener { task ->
                busy = false
                val verified = task.isSuccessful &&
                    auth.currentUser?.uid == pendingUser.uid &&
                    auth.currentUser?.isEmailVerified == true
                message = if (verified) {
                    if (french) "Adresse vérifiée." else "Email verified."
                } else {
                    if (french) "Vérification non confirmée." else "Verification not confirmed."
                }
                if (verified) onVerified()
            }
        }) { Text(if (french) "J'ai vérifié mon adresse" else "I've verified my email") }
        TextButton(enabled = !busy, onClick = {
            auth.currentUser?.sendEmailVerification()?.addOnCompleteListener { task ->
                message = if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    if (french) "E-mail de vérification envoyé." else "Verification email sent."
                } else {
                    if (french) "Envoi impossible." else "Unable to send email."
                }
            }
        }) { Text(if (french) "Renvoyer l'e-mail" else "Resend email") }
        TextButton(onClick = { signOut() }) {
            Text(if (french) "Se déconnecter" else "Sign out")
        }
        if (message.isNotBlank()) Text(message)
    }
}

/** Clears the Google Credential Manager selection after ending a Firebase session. */
@Composable
private fun rememberFirebaseSignOut(auth: FirebaseAuth): () -> Unit {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    return remember(auth, context, scope) {
        {
            auth.signOut()
            scope.launch {
                runCatching {
                    CredentialManager.create(context)
                        .clearCredentialState(ClearCredentialStateRequest())
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.auth

/**
 * The grace period applies only to a Firebase session previously validated
 * online on this device. Revocation cannot be checked without connectivity.
 */
internal object OfflineSessionPolicy {
    const val MAX_OFFLINE_MILLIS: Long = 7L * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L

    fun allowsOfflineAccess(lastValidatedMillis: Long, nowMillis: Long): Boolean =
        lastValidatedMillis > 0L &&
            nowMillis >= lastValidatedMillis &&
            nowMillis - lastValidatedMillis <= MAX_OFFLINE_MILLIS
}

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
    private val viewModel: MainViewModel by viewModels()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        // Recover missed MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED broadcasts after process death:
        // delete downloaded update APKs only if the installed versionCode advanced.
        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.cleanupAfterSuccessfulInstall(applicationContext)
        }
        // Keep Compose content within the system bars on Android 10–16.
        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window, true)
        setContent {
            val language by viewModel.language.collectAsState()
            val followSystem by viewModel.followSystemLanguage.collectAsState()
            val systemLocale = LocalConfiguration.current.locales[0]
            LaunchedEffect(followSystem, systemLocale) { viewModel.refreshSystemLanguage(systemLocale) }
            AppLanguageContent(language) {
                CamaroDiagTheme {
                    CamaroAuthGate(
                        onAccountChanged = viewModel::onAccountSessionChanged,
                        onAccountDeleted = viewModel::onAccountDeleted
                    ) { openAccount -> CamaroDiagApp(viewModel, systemLocale, openAccount) }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.ui

import android.content.Context
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper
import android.view.View
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalConfiguration
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalLayoutDirection
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.LayoutDirection
import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.AppLanguage
import java.util.Locale

internal fun Context.forAppLanguage(language: AppLanguage, base: Configuration = resources.configuration): Context {
    val current = base.locales[0]
    val locale = when (language) {
        AppLanguage.ZH -> Locale.SIMPLIFIED_CHINESE
        AppLanguage.KO -> Locale.KOREA
        else -> if (current.language == language.code) current else Locale.forLanguageTag(language.code)
    }
    if (current == locale && base == resources.configuration) return this
    return ContextThemeWrapper(this, theme).apply {
        applyOverrideConfiguration(Configuration(base).apply { setLocale(locale) })
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun AppLanguageContent(language: AppLanguage, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val base = LocalContext.current
    val configuration = LocalConfiguration.current
    val context = remember(base, configuration, language) { base.forAppLanguage(language, configuration) }
    val localized = context.resources.configuration
    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalContext provides context,
        LocalConfiguration provides localized,
        LocalLayoutDirection provides if (localized.layoutDirection == View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL)
            LayoutDirection.Rtl else LayoutDirection.Ltr,
        content = content
    )
}

@Composable
private fun localizedAxisSummary(
    axisLabelResource: Int,
    axis: CalibrationAxisDefinition?
): String {
    val axisLabel = stringResource(axisLabelResource)
    val details = if (axis == null) {
        stringResource(R.string.cal_axis_undefined)
    } else {
        stringResource(R.string.cal_axis_values)
            .replace("%1\u0024s", axis.fileOffset.toString(16).uppercase())
            .replace("%2\u0024d", axis.count.toString())
            .replace("%3\u0024s", axis.unit.orEmpty())
    }
    return stringResource(R.string.cal_axis_summary)
        .replace("%1\u0024s", axisLabel)
        .replace("%2\u0024s", details)
}
