private data class CamaroDiagUpdate(val version: String, val channel: String, val url: String, val versionCode: Long)
private data class CamaroDiagUpdateCheck(val update: CamaroDiagUpdate?, val hasNewerVersion: Boolean)

private object CamaroDiagUpdateChecker {
    private const val API = "https://api.github.com/repos/Hellorheaven/CamaroDiag/releases/latest"

    suspend fun check(context: Context): CamaroDiagUpdateCheck = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val info = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(
                context.packageName,
                PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(0)
            )
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(context.packageName, 0)
        }
        val installedCode = info.longVersionCode
        val channel = if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) "debug" else "release"
        val wanted = if (channel == "debug") "CamaroDiag-debug.apk" else "CamaroDiag-release.apk"
        val connection = URL(API).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        connection.connectTimeout = 15_000
        connection.readTimeout = 15_000
        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
        connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "CamaroDiag-Updater")
        try {
            val json = JSONObject(connection.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText() })
            if (json.optBoolean("draft") || json.optBoolean("prerelease")) return@withContext CamaroDiagUpdateCheck(null, false)
            val versionCode = Regex(
                "Android versionCode\\s*:\\s*(\\d+)",
                RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE
            ).find(json.optString("body"))?.groupValues?.getOrNull(1)?.toLongOrNull()
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Latest release does not publish an Android versionCode.")
            if (versionCode <= installedCode) return@withContext CamaroDiagUpdateCheck(null, false)

            val assets = json.optJSONArray("assets") ?: return@withContext CamaroDiagUpdateCheck(null, true)
            var downloadUrl: String? = null
            for (index in 0 until assets.length()) {
                val asset = assets.optJSONObject(index) ?: continue
                if (asset.optString("name") == wanted) {
                    downloadUrl = asset.optString("browser_download_url")
                    break
                }
            }
            val safeUrl = downloadUrl?.takeIf { it.startsWith("https://github.com/") }
                ?: return@withContext CamaroDiagUpdateCheck(null, true)
            CamaroDiagUpdateCheck(
                CamaroDiagUpdate(
                    json.optString("tag_name").removePrefix("v"), channel, safeUrl, versionCode
                ),
                true
            )
        } finally {
            connection.disconnect()
        }
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    fun enqueue(context: Context, update: CamaroDiagUpdate): Long {
        // Public, visible top-level Downloads directory, NOT Android/data/<package>/files.
        // Distinct filename allows retry after cancelled installation without
        // colliding with an older APK the user deliberately kept in Downloads.
        val safeVersion = update.version.replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]"), "_").take(64)
        require(safeVersion.isNotBlank()) { "Missing update version." }
        val fileName = "CamaroDiag-${update.channel}-${safeVersion}-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.apk"
        val request = DownloadManager.Request(update.url.toUri())
            .setTitle(context.getString(R.string.update_notification_title, update.version))
            .setMimeType("application/vnd.android.package-archive")
            .setNotificationVisibility(DownloadManager.Request.VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED)
            .setDestinationInExternalPublicDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS, fileName)
        val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE) as DownloadManager
        val id = manager.enqueue(request)
        // Persist BEFORE starting the installer; only the installer success (new
        // installed versionCode) permits automatic deletion of this download.
        if (!CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.recordDownload(
                context, PendingCamaroDiagApk(id, update.versionCode)
            )
        ) {
            manager.remove(id)
            error("Unable to persist APK cleanup record.")
        }
        return id
    }

    fun signatureMatches(context: Context, file: File, expectedVersionCode: Long): Boolean {
        val flags = PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES
        val downloaded = context.packageManager.getPackageArchiveInfo(file.absolutePath, flags)
            ?: return false
        if (downloaded.packageName != context.packageName ||
            downloaded.longVersionCode != expectedVersionCode
        ) return false
        val installed = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(
                context.packageName,
                PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(flags.toLong())
            )
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(context.packageName, flags)
        }
        val downloadedSigners = downloaded.signingInfo?.apkContentsSigners
            ?.map { it.toCharsString() }?.toSet()
        val installedSigners = installed.signingInfo?.apkContentsSigners
            ?.map { it.toCharsString() }?.toSet()
        return !downloadedSigners.isNullOrEmpty() && downloadedSigners == installedSigners
    }

    /** Return the DownloadManager state without requiring direct public-file access. */
    suspend fun downloadStatus(context: Context, downloadId: Long): Int? =
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE) as DownloadManager
            manager.query(DownloadManager.Query().setFilterById(downloadId)).use { cursor ->
                val index = cursor.getColumnIndex(DownloadManager.COLUMN_STATUS)
                if (!cursor.moveToFirst() || index < 0) null else cursor.getInt(index)
            }
        }

    /**
     * Stage an owned, completed public-Downloads APK in private cache before the
     * installer starts. Never trust a path from an external broadcast.
     */
    suspend fun stageVerifiedDownload(context: Context, downloadId: Long): File? =
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val version = CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.targetVersion(context, downloadId)
                ?: return@withContext null
            if (downloadStatus(context, downloadId) != DownloadManager.STATUS_SUCCESSFUL) {
                return@withContext null
            }
            val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE) as DownloadManager
            val file = CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.verifiedInstallFile(context, downloadId)
            try {
                check(file.parentFile?.mkdirs() == true || file.parentFile?.isDirectory == true) {
                    "Unable to create verified update cache."
                }
                manager.openDownloadedFile(downloadId).use { descriptor ->
                    FileInputStream(descriptor.fileDescriptor).use { input ->
                        file.outputStream().use { output -> input.copyTo(output) }
                    }
                }
                check(signatureMatches(context, file, version)) {
                    "Downloaded APK certificate, package or version does not match."
                }
                file
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                file.delete()
                null
            }
        }
}

@Composable
fun AboutUpdateCard() {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var update by remember { mutableStateOf<CamaroDiagUpdate?>(null) }
    var checking by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var downloading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var downloadId by remember { mutableLongStateOf(-1L) }
    var downloadedApk by remember { mutableStateOf<File?>(null) }
    var status by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var installRequested by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val latestDownloadId = rememberUpdatedState(downloadId)
    val setDownloadedApk = rememberUpdatedState<(File?) -> Unit>({ downloadedApk = it })
    val setDownloading = rememberUpdatedState<(Boolean) -> Unit>({ downloading = it })
    val setStatus = rememberUpdatedState<(String?) -> Unit>({ status = it })
    val latestInstallRequested = rememberUpdatedState(installRequested)
    val latestDownloadedApk = rememberUpdatedState(downloadedApk)

    // The DownloadManager broadcast is not guaranteed while this Compose
    // screen is absent or the process is killed. Recover *owned* downloads
    // from durable IDs without starting a second download or silently
    // relaunching the installer.
    LaunchedEffect(context) {
        val pending = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.cleanupAfterSuccessfulInstall(context)
            CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.pendingDownloads(context).firstOrNull()
        }
        if (pending != null) {
            val downloadState = CamaroDiagUpdateChecker.downloadStatus(context, pending.downloadId)
            when (downloadState) {
                DownloadManager.STATUS_SUCCESSFUL -> {
                    val staged = CamaroDiagUpdateChecker.stageVerifiedDownload(
                        context, pending.downloadId
                    )
                    if (staged != null) {
                        downloadId = pending.downloadId
                        downloadedApk = staged
                        downloading = false
                        status = context.getString(R.string.update_ready_to_install)
                    } else {
                        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.discardInvalidDownload(context, pending.downloadId)
                        }
                        status = context.getString(R.string.update_download_invalid_signature)
                    }
                }
                DownloadManager.STATUS_PENDING,
                DownloadManager.STATUS_RUNNING,
                DownloadManager.STATUS_PAUSED -> {
                    downloadId = pending.downloadId
                    downloading = true
                    status = context.getString(R.string.update_downloading)
                }
                DownloadManager.STATUS_FAILED -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.discardInvalidDownload(context, pending.downloadId)
                    }
                    status = context.getString(R.string.update_download_failed)
                }
                else -> Unit
            }
        }
    }

    fun launchInstaller(file: File) {
        if (!context.packageManager.canRequestPackageInstalls()) {
            installRequested = true
            context.startActivity(
                Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_UNKNOWN_APP_SOURCES, "package:${context.packageName}".toUri())
                    .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
            )
            status = context.getString(R.string.update_allow_unknown_sources)
            return
        }
        installRequested = false
        val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", file)
        // Android requires an explicit user confirmation for installing an APK.
        // The app opens the system installer automatically after signature validation.
        context.startActivity(
            Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW)
                .setDataAndType(uri, "application/vnd.android.package-archive")
                .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
        )
    }

    DisposableEffect(lifecycleOwner) {
        val observer = LifecycleEventObserver { _, event ->
            if (event == Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME &&
                latestInstallRequested.value &&
                latestDownloadedApk.value?.isFile == true &&
                context.packageManager.canRequestPackageInstalls()
            ) {
                latestDownloadedApk.value?.let { launchInstaller(it) }
            }
        }
        lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.addObserver(observer)
        onDispose { lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.removeObserver(observer) }
    }

    DisposableEffect(context) {
        val receiver = object : BroadcastReceiver() {
            override fun onReceive(receiverContext: Context, intent: Intent) {
                if (intent.action != DownloadManager.ACTION_DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE) return
                val completedId = intent.getLongExtra(DownloadManager.EXTRA_DOWNLOAD_ID, -1L)
                if (completedId != latestDownloadId.value || completedId < 0L) return

                // DownloadManager owns the public file on Android 10-16. Read
                // using its file descriptor, not raw /storage/... access, which
                // scoped storage can reject. A private verification copy is used
                // for signature inspection and FileProvider installation.
                scope.launch {
                    val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE) as DownloadManager
                    val targetVersion = CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.targetVersion(context, completedId)
                    val successful = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        manager.query(DownloadManager.Query().setFilterById(completedId)).use { cursor ->
                            if (!cursor.moveToFirst()) false
                            else {
                                val statusColumn = cursor.getColumnIndex(DownloadManager.COLUMN_STATUS)
                                statusColumn >= 0 &&
                                    cursor.getInt(statusColumn) == DownloadManager.STATUS_SUCCESSFUL
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (!successful || targetVersion == null) {
                        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.discardInvalidDownload(context, completedId)
                        }
                        setDownloading.value(false)
                        setStatus.value(context.getString(R.string.update_download_failed))
                        return@launch
                    }

                    val verifiedFile = CamaroDiagUpdateChecker.stageVerifiedDownload(
                        context, completedId
                    )
                    if (verifiedFile == null) {
                        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            CamaroDiagUpdateCleanup.discardInvalidDownload(context, completedId)
                        }
                        setDownloadedApk.value(null)
                        setDownloading.value(false)
                        setStatus.value(context.getString(R.string.update_download_invalid_signature))
                        return@launch
                    }
                    setDownloadedApk.value(verifiedFile)
                    setDownloading.value(false)
                    setStatus.value(context.getString(R.string.update_download_complete))
                    try {
                        launchInstaller(verifiedFile)
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                        // Installation not launched: preserve public APK so the
                        // user may retry. NEVER delete merely on installer open.
                        setStatus.value(context.getString(R.string.update_download_failed))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
            context,
            receiver,
            IntentFilter(DownloadManager.ACTION_DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE),
            // DownloadManager may broadcast from a privileged process outside
            // system UID. Ignore spoofed events: only our persisted download
            // ID and an APK with matching signature/version can be installed.
            ContextCompat.RECEIVER_EXPORTED
        )
        onDispose { runCatching { context.unregisterReceiver(receiver) } }
    }


    Card(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
        ) {
            Text(stringResource(R.string.about_title))
            Text(stringResource(R.string.about_version, BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME))
            Text(stringResource(R.string.about_build, BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE))
            status?.let { Text(it) }
            update?.let {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.update_version_available, it.version))
            }
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                OutlinedButton(
                    enabled = !checking && !downloading,
                    onClick = {
                        scope.launch {
                            checking = true
                            update = null
                            // Preserve an already verified APK so checking the
                            // latest release does not force another download.
                            status = null
                            try {
                                val result = CamaroDiagUpdateChecker.check(context)
                                update = result.update
                                status = context.getString(
                                    when {
                                        result.update != null -> R.string.about_update_found
                                        result.hasNewerVersion -> R.string.about_channel_update_unavailable
                                        else -> R.string.about_up_to_date
                                    }
                                )
                            } catch (_: Exception) {
                                status = context.getString(R.string.about_check_failed)
                            } finally {
                                checking = false
                            }
                        }
                    }
                ) {
                    Text(
                        stringResource(
                            if (checking) R.string.about_checking
                            else R.string.about_check_updates
                        )
                    )
                }
                if (update != null && downloadedApk == null) {
                    Button(
                        enabled = !downloading,
                        onClick = {
                            val available = update
                            if (available != null) {
                                try {
                                    downloadId = CamaroDiagUpdateChecker.enqueue(context, available)
                                    downloading = true
                                    status = context.getString(R.string.update_downloading)
                                } catch (_: Exception) {
                                    downloading = false
                                    status = context.getString(R.string.update_download_failed)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            stringResource(
                                if (downloading) R.string.update_downloading
                                else R.string.update_install_update
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }
                val staged = downloadedApk
                if (staged != null && staged.isFile) {
                    Button(
                        enabled = !checking && !downloading,
                        onClick = {
                            try {
                                launchInstaller(staged)
                            } catch (_: Exception) {
                                status = context.getString(R.string.update_download_failed)
                            }
                        }
                    ) {
                        Text(stringResource(R.string.update_install_update))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

class AccountStorageKeysTest {
    @Test fun sameUidAlwaysUsesSameGarage() {
        assertEquals(
            AccountStorageKeys.garageName("firebase-user-a"),
            AccountStorageKeys.garageName("firebase-user-a")
        )
    }

    @Test fun differentAccountsCannotShareTheirGarageFilename() {
        assertNotEquals(
            AccountStorageKeys.garageName("firebase-user-a"),
            AccountStorageKeys.garageName("firebase-user-b")
        )
    }

    @Test fun namesDoNotExposeRawFirebaseUidOrFilesystemSeparators() {
        val name = AccountStorageKeys.garageName("user@example.com/path")
        assertTrue(name.startsWith("camarodiag_garage_"))
        assertFalse(name.contains("user@example.com"))
        assertFalse(name.contains("/"))
    }

    @Test fun signedOutStoreIsSeparateFromAnyAccount() {
        assertEquals("camarodiag_garage_no_account", AccountStorageKeys.garageName(null))
        assertNotEquals(AccountStorageKeys.garageName(null), AccountStorageKeys.garageName("no_account"))
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.auth

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class OfflineSessionPolicyTest {
    @Test fun neverAcceptsAFirstTimeUnvalidatedSession() {
        assertFalse(OfflineSessionPolicy.allowsOfflineAccess(0L, 1_000L))
        assertFalse(OfflineSessionPolicy.allowsOfflineAccess(-1L, 1_000L))
    }

    @Test fun acceptsRecentlyValidatedSessionDuringNetworkLoss() {
        val now = 1_800_000_000_000L
        assertTrue(OfflineSessionPolicy.allowsOfflineAccess(now - 60_000L, now))
        assertTrue(OfflineSessionPolicy.allowsOfflineAccess(
            now - OfflineSessionPolicy.MAX_OFFLINE_MILLIS, now
        ))
    }

    @Test fun rejectsExpiredOrFutureValidation() {
        val now = 1_800_000_000_000L
        assertFalse(OfflineSessionPolicy.allowsOfflineAccess(
            now - OfflineSessionPolicy.MAX_OFFLINE_MILLIS - 1L, now
        ))
        assertFalse(OfflineSessionPolicy.allowsOfflineAccess(now + 1L, now))
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CalibrationBinaryComparerTest {

    @Test
    fun identifiesDifferentByteRangesWithoutChangingInputArrays() {
        val reference = byteArrayOf(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
        val modified = byteArrayOf(0, 1, 9, 3, 8, 5)

        val result = CalibrationBinaryComparer.compare(reference, modified)

        assertEquals(6L, result.comparedBytes)
        assertEquals(2L, result.changedBytes)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(CalibrationDiffRange(2, 2), CalibrationDiffRange(4, 4)),
            result.changedRanges
        )
        assertFalse(result.identical)
        assertEquals(2, reference[2].toInt())
        assertEquals(9, modified[2].toInt())
    }

    @Test
    fun reportsAppendedAndMissingBytesWhenSizesDiffer() {
        val longer = CalibrationBinaryComparer.compare(
            byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3),
            byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
        )
        assertEquals(0L, longer.changedBytes)
        assertEquals(2L, longer.appendedBytes)
        assertEquals(0L, longer.missingBytes)
        assertFalse(longer.identical)

        val shorter = CalibrationBinaryComparer.compare(
            byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
            byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3)
        )
        assertEquals(2L, shorter.missingBytes)
        assertEquals(0L, shorter.appendedBytes)
    }

    @Test
    fun recognizesIdenticalImages() {
        val result = CalibrationBinaryComparer.compare(
            byteArrayOf(0x10, 0x20, 0x30),
            byteArrayOf(0x10, 0x20, 0x30)
        )
        assertTrue(result.identical)
        assertEquals(0L, result.changedBytes)
        assertTrue(result.changedRanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun limitsReportedRangesForVeryFragmentedFiles() {
        val reference = ByteArray(1500)
        val modified = ByteArray(1500) { index -> if (index % 2 == 0) 1 else 0 }

        val result = CalibrationBinaryComparer.compare(reference, modified)

        assertEquals(750L, result.changedBytes)
        assertEquals(500, result.changedRanges.size)
        assertEquals(250, result.omittedRangeCount)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream
import org.junit.Test

class CalibrationFileInspectorTest {

    @Test
    fun recognizesRawBinaryWithoutClaimingEcuCompatibility() {
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("stock.bin", byteArrayOf(0x01, 0x02, 0x03))
        assertEquals(CalibrationFileFormat.RAW_BINARY, result.format)
        assertTrue(result.valid)
        assertEquals(3L, result.payloadBytes)
        assertTrue(result.warnings.any { it.contains("compatibilité ECU") })
    }

    @Test
    fun validatesIntelHexChecksumsAndEof() {
        val input = ":0100000001FE\n:00000001FF\n".toByteArray()
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("stock.hex", input)
        assertEquals(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, result.format)
        assertTrue(result.valid)
        assertEquals(1L, result.payloadBytes)
        assertEquals(2, result.recordCount)
        assertEquals(0L, result.addressRanges.single().start)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsIntelHexWithBadChecksum() {
        val input = ":0100000001FF\n:00000001FF\n".toByteArray()
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("bad.hex", input)
        assertFalse(result.valid)
        assertTrue(result.summary.contains("Checksum"))
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsIntelHexWithoutEofRecord() {
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("missing.hex", ":0100000001FE\n".toByteArray())
        assertFalse(result.valid)
        assertTrue(result.summary.contains("EOF"))
    }

    @Test
    fun validatesMotorolaSRecordChecksumsAndTermination() {
        val input = "S1061000010203E3\nS9031000EC\n".toByteArray()
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("stock.s19", input)
        assertEquals(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, result.format)
        assertTrue(result.valid)
        assertEquals(3L, result.payloadBytes)
        assertEquals(2, result.recordCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsMotorolaSRecordWithBadChecksum() {
        val input = "S1061000010203E4\nS9031000EC\n".toByteArray()
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("bad.s19", input)
        assertFalse(result.valid)
        assertTrue(result.summary.contains("Checksum"))
    }

    @Test
    fun acceptsZipTuneArchiveWithoutClaimingToDecodeItsContents() {
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        ZipOutputStream(output).use { zip ->
            zip.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("read/stock.bin"))
            zip.write(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4))
            zip.closeEntry()
            zip.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("definitions/table.xdf"))
            zip.write("<XDF/>".toByteArray())
            zip.closeEntry()
        }

        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("external-calibration.zip", output.toByteArray())

        assertEquals(CalibrationFileFormat.ZIP_ARCHIVE, result.format)
        assertTrue(result.valid)
        assertEquals(2, result.recordCount)
        assertTrue(result.warnings.any { it.contains("stock.bin") })
        assertTrue(result.warnings.any { it.contains("aucune cartographie interne") })
    }

    @Test
    fun acceptsExternalMapDefinitionFilesAsAttachmentsWithoutApplyingGuessedTables() {
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("engine-map.xdf", "<XDF/>".toByteArray())

        assertEquals(CalibrationFileFormat.EXTERNAL_DEFINITION, result.format)
        assertFalse(result.valid)
        assertTrue(result.summary.contains("non encore converti"))
        assertTrue(result.warnings.any { it.contains("offset") })
    }


    @Test
    fun recognizesExternalTuneProjectPackagesWithoutDecodingThem() {
        listOf("project.olsx", "calibration.ptx").forEach { name ->
            val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect(name, byteArrayOf(0x01, 0x23, 0x45, 0x67))
            assertEquals(CalibrationFileFormat.EXTERNAL_TUNE_PROJECT, result.format)
            assertFalse(result.valid)
            assertTrue(result.summary.contains("non décodé"))
            assertTrue(result.warnings.any { it.contains("conservé octet par octet") })
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun keepsUnrecognizedCalibrationContainersOpaque() {
        val result = CalibrationFileInspector.inspect("vendor-map.opaque", byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4))
        assertEquals(CalibrationFileFormat.UNKNOWN, result.format)
        assertFalse(result.valid)
        assertTrue(result.summary.contains("non reconnu"))
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CalibrationTableCodecTest {

    @Test
    fun validatesDefinitionMetadataAgainstVehicleImageAndEcuIdentifiers() {
        val binary = byteArrayOf(0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40)
        val sha256 = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(binary)
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
        val metadata = CalibrationDefinitionMetadata(
            vin = "1G1FA1RXXR0123456",
            calibrationId = "CAL-123",
            cvn = "A1B2C3D4",
            operatingSystemId = "OS-123",
            hardwarePartNumber = "HW-123",
            sourceSha256 = sha256
        )

        assertTrue(
            CalibrationTableCodec.validateMetadataForImage(
                metadata,
                "1G1FA1RXXR0123456",
                "1G1FA1RXXR0123456",
                binary,
                listOf("CAL-123"),
                listOf("A1B2C3D4")
            ).isEmpty()
        )
        val issues = CalibrationTableCodec.validateMetadataForImage(
            metadata,
            "1G1FA1RXXR0123457",
            "1G1FA1RXXR0123457",
            binary + byteArrayOf(0x50),
            listOf("CAL-OTHER"),
            listOf("00000000")
        )
        assertEquals(5, issues.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsCvnThatBelongsToAnotherCalibrationIdRecord() {
        val binary = byteArrayOf(0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40)
        val sha256 = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(binary)
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
        val metadata = CalibrationDefinitionMetadata(
            vin = "1G1FA1RXXR0123456",
            calibrationId = "CAL-123",
            cvn = "A1B2C3D4",
            operatingSystemId = "OS-123",
            hardwarePartNumber = "HW-123",
            sourceSha256 = sha256
        )

        val issues = CalibrationTableCodec.validateMetadataForImage(
            metadata,
            "1G1FA1RXXR0123456",
            "1G1FA1RXXR0123456",
            binary,
            listOf("CAL-123", "CAL-456"),
            listOf("00000000", "A1B2C3D4")
        )

        assertTrue(issues.any { it.contains("associé au CAL ID") })
    }

    @Test
    fun parsesUserSuppliedTsvDefinition() {
        val definitions = CalibrationTableCodec.parseDefinitions(CalibrationTableCodec.template)
        val table = definitions.definitions.single()
        assertEquals("example_fuel", table.id)
        assertEquals(0x1000L, table.fileOffset)
        assertEquals(16, table.rows)
        assertEquals(16, table.columns)
        assertEquals(CalibrationValueType.U16, table.valueType)
        assertEquals(CalibrationEndian.LITTLE, table.endian)
        assertEquals(null, table.xAxis)
        assertEquals(null, table.yAxis)
    }

    @Test
    fun parsesCommaSeparatedDefinitionsWithQuotedNamesAndExplicitAxes() {
        val csv = listOf(
            "id,name,offset,rows,columns,type,endian,scale,bias,unit,minimum,maximum,x_offset,x_type,x_endian,x_scale,x_bias,x_unit,y_offset,y_type,y_endian,y_scale,y_bias,y_unit",
            "fuel_main,\"Fuel, main\",0x4,1,2,U16,LE,0.1,0,mg,0,100,0x0,U8,LE,1,0,rpm,0x2,U8,LE,1,0,kPa"
        ).joinToString("\n")

        val parsed = CalibrationTableCodec.parseDefinitions(csv)
        val definition = parsed.definitions.single()

        assertEquals("Fuel, main", definition.name)
        assertEquals(0L, definition.xAxis?.fileOffset)
        assertEquals(2, definition.xAxis?.count)
        assertEquals(2L, definition.yAxis?.fileOffset)
        assertEquals(1, definition.yAxis?.count)
    }

    @Test
    fun decodesSeparateXAxisAndYAxisValuesFromBinaryImage() {
        val csv = listOf(
            "id;name;offset;rows;columns;type;endian;scale;bias;unit;x_offset;x_type;x_endian;x_scale;x_bias;x_unit;y_offset;y_type;y_endian;y_scale;y_bias;y_unit",
            "fuel;Fuel table;4;1;2;U16;LE;0.1;0;mg;0;U8;LE;1;0;rpm;2;U8;LE;1;0;kPa"
        ).joinToString("\n")
        val definition = CalibrationTableCodec.parseDefinitions(csv).definitions.single()
        val binary = byteArrayOf(100, 200.toByte(), 30, 40, 100, 0, 200.toByte(), 0)

        val decoded = CalibrationTableCodec.decode(binary, definition)

        assertEquals(listOf(100.0, 200.0), decoded.xAxisValues)
        assertEquals(listOf(30.0), decoded.yAxisValues)
        assertEquals(10.0, decoded.values[0][0], 0.0001)
        assertEquals(20.0, decoded.values[0][1], 0.0001)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsAxisRangesThatExtendBeyondTheBinaryImage() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "axis-outside", name = "Axis outside", fileOffset = 0, rows = 1, columns = 1,
            valueType = CalibrationValueType.U8, endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE,
            scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = "",
            xAxis = CalibrationAxisDefinition(
                fileOffset = 4, count = 2, valueType = CalibrationValueType.U16,
                endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE, scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = ""
            )
        )

        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.decode(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), definition) }.isSuccess)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsOverflowingDefinitionOffsetsAndOversizedDirectDefinitions() {
        val overflow = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "overflow", name = "Overflow", fileOffset = Long.MAX_VALUE - 1,
            rows = 1, columns = 2, valueType = CalibrationValueType.U32,
            endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE, scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = ""
        )
        val oversized = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "oversized", name = "Oversized", fileOffset = 0,
            rows = 256, columns = 256, valueType = CalibrationValueType.U8,
            endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE, scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = ""
        )

        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.decode(ByteArray(32), overflow) }.isSuccess)
        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.decode(ByteArray(65_536), oversized) }.isSuccess)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsNonFiniteFloatValuesWhenDecoding() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "float", name = "Float", fileOffset = 0, rows = 1, columns = 1,
            valueType = CalibrationValueType.F32, endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE,
            scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = ""
        )
        val nanBytes = byteArrayOf(0x00, 0x00, 0xC0.toByte(), 0x7F)

        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.decode(nanBytes, definition) }.isSuccess)
    }

    @Test
    fun formattingAndReapplyingFloatCellsPreservesUneditedBinaryPrecision() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "float-precision", name = "Float precision", fileOffset = 0,
            rows = 1, columns = 2, valueType = CalibrationValueType.F32,
            endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE, scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = ""
        )
        val original = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(8)
            .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            .putFloat(0.1234567f)
            .putFloat(12345.678f)
            .array()
        val decoded = CalibrationTableCodec.decode(original, definition)
        val roundTrippedValues = decoded.values.map { row ->
            row.map { CalibrationTableCodec.formatEngineeringValue(it).toDouble() }
        }

        val reapplied = CalibrationTableCodec.applyEdits(original, definition, roundTrippedValues)

        assertTrue(original.contentEquals(reapplied))
    }

    @Test
    fun decodesAndEditsLittleEndianU16WithoutChangingOtherBytes() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "fuel", name = "Fuel", fileOffset = 2, rows = 1, columns = 2,
            valueType = CalibrationValueType.U16, endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE,
            scale = 0.5, bias = 0.0, unit = "mg"
        )
        val original = byteArrayOf(0x55, 0x66, 0x0A, 0x00, 0x14, 0x00, 0x77)
        val decoded = CalibrationTableCodec.decode(original, definition)
        assertEquals(5.0, decoded.values[0][0], 0.0001)
        assertEquals(10.0, decoded.values[0][1], 0.0001)

        val modified = CalibrationTableCodec.applyEdits(original, definition, listOf(listOf(6.0, 8.0)))
        assertEquals(0x55.toByte(), modified[0])
        assertEquals(0x66.toByte(), modified[1])
        assertEquals(12, modified[2].toInt() and 0xFF)
        assertEquals(0, modified[3].toInt() and 0xFF)
        assertEquals(16, modified[4].toInt() and 0xFF)
        assertEquals(0, modified[5].toInt() and 0xFF)
        assertEquals(0x77.toByte(), modified[6])
        assertEquals(10, original[2].toInt() and 0xFF)
    }

    @Test
    fun decodesBigEndianAndSignedValues() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "signed", name = "Signed", fileOffset = 0, rows = 1, columns = 1,
            valueType = CalibrationValueType.S16, endian = CalibrationEndian.BIG,
            scale = 0.1, bias = 0.0, unit = "deg"
        )
        val table = CalibrationTableCodec.decode(byteArrayOf(0xFF.toByte(), 0x9C.toByte()), definition)
        assertEquals(-10.0, table.values[0][0], 0.0001)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsInvalidOrDuplicateDefinitionIdsAndDimensions() {
        val duplicate = """
            id;name;offset;rows;columns;type;endian;scale;bias;unit
            a;Table A;0;1;1;U8;LE;1;0;x
            a;Table B;1;1;1;U8;LE;1;0;x
        """.trimIndent()
        val oversized = """
            id;name;offset;rows;columns;type;endian;scale;bias;unit
            a;Huge;0;128;128;U8;LE;1;0;x
        """.trimIndent()
        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.parseDefinitions(duplicate) }.isSuccess)
        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.parseDefinitions(oversized) }.isSuccess)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsTableDefinitionsThatExtendBeyondTheBinaryImage() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "outside", name = "Outside", fileOffset = 3, rows = 1, columns = 2,
            valueType = CalibrationValueType.U16, endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE,

        )
        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.decode(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4), definition) }.isSuccess)
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsValuesOutsideTheStorageTypeRange() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "byte", name = "Byte", fileOffset = 0, rows = 1, columns = 1,
            valueType = CalibrationValueType.U8, endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE,
            scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = ""
        )
        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.applyEdits(byteArrayOf(0), definition, listOf(listOf(256.0))) }.isSuccess)
        assertTrue(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.applyEdits(byteArrayOf(0), definition, listOf(listOf(255.0))) }.isSuccess)
    }

    @Test
    fun enforcesOptionalEngineeringLimits() {
        val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
            id = "limited", name = "Limited", fileOffset = 0, rows = 1, columns = 1,
            valueType = CalibrationValueType.U8, endian = CalibrationEndian.LITTLE,
            scale = 1.0, bias = 0.0, unit = "%", minimum = 0.0, maximum = 100.0
        )
        assertFalse(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.applyEdits(byteArrayOf(0), definition, listOf(listOf(101.0))) }.isSuccess)
        assertTrue(runCatching { CalibrationTableCodec.applyEdits(byteArrayOf(0), definition, listOf(listOf(100.0))) }.isSuccess)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

class CamaroCalibrationCatalogTest {

    @Test
    fun catalogueContainsEveryGen5AndGen6EngineProfile() {
        assertEquals(CamaroEngine.entries.toSet(), CamaroCalibrationCatalog.profiles.map { it.engine }.toSet())
        assertEquals(10, CamaroCalibrationCatalog.profiles.size)
        CamaroCalibrationCatalog.profiles.forEach { profile ->
            assertEquals(profile.engine.years, profile.modelYears)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun catalogueCoversEveryExpectedGen5Powertrain() {
        val gen5 = CamaroCalibrationCatalog.profiles
            .filter { it.generation == CamaroGeneration.GEN5 }
            .map { it.engine }
            .toSet()

        assertEquals(
            setOf(CamaroEngine.LLT, CamaroEngine.LFX, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LSA, CamaroEngine.LS7),
            gen5
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun catalogueCoversEveryExpectedGen6PowertrainIncludingLtg() {
        val gen6 = CamaroCalibrationCatalog.profiles
            .filter { it.generation == CamaroGeneration.GEN6 }
            .map { it.engine }
            .toSet()

        assertEquals(
            setOf(CamaroEngine.LTG, CamaroEngine.LGX, CamaroEngine.LT1, CamaroEngine.LT4),
            gen6
        )
        assertTrue(2016 in CamaroEngine.LTG.years)
        assertTrue(2020 in CamaroEngine.LTG.years)
        assertTrue(2021 in CamaroEngine.LTG.years)
        assertTrue(2023 in CamaroEngine.LTG.years)
        assertFalse(2024 in CamaroEngine.LTG.years)
    }

    @Test
    fun profileLookupRequiresBothEngineAndApplicableModelYear() {
        val valid = CamaroCalibrationCatalog.forVehicle(
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2018, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG)
        )
        val valid2022 = CamaroCalibrationCatalog.forVehicle(
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2022, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG)
        )
        val valid2023 = CamaroCalibrationCatalog.forVehicle(
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2023, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG)
        )
        val invalid = CamaroCalibrationCatalog.forVehicle(
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2024, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG)
        )

        assertNotNull(valid)
        assertNotNull(valid2022)
        assertNotNull(valid2023)
        assertEquals("GM E80 (RPO LTG)", valid?.nominalControllerFamily)
        assertEquals("GM E80 (RPO LTG)", valid2022?.nominalControllerFamily)
        assertEquals("GM E80 (RPO LTG)", valid2023?.nominalControllerFamily)
        assertNull(invalid)
    }

    @Test
    fun binaryReadEditAndFlashRemainDisabledUntilControllerProceduresAreVerified() {
        CamaroCalibrationCatalog.profiles.forEach { profile ->
            assertTrue(profile.supportsStandardCalIdRead)
            assertTrue(profile.supportsStandardCvnRead)
            assertFalse(profile.supportsBinaryRead)
            assertFalse(profile.supportsTableEditing)
            assertFalse(profile.supportsEcuWrite)
        }
    }
}

            AdapterCapabilities(tier = AdapterTier.PRO_STN, supportsCanHeaders = true)
        )

        val confirmed = CamaroUdsProtocol.applyStandardObdDiscovery(topology, listOf("7E8", "7E9"))
        val unconfirmed = CamaroUdsProtocol.applyStandardObdDiscovery(topology, listOf("7E9"))

        assertEquals(ModuleStatus.ACCESSIBLE, confirmed.single { it.id == "ECM" }.status)
        assertEquals("7E8", confirmed.single { it.id == "ECM" }.rxHeader)
        assertEquals(ModuleStatus.DISCOVERY_REQUIRED, unconfirmed.single { it.id == "ECM" }.status)
        assertEquals("", unconfirmed.single { it.id == "ECM" }.rxHeader)

    @Test

        val optionalIds = setOf("HVAC", "PSCM", "RCDLR", "RADIO", "AMP", "DDM", "PDM", "FPCM", "PARK_ASSIST", "HMI")
        listOf(
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.LFX),
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2018, engine = CamaroEngine.LT1)
        ).forEach { vehicle ->
            val modules = CamaroUdsProtocol.buildTopology(
                vehicle,
                AdapterCapabilities(tier = AdapterTier.PRO_STN, supportsCanHeaders = true)
            )
            val candidates = modules.filter { it.id in optionalIds }
            assertEquals(optionalIds, candidates.map { it.id }.toSet())
            candidates.forEach { module ->
                assertEquals(ModuleStatus.DISCOVERY_REQUIRED, module.status)
                assertEquals("", module.txHeader)
                assertEquals("", module.rxHeader)
                assertTrue(module.notesEn.contains("Optional equipment candidate"))
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun gen5AndGen6EngineRangesDoNotOverlap() {
        assertTrue(2012 in CamaroEngine.LFX.years)
        assertTrue(2020 in CamaroEngine.LGX.years)
        assertFalse(2020 in CamaroEngine.LFX.years)
    }

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class Obd2FeatureEngineTest {

    @Test
    fun doesNotQueryMode01PidThatTheEcuDidNotAdvertise() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            "NO DATA"
        })

        assertEquals(null, engine.readMode01PidIfSupported(0xA6, setOf(0x0C)))
        assertTrue(commands.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun readsMode01PidOnlyAfterSupportBitmapConfirmsIt() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            if (command == "01A6") "41A6000012D687" else "NO DATA"
        })

        val response = engine.readMode01PidIfSupported(0xA6, setOf(0xA6))

        assertEquals("41A6000012D687", response)
        assertEquals(listOf("01A6"), commands)
    }

    @Test
    fun fullScanUsesOnlyReadOnlyServicesAndAdapterSetupCommands() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "0100", "0101" -> if (command == "0101") "NO DATA" else "4100000000"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        val report = engine.fullReadOnlyScan()

        assertTrue(report.supportedPids.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(commands.containsAll(listOf("ATZ", "ATSP6", "ATI", "AT@1", "03", "07", "0A", "0902", "0904", "0906", "090A", "0600")))
        assertTrue(commands.none { command ->
            command == "04" || command.startsWith("2E") || command.startsWith("31") ||
                command.startsWith("34") || command.startsWith("36") || command.startsWith("11")
        })
    }

    @Test
    fun decodesFreezeFrameDtcAndKeepsOnlyTheFrameNumberOutOfSensorData() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "020200" -> "4202000171"
                "020000" -> "42000008100000"
                "020500" -> "4205007F"
                "020C00" -> "420C001AF8"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        val triggerDtc = engine.readFreezeFrameDtc()
        val supported = engine.discoverFreezeFrameSupportedPids()
        val values = engine.readFreezeFrame(supported)

        assertEquals("P0171", triggerDtc?.code)
        assertEquals("freeze-frame", triggerDtc?.status)
        assertEquals(setOf(0x05, 0x0C), supported)
        assertEquals(listOf(0x7F), values[0x05])
        assertEquals(listOf(0x1A, 0xF8), values[0x0C])
        assertEquals(setOf(0x05, 0x0C), values.keys)
        assertEquals(listOf("020200", "020000", "020500", "020C00"), commands)
    }

    @Test
    fun discoversMode02PidsWithoutCountingBitmapContinuationMarkers() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "020000" -> "42000000000001"
                "022000" -> "42200000000001"
                "024000" -> "42400080000000"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        assertEquals(setOf(0x41), engine.discoverFreezeFrameSupportedPids())
        assertEquals(listOf("020000", "022000", "024000"), commands)
    }

    @Test
    fun doesNotQueryFreezeFrameValuesWhenNoTriggerDtcIsStored() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "0100" -> "410000000000"
                "020200" -> "4202000000"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        val report = engine.fullReadOnlyScan()

        assertNull(report.freezeFrameDtc)
        assertTrue(report.freezeFrame.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(listOf("020200"), commands.filter { it.startsWith("02") })
    }

    @Test
    fun decodesMode09CalibrationIdAndCvnRecords() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "0904" -> "49040141424344454647483132333435363738"
                "0906" -> "4906019F3E61C2"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        assertEquals(listOf("ABCDEFGH12345678"), engine.readCalibrationIds())
        assertEquals(listOf("9F3E61C2"), engine.readCalibrationVerificationNumbers())
        assertTrue(commands.containsAll(listOf("0904", "0906")))
    }

    @Test
    fun readsAndDecodesEngineRpmFromSupportedPid() = runBlocking {
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            when (command) {
                "0100" -> "410000100000"
                "010C" -> "410C1AF8"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        val supported = engine.discoverSupportedPids()
        assertTrue(0x0C in supported)
        val rpm = engine.readLiveData(supported).single { it.pid == 0x0C }
        assertEquals("1726.00", rpm.value)
        assertEquals("rpm", rpm.unit)
    }

    @Test
    fun discoversObservedFunctionalObdCanResponseIdsAndRestoresElmFormatting() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "0100" -> "7E0 06 41 00 FF FF FF FF 7DF 06 41 00 FF FF FF FF 7E8 06 41 00 FF FF FF FF 7E9 06 41 00 80 00 00 00"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        })

        assertEquals(listOf("7E8", "7E9"), engine.discoverFunctionalObdResponders())
        assertTrue(commands.containsAll(listOf("ATS1", "ATH1", "0100", "ATH0", "ATS0")))
    }

    @Test
    fun doesNotTreatFunctionalObdRequestIdAsAnEcuResponse() = runBlocking {
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            if (command == "0100") "7DF 06 41 00 FF FF FF FF" else "OK"
        })

        assertTrue(engine.discoverFunctionalObdResponders().isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun followsContinuationPagesWithoutReportingTheirMarkerAsADataPid() = runBlocking {
        val requested = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            requested += command
            when (command) {
                // Only the continuation flag (bit 31) is set on the first two pages.
                "0100" -> "410000000001"
                "0120" -> "412000000001"
                // PID 0x41 is supported; no further page is advertised.
                "0140" -> "414080000000"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        assertEquals(setOf(0x41), engine.discoverSupportedPids())
        assertEquals(listOf("0100", "0120", "0140"), requested)
    }

    @Test
    fun stopsPidDiscoveryWhenTheAdapterDoesNotReturnAValidBitmap() = runBlocking {
        val requested = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            requested += command
            "NO DATA"
        })

        assertTrue(engine.discoverSupportedPids().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(listOf("0100"), requested)
    }

    @Test
    fun decodesConfirmedPendingAndPermanentDiagnosticCodes() = runBlocking {
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            when (command) {
                "03" -> "4301710000"
                "07" -> "4701330000"
                "0A" -> "4A01020000"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        val (confirmed, pending, permanent) = engine.readDtcs()
        assertEquals("P0171", confirmed.single().code)
        assertEquals("P0133", pending.single().code)
        assertEquals("P0102", permanent.single().code)
    }

    @Test
    fun verifiesElmMultilineVinAcrossTransportFraming() = runBlocking {
        val reply = "014\r0: 490201314731\r1: 46413152585852\r2: 30313233343536"
        suspend fun vin(raw: String) =
            Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { _, _ -> raw }).readVin()
        assertEquals("1G1FA1RXXR0123456", vin(reply))
        assertEquals("1G1FA1RXXR0123456", vin(reply.replace('\r', ' ')))
        assertNull(vin(reply.replace("1:", "2:")))
        assertNull(vin(reply.dropLast(2)))
        assertNull(vin(reply.replace("014", "013")))
    }

    @Test
    fun parsesMode09VinWithCountByte() = runBlocking {
        val vin = "1G1FA1RXXR0123456"
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            if (command == "0902") "490201${vin.toByteArray().joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }}" else "NO DATA"
        })
        assertEquals(vin, engine.readVin())
    }
    @Test
    fun decodesWidebandOxygenRatioAndVoltage() = runBlocking {
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            if (command == "0124") "4124 80 00 40 00" else "NO DATA"
        })

        val values = engine.readLiveData(setOf(0x24))

        assertEquals(2, values.size)
        assertEquals("O2 Bank 1 sensor 1 equivalence ratio", values[0].name)
        assertEquals("1.00", values[0].value)
        assertEquals("lambda", values[0].unit)
        assertEquals("O2 Bank 1 sensor 1 voltage", values[1].name)
        assertEquals("2.00", values[1].value)
        assertEquals("V", values[1].unit)
    }

    @Test
    fun identifiesElmAdapterAndReturnsAdapterDescription() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "ATI" -> "ELM327 v1.5"
                "AT@1" -> "OBDII to RS232 Interpreter"
                "ATDP" -> "ISO 15765-4 CAN (11 bit ID, 500 kbaud)"
                "ATRV" -> "12.4V"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        })

        val info = engine.initialize()

        assertEquals("ELM327 v1.5", info["IDENTIFICATION"])
        assertEquals("OBDII to RS232 Interpreter", info["DESCRIPTION"])
        assertTrue(commands.containsAll(listOf("ATZ", "ATSP6", "ATI", "AT@1", "ATDP", "ATRV")))
    }

    @Test
    fun readsStandardEcuIdentityAndKeepsResponderAddressesUnmapped() = runBlocking {
        val vin = "1G1FA1RXXR0123456"
        val calId = "ABCDEFGH12345678"
        val ecuName = "GM ECM MODULE".padEnd(20, ' ')
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "0100" -> "7E8 06 41 00 FF FF FF FF"
                "0902" -> "490201" + vin.toByteArray().joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }
                "0904" -> "490401" + calId.toByteArray().joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }
                "0906" -> "4906019F3E61C2"
                "090A" -> "490A01" + ecuName.toByteArray().joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }
                else -> "OK"
            }
        })

        val identity = engine.readEcuIdentification()

        assertEquals(vin, identity.vin)
        assertEquals(listOf(calId), identity.calibrationIds)
        assertEquals(listOf("9F3E61C2"), identity.calibrationVerificationNumbers)
        assertEquals(listOf("GM ECM MODULE"), identity.ecuNames)
        assertEquals(listOf("7E8"), identity.respondingEcuAddresses)
        assertTrue(commands.containsAll(listOf("0100", "0902", "0904", "0906", "090A")))
        assertTrue(commands.containsAll(listOf("ATH0", "ATS0")))
    }

    @Test
    fun retainsAvailableIdentityFieldsWhenOptionalMode09EcuNameIsUnsupported() = runBlocking {
        val vin = "1G1FA1RXXR0123456"
        val engine = Obd2FeatureEngine(ObdCommandChannel { command, _ ->
            when (command) {
                "0902" -> "490201" + vin.toByteArray().joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }
                "0904" -> "49040141424344454647483132333435363738"
                "0906" -> "4906019F3E61C2"
                "090A" -> "NO DATA"
                else -> "NO DATA"
            }
        })

        val identity = engine.readEcuIdentification()

        assertEquals(vin, identity.vin)
        assertEquals(listOf("ABCDEFGH12345678"), identity.calibrationIds)
        assertEquals(listOf("9F3E61C2"), identity.calibrationVerificationNumbers)
        assertTrue(identity.ecuNames.isEmpty())
    }

}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DtcCatalogRegistryTest {
    @Test
    fun registryCoversEveryEngineRpoDeclaredByTheVehicleModel() {
        assertEquals(CamaroEngine.entries.map { it.rpo }.toSet(), DtcCatalogRegistry.supportedEngineRpos)
        CamaroEngine.entries.forEach { engine ->
            val year = engine.years.first
            val vehicle = VehicleProfile(modelYear = year, engine = engine)
            val hasDocumentedEngineEvidence = when (engine) {
                CamaroEngine.LLT, CamaroEngine.LFX -> true
                CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.L99 -> year in 2010..2012
                CamaroEngine.LSA -> year in 2012..2012
                else -> false
            }
            assertEquals(
                if (hasDocumentedEngineEvidence) DtcEvidenceStatus.DOCUMENTED
                else DtcEvidenceStatus.GENERIC_ONLY,
                DtcCatalogRegistry.evidenceStatus(vehicle, "ECM")
            )
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun engineProfilesExposeRpoSpecificArchitectureWithoutCrossEngineAssumptions() {
        val expected = mapOf(
            "LLT" to Triple(6, EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, EngineFuelSystemType.DIRECT_INJECTION),
            "LFX" to Triple(6, EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, EngineFuelSystemType.DIRECT_INJECTION),
            "LS3" to Triple(8, EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, EngineFuelSystemType.PORT_INJECTION),
            "L99" to Triple(8, EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, EngineFuelSystemType.PORT_INJECTION),
            "LSA" to Triple(8, EngineInductionType.SUPERCHARGED, EngineFuelSystemType.PORT_INJECTION),
            "LS7" to Triple(8, EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, EngineFuelSystemType.PORT_INJECTION),
            "LTG" to Triple(4, EngineInductionType.TURBOCHARGED, EngineFuelSystemType.DIRECT_INJECTION),
            "LGX" to Triple(6, EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, EngineFuelSystemType.DIRECT_INJECTION),
            "LT1" to Triple(8, EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, EngineFuelSystemType.DIRECT_INJECTION),
            "LT4" to Triple(8, EngineInductionType.SUPERCHARGED, EngineFuelSystemType.DIRECT_INJECTION)
        )
        assertEquals(expected.keys, DtcCatalogRegistry.engineProfiles.keys)
        assertEquals(2016..2023, CamaroEngine.LTG.years)
        assertEquals(2016..2023, DtcCatalogRegistry.engineProfiles.getValue("LTG").modelYears)
        assertEquals(CamaroEngine.LTG.years, DtcCatalogRegistry.engineProfile(CamaroEngine.LTG)?.modelYears)
        CamaroEngine.entries.forEach { engine ->
            assertEquals(engine.years, DtcCatalogRegistry.engineProfile(engine)?.modelYears)
        }
        expected.forEach { (rpo, architecture) ->
            val profile = DtcCatalogRegistry.engineProfiles.getValue(rpo)
            assertEquals(architecture.first, profile.cylinderCount)
            assertEquals(architecture.second, profile.induction)
            assertEquals(architecture.third, profile.fuelSystem)
        }
    }

    }

    @Test
    fun perModuleCatalogueNeverClaimsUnsupportedOemCoverage() {
        val lfx = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.LFX)
        val lt1 = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2018, engine = CamaroEngine.LT1)

        val lfxEcm = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor("ECM", lfx)
        val lt1Ecm = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor("ECM", lt1)
        val l99_2012Ecm = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor(
            "ECM", VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.L99)
        )
        val llt2010Ecm = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor(
            "ECM", VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2010, engine = CamaroEngine.LLT)
        )
        val lt4_2019Ecm = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor(
            "ECM", VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2019, engine = CamaroEngine.LT4)
        )
        val impossibleLsa2011Ecm = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor(
            "ECM", VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2011, engine = CamaroEngine.LSA)
        )
        val ls7_2014Ecm = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor(
            "ECM", VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2014, engine = CamaroEngine.LS7)
        )
        val lfxAbs = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor("EBCM", lfx)
        val unknown = DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor("ECU 7E8", lfx)

        assertTrue(lfxEcm.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.DOCUMENTED, lfxEcm.evidenceStatus)
        assertTrue(lfxEcm.noteEn.contains("Partial"))
        assertTrue(lfxEcm.noteFr.contains("partielles"))
        assertTrue(l99_2012Ecm.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertTrue(llt2010Ecm.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertTrue(lt4_2019Ecm.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertFalse(impossibleLsa2011Ecm.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertFalse(ls7_2014Ecm.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertFalse(lt1Ecm.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.GENERIC_ONLY, lt1Ecm.evidenceStatus)
        assertFalse(lfxAbs.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.GENERIC_ONLY, lfxAbs.evidenceStatus)
        assertFalse(unknown.hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions)
        assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.DISCOVERY_REQUIRED, unknown.evidenceStatus)
        assertTrue(unknown.noteEn.contains("generic SAE description"))
        assertTrue(unknown.noteFr.contains("SAE générique"))
    }

        listOf(l99, ls3, lsa).forEach { profile ->

        }
    }

    @Test
    fun v8DtcAndMonitorCatalogsRespectL99VvtVersusLs3NonVvtArchitecture() {
        val l99_2010 = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2010, engine = CamaroEngine.L99)
        val l99_2011 = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2011, engine = CamaroEngine.L99)
        val ls3_2010 = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2010, engine = CamaroEngine.LS3)
        val ls3_2011 = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2011, engine = CamaroEngine.LS3)
        val l99_2012 = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.L99)

        listOf("P0010", "P0011", "P0013", "P0014", "P0016").forEach { code ->
            assertNotNull("Missing L99 interpretation for $code", CamaroDtcCatalog.find(code, l99_2010))
            assertNotNull("Missing L99 monitor for $code", GmEngineMonitorCatalog.find(code, l99_2010))
        }
        listOf("P0016").forEach { code ->
            assertNotNull("Missing LS3 correlation interpretation for $code", CamaroDtcCatalog.find(code, ls3_2010))
            assertNotNull("Missing LS3 correlation monitor for $code", GmEngineMonitorCatalog.find(code, ls3_2011))
        }
        listOf("P0010", "P0011", "P0013", "P0014").forEach { code ->
            assertEquals(null, CamaroDtcCatalog.find(code, ls3_2010))
            assertEquals(null, GmEngineMonitorCatalog.find(code, ls3_2011))
        }
        assertEquals("10OBDG12", GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(l99_2010))
        assertEquals("11OBDG07", GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(ls3_2011))
        assertNotNull("2012 L99 retains its VVT monitor", GmEngineMonitorCatalog.find("P0011", l99_2012))
        assertEquals(5, GmL99MonitorCatalog.supportedCodes().size)
        assertEquals(1, GmLs3MonitorCatalog.supportedCodes().size)
    }

    @Test
    fun gen6CertificationSourcesAreYearAndEngineSpecific() {
        assertEquals(
            "16OBDG03",
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2016, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG))
        )
        assertEquals(
            "16OBDG05",
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2016, engine = CamaroEngine.LGX))
        )
        assertEquals(
            "16OBDG07A",
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2016, engine = CamaroEngine.LT1))
        )
        assertEquals(null, GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2016, engine = CamaroEngine.LT4)))

        listOf(CamaroEngine.LTG, CamaroEngine.LGX, CamaroEngine.LT1, CamaroEngine.LT4).forEach { engine ->
            assertEquals(
                "17OBDG03",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2017, engine = engine))
            )
            assertEquals(
                "18OBDG03A",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2018, engine = engine))
            )
            assertEquals(
                if (engine == CamaroEngine.LTG || engine == CamaroEngine.LGX) "19OBDG03B" else "19OBDG03A",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2019, engine = engine))
            )
            assertEquals(
                "20OBDG03A",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2020, engine = engine))
            )
        }
        assertEquals(
            "21OBDG03A",
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2021, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG))
        )
        listOf(CamaroEngine.LGX, CamaroEngine.LT1, CamaroEngine.LT4).forEach { engine ->
            assertEquals(
                "21OBDG03B",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2021, engine = engine))
            )
        }

        assertEquals(
            "22OBDG03A",
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2022, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG))
        )
        listOf(CamaroEngine.LGX, CamaroEngine.LT1, CamaroEngine.LT4).forEach { engine ->
            assertEquals(
                "22OBDG03B",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2022, engine = engine))
            )
            assertEquals(
                "23OBDG03B",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2023, engine = engine))
            )
            assertEquals(
                "24OBDG03B Part 2",
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2024, engine = engine))
            )
        }
        assertEquals(
            "23OBDG03A Part2",
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2023, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG))
        )
        assertEquals(null, GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2024, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG)))
        assertTrue(
            CamaroDtcCatalog.coverageNotice(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2019, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG))
                .first.contains("19OBDG03B")
        )
        assertTrue(
            CamaroDtcCatalog.coverageNotice(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2019, engine = CamaroEngine.LT1))
                .first.contains("19OBDG03A")
        )
        assertTrue(
            CamaroDtcCatalog.coverageNotice(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2023, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG))
                .first.contains("23OBDG03A Part2")
        )
        assertTrue(
            CamaroDtcCatalog.coverageNotice(VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2024, engine = CamaroEngine.LT1))
                .first.contains("24OBDG03B Part 2")
        )

        // Group provenance is available; detailed Gen6 monitor evidence is not
        // yet integrated and must not be inferred from a certification label.
        assertEquals(
            null,
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.find("P0011", VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2017, engine = CamaroEngine.LTG))
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun evidenceStatusMatchesTheActualPerModuleCatalogueCoverage() {
        val coveredProfiles = listOf(
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2010, engine = CamaroEngine.LLT),
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.LFX),
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.L99),
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2013, engine = CamaroEngine.LS3),
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2013, engine = CamaroEngine.LSA),
            VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2019, engine = CamaroEngine.LT4)
        )

        coveredProfiles.forEach { vehicle ->
            assertEquals(
                "Evidence status must agree with catalogue routing for ${vehicle.modelYear} ${vehicle.engine.rpo}",
                DtcCatalogRegistry.catalogueFor("ECM", vehicle).evidenceStatus,
                DtcCatalogRegistry.evidenceStatus(vehicle, "ECM")
            )
            assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.DOCUMENTED, DtcCatalogRegistry.evidenceStatus(vehicle, "ECM"))
        }

        val genericProfile = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2018, engine = CamaroEngine.LT1)
        assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.GENERIC_ONLY, DtcCatalogRegistry.evidenceStatus(genericProfile, "ECM"))
        assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.GENERIC_ONLY, DtcCatalogRegistry.evidenceStatus(genericProfile, "EBCM"))
        assertEquals(DtcEvidenceStatus.DISCOVERY_REQUIRED, DtcCatalogRegistry.evidenceStatus(genericProfile, "ECU 7E8"))
    }

    @Test
    fun independentCommunityEvidenceRequiresTwoDistinctApplicablePublishers() {
        val vehicle = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.LFX)
        val first = DtcCommunityEvidenceReference(
            source = DtcDefinitionSource.TECHNICAL_FORUM,
            reference = "https://forum.example/threads/dtc-investigation",
            publisher = "Forum A",
            independenceGroup = "forum-a-original-thread",
            modelYears = 2012..2015,
            engineRpos = setOf("LFX"),
            moduleId = "ECM"
        )
        val repost = first.copy(
            reference = "https://archive.example/repost",
            publisher = "Archive",
            independenceGroup = "forum-a-original-thread"
        )
        val samePublisherDifferentInvestigation = first.copy(
            reference = "https://forum.example/threads/another-investigation",
            independenceGroup = "forum-a-second-original-thread"
        )
        val independent = first.copy(
            source = DtcDefinitionSource.SPECIALIST_REPAIR_DATABASE,
            reference = "https://repair.example/dtc",
            publisher = "Repair database",
            independenceGroup = "repair-database-entry"
        )

        val samePublisherOnly = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(
            listOf(first, samePublisherDifferentInvestigation),
            vehicle,
            "ECM"
        )
        assertEquals(DtcCommunityConfidence.SINGLE_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE, samePublisherOnly.confidence)
        assertEquals(1, samePublisherOnly.independentPublisherCount)

        // A cross-posted investigation may carry another publisher label. Its
        // publisher association is ambiguous and must not inflate corroboration.
        val crossPosted = first.copy(publisher = "Archive")
        val mixedPublisherReferences = listOf(
            crossPosted,
            first,
            samePublisherDifferentInvestigation,
            independent
        )
        val mixedOrderAssessment = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(
            mixedPublisherReferences,
            vehicle,
            "ECM"
        )
        val reversedOrderAssessment = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(
            mixedPublisherReferences.reversed(),
            vehicle,
            "ECM"
        )
        assertEquals(DtcCommunityConfidence.CORROBORATED_INDEPENDENT_SOURCES, mixedOrderAssessment.confidence)
        assertEquals(2, mixedOrderAssessment.independentPublisherCount)
        assertEquals(mixedOrderAssessment.confidence, reversedOrderAssessment.confidence)
        assertEquals(mixedOrderAssessment.independentPublisherCount, reversedOrderAssessment.independentPublisherCount)

        val single = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(
            listOf(first, repost),
            vehicle,
            "ECM"
        )
        assertEquals(DtcCommunityConfidence.SINGLE_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE, single.confidence)
        assertEquals(1, single.independentPublisherCount)
        assertTrue(single.mayShowCommunityExplanation)

        val corroborated = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(
            listOf(first, repost, independent),
            vehicle,
            "ECM"
        )
        assertEquals(DtcCommunityConfidence.CORROBORATED_INDEPENDENT_SOURCES, corroborated.confidence)
        assertEquals(2, corroborated.independentPublisherCount)
        assertEquals(3, corroborated.applicableReferences.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun communityEvidenceRejectsOutOfScopeAndUntraceableReferences() {
        val vehicle = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.LFX)
        val base = DtcCommunityEvidenceReference(
            source = DtcDefinitionSource.COMMUNITY_DATABASE,
            reference = "https://community.example/dtc",
            publisher = "Community",
            independenceGroup = "community-original",
            modelYears = 2012..2015,
            engineRpos = setOf("LFX"),
            moduleId = "ECM"
        )
        val rejected = listOf(
            base.copy(reference = "not-a-url"),
            base.copy(modelYears = 2010..2011),
            base.copy(engineRpos = setOf("LLT")),
            base.copy(moduleId = "TCM"),
            base.copy(publisher = ""),
            base.copy(independenceGroup = ""),
            base.copy(source = DtcDefinitionSource.SAE_J2012_GENERIC)
        )

        rejected.forEach { reference ->
            val assessment = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(
                listOf(reference),
                vehicle,
                "ECM"
            )
            assertEquals(DtcCommunityConfidence.INSUFFICIENT, assessment.confidence)
            assertFalse(assessment.mayShowCommunityExplanation)
            assertTrue(assessment.applicableReferences.isEmpty())
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun communityEvidenceIsMarkedVehicleValidatedOnlyForTheMatchingVin() {
        val vin = "1G1FB1E30C9123456"
        val vehicle = VehicleProfile(
            modelYear = 2012,
            engine = CamaroEngine.LFX,
            vin = vin
        )
        val reference = DtcCommunityEvidenceReference(
            source = DtcDefinitionSource.OWNER_REPAIR_REPORT,
            reference = "https://owners.example/report",
            publisher = "Vehicle owner",
            independenceGroup = "owner-report-2012-lfx",
            modelYears = 2012..2012,
            engineRpos = setOf("LFX"),
            moduleId = "ECM",
            validatedVin = vin
        )

        val matching = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(listOf(reference), vehicle, "ECM")
        assertEquals(DtcCommunityConfidence.VALIDATED_ON_THIS_VEHICLE, matching.confidence)

        val otherVehicle = vehicle.copy(vin = "1G1FB1E30C9123457")
        val notMatching = DtcCatalogRegistry.assessCommunityEvidence(listOf(reference), otherVehicle, "ECM")
        assertEquals(DtcCommunityConfidence.SINGLE_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE, notMatching.confidence)
    }


    @Test
    fun corroboratedCommunityEvidenceNeverQualifiesAsOemInterpretation() {
        val vin = "1G1FB1E30C9123456"
        val vehicle = VehicleProfile(

            operatingSystemId = "OS-123",
            calibrationId = "CAL-123",

            reference = "https://community.example/dtc"
        )

        assertTrue(communityEvidence.validationIssues(vehicle, "ECM").isEmpty())
        assertFalse(communityEvidence.isUsableForOemInterpretation(vehicle, "ECM"))
    }

    @Test
    fun vehicleSpecificDefinitionsRequireAnExplicitMatchingEcuVin() {
        val vin = "1G1FB1E30C9123456"
        val vehicle = VehicleProfile(modelYear = 2012, engine = CamaroEngine.LFX, vin = vin)
        val matching = VehicleVinMatcher.compare(vin, vin)
        val mismatch = VehicleVinMatcher.compare(vin, "1G1FB1E30C9123457")

        assertTrue(DtcCatalogRegistry.mayApplyVehicleSpecificDefinitions(vehicle, "ECM", matching))
        assertFalse(DtcCatalogRegistry.mayApplyVehicleSpecificDefinitions(vehicle, "ECM", mismatch))
        assertFalse(DtcCatalogRegistry.mayApplyVehicleSpecificDefinitions(vehicle, "ECM", null))
        assertFalse(DtcCatalogRegistry.mayApplyVehicleSpecificDefinitions(
            vehicle, "EBCM", matching
        ))
    }

}
