package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream
import java.util.Properties
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream

/**
 * Portable, offline ECU capture archive. No hardware provenance or restore capability is implied.
 * The caller owns the source bytes and must retain its original immutable capture separately.
 */
object EcuBackupArchive {
    private const val FORMAT_WITH_VIN = "CamaroDiag ECU offline archive v2"
    private const val FORMAT = "CamaroDiag ECU offline archive v1"
    private const val MAX_ENTRIES = 128
    private const val MAX_REGION_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024
    private const val MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES = 256L * 1024 * 1024

    /**
     * The import limit includes decompressed manifest bytes, not just payloads.
     * Keep the same ceiling at export to guarantee that our own ZIP is readable.
     */
    internal fun fitsUncompressedLimit(payloadBytes: Long, manifestBytes: Long): Boolean =
        payloadBytes >= 0L && manifestBytes >= 0L &&
            payloadBytes <= MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES &&
            manifestBytes <= MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES - payloadBytes

    data class Imported(
        val manifest: EcuBackupManifest.Manifest,
        val captures: List<EcuBackupManifest.Capture>,
        val requiredRegions: Set<EcuBackupCoverage.Region>,
        val verification: EcuBackupIntegrity.Result
    )

    fun export(
        output: OutputStream,
        captures: List<EcuBackupManifest.Capture>,
        requiredRegions: Set<EcuBackupCoverage.Region>,
        controllerLabel: String? = null,
        createdAtUtcMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        vehicleVin: String? = null
    ) {
        require(captures.isNotEmpty()) { "Cannot export an empty ECU backup" }
        require(captures.size <= MAX_ENTRIES) { "Too many memory segments" }
        require(captures.all { it.firstRead.isNotEmpty() && it.expectedBytes > 0 &&
            it.startAddress >= 0 && it.startAddress <= Long.MAX_VALUE - it.expectedBytes &&
            it.firstRead.size.toLong() <= it.expectedBytes }) { "Invalid capture range" }
        require(captures.all { it.firstRead.size <= MAX_REGION_BYTES &&
            (it.independentRead?.size ?: 0) <= MAX_REGION_BYTES }) { "Segment too large" }
        require(captures.sumOf { it.firstRead.size.toLong() + (it.independentRead?.size?.toLong() ?: 0L) } <= MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES) { "Archive data exceeds size limit" }
        // Freeze mutable byte arrays before hashing and serialization. Otherwise
        // a caller could change a ByteArray between checksum calculation and ZIP
        // writing, producing an archive with mismatched metadata and payload.
        val snapshots = captures.map { capture ->
            capture.copy(
                firstRead = capture.firstRead.copyOf(),
                independentRead = capture.independentRead?.copyOf()
            )
        }
        // Reject inconsistent captures before writing any archive header or bytes.
        // In particular, two independent reads must agree, or the archive
        // would be rejected by the corresponding import validation.
        val manifest = EcuBackupManifest.inspect(controllerLabel, createdAtUtcMillis, snapshots, requiredRegions, vehicleVin)
        val verification = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(manifest, snapshots, requiredRegions)
        require(verification.consistent) { "Inconsistent backup captures: ${verification.problems}" }
        val properties = Properties()
        properties.setProperty("format", if (vehicleVin == null) FORMAT else FORMAT_WITH_VIN)
        if (vehicleVin != null) properties.setProperty("vin", vehicleVin)
        properties.setProperty("controller", manifest.controllerLabel.orEmpty())
        properties.setProperty("created", createdAtUtcMillis.toString())
        properties.setProperty("count", snapshots.size.toString())
        properties.setProperty("required", requiredRegions.joinToString(",") { it.name })
        snapshots.forEachIndexed { index, capture ->
            val prefix = "capture.$index."
            properties.setProperty(prefix + "region", capture.region.name)
            properties.setProperty(prefix + "start", capture.startAddress.toString())
            properties.setProperty(prefix + "expected", capture.expectedBytes.toString())
            properties.setProperty(prefix + "origin", capture.origin.name)
            properties.setProperty(prefix + "sha256", manifest.entries[index].sha256)
            properties.setProperty(prefix + "second", (capture.independentRead != null).toString())
        }
        val metadata = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { properties.store(it, properties.getProperty("format")) }.toByteArray()
        require(metadata.size <= 64 * 1024) { "Manifest too large" }
        val payloadBytes = snapshots.sumOf { it.firstRead.size.toLong() +
            (it.independentRead?.size?.toLong() ?: 0L) }
        require(fitsUncompressedLimit(payloadBytes, metadata.size.toLong())) {
            "Archive payload and manifest together exceed the uncompressed size limit"
        }
        ZipOutputStream(output).use { zip ->
            fun write(name: String, bytes: ByteArray) {
                zip.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(name))
                zip.write(bytes)
                zip.closeEntry()
            }
            write("manifest.properties", metadata)
            snapshots.forEachIndexed { index, capture ->
                write("capture/$index/first.bin", capture.firstRead)
                capture.independentRead?.let { write("capture/$index/second.bin", it) }
            }
        }
    }

    fun import(input: InputStream, maxUncompressedBytes: Long = MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES): Imported {
        require(maxUncompressedBytes in 1..MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES) { "Invalid archive size limit" }
        val files = linkedMapOf<String, ByteArray>()
        var total = 0L
        ZipInputStream(input).use { zip ->
            while (true) {
                val entry = zip.nextEntry ?: break
                require(!entry.isDirectory) { "Unexpected archive directory" }
                require(entry.name == "manifest.properties" ||
                    Regex("capture/[0-9]+/(first|second)\\.bin").matches(entry.name)) {
                    "Unexpected archive entry"
                }
                require(entry.name !in files) { "Duplicate archive entry" }
                require(files.size < 1 + 2 * MAX_ENTRIES) { "Too many archive entries" }
                val data = ByteArrayOutputStream()
                val entryLimit = if (entry.name == "manifest.properties") 64 * 1024 else MAX_REGION_BYTES
                val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
                while (true) {
                    val n = zip.read(buffer)
                    if (n < 0) break
                    total += n
                    require(total <= maxUncompressedBytes && data.size() + n <= entryLimit) {
                        "Archive exceeds size limit"
                    }
                    data.write(buffer, 0, n)
                }
                files[entry.name] = data.toByteArray()
                zip.closeEntry()
            }
        }
        val metadata = files.remove("manifest.properties")
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Missing archive manifest")
        // Properties.load normally accepts duplicate keys and silently keeps the last
        // value. Reject ambiguous manifests instead of allowing metadata shadowing.
        val properties = object : Properties() {
            override fun put(key: Any, value: Any): Any? {
                require(!containsKey(key)) { "Duplicate archive manifest property" }
                return super.put(key, value)
            }
        }.apply { load(ByteArrayInputStream(metadata)) }
        val vehicleVin = when (properties.getProperty("format")) {
            FORMAT -> {
                require("vin" !in properties.stringPropertyNames()) { "Unexpected VIN in v1 archive" }
                null
            }
            FORMAT_WITH_VIN -> requireNotNull(properties.getProperty("vin")) { "Missing archive VIN" }
            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported archive format")
        }
        val count = properties.getProperty("count")?.toIntOrNull()
        require(count != null && count in 1..MAX_ENTRIES) { "Invalid segment count" }
        val required = properties.getProperty("required", "").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?.split(",")?.map { EcuBackupCoverage.Region.valueOf(it) }?.toSet().orEmpty()
        val captures = (0 until count).map { index ->
            val prefix = "capture.$index."
            fun field(key: String) = properties.getProperty(prefix + key)
                ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Missing metadata $prefix$key")
            val first = files.remove("capture/$index/first.bin")
                ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Missing primary read $index")
            val second = if (field("second") == "true") {
                files.remove("capture/$index/second.bin")
                    ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Missing independent read $index")
            } else {
                require(field("second") == "false") { "Invalid second read flag" }
                null
            }
            require(first.isNotEmpty()) { "Empty primary read for segment $index" }
            require(second != null) { "Missing independent read for segment $index" }
            require(EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(first).equals(field("sha256"), ignoreCase = true)) {
                "Primary read checksum mismatch"
            }
            require(first.contentEquals(second)) {
                "Independent read differs from primary read for segment $index"
            }
            EcuBackupManifest.Capture(
                EcuBackupCoverage.Region.valueOf(field("region")),
                field("start").toLong(), field("expected").toLong(),
                first, second, EcuBackupManifest.Origin.valueOf(field("origin"))
            )
        }
        require(files.isEmpty()) { "Unreferenced archive data" }
        require(properties.stringPropertyNames().all { key ->
            key in setOf("format", "controller", "created", "count", "required", "vin") ||
                (0 until count).any { index ->
                    key in setOf("region", "start", "expected", "origin", "sha256", "second")
                        .map { "capture.$index.$it" }
                }
        }) { "Unknown archive manifest property" }
        val created = properties.getProperty("created")?.toLongOrNull()
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid creation timestamp")
        val manifest = EcuBackupManifest.inspect(
            properties.getProperty("controller").orEmpty().ifBlank { null },
            created, captures, required, vehicleVin
        )
        val verification = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(manifest, captures, required)
        require(verification.consistent) { "Archive failed offline verification: ${verification.problems}" }
        return Imported(manifest, captures, required, verification)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Offline evidence about ECU memory snapshots.
 * A valid manifest is NOT evidence that the bytes originated from a physical ECU.
 * The hardware reader must separately prove the acquisition provenance.
 */
object EcuBackupCoverage {
    enum class Region { CALIBRATION, PROGRAM_FLASH, DATA_FLASH, EXTERNAL_EEPROM, OTHER }
    enum class Status { COMPLETE, PARTIAL, INCONSISTENT }
    data class Segment(
        val region: Region,
        val startAddress: Long,
        val expectedBytes: Long,
        val capturedBytes: Long,
        val sha256: String?,
        val verifiedIndependentReadback: Boolean
    )
    data class Report(
        val status: Status,
        val capturedBytes: Long,
        val missingBytes: Long,
        val missingRegions: Set<Region> = emptySet()
    )

    /**
     * Checks a single non-overlapping memory segment against the expected coverage.
     * The caller must not substitute a checksum reported by an untrusted device for
     * hashing the actual captured bytes.
     */
    fun inspect(
        segments: List<Segment>,
        requiredRegions: Set<Region> = emptySet()
    ): Report {
        val observedRegions = segments.map(Segment::region).toSet()
        val missingRegions = requiredRegions - observedRegions
        if (segments.isEmpty()) return Report(Status.PARTIAL, 0, 0, missingRegions)
        var captured = 0L
        var missing = 0L
        var inconsistent = false
        var allVerified = true
        val ordered = segments.sortedWith(compareBy<Segment>({ it.region.ordinal }, { it.startAddress }))
        var previous: Segment? = null
        for (segment in ordered) {
            if (segment.startAddress < 0 || segment.expectedBytes <= 0 ||
                segment.capturedBytes < 0 || segment.capturedBytes > segment.expectedBytes ||
                segment.startAddress > Long.MAX_VALUE - segment.expectedBytes
            ) {
                inconsistent = true
                continue
            }
            val prev = previous
            if (prev != null && prev.region == segment.region &&
                segment.startAddress < prev.startAddress + prev.expectedBytes
            ) inconsistent = true
            previous = segment
            if (Long.MAX_VALUE - captured < segment.capturedBytes ||
                Long.MAX_VALUE - missing < segment.expectedBytes - segment.capturedBytes
            ) {
                inconsistent = true
                continue
            }
            captured += segment.capturedBytes
            missing += segment.expectedBytes - segment.capturedBytes
            if (!segment.verifiedIndependentReadback ||
                segment.sha256?.matches(Regex("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}")) != true
            ) allVerified = false
        }
        val status = when {
            inconsistent -> Status.INCONSISTENT
            missing == 0L && allVerified && missingRegions.isEmpty() -> Status.COMPLETE
            else -> Status.PARTIAL
        }
        return Report(status, captured, missing, missingRegions)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Offline consistency check for a backup manifest and the bytes it describes.
 *
 * A passing result proves consistency of the supplied in-memory data only.
 * It does NOT prove that a hardware ECU was read, that the expected memory
 * map is exhaustive, or that this image can be flashed/restored.
 */
object EcuBackupIntegrity {
    enum class Problem {
        EMPTY_BACKUP,
        ENTRY_COUNT_MISMATCH,
        METADATA_MISMATCH,
        DIGEST_MISMATCH,
        INDEPENDENT_READ_MISMATCH,
        COVERAGE_MISMATCH,
        INVALID_COVERAGE,
        UNVERIFIABLE_HARDWARE_PROVENANCE,
        MISSING_INDEPENDENT_READ,
        DIVERGENT_INDEPENDENT_READ
    }

    data class Result(val problems: Set<Problem>) {
        val consistent: Boolean get() = problems.isEmpty()
    }

    fun verify(
        manifest: EcuBackupManifest.Manifest,
        captures: List<EcuBackupManifest.Capture>,
        requiredRegions: Set<EcuBackupCoverage.Region>
    ): Result {
        val problems = mutableSetOf<Problem>()
        if (captures.isEmpty()) problems += Problem.EMPTY_BACKUP
        if (manifest.hardwareProvenanceVerified) {
            // No hardware reader currently issues an independently authenticated attestation.
            problems += Problem.UNVERIFIABLE_HARDWARE_PROVENANCE
        }
        if (manifest.entries.size != captures.size) {
            problems += Problem.ENTRY_COUNT_MISMATCH
        }
        // Do not let an absent second read pass simply because the manifest also says false.
        captures.forEach { capture ->
            if (capture.independentRead == null) {
                problems += Problem.MISSING_INDEPENDENT_READ
            } else if (!capture.firstRead.contentEquals(capture.independentRead)) {
                problems += Problem.DIVERGENT_INDEPENDENT_READ
            }
        }
        manifest.entries.zip(captures).forEach { (entry, capture) ->
            if (entry.region != capture.region ||
                entry.startAddress != capture.startAddress ||
                entry.expectedBytes != capture.expectedBytes ||
                entry.bytesCaptured != capture.firstRead.size.toLong() ||
                entry.origin != capture.origin
            ) problems += Problem.METADATA_MISMATCH

            if (!entry.sha256.equals(EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(capture.firstRead), ignoreCase = true)) {
                problems += Problem.DIGEST_MISMATCH
            }
            val identical = capture.independentRead != null &&
                EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifiedReadback(capture.firstRead, capture.independentRead)
            if (entry.readsIdentical != identical) {
                problems += Problem.INDEPENDENT_READ_MISMATCH
            }
        }
        val expected = EcuBackupManifest.inspect(
            controllerLabel = manifest.controllerLabel,
            createdAtUtcMillis = manifest.createdAtUtcMillis,
            captures = captures,
            expectedRegions = requiredRegions
        )
        if (expected.coverage.status == EcuBackupCoverage.Status.INCONSISTENT) {
            problems += Problem.INVALID_COVERAGE
        }
        if (manifest.coverage != expected.coverage ||
            manifest.entries.size != expected.entries.size
        ) problems += Problem.COVERAGE_MISMATCH
        return Result(problems)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Builds a non-destructive, offline inventory from actual ECU image bytes.
 *
 * This manifest is not a hardware acquisition certificate or a valid cloning
 * image. A real programmer must separately verify controller provenance,
 * memory mapping, protected areas and the device's own checksums.
 */
object EcuBackupManifest {
    enum class Origin { IMPORTED_FILE, SIMULATION, REPORTED_HARDWARE_READ }

    data class Capture(
        val region: EcuBackupCoverage.Region,
        val startAddress: Long,
        val expectedBytes: Long,
        val firstRead: ByteArray,
        val independentRead: ByteArray?,
        val origin: Origin
    )

    data class Entry(
        val region: EcuBackupCoverage.Region,
        val startAddress: Long,
        val expectedBytes: Long,
        val bytesCaptured: Long,
        val sha256: String,
        val readsIdentical: Boolean,
        val origin: Origin
    )

    data class Manifest(
        val controllerLabel: String?,
        val createdAtUtcMillis: Long,
        val entries: List<Entry>,
        val coverage: EcuBackupCoverage.Report,
        /** Always false until a separately validated hardware reader can attest provenance. */
        val hardwareProvenanceVerified: Boolean = false,
        /** VIN reported during acquisition, when available. It is not an attestation. */
        val vehicleVin: String? = null
    )

    fun inspect(
        controllerLabel: String?,
        createdAtUtcMillis: Long,
        captures: List<Capture>,
        expectedRegions: Set<EcuBackupCoverage.Region>,
        vehicleVin: String? = null
    ): Manifest {
        require(vehicleVin == null || vehicleVin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}"))) {
            "Invalid VIN in ECU backup manifest"
        }
        val entries = captures.map { capture ->
            Entry(
                region = capture.region,
                startAddress = capture.startAddress,
                expectedBytes = capture.expectedBytes,
                bytesCaptured = capture.firstRead.size.toLong(),
                sha256 = EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(capture.firstRead),
                readsIdentical = capture.independentRead != null &&
                    EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifiedReadback(capture.firstRead, capture.independentRead),
                origin = capture.origin
            )
        }
        val evidence = entries.map { entry ->
            EcuBackupCoverage.Segment(
                region = entry.region,
                startAddress = entry.startAddress,
                expectedBytes = entry.expectedBytes,
                capturedBytes = entry.bytesCaptured,
                sha256 = entry.sha256,
                verifiedIndependentReadback = entry.readsIdentical
            )
        }
        // An unspecified target map can never be advertised as a complete backup.
        val coverage = EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(evidence, expectedRegions)
        val conservativeCoverage = if (expectedRegions.isEmpty() &&
            coverage.status == EcuBackupCoverage.Status.COMPLETE
        ) coverage.copy(status = EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL) else coverage
        return Manifest(
            controllerLabel = controllerLabel?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank),
            createdAtUtcMillis = createdAtUtcMillis,
            entries = entries,
            coverage = conservativeCoverage,
            vehicleVin = vehicleVin
        )
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.security.MessageDigest

/**
 * Preparation for direct ECU memory work on a removed controller.
 *
 * BOOT/BAM and Nexus/JTAG access to an MCU with internal flash is not equivalent
 * to removing an external EEPROM. No transport driver or programming routine
 * is registered in CamaroDiag yet; these checks must never enable a write.
 */
object EcuBenchExpertPlan {
    enum class AccessMethod { OBD, BENCH, BOOT_BAM, NEXUS_JTAG, EXTERNAL_CHIP_OFF }
    enum class MemoryRegion { PFLASH, DFLASH, EXTERNAL_EEPROM }
    enum class Blocker {
        CONTROLLER_NOT_IDENTIFIED,
        CHIP_NOT_IDENTIFIED,
        ACCESS_REGION_INCOMPATIBLE,
        PROGRAMMER_NOT_IDENTIFIED,
        IMAGE_MISSING,
        IMAGE_NOT_RAW_BINARY,
        IMAGE_INTEGRITY_MISSING,
        ORIGINAL_READBACK_NOT_VERIFIED,
        RECOVERY_PATH_NOT_VERIFIED,
        MEMORY_MAP_NOT_VERIFIED,
        HARDWARE_PROGRAMMING_DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE
    }

    data class CandidateImage(
        val fileName: String?,
        val format: String?,
        val sizeBytes: Long?,
        val sha256: String?
    )

    data class Target(
        val controllerFamily: String?,
        val chipMarking: String?,
        val programmerName: String?,
        val accessMethod: AccessMethod,
        val region: MemoryRegion
    )

    data class Evidence(
        val originalReadbackVerified: Boolean = false,
        val recoveryPathVerified: Boolean = false,
        val memoryMapVerified: Boolean = false
    )

    /**
     * A filename, SHA-256 or user-entered chip name cannot confirm that an image
     * belongs to this ECU, contains a full flash or has a valid ECU checksum.
     * Even all declared evidence cannot authorize a write without a validated driver.
     */
    fun blockers(target: Target, image: CandidateImage?, evidence: Evidence = Evidence()): List<Blocker> {
        val missing = mutableListOf<Blocker>()
        val family = target.controllerFamily?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (family !in setOf("E39", "E39A")) missing += Blocker.CONTROLLER_NOT_IDENTIFIED
        if (target.chipMarking.isNullOrBlank() ||
            target.chipMarking.trim().equals("unknown", ignoreCase = true)
        ) missing += Blocker.CHIP_NOT_IDENTIFIED
        if ((target.accessMethod == AccessMethod.EXTERNAL_CHIP_OFF) !=
            (target.region == MemoryRegion.EXTERNAL_EEPROM)
        ) missing += Blocker.ACCESS_REGION_INCOMPATIBLE
        if (target.programmerName.isNullOrBlank()) missing += Blocker.PROGRAMMER_NOT_IDENTIFIED
        if (image?.fileName.isNullOrBlank() || (image?.sizeBytes ?: 0L) <= 0L) {
            missing += Blocker.IMAGE_MISSING
        } else {
            if (image?.format != "RAW_BINARY") missing += Blocker.IMAGE_NOT_RAW_BINARY
            if (!isSha256(image?.sha256)) missing += Blocker.IMAGE_INTEGRITY_MISSING
        }
        if (!evidence.originalReadbackVerified) missing += Blocker.ORIGINAL_READBACK_NOT_VERIFIED
        if (!evidence.recoveryPathVerified) missing += Blocker.RECOVERY_PATH_NOT_VERIFIED
        if (!evidence.memoryMapVerified) missing += Blocker.MEMORY_MAP_NOT_VERIFIED
        missing += Blocker.HARDWARE_PROGRAMMING_DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE
        return missing
    }

    fun isProgrammingEnabled(target: Target, image: CandidateImage?, evidence: Evidence = Evidence()): Boolean =
        blockers(target, image, evidence).isEmpty()

    /**
     * Offline file integrity check using actual bytes, not just user-supplied
     * metadata. A matching checksum does not prove that these bytes were
     * read from this specific ECU or authorize flashing them.
     */
    fun verifyCandidateImage(image: CandidateImage?, rawBytes: ByteArray?): Boolean {
        if (image == null || rawBytes == null || rawBytes.isEmpty()) return false
        if (image.fileName.isNullOrBlank() || image.format != "RAW_BINARY") return false
        if (image.sizeBytes != rawBytes.size.toLong() || !isSha256(image.sha256)) return false
        return sha256Hex(rawBytes).equals(image.sha256, ignoreCase = true)
    }

    /** Compare two actual byte arrays, not merely two filenames or reported hashes. */
    fun verifiedReadback(sourceBytes: ByteArray, readbackBytes: ByteArray): Boolean =
        sourceBytes.isNotEmpty() && sourceBytes.contentEquals(readbackBytes)

    fun sha256Hex(bytes: ByteArray): String =
        MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

    private fun isSha256(value: String?): Boolean =
        value?.matches(Regex("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}")) == true
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Offline preview of changed bytes and affected flash erase sectors.
 *
 * It never writes to a controller. Sector geometry must be supplied from an
 * independently verified, ECU-specific memory map before ANY physical use.
 * A computed SHA-256 is not an OEM calibration checksum.
 */
object EcuPartialWritePlanner {
    data class Range(val start: Long, val endExclusive: Long)

    data class Layout(
        val regionStartAddress: Long,
        val regionSize: Long,
        val eraseBlockBytes: Int,
        val programBlockBytes: Int,
        val protectedRanges: List<Range> = emptyList(),
        val mapVerifiedForTargetEcu: Boolean = false
    )

    data class Sector(
        val absoluteAddress: Long,
        val changedBytes: Int,
        val originalSha256: String,
        val updatedSha256: String,
        /** Entire original sector, including neighboring bytes that must be preserved. */
        val originalBytes: ByteArray,
        /** Entire sector as it would appear after applying only the compared changes. */
        val patchedBytes: ByteArray
    )

    data class Preview(
        val changedBytes: Long,
        val affectedSectors: List<Sector>,
        val memoryMapVerified: Boolean,
        val hardwareWritePermitted: Boolean = false
    )

    fun preview(layout: Layout, original: ByteArray, modified: ByteArray): Preview {
        require(original.isNotEmpty() && original.size == modified.size) {
            "Offline sector planning requires equal-size, nonempty original and modified images."
        }
        require(layout.regionSize == original.size.toLong()) {
            "Both files must match the declared memory region exactly."
        }
        require(layout.regionStartAddress >= 0 &&
            layout.regionStartAddress <= Long.MAX_VALUE - layout.regionSize
        ) { "Invalid or overflowing ECU memory range." }
        require(layout.eraseBlockBytes > 0 && layout.programBlockBytes > 0 &&
            layout.eraseBlockBytes % layout.programBlockBytes == 0
        ) { "Programming units must divide a positive erase-sector size." }
        require(layout.regionStartAddress % layout.eraseBlockBytes == 0L &&
            layout.regionSize % layout.eraseBlockBytes == 0L
        ) { "Region boundaries must align with complete erase sectors." }
        val protected = layout.protectedRanges
        require(protected.all {
            it.start >= layout.regionStartAddress &&
                it.endExclusive <= layout.regionStartAddress + layout.regionSize &&
                it.endExclusive > it.start
        }) { "Invalid protected-region bounds." }

        val changedBySector = sortedMapOf<Int, Int>()
        for (offset in original.indices) {
            if (original[offset] == modified[offset]) continue
            val address = layout.regionStartAddress + offset.toLong()
            require(protected.none { address >= it.start && address < it.endExclusive }) {
                "Patch would touch protected ECU memory."
            }
            val sector = offset / layout.eraseBlockBytes
            changedBySector[sector] = (changedBySector[sector] ?: 0) + 1
        }
        val sectors = changedBySector.map { (index, count) ->
            val start = index * layout.eraseBlockBytes
            val finish = start + layout.eraseBlockBytes
            val eraseStart = layout.regionStartAddress + start.toLong()
            val eraseEnd = layout.regionStartAddress + finish.toLong()
            // A sector containing protected bytes must never be erased, even
            // when the changed byte itself is outside the protected interval.
            require(protected.none {
                it.start < eraseEnd && it.endExclusive > eraseStart
            }) { "Erase-sector operation would affect protected ECU memory." }
            val before = original.copyOfRange(start, finish)
            val after = modified.copyOfRange(start, finish)
            Sector(
                absoluteAddress = layout.regionStartAddress + start.toLong(),
                changedBytes = count,
                originalSha256 = EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(before),
                updatedSha256 = EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(after),
                originalBytes = before,
                patchedBytes = after
            )
        }
        return Preview(
            changedBytes = changedBySector.values.sumOf(Int::toLong),
            affectedSectors = sectors,
            memoryMapVerified = layout.mapVerifiedForTargetEcu
        )
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Explicit contract for future hardware-specific ECU readers/programmers.
 * There is currently no registered ECU writer; no transport is interchangeable.
 */
interface EcuProgrammingDriverContract {
    enum class Transport { ELM_DIAGNOSTICS, J2534, BENCH, BOOT_BAM, NEXUS_JTAG, CHIP_OFF }
    enum class Capability {
        IDENTIFY, READ_REGION, ERASE_REGION, WRITE_REGION, READBACK_VERIFY, RESET
    }

    /**
     * An ECU family defines the shared diagnostic/programming protocol.
     * GM service-part supersessions, printed part numbers and BCC labels
     * are catalogue aliases, NOT separate protocols or firmware identifiers.
     *
     * FirmwareTarget represents one known image/firmware configuration for
     * authorizing a destructive write, not a dedicated protocol driver.
     */
    data class FirmwareTarget(val controllerFamily: String, val controllerId: String, val firmwareId: String)

    data class Descriptor(
        val id: String,
        val transport: Transport,
        val capabilities: Set<Capability>,
        val controllerFamilies: Set<String>,
        val physicalHardwareValidated: Boolean,
        val writeTargets: Set<FirmwareTarget> = emptySet()
    ) {
        /** Shared protocol-family match; neither a firmware nor a service number is required. */
        fun supportsFamilyProtocol(controllerFamily: String, requestedTransport: Transport): Boolean =
            transport == requestedTransport && controllerFamily in controllerFamilies &&
                Capability.IDENTIFY in capabilities

        /**
         * Destructive operations require a separately validated image/firmware
         * configuration. Never infer flash approval from a catalogue supersession.
         * One protocol driver may support many firmware versions on that family.
         */
        fun supportsWrite(target: FirmwareTarget, requestedTransport: Transport): Boolean =
            physicalHardwareValidated &&
                supportsFamilyProtocol(target.controllerFamily, requestedTransport) &&
                target in writeTargets &&
                capabilities.containsAll(requiredWriteCapabilities)
    }

    data class Identity(val controllerId: String, val firmwareId: String, val vin: String?)
    data class RegionRequest(
        val region: EcuBackupCoverage.Region,
        val address: Long,
        val length: Long
    )

    val descriptor: Descriptor
    suspend fun identify(): Identity
    suspend fun read(request: RegionRequest): ByteArray
    suspend fun erase(request: RegionRequest)
    suspend fun write(request: RegionRequest, bytes: ByteArray)
    suspend fun independentReadback(request: RegionRequest): ByteArray
    suspend fun resetController()

    companion object {
        private val requiredWriteCapabilities = setOf(
            Capability.IDENTIFY, Capability.READ_REGION, Capability.ERASE_REGION,
            Capability.WRITE_REGION, Capability.READBACK_VERIFY
        )

        /**
         * No experimental or user-declared adapter may silently become a
         * registered writer. Add a hardware-validated implementation only after
         * the target ECU, firmware and recovery procedure are proven.
         */
        val registeredHardwareDrivers: List<EcuProgrammingDriverContract> = emptyList()

        fun hasValidatedWriteDriver(controllerFamily: String, transport: Transport): Boolean =
            registeredHardwareDrivers.any { driver ->
                driver.descriptor.writeTargets.any { target ->
                    target.controllerFamily == controllerFamily && driver.descriptor.supportsWrite(target, transport)
                }
            }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Non-destructive assessment of an interrupted or uncertain ECU programming session.
 * Never attempts to erase, reflash, reset, unlock or retry an ECU.
 */
object EcuRecoveryAssessment {
    enum class LinkStatus { COMMUNICATING, NOT_RESPONDING, NOT_CHECKED }
    enum class PowerStatus { VERIFIED_STABLE, UNSTABLE, NOT_CHECKED }
    enum class Disposition {
        NOT_AN_INTERRUPTED_SESSION,
        CHECK_ECU_WITHOUT_WRITING,
        ASSESS_BENCH_RECOVERY,
        STOP_AND_PRESERVE_EVIDENCE
    }
    enum class Warning {
        ECU_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED,
        ORIGINAL_BACKUP_MISSING,
        RECOVERY_DRIVER_NOT_VALIDATED,
        POWER_NOT_VERIFIED,
        ECU_COMMUNICATION_UNKNOWN,
        INTERRUPTION_REQUIRES_REASSESSMENT
    }

    data class Context(
        val programmingWasInterrupted: Boolean,
        val linkStatus: LinkStatus,
        val powerStatus: PowerStatus,
        val ecuIdentityVerified: Boolean,
        val originalBackupAvailable: Boolean,
        val validatedRecoveryDriverAvailable: Boolean
    )

    data class Assessment(
        val disposition: Disposition,
        val warnings: Set<Warning>,
        val automaticRetryAllowed: Boolean = false,
        val restoreGuaranteed: Boolean = false
    )

    fun assess(context: Context): Assessment {
        if (!context.programmingWasInterrupted) {
            return Assessment(Disposition.NOT_AN_INTERRUPTED_SESSION, emptySet())
        }
        val warnings = mutableSetOf(Warning.INTERRUPTION_REQUIRES_REASSESSMENT)
        if (!context.ecuIdentityVerified) warnings += Warning.ECU_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED
        if (!context.originalBackupAvailable) warnings += Warning.ORIGINAL_BACKUP_MISSING
        if (!context.validatedRecoveryDriverAvailable) warnings += Warning.RECOVERY_DRIVER_NOT_VALIDATED
        if (context.powerStatus != PowerStatus.VERIFIED_STABLE) warnings += Warning.POWER_NOT_VERIFIED
        if (context.linkStatus == LinkStatus.NOT_CHECKED) {
            warnings += Warning.ECU_COMMUNICATION_UNKNOWN
        }
        val disposition = when {
            context.powerStatus != PowerStatus.VERIFIED_STABLE ||
                !context.ecuIdentityVerified || !context.originalBackupAvailable ||
                !context.validatedRecoveryDriverAvailable ->
                Disposition.STOP_AND_PRESERVE_EVIDENCE
            context.linkStatus == LinkStatus.NOT_RESPONDING ->
                Disposition.ASSESS_BENCH_RECOVERY
            context.linkStatus == LinkStatus.COMMUNICATING ->
                Disposition.CHECK_ECU_WITHOUT_WRITING
            else -> Disposition.STOP_AND_PRESERVE_EVIDENCE
        }
        return Assessment(disposition, warnings)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException

/**
 * Guarded, per-erase-sector programming sequence.
 *
 * This is a software foundation, NOT a validated LFX/Gen5/Gen6 ECU writer.
 * The production entry point obtains a driver exclusively from the (currently
 * empty) hardware-validated registry. Unit tests exercise the internal engine
 * with a fake in-memory controller; no real protocol is inferred.
 *
 * A caller-provided Boolean is not a substitute for OEM checksum validation,
 * verified memory geometry, stable power, or a real independent ECU backup.
 */
object EcuWriteTransaction {
    data class SafetyEvidence(
        val oemChecksumValidated: Boolean = false,
        val independentHardwareBackupVerified: Boolean = false,
        val recoveryProcedureValidated: Boolean = false
    )

    data class Request(
        val controllerFamily: String,
        val transport: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport,
        val expectedIdentity: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Identity,
        val region: EcuBackupCoverage.Region,
        val layout: EcuPartialWritePlanner.Layout,
        val originalImage: ByteArray,
        val updatedImage: ByteArray,
        val evidence: SafetyEvidence
    ) {
        internal val firmwareTarget get() = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.FirmwareTarget(
            controllerFamily, expectedIdentity.controllerId, expectedIdentity.firmwareId
        )
    }

    enum class Blocker {
        UNKNOWN_TARGET, DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_TRANSPORT, UNVERIFIED_MEMORY_MAP,
        UNVERIFIED_OEM_CHECKSUM, UNVERIFIED_HARDWARE_BACKUP, NO_VALIDATED_RECOVERY,
        INVALID_IMAGE_OR_LAYOUT, NO_VALIDATED_DRIVER
    }

    data class Preparation(
        val blockers: Set<Blocker>,
        val changedBytes: Long,
        val affectedEraseSectors: Int
    ) {
        val canAttemptWithValidatedHardware: Boolean get() = blockers.isEmpty()
    }

    enum class Stage { BASELINE_CHECKED, BEFORE_ERASE, VERIFIED_AFTER_WRITE }
    data class Record(
        val stage: Stage,
        val region: EcuBackupCoverage.Region,
        val address: Long,
        val originalSha256: String,
        val updatedSha256: String
    )

    /** Must be backed by persistent storage before enabling real hardware. */
    fun interface Journal {
        suspend fun append(record: Record)
    }

    /** Live voltage/power health must be verified by target-specific hardware. */
    fun interface PowerMonitor {
        suspend fun isStable(): Boolean
    }

    enum class Status { BLOCKED, NO_CHANGE, COMPLETED, STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT }

    data class Outcome(
        val status: Status,
        val blockers: Set<Blocker> = emptySet(),
        val verifiedSectors: Int = 0,
        val failedAddress: Long? = null
    )

    fun prepare(request: Request): Preparation {
        val blockers = linkedSetOf<Blocker>()
        if (request.controllerFamily.isBlank() ||
            request.expectedIdentity.controllerId.isBlank() ||
            request.expectedIdentity.firmwareId.isBlank() ||
            request.expectedIdentity.vin.isNullOrBlank()
        ) blockers += Blocker.UNKNOWN_TARGET
        if (request.transport == EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.ELM_DIAGNOSTICS) {
            blockers += Blocker.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_TRANSPORT
        }
        if (!request.layout.mapVerifiedForTargetEcu) blockers += Blocker.UNVERIFIED_MEMORY_MAP
        if (!request.evidence.oemChecksumValidated) blockers += Blocker.UNVERIFIED_OEM_CHECKSUM
        if (!request.evidence.independentHardwareBackupVerified) {
            blockers += Blocker.UNVERIFIED_HARDWARE_BACKUP
        }
        if (!request.evidence.recoveryProcedureValidated) blockers += Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_RECOVERY
        val preview = try {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(
                request.layout, request.originalImage.copyOf(), request.updatedImage.copyOf()
            )
        } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
            blockers += Blocker.INVALID_IMAGE_OR_LAYOUT
            null
        }
        return Preparation(
            blockers = blockers,
            changedBytes = preview?.changedBytes ?: 0L,
            affectedEraseSectors = preview?.affectedSectors?.size ?: 0
        )
    }

    /**
     * Public hardware entrypoint. The destination must be in persistent, app-private
     * storage. No destructive operation is permitted without the journal being
     * created and successfully synced; an earlier log is never overwritten.
     * An ECU writer still needs to be explicitly registered after bench validation.
     */
    suspend fun execute(
        request: Request,
        journalFile: java.io.File,
        powerMonitor: PowerMonitor
    ): Outcome {
        val preparation = prepare(request)
        if (!preparation.canAttemptWithValidatedHardware) {
            return Outcome(Status.BLOCKED, preparation.blockers)
        }
        if (preparation.changedBytes == 0L) return Outcome(Status.NO_CHANGE)
        val driver = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.registeredHardwareDrivers.firstOrNull {
            it.descriptor.supportsWrite(request.firmwareTarget, request.transport)
        } ?: return Outcome(Status.BLOCKED, setOf(Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_DRIVER))
        val journal = try {
            PersistentEcuWriteJournal(
                journalFile, request.firmwareTarget, requireNotNull(request.expectedIdentity.vin)
            )
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            return Outcome(Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT)
        }
        return EcuWriteExecutionEngine(driver, journal, powerMonitor).run(request)
    }

    /**
     * Internal test harness. Application callers cannot supply a volatile journal:
     * live programming must use the public file-backed entrypoint above.
     */
    internal suspend fun execute(
        request: Request,
        journal: Journal,
        powerMonitor: PowerMonitor
    ): Outcome {
        val preparation = prepare(request)
        if (!preparation.canAttemptWithValidatedHardware) {
            return Outcome(Status.BLOCKED, preparation.blockers)
        }
        if (preparation.changedBytes == 0L) return Outcome(Status.NO_CHANGE)
        val driver = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.registeredHardwareDrivers.firstOrNull {
            it.descriptor.supportsWrite(request.firmwareTarget, request.transport)
        } ?: return Outcome(Status.BLOCKED, setOf(Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_DRIVER))
        return EcuWriteExecutionEngine(driver, journal, powerMonitor).run(request)
    }
}

/**
 * Internal engine; only production's registry-gated entry point can expose it.
 * Separately testable with an in-memory fake driver, without vehicle access.
 */
internal class EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
    private val driver: EcuProgrammingDriverContract,
    private val journal: EcuWriteTransaction.Journal,
    private val powerMonitor: EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor
) {
    suspend fun run(request: EcuWriteTransaction.Request): EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome {
        val plan = EcuWriteTransaction.prepare(request)
        if (!plan.canAttemptWithValidatedHardware) {
            return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                EcuWriteTransaction.Status.BLOCKED, plan.blockers
            )
        }
        if (plan.changedBytes == 0L) {
            return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.NO_CHANGE)
        }
        // Freeze caller-owned mutable arrays before any suspension/driver I/O.
        val original = request.originalImage.copyOf()
        val updated = request.updatedImage.copyOf()
        val preview = EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(request.layout, original, updated)
        if (!driver.descriptor.supportsWrite(request.firmwareTarget, request.transport)) {
            return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                EcuWriteTransaction.Status.BLOCKED,
                setOf(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_DRIVER)
            )
        }
        var verified = 0
        var currentAddress: Long? = null
        try {
            if (!powerMonitor.isStable()) {
                return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                    EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT
                )
            }
            val identity = driver.identify()
            if (identity != request.expectedIdentity) {
                return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                    EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT
                )
            }
            // Check EVERY sector before the first erase. Readback must be an
            // independent acquisition, not merely a copy of the planned BIN.
            for (sector in preview.affectedSectors) {
                currentAddress = sector.absoluteAddress
                val region = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest(
                    request.region, sector.absoluteAddress, sector.originalBytes.size.toLong()
                )
                if (!driver.read(region).contentEquals(sector.originalBytes) ||
                    !driver.independentReadback(region).contentEquals(sector.originalBytes)
                ) {
                    return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                        EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT,
                        verifiedSectors = verified,
                        failedAddress = currentAddress
                    )
                }
                journal.append(
                    EcuWriteTransaction.Record(
                        EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BASELINE_CHECKED,
                        request.region, sector.absoluteAddress,
                        sector.originalSha256, sector.updatedSha256
                    )
                )
            }
            for (sector in preview.affectedSectors) {
                currentAddress = sector.absoluteAddress
                val region = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest(
                    request.region, sector.absoluteAddress, sector.patchedBytes.size.toLong()
                )
                if (!powerMonitor.isStable()) {
                    return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                        EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT,
                        verifiedSectors = verified, failedAddress = currentAddress
                    )
                }
                // Journal must accept the irreversible step before any erase.
                journal.append(
                    EcuWriteTransaction.Record(
                        EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BEFORE_ERASE,
                        request.region, sector.absoluteAddress,
                        sector.originalSha256, sector.updatedSha256
                    )
                )
                driver.erase(region)
                val unitBytes = request.layout.programBlockBytes
                for (offset in sector.patchedBytes.indices step unitBytes) {
                    val unitAddress = sector.absoluteAddress + offset
                    currentAddress = unitAddress
                    if (!powerMonitor.isStable()) {
                        return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                            EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT,
                            verifiedSectors = verified, failedAddress = unitAddress
                        )
                    }
                    val unit = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest(
                        request.region, unitAddress, unitBytes.toLong()
                    )
                    driver.write(unit, sector.patchedBytes.copyOfRange(offset, offset + unitBytes))
                }
                currentAddress = sector.absoluteAddress
                if (!driver.independentReadback(region).contentEquals(sector.patchedBytes)) {
                    return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                        EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT,
                        verifiedSectors = verified, failedAddress = currentAddress
                    )
                }
                journal.append(
                    EcuWriteTransaction.Record(
                        EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.VERIFIED_AFTER_WRITE,
                        request.region, sector.absoluteAddress,
                        sector.originalSha256, sector.updatedSha256
                    )
                )
                verified++
            }
            return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                EcuWriteTransaction.Status.COMPLETED, verifiedSectors = verified
            )
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            throw cancelled
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            // No blind retry, reset, or automatic recovery after an uncertain
            // erase/write/transport failure. Preserve journal for bench triage.
            return EcuWriteTransaction.Outcome(
                EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT,
                verifiedSectors = verified, failedAddress = currentAddress
            )
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.net.SocketTimeoutException

/**
 * Keeps ordinary ELM commands from exposing a partial response as complete.
 * Streaming monitor commands are intentionally exempt because they terminate
 * through an explicit stop command rather than the normal ELM prompt.
 */
internal object ElmResponseCompletion {
    fun requirePrompt(command: String, streaming: Boolean, promptReceived: Boolean) {
        if (!streaming && !promptReceived) {
            throw SocketTimeoutException(
                "Timed out waiting for the ELM prompt after command: $command"
            )
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * SAE J1979 Mode 01 PID 52: ethanol fuel percentage, A * 100 / 255.
 *
 * A valid diagnostic response reports what the ECU exposes; it does NOT
 * establish the presence of a physical ethanol sensor, FlexFuel enablement,
 * or permission to change ECU calibrations.
 */
object EthanolContentPidDecoder {
    /** A response payload without CAN framing: 41 52 AA. */
    fun decode(response: ByteArray): Double? {
        if (response.size != 3 ||
            (response[0].toInt() and 0xFF) != 0x41 ||
            (response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) != 0x52
        ) return null
        return (response[2].toInt() and 0xFF) * 100.0 / 255.0
    }

    /** The corresponding supported-PID bit is in Mode 01 PID 40, bit 14 (PID 52). */
    fun isSupported(pid40Response: ByteArray): Boolean {
        if (pid40Response.size != 6 ||
            (pid40Response[0].toInt() and 0xFF) != 0x41 ||
            (pid40Response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) != 0x40
        ) return false
        // PIDs 41..60 are indexed from MSB of A; PID 52 is offset 18.
        val offset = 0x52 - 0x40
        val byteIndex = 2 + (offset - 1) / 8
        val mask = 0x80 ushr ((offset - 1) % 8)
        return (pid40Response[byteIndex].toInt() and mask) != 0
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.BufferedWriter
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter
import java.net.InetSocketAddress
import java.net.Socket
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * JSON-lines TCP client for the Windows J2534 bridge.
 * J2534 performs ISO-TP framing on the PC; this class exchanges complete UDS payloads.
 */
class J2534BridgeTransport(
    private val host: String,
    private val port: Int,
    private val pairingToken: String
) : UdsPayloadTransport {
    private val mutex = Mutex()
    @Volatile private var socket: Socket? = null
    private var reader: BufferedReader? = null
    private var writer: BufferedWriter? = null
    @Volatile private var opened = false
    @Volatile private var scopedMemoryReadEnabled = false

    /** True only when the authenticated PC bridge confirmed a VIN-bound memory scope. */
    val isScopedMemoryReadEnabled: Boolean
        get() = isConnected && scopedMemoryReadEnabled
    /** Close requested by the app, not a spontaneous I/O failure of the bridge. */
    @Volatile private var externallyClosed = false

    /** Reflects a live TCP session rather than just an allocated transport object. */
    val isConnected: Boolean
        get() = opened && socket?.let {
            it.isConnected && !it.isClosed && !it.isInputShutdown && !it.isOutputShutdown
        } == true

    suspend fun connect(
        requestCanId: Int,
        responseCanId: Int,
        can29Bit: Boolean,
        protocolNumber: Int = 33
    ): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        mutex.withLock {
            closeInternal()
            externallyClosed = false
            require(host.isNotBlank()) { "Adresse IP du PC manquante." }
            require(port in 1024..65535) { "Port du pont PC invalide." }
            require(pairingToken.isNotBlank()) { "Jeton d'appairage du pont PC manquant." }
            require(protocolNumber in setOf(33, 34, 35, 36, 63, 64)) { "Profil CAN J2534 non pris en charge." }
            val maxId = if (can29Bit) 0x1FFFFFFF else 0x7FF
            require(requestCanId in 0..maxId && responseCanId in 0..maxId && requestCanId != responseCanId) {
                "Identifiants CAN incompatibles avec le format sélectionné."
            }
            require(can29Bit == (protocolNumber in setOf(34, 36, 64))) {
                "La largeur des identifiants CAN ne correspond pas au profil sélectionné."
            }
            try {
                val connected = Socket()
                // Track the descriptor before connect: the failure path must
                // close it even when TCP establishment never completes.
                socket = connected
                connected.tcpNoDelay = true
                connected.connect(InetSocketAddress(host, port), 5000)
                connected.soTimeout = 12_000
                reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(connected.getInputStream(), Charsets.UTF_8))
                writer = BufferedWriter(OutputStreamWriter(connected.getOutputStream(), Charsets.UTF_8))
                val response = request(
                    JSONObject()
                        .put("op", "open")
                        .put("token", pairingToken)
                        .put("requestCanId", requestCanId.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(if (can29Bit) 8 else 3, '0'))
                        .put("responseCanId", responseCanId.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(if (can29Bit) 8 else 3, '0'))
                        .put("can29Bit", can29Bit)
                        .put("protocolNumber", protocolNumber),
                    10_000
                )
                scopedMemoryReadEnabled = response.optBoolean("scopedPhysicalMemoryRead", false)
                opened = true
                val adapter = response.optString("adapter", "J2534")
                val voltage = response.optLong("batteryMillivolts", -1L)
                val voltageLabel = if (voltage >= 0) {
                    String.format(Locale.getDefault(), " • %.2f V", voltage / 1000.0)
                } else ""
                "$adapter • ${response.optString("protocol", "ISO15765")} • ${response.optInt("baudRate")} bit/s$voltageLabel"
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                closeInternal()
                throw error
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun readCalibrationIdentification(): ObdEcuIdentification = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        mutex.withLock {
            ensureOpen()
            val data = request(JSONObject().put("op", "identify").put("token", pairingToken), 15_000)
                .getJSONObject("identity")
            fun records(name: String): List<String> {
                val values = data.getJSONArray(name)
                return List(values.length()) { index -> values.getString(index) }
            }
            ObdEcuIdentification(
                vin = if (data.isNull("vin")) null else data.getString("vin"),
                calibrationIds = records("calibrationIds"),
                calibrationVerificationNumbers = records("cvns"),
                ecuNames = records("ecuNames"),
                respondingEcuAddresses = listOf(data.getString("responseCanId"))
            )
        }
    }

    override suspend fun exchange(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        mutex.withLock {
            ensureOpen()
            require(payload.size in 1..4095) { "La requête UDS doit contenir entre 1 et 4095 octets." }
            val boundedTimeout = J2534BridgeProtocol.boundedTimeoutMs(timeoutMs)
            socket?.soTimeout = boundedTimeout + 3000
            val response = request(
                JSONObject()
                    .put("op", "exchange")
                    .put("token", pairingToken)
                    .put("payloadHex", payload.toHex())
                    .put("timeoutMs", boundedTimeout),
                boundedTimeout + 3000
            )
            val hex = response.optString("payloadHex")
            if (hex.isBlank() || hex.length % 2 != 0 || hex.length > 8190 ||
                !hex.all { it in '0'..'9' || it in 'A'..'F' || it in 'a'..'f' }
            ) {
                closeInternal()
                throw IllegalStateException("Réponse UDS vide, trop longue ou mal formée du pont J2534.")
            }
            hex.hexToBytes()
        }
    }

    override suspend fun sendOnly(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long) = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        mutex.withLock {
            ensureOpen()
            require(payload.size in 1..4095) { "La requête UDS doit contenir entre 1 et 4095 octets." }
            val boundedTimeout = timeoutMs.coerceIn(100L, 10_000L).toInt()
            request(
                JSONObject()
                    .put("op", "sendOnly")
                    .put("token", pairingToken)
                    .put("payloadHex", payload.toHex())
                    .put("timeoutMs", boundedTimeout),
                boundedTimeout + 3000
            )
            Unit
        }
    }

    private fun request(json: JSONObject, timeoutMs: Int): JSONObject {
        val activeSocket = socket ?: error("Pont PC J2534 non connecté.")
        activeSocket.soTimeout = timeoutMs.coerceIn(1000, 15_000)
        val output = writer ?: error("Canal d'écriture du pont PC indisponible.")
        val input = reader ?: error("Canal de lecture du pont PC indisponible.")
        val line = try {
            output.write(json.toString())
            output.newLine()
            output.flush()
            J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input)
                ?: throw java.io.EOFException("Le pont PC a fermé la connexion.")
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            val wasClosedByApp = externallyClosed
            closeInternal()
            // Closing the old PC bridge intentionally during a reconnect can
            // break a blocked read. Do not report that error against the new bridge.
            if (wasClosedByApp) throw ObdSupersededSessionException(error)
            throw error
        }
        val response = try {
            JSONObject(line)
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            closeInternal()
            throw IllegalStateException("Le pont J2534 a retourné une réponse JSON invalide.", error)
        }
        if (!response.optBoolean("ok", false)) {
            throw IllegalStateException(response.optString("error", "Erreur inconnue du pont J2534."))
        }
        return response
    }

    private fun ensureOpen() {
        check(isConnected) {
            "Connecte d'abord le pont PC J2534."
        }
    }

    fun close() {
        externallyClosed = true
        closeInternal()
    }

    private fun closeInternal() {
        // Closing the TCP socket is the release signal; the PC server disposes the J2534
        // channel when it observes EOF. Avoid a blocking read on the Android UI thread.
        runCatching { socket?.close() }
        runCatching { reader?.close() }
        runCatching { writer?.close() }
        reader = null
        writer = null
        socket = null
        opened = false
        scopedMemoryReadEnabled = false
    }

    private fun ByteArray.toHex(): String =
        joinToString("") { "%02X".format(Locale.ROOT, it.toInt() and 0xFF) }

    private fun String.hexToBytes(): ByteArray =
        chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
}

/** Bounded framing helpers for the untrusted JSON-lines PC bridge stream. */
internal object J2534BridgeProtocol {
    private const val MAX_RESPONSE_LINE_CHARS = 32 * 1024

    fun boundedTimeoutMs(timeoutMs: Long): Int = timeoutMs.coerceIn(100L, 10_000L).toInt()

    fun readBoundedLine(input: BufferedReader): String? {
        val line = StringBuilder()
        while (true) {
            val next = input.read()
            if (next == -1) {
                if (line.isEmpty()) return null
                break
            }
            if (next == '\n'.code) break
            if (next != '\r'.code) {
                check(line.length < MAX_RESPONSE_LINE_CHARS) {
                    "The J2534 bridge response exceeds the maximum allowed line size."
                }
                line.append(next.toChar())
            }
        }
        return line.toString()
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.io.OutputStream

/**
 * Real, non-destructive memory capture over a connected Windows J2534 PassThru bridge.
 *
 * There are NO built-in GM memory maps. Each address and length must be independently
 * documented and authorized by the PC-side VIN-bound --memory-read-profile. If the
 * controller refuses 0x23 or requires unavailable SecurityAccess, capture fails closed.
 *
 * A complete requested REGION is not necessarily a complete ECU image, and two
 * consistent reads do not prove that its bytes are restorable.
 */
object J2534LiveMemoryBackup {
    private const val MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024
    private const val TIMEOUT_MS = 6000L

    data class Request(
        val expectedVin: String,
        val region: EcuBackupCoverage.Region,
        val address: Long,
        val lengthBytes: Int,
        val chunkBytes: Int = 128,
        /** 1 = default session; 3 = extended diagnostics (PC scope must allow it). */
        val diagnosticSession: Int = 1,
        val controllerLabel: String? = null
    )

    /** Independent acquisition 1 or 2; byte counts describe actual ECU responses. */
    data class CaptureProgress(
        val pass: Int,
        val completedBytes: Int,
        val regionBytes: Int
    ) {
        init {
            require(pass in 1..2 && regionBytes > 0 && completedBytes in 0..regionBytes)
        }
        val totalBytesRead: Long get() = (pass - 1L) * regionBytes + completedBytes
        val requiredBytesRead: Long get() = regionBytes.toLong() * 2L
    }

    data class CaptureResult(
        val manifest: EcuBackupManifest.Manifest,
        val capture: EcuBackupManifest.Capture,
        val verification: EcuBackupIntegrity.Result
    ) {
        internal fun export(output: OutputStream) = EcuBackupArchive.export(
            output, listOf(capture), setOf(capture.region), manifest.controllerLabel,
            manifest.createdAtUtcMillis, manifest.vehicleVin
        )
    }

    /**
     * Production entry point: no simulator transport can be supplied.
     * This requires the actual PC bridge to be connected to a physical J2534 device.
     */
    suspend fun capture(
        bridge: J2534BridgeTransport,
        request: Request,
        progress: (CaptureProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): CaptureResult {
        check(bridge.isConnected && bridge.isScopedMemoryReadEnabled) {
            "A real J2534 bridge with an approved ECU memory read scope must be connected."
        }
        return acquire(bridge, request, EcuBackupManifest.Origin.REPORTED_HARDWARE_READ, progress)
    }

    suspend fun captureAndExport(
        bridge: J2534BridgeTransport,
        request: Request,
        output: OutputStream,
        progress: (CaptureProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): CaptureResult {
        val read = capture(bridge, request, progress)
        read.export(output)
        return read
    }

    /** Only fake transport may enter unit tests; fake data is never marked as hardware. */
    internal suspend fun captureForTest(
        transport: UdsPayloadTransport,
        request: Request,
        progress: (CaptureProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): CaptureResult =
        acquire(transport, request, EcuBackupManifest.Origin.SIMULATION, progress)

    private suspend fun acquire(
        transport: UdsPayloadTransport,
        request: Request,
        origin: EcuBackupManifest.Origin,
        progress: (CaptureProgress) -> Unit
    ): CaptureResult {
        require(request.expectedVin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}"))) { "Invalid target VIN." }
        require(request.address in 0L..0xFFFFFFFFL &&
            request.lengthBytes in 1..MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES &&
            request.address + request.lengthBytes <= 0x1_0000_0000L
        ) { "Invalid or overflowing ECU memory capture range." }
        require(request.chunkBytes in 1..256) { "J2534 memory read blocks must be 1..256 bytes." }
        require(request.diagnosticSession == 1 || request.diagnosticSession == 3) {
            "Only default and extended read sessions are supported."
        }

        suspend fun liveVin(): String {
            val response = transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()), TIMEOUT_MS)
            require(response.size == 20 &&
                response[0] == 0x62.toByte() &&
                response[1] == 0xF1.toByte() && response[2] == 0x90.toByte()
            ) { "ECU did not respond to DID F190 with a valid VIN." }
            val vin = response.copyOfRange(3, 20).toString(Charsets.US_ASCII)
            require(vin == request.expectedVin) { "Live ECU VIN differs from selected vehicle." }
            return vin
        }

        fun memoryRequest(address: Long, bytes: Int): ByteArray =
            byteArrayOf(0x23, 0x24) +
                byteArrayOf(
                    (address ushr 24).toByte(), (address ushr 16).toByte(),
                    (address ushr 8).toByte(), address.toByte(),
                    (bytes ushr 8).toByte(), bytes.toByte()
                )

        suspend fun pass(passNumber: Int): ByteArray {
            val image = ByteArray(request.lengthBytes)
            var offset = 0
            progress(CaptureProgress(passNumber, 0, image.size))
            var blocks = 0
            while (offset < image.size) {
                if (blocks > 0 && blocks % 32 == 0) {
                    val ping = transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x3E, 0x00), TIMEOUT_MS)
                    require(ping.size >= 2 && ping[0] == 0x7E.toByte()) {
                        "ECU no longer confirms its active diagnostic session."
                    }
                }
                val length = minOf(request.chunkBytes, image.size - offset)
                val response = transport.exchange(
                    memoryRequest(request.address + offset, length), TIMEOUT_MS
                )
                require(response.size == length + 1 && response[0] == 0x63.toByte()) {
                    "ECU memory response is not a complete ReadMemoryByAddress result."
                }
                response.copyInto(image, destinationOffset = offset, startIndex = 1)
                offset += length
                blocks++
                // Emit progress periodically rather than on every CAN frame.
                if (blocks % 16 == 0 || offset == image.size) {
                    progress(CaptureProgress(passNumber, offset, image.size))
                }
            }
            return image
        }

        liveVin()
        var enteredExtended = false
        try {
            if (request.diagnosticSession == 3) {
                val response = transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x10, 0x03), TIMEOUT_MS)
                require(response.size >= 2 && response[0] == 0x50.toByte() &&
                    response[1] == 0x03.toByte()) {
                    "ECU did not accept the extended read session."
                }
                enteredExtended = true
            }
            val first = pass(1)
            // A second independent hardware acquisition is compulsory.
            val second = pass(2)
            // VIN could change after a session replacement or reconnect.
            val observedVin = liveVin()
            require(first.contentEquals(second)) {
                "Two physical memory acquisitions disagree; do not export this backup."
            }
            val capture = EcuBackupManifest.Capture(
                region = request.region,
                startAddress = request.address,
                expectedBytes = request.lengthBytes.toLong(),
                firstRead = first,
                independentRead = second,
                origin = origin
            )
            val required = setOf(request.region)
            val manifest = EcuBackupManifest.inspect(
                request.controllerLabel, System.currentTimeMillis(), listOf(capture), required, observedVin
            )
            val verification = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(manifest, listOf(capture), required)
            check(verification.consistent) { "Physical ECU memory backup failed integrity checks." }
            return CaptureResult(manifest, capture, verification)
        } finally {
            if (enteredExtended) {
                // Best-effort return to default session. If the bridge vanished,
                // there must be no automatic reconnect or write/recovery attempt.
                runCatching { transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x10, 0x01), TIMEOUT_MS) }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Published service-parts references for the Camaro Gen 5 2012 LFX 3.6L.
 *
 * Service parts and supersessions are not ECU firmware identifiers.
 * They must NEVER be used to automatically approve an ECU flash/calibration.
 */
object Lfx2012ControllerReferences {
    const val controllerFamily = "E39"
    const val currentServicePart = "12651994"
    const val supersededServicePart = "12643248"
    const val associatedMainBootFile = "12632286"

        "https://www.gmpartsgiant.com/parts-list/2012-chevrolet-camaro-coupe/fuel_system_exhaust_emission_system/e_c_m_module_wiring_harness.html"

    data class ServicePartGroup(
        val servicePart: String,
        val replaces: List<String>,
        val exampleLabel: String,
        val catalogBootFile: String? = null
    )

    // Camaro MY2012 V6 catalog supersessions. A predecessor can also appear on
    // other models. The label on one donor identifies only that physical part.
    // 12653998 is deliberately excluded: GM bulletin PIC5696A limits it to MY2013.

            servicePart = currentServicePart,
            replaces = listOf(supersededServicePart),
            exampleLabel = "Serv# 12643248 · 12648906 · AA69",

        // https://www.chevypartsdeal.com/oem/gm~engine-control-module-w-2nd-mpu~12651993

            servicePart = "12651993",
            replaces = listOf("12637106", "12642665", "12650256", "12616889"),
            exampleLabel = "Serv# 12637106 · 12637489 · AAMU"

    )

    data class Label(val serviceNumber: String, val partNumber: String, val bcc: String)

    // Individual MY2012 3.6L catalog records, searchable by their printed identifiers.
    // The BCC on a replacement part does not attest to the software currently installed.
    // https://www.fs1inc.com/2012-chevrolet-camaro-3-6l-ecm-engine-computer-pcm-ecu-programmed-plug-play.html
    private val catalogLabels = listOf(
        Label("12616889", "12635821", "AAKG"),
        Label("12616889", "12636333", "AALW"),
        Label("12637106", "12636635", "AAL9"),
        Label("12637106", "12637157", "AAMK"),
        Label("12637106", "12637489", "AAMU"),
        Label("12637106", "12639985", "AAUB"),
        Label("12637106", "12639986", "AAUC"),
        Label("12637106", "12640385", "AAUL"),
        Label("12642665", "12641497", "AAWD"),
        Label("12642665", "12642569", "AAXP"),
        Label("12642665", "12642612", "AAXS"),
        Label("12642665", "12642843", "AAXY"),
        Label("12642665", "12642856", "AAX1"),
        Label("12642665", "12643469", "AAYY"),
        Label("12642665", "12643542", "AAZA"),
        Label("12642665", "12646438", "AA3Y"),
        Label("12642665", "12646944", "AA4G"),

        Label("12651994", "12655480", "ABMY"),
        Label("12651994", "12663029", "AB3M")
    )

    fun findLabels(query: String): List<Label> {
        val value = query.trim()
        if (value.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return catalogLabels.filter {
            it.serviceNumber == value || it.partNumber == value || it.bcc.equals(value, ignoreCase = true)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Service numbers can be superseded and printed part numbers/BCC labels may
     * represent different calibrations on the same ECU protocol family.
     * Resolve them to the catalogued family without pretending that they are
     * separate communication drivers or proven identical circuit boards.
     */
    enum class CatalogReferenceKind {
        CURRENT_SERVICE_NUMBER, SUPERSEDED_SERVICE_NUMBER, PRINTED_PART_NUMBER, BROADCAST_CODE
    }

    data class CatalogReference(
        val family: String,
        val serviceGroup: String,
        val kind: CatalogReferenceKind,
        val queriedReference: String
    ) {
        /** A matching catalogue reference must never grant flash permission. */
        val authorizesProgramming: Boolean get() = false
    }

    fun resolveCatalogReference(reference: String): List<CatalogReference> {
        val query = reference.trim().uppercase()
        if (query.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return servicePartGroups.mapNotNull { group ->
            val knownServiceNumbers = (group.replaces + group.servicePart).toSet()
            val match = when {
                query == group.servicePart -> CatalogReferenceKind.CURRENT_SERVICE_NUMBER
                query in group.replaces -> CatalogReferenceKind.SUPERSEDED_SERVICE_NUMBER
                catalogLabels.any {
                    it.serviceNumber in knownServiceNumbers && it.partNumber == query
                } -> CatalogReferenceKind.PRINTED_PART_NUMBER
                catalogLabels.any {
                    it.serviceNumber in knownServiceNumbers && it.bcc.equals(query, ignoreCase = true)
                } -> CatalogReferenceKind.BROADCAST_CODE
                else -> null
            }
            match?.let { CatalogReference(controllerFamily, group.servicePart, it, query) }
        }
    }

    data class ObservedIdentity(
        val ecuName: String?,
        val calibrationIds: List<String>,
        val calibrationVerificationNumbers: List<String>,
        val simulated: Boolean = false
    )

    /**
     * These observations are informational only. A CAL ID/CVN is not a service part
     * number; an ECU name mentioning E39 does not validate memory layout or recovery.
     */
    fun hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(observed: ObservedIdentity): Boolean =
        !observed.simulated &&
            hasMeaningfulComponent(observed.ecuName.orEmpty()) &&
            observed.calibrationIds.any(::hasMeaningfulComponent) &&
            observed.calibrationVerificationNumbers.any(::hasMeaningfulComponent)

    // Identification responses may contain several CAL IDs/CVNs joined into one
    // display string. Validate each item, not the concatenation of placeholders.
    private fun hasMeaningfulComponent(response: String): Boolean =
        response.split('\r', '\n', '|', ';').any(::isMeaningfulIdentifier)

    /**
     * Reject demo/placeholder diagnostic fields before presenting an ECU
     * identification as complete. A complete fingerprint is still informational;
     * it never establishes a safe firmware, memory layout or flash procedure.
     */
    private fun isMeaningfulIdentifier(raw: String?): Boolean {
        val value = raw?.trim()?.uppercase().orEmpty()
        if (value.isEmpty() || value in setOf("N/A", "NONE", "NULL", "-", "?")) return false
        // ELM and diagnostic placeholders must never count as observed ECU evidence.
        // Reject placeholder tokens even when the response prefixes them with "ECU:".
        val placeholder = Regex(
            "(?i)(?:^|[^A-Z0-9])(?:UNKNOWN|UNAVAILABLE|DEMO|SIMULATED|SAMPLE|" +
                "INVALID|NOT AVAILABLE|NOT SUPPORTED|NO DATA|NO RESPONSE|PENDING|" +
                "TBD|TEST|ERROR|STOPPED)(?:$|[^A-Z0-9])"
        )
        if (placeholder.containsMatchIn(value)) return false
        // Some adapters format zero/FF responses with hex prefixes and separators.
        val compact = value.removePrefix("0X").replace(Regex("[\\s:_-]"), "")
        if (compact.isEmpty()) return false
        if (compact.all { it == '0' } || compact.all { it == 'F' }) return false
        return true
    }

    /** Candidate E39/E39A family label, not proof of a specific physical ECU or firmware. */
    fun hasCandidateE39FamilyLabel(ecuName: String?): Boolean =
        ecuName?.let { name ->
            hasMeaningfulComponent(name) &&
                Regex("(?i)(?:^|[^A-Z0-9])E39A?(?:$|[^A-Z0-9])").containsMatchIn(name)
        } ?: false

    /**
     * Distinguishes an unknown, single or mixed responder set observed during Mode 09.
     * Even one response address does not prove which physical ECU supplied a CAL ID,
     * that the ECU is an ECM, or that its firmware is compatible with writing.
     */
    enum class ResponderAttribution {
        NO_VALID_CAN_ADDRESS,
        SINGLE_ADDRESS_OBSERVED,
        MULTIPLE_ADDRESSES_OBSERVED
    }

    fun classifyResponderAttribution(respondingAddresses: Collection<String>): ResponderAttribution {
        val rawAddresses = respondingAddresses.map(String::trim).filter(String::isNotEmpty)
        if (rawAddresses.isEmpty()) return ResponderAttribution.NO_VALID_CAN_ADDRESS
        val validAddress = Regex("(?:[0-9A-F]{3}|[0-9A-F]{8})")
        val normalized = rawAddresses.map { it.uppercase().removePrefix("0X") }
        if (normalized.any { !validAddress.matches(it) }) {
            return ResponderAttribution.NO_VALID_CAN_ADDRESS
        }
        return if (normalized.distinct().size == 1) {
            ResponderAttribution.SINGLE_ADDRESS_OBSERVED
        } else {
            ResponderAttribution.MULTIPLE_ADDRESSES_OBSERVED
        }
    }

    fun describedServiceParts(): List<String> =
        servicePartGroups.flatMap { listOf(it.servicePart) + it.replaces }
}
