package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Conservative preflight for the first FlexFuel target: the 2012 Camaro LFX.
 *
 * A matching vehicle profile does not prove ECU calibration compatibility.
 * Until the exact controller/firmware, verified backup and recovery procedure
 * have been established, no calibration write is authorized.
 */
object Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight {
    enum class Status {
        VEHICLE_NOT_SELECTED,
        WRONG_VEHICLE,
        VIN_MISMATCH,
        ECU_IDENTITY_MISSING,
        ECU_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED,
        FIRMWARE_NOT_VERIFIED,
        ORIGINAL_BACKUP_MISSING,
        RECOVERY_NOT_VERIFIED,
        WRITE_NOT_VALIDATED
    }

    data class Vehicle(
        val modelYear: Int,
        val engineCode: String,
        val generation: Int,
        val selectedVin: String?,
        val ecuVin: String?
    )

    data class Evidence(
        val controllerId: String?,
        val firmwareId: String?,
        val verifiedFirmware: Boolean,
        val originalBackupVerified: Boolean,
        val recoveryVerified: Boolean
    )

    /**
     * Return all missing preconditions. WRITE_NOT_VALIDATED is always present
     * until a separate, vehicle-verified calibration implementation exists.
     */
    fun missingPreconditions(vehicle: Vehicle?, evidence: Evidence): List<Status> {
        if (vehicle == null) return listOf(Status.VEHICLE_NOT_SELECTED)
        if (vehicle.modelYear != 2012 ||
            vehicle.generation != 5 ||
            !vehicle.engineCode.trim().equals("LFX", ignoreCase = true)
        ) return listOf(Status.WRONG_VEHICLE)

        val problems = mutableListOf<Status>()
        val selectedVin = vehicle.selectedVin?.trim()?.uppercase()
        val ecuVin = vehicle.ecuVin?.trim()?.uppercase()
        if (!isVin(selectedVin) || !isVin(ecuVin) || selectedVin != ecuVin) {
            problems += Status.VIN_MISMATCH
        }
        if (evidence.controllerId.isNullOrBlank() || evidence.firmwareId.isNullOrBlank()) {
            problems += Status.ECU_IDENTITY_MISSING
        }
        if (isPlaceholderIdentity(evidence.controllerId) || isPlaceholderIdentity(evidence.firmwareId)) problems += Status.ECU_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED
        if (!evidence.verifiedFirmware) problems += Status.FIRMWARE_NOT_VERIFIED
        if (!evidence.originalBackupVerified) problems += Status.ORIGINAL_BACKUP_MISSING
        if (!evidence.recoveryVerified) problems += Status.RECOVERY_NOT_VERIFIED
        problems += Status.WRITE_NOT_VALIDATED
        return problems
    }

    /** No ECU writes are supported until a separately validated implementation exists. */
    fun canWriteCalibration(vehicle: Vehicle?, evidence: Evidence): Boolean =
        missingPreconditions(vehicle, evidence).isEmpty()

    private fun isPlaceholderIdentity(value: String?): Boolean {
        val normalized = value?.trim()?.lowercase().orEmpty()
        if (normalized.isEmpty() || normalized == "n/a" ||
            normalized == "none" || normalized == "null" || normalized == "-"
        ) return true
        val placeholders = Regex(
            "(?:^|[^a-z0-9])(?:unknown|demo|sample|simulated|invalid|" +
                "not available|not supported|unavailable|no data|no response|" +
                "pending|tbd|test|error|stopped)(?:$|[^a-z0-9])"
        )
        if (placeholders.containsMatchIn(normalized)) return true
        // Some ELM responses include a 0x prefix, spaces or separators.
        // Remove them before checking for missing data filled with 00 or FF.
        val bytes = normalized.removePrefix("0x").replace(Regex("[\\s:_-]"), "")
        return bytes.isEmpty() || bytes.all { it == '0' } || bytes.all { it == 'f' }
    }

    private fun isVin(value: String?): Boolean =
        value != null && value.length == 17 && value.all {
            it in 'A'..'Z' && it != 'I' && it != 'O' && it != 'Q' || it in '0'..'9'
        }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Non-destructive before/after evidence checklist for a 2012 Camaro LFX ECM.
 * A successful flash response alone never proves the vehicle is operational.
 * No active controller adaptations or clutch-pedal relearns are issued here.
 */
object Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit {
    enum class Item {
        VEHICLE_VIN,
        ECU_NAME,
        CALIBRATION_ID,
        CALIBRATION_VERIFICATION_NUMBER,
        DIAGNOSTIC_TROUBLE_CODES,
        VOLTAGE,
        COMMUNICATION,
        VEHICLE_FUNCTIONAL_CHECK,
        OEM_RELEARN_REQUIREMENTS
    }
    enum class CheckStatus { OBSERVED, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_PERFORMED, REQUIRES_REVIEW }
    enum class Overall { NOT_PERFORMED, INCOMPLETE, REQUIRES_REVIEW, READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW }

    data class Snapshot(
        val vin: String?,
        val ecuName: String?,
        val calibrationIds: List<String>,
        val verificationNumbers: List<String>,
        val dtcs: List<String>?,
        val voltage: Double?,
        val communicationConfirmed: Boolean,
        val functionalCheckPassed: Boolean?,
        val oemRelearnReviewed: Boolean,
        val capturedAtUtcMillis: Long
    )

    data class Check(val item: Item, val status: CheckStatus)
    data class Report(
        val before: List<Check>,
        val after: List<Check>,
        val overall: Overall,
        val physicalValidationComplete: Boolean = false
    )

    fun review(before: Snapshot?, after: Snapshot?): Report {
        val original = before?.let(::checks).orEmpty()
        val current = after?.let(::checks).orEmpty()
        if (before == null || after == null) {
            return Report(original, current, Overall.NOT_PERFORMED)
        }
        val vinChanged = !before.vin.isNullOrBlank() && !after.vin.isNullOrBlank() &&
            !before.vin.equals(after.vin, ignoreCase = true)
        val hasUnavailable = original.any {
            it.status == CheckStatus.UNAVAILABLE || it.status == CheckStatus.NOT_PERFORMED
        } || current.any {
            it.status == CheckStatus.UNAVAILABLE || it.status == CheckStatus.NOT_PERFORMED
        }
        val requiresReview = vinChanged ||
            after.capturedAtUtcMillis <= before.capturedAtUtcMillis ||
            original.any { it.status == CheckStatus.REQUIRES_REVIEW } ||
            current.any { it.status == CheckStatus.REQUIRES_REVIEW }
        return Report(
            before = original,
            after = current,
            overall = when {
                requiresReview -> Overall.REQUIRES_REVIEW
                hasUnavailable -> Overall.INCOMPLETE
                else -> Overall.READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW
            }
        )
    }

    private fun checks(snapshot: Snapshot): List<Check> {
        fun reported(text: String?): CheckStatus =
            if (text.isNullOrBlank()) CheckStatus.UNAVAILABLE else CheckStatus.OBSERVED
        return listOf(
            Check(Item.VEHICLE_VIN, reported(snapshot.vin)),
            Check(Item.ECU_NAME, reported(snapshot.ecuName)),
            Check(Item.CALIBRATION_ID, if (snapshot.calibrationIds.any(String::isNotBlank))
                CheckStatus.OBSERVED else CheckStatus.UNAVAILABLE),
            Check(Item.CALIBRATION_VERIFICATION_NUMBER,
                if (snapshot.verificationNumbers.any(String::isNotBlank))
                    CheckStatus.OBSERVED else CheckStatus.UNAVAILABLE),
            Check(Item.DIAGNOSTIC_TROUBLE_CODES,
                if (snapshot.dtcs == null) CheckStatus.UNAVAILABLE else CheckStatus.OBSERVED),
            Check(Item.VOLTAGE,
                if (snapshot.voltage == null || !snapshot.voltage.isFinite())
                    CheckStatus.UNAVAILABLE else CheckStatus.OBSERVED),
            Check(Item.COMMUNICATION,
                if (snapshot.communicationConfirmed) CheckStatus.OBSERVED
                    else CheckStatus.REQUIRES_REVIEW),
            Check(Item.VEHICLE_FUNCTIONAL_CHECK,
                when (snapshot.functionalCheckPassed) {
                    null -> CheckStatus.NOT_PERFORMED
                    true -> CheckStatus.OBSERVED
                    false -> CheckStatus.REQUIRES_REVIEW
                }),
            Check(Item.OEM_RELEARN_REQUIREMENTS,
                if (snapshot.oemRelearnReviewed) CheckStatus.OBSERVED
                    else CheckStatus.NOT_PERFORMED)
        )
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.hardware.usb.UsbManager
import android.os.Build
import com.hoho.android.usbserial.driver.UsbSerialPort
import com.hoho.android.usbserial.driver.UsbSerialProber
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.net.InetSocketAddress
import java.net.Socket

/** USB serial ELM/STN transport. Device permission is requested by Android when opened. */
class ElmUsbTransport(private val context: Context) {

    private val usbManager =
        context.getSystemService(Context.USB_SERVICE) as UsbManager

    @Volatile private var port: UsbSerialPort? = null
    @Volatile private var connection: android.hardware.usb.UsbDeviceConnection? = null
    @Volatile private var connectionLost = false

    val isConnected: Boolean
        get() = port != null && connection != null && !connectionLost

    fun availableDevices(): List<String> =
        UsbSerialProber.getDefaultProber()
            .findAllDrivers(usbManager)
            .map {
                "${it.device.productName ?: "USB OBD"} (#${it.device.deviceId})"
            }

    suspend fun connect(
        deviceId: Int,
        baudRate: Int = 38400
    ): Result<Unit> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        close()
        try {
            val driver = UsbSerialProber.getDefaultProber()
                .findAllDrivers(usbManager)
                .firstOrNull { it.device.deviceId == deviceId }
                ?: return@withContext Result.failure(
                    IllegalArgumentException("USB serial OBD device not found")
                )

            if (!usbManager.hasPermission(driver.device)) {
                val intent = Intent(UsbPermissionReceiver.ACTION)
                    .setPackage(context.packageName)

                val flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or
                    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) {
                        PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE
                    } else {
                        0
                    }

                val permissionIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                    context,
                    deviceId,
                    intent,
                    flags
                )

                usbManager.requestPermission(driver.device, permissionIntent)

                return@withContext Result.failure(
                    SecurityException(
                        "Autorisation USB demandée. Validez la fenêtre Android puis reconnectez l'adaptateur."
                    )
                )
            }

            val conn = usbManager.openDevice(driver.device)
                ?: return@withContext Result.failure(
                    IllegalStateException("Unable to open USB OBD device")
                )
            // Track ownership before subsequent setup so every failure releases
            // the USB device handle, including missing-port and serial-open errors.
            connection = conn

            val serial = driver.ports.firstOrNull() ?: run {
                close()
                return@withContext Result.failure<Unit>(
                    IllegalStateException("No USB serial port")
                )
            }

            port = serial
            serial.open(conn)
            serial.setParameters(
                baudRate,
                8,
                UsbSerialPort.STOPBITS_1,
                UsbSerialPort.PARITY_NONE
            )
            connectionLost = false

            Result.success(Unit)

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            close()
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    fun write(data: ByteArray) {
        if (connectionLost) throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("USB OBD adapter disconnected")
        val activePort = port ?: throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("USB OBD adapter is not connected")
        try {
            activePort.write(data, 1500)
        } catch (error: java.io.IOException) {
            if (port === activePort) connectionLost = true
            throw error
        }
    }

    fun read(buffer: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Int): Int {
        if (connectionLost) throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("USB OBD adapter disconnected")
        val activePort = port ?: run {
            connectionLost = true
            return -1
        }
        return try {
            activePort.read(buffer, timeoutMs).also { count ->
                if (count < 0 && port === activePort) connectionLost = true
            }
        } catch (error: java.io.IOException) {
            if (port === activePort) connectionLost = true
            throw error
        }
    }

    fun close() {
        try {
            port?.close()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }

        try {
            connection?.close()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }

        port = null
        connection = null
        connectionLost = false
    }
}

/** TCP transport for Wi-Fi ELM327 adapters; common defaults are configurable by the caller. */
class ElmWifiTransport {

    @Volatile private var socket: Socket? = null
    @Volatile private var connectionLost = false

    val isConnected: Boolean
        get() = socket?.let { it.isConnected && !it.isClosed && !it.isInputShutdown && !it.isOutputShutdown && !connectionLost } == true

    suspend fun connect(
        host: String,
        port: Int = 35000,
        timeoutMs: Int = 4000
    ): Result<Unit> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            close()

            val s = Socket()
            // Publish the socket before connect so a failed attempt can close it.
            socket = s
            s.connect(InetSocketAddress(host, port), timeoutMs)
            s.soTimeout = 1200
            connectionLost = false

            Result.success(Unit)

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            close()
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    fun write(data: ByteArray) {
        if (connectionLost) throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("Wi-Fi OBD adapter disconnected")
        val activeSocket = socket ?: throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("Wi-Fi OBD adapter is not connected")
        try {
            activeSocket.getOutputStream().write(data)
        } catch (error: java.io.IOException) {
            if (socket === activeSocket) connectionLost = true
            throw error
        }
    }

    fun read(buffer: ByteArray): Int {
        if (connectionLost) throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("Wi-Fi OBD adapter disconnected")
        val activeSocket = socket ?: run {
            connectionLost = true
            return -1
        }
        return try {
            activeSocket.getInputStream().read(buffer).also { count ->
                if (count < 0 && socket === activeSocket) connectionLost = true
            }
        } catch (timeout: java.net.SocketTimeoutException) {
            // A read timeout is normal while waiting for the ELM prompt.
            throw timeout
        } catch (error: java.io.IOException) {
            if (socket === activeSocket) connectionLost = true
            throw error
        }
    }

    fun close() {
        try {
            socket?.close()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }

        socket = null
        connectionLost = false
    }
}

class UsbPermissionReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {

    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        // Android USB permission result is reflected by UsbManager.hasPermission().
    }

    companion object {
        const val ACTION = "com.camarodiag.gen5.USB_PERMISSION"
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothDevice
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothGatt
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothGattCallback
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothGattCharacteristic
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothGattDescriptor
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothProfile
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothStatusCodes
import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.selects.select
import java.util.UUID

/**
 * OBDLink CX BLE serial transport.
 *
 * CX uses the documented OBDLink custom UART service FFF0, notifications FFF1
 * and writes FFF2. It is intentionally separate from Bluetooth Classic SPP.
 */
@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
internal class OBDLinkBleTransport(private val context: Context) {
    private val serviceUuid = UUID.fromString("0000FFF0-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB")
    private val notifyUuid = UUID.fromString("0000FFF1-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB")
    private val writeUuid = UUID.fromString("0000FFF2-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB")
    private val cccdUuid = UUID.fromString("00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB")

    @Volatile private var gatt: BluetoothGatt? = null
    private var writeCharacteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic? = null
    private var mtuPayload = 20
    private var characteristicWriteType = BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT
    /** True only while the current GATT session has not reported a disconnect. */
    val isConnected: Boolean
        get() = gatt != null && connectionFailure == null

    private val incoming = Channel<ByteArray>(Channel.UNLIMITED)
    private var pending = ByteArray(0)
    @Volatile private var connectionFailure: Throwable? = null

    private var connectResult: CompletableDeferred<Unit>? = null
    private var writeResult: CompletableDeferred<Unit>? = null
    /** Serializes GATT writes so callbacks cannot complete the wrong operation. */
    private val writeMutex = Mutex()
    /** Only one reader may consume the shared response buffer at a time. */
    private val readMutex = Mutex()
    private val readWakeup = ObdReadWakeup()
    private var mtuResult: CompletableDeferred<Unit>? = null

    private val callback = object : BluetoothGattCallback() {
        override fun onConnectionStateChange(g: BluetoothGatt, status: Int, newState: Int) {
            // Ignore callbacks from a GATT instance that was closed/replaced by a reconnect.
            if (g !== gatt) return
            if (status != BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) {
                val failure = ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE connection failed (status $status)")
                connectionFailure = failure
                connectResult?.completeExceptionally(failure)
                writeResult?.completeExceptionally(failure)
                readWakeup.signal(failure)
                return
            }
            if (newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_CONNECTED) {
                if (!g.discoverServices()) {
                    connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("BLE service discovery could not start"))
                }
            } else if (newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_DISCONNECTED) {
                val failure = ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE disconnected")
                connectionFailure = failure
                connectResult?.completeExceptionally(failure)
                writeResult?.completeExceptionally(failure)
                // Wake a reader waiting for notifications so it can surface the disconnect.
                readWakeup.signal(failure)
            }
        }

        override fun onServicesDiscovered(g: BluetoothGatt, status: Int) {
            if (g !== gatt) return
            if (status != BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) {
                connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("BLE service discovery failed ($status)"))
                return
            }
            val service = g.getService(serviceUuid)
            val notify = service?.getCharacteristic(notifyUuid)
            val write = service?.getCharacteristic(writeUuid)
            if (notify == null || write == null) {
                connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("OBDLink BLE UART service FFF0/FFF1/FFF2 not found"))
                return
            }
            val notificationValue = when {
                notify.properties and BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_NOTIFY != 0 ->
                    BluetoothGattDescriptor.ENABLE_NOTIFICATION_VALUE
                notify.properties and BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_INDICATE != 0 ->
                    BluetoothGattDescriptor.ENABLE_INDICATION_VALUE
                else -> {
                    connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("OBDLink BLE receive characteristic does not support notifications or indications"))
                    return
                }
            }
            characteristicWriteType = when {
                write.properties and BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE != 0 ->
                    BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT
                write.properties and BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE_NO_RESPONSE != 0 ->
                    BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE
                else -> {
                    connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("OBDLink BLE transmit characteristic does not support writes"))
                    return
                }
            }
            writeCharacteristic = write
            if (!g.setCharacteristicNotification(notify, true)) {
                connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("Unable to enable OBDLink BLE notifications"))
                return
            }
            val descriptor = notify.getDescriptor(cccdUuid)
            if (descriptor == null) {
                connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("BLE notification descriptor not found"))
                return
            }
            val started = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
                g.writeDescriptor(descriptor, notificationValue) == BluetoothStatusCodes.SUCCESS
            } else {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                descriptor.value = notificationValue
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                g.writeDescriptor(descriptor)
            }
            if (!started) {
                connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("Unable to subscribe to OBDLink BLE notifications"))
            }
        }

        override fun onDescriptorWrite(g: BluetoothGatt, descriptor: BluetoothGattDescriptor, status: Int) {
            if (g !== gatt) return
            if (status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) connectResult?.complete(Unit)
            else connectResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("BLE notification subscription failed ($status)"))
        }

        override fun onMtuChanged(g: BluetoothGatt, mtu: Int, status: Int) {
            if (g !== gatt) return
            if (status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) mtuPayload = (mtu - 3).coerceAtLeast(20)
            mtuResult?.complete(Unit)
        }

        override fun onCharacteristicWrite(g: BluetoothGatt, characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic, status: Int) {
            if (g !== gatt) return
            if (status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) writeResult?.complete(Unit)
            else writeResult?.completeExceptionally(IllegalStateException("BLE write failed ($status)"))
        }

        override fun onCharacteristicChanged(g: BluetoothGatt, characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic) {
            if (g !== gatt) return
            if (characteristic.uuid == notifyUuid) {
                readLegacyNotificationValue(characteristic)?.let { incoming.trySend(it) }
            }
        }

        override fun onCharacteristicChanged(
            g: BluetoothGatt,
            characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic,
            value: ByteArray
        ) {
            if (g !== gatt) return
            if (characteristic.uuid == notifyUuid) incoming.trySend(value.copyOf())
        }
    }

    suspend fun connect(device: BluetoothDevice): Result<Unit> {
        return try {
            close()
            connectionFailure = null
            connectResult = CompletableDeferred()
            gatt = device.connectGatt(context, false, callback, BluetoothDevice.TRANSPORT_LE)
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Unable to create BLE connection")
            withTimeout(15_000) { connectResult!!.await() }
            mtuResult = CompletableDeferred()
            gatt?.requestMtu(247)
            withTimeoutOrNull(3_000) { mtuResult?.await() }
            Result.success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            close()
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    suspend fun write(data: ByteArray) = writeMutex.withLock {
        var writeSession: BluetoothGatt? = null
        try {
            connectionFailure?.let {
                throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE connection is unavailable", it)
            }
            val g = gatt ?: error("BLE transport not connected")
            writeSession = g
            val characteristic = writeCharacteristic ?: error("OBDLink BLE write characteristic unavailable")
            var offset = 0
            while (offset < data.size) {
                // A disconnect may arrive between BLE chunks.
                connectionFailure?.let {
                    throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE disconnected during write", it)
                }
                check(gatt === g) { "BLE transport session was replaced during write" }
                val count = minOf(mtuPayload, data.size - offset)
                val chunk = data.copyOfRange(offset, offset + count)
                val result = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
                writeResult = result
                val started = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
                    g.writeCharacteristic(characteristic, chunk, characteristicWriteType) == BluetoothStatusCodes.SUCCESS
                } else {
                    writeLegacyCharacteristic(g, characteristic, chunk)
                }
                check(started) { "Unable to start OBDLink BLE write" }
                // Also wait for WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE: it skips the peer's ATT
                // acknowledgement, but Android still reports local GATT completion.
                // Sending the next chunk before this callback can make Android reject
                // it as GATT_BUSY and silently truncate an ELM command.
                withTimeout(4_000) { result.await() }
                check(gatt === g) { "BLE transport session was replaced during write" }
                offset += count
            }
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            // GATT callbacks carry no operation identifier. After a timeout or
            // cancellation, a late callback could otherwise complete the next write.
            // Retire this GATT instance so callbacks from it can never affect a retry.
            writeSession?.let { invalidateSession(it, error) }
            throw error
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retires a GATT session after an ambiguous write outcome. A late callback from
     * this instance is ignored because callbacks verify identity against [gatt].
     * The failure remains visible until connect() starts a fresh session.
     */
    private fun invalidateSession(expectedGatt: BluetoothGatt, cause: Throwable) {
        // A reconnect may have replaced this session while the old coroutine was
        // unwinding. Never let an old write tear down the newly connected adapter.
        if (gatt !== expectedGatt) return
        connectionFailure = cause
        connectResult?.completeExceptionally(cause)
        writeResult?.completeExceptionally(cause)
        mtuResult?.completeExceptionally(cause)

        val failedGatt = gatt
        gatt = null
        writeCharacteristic = null
        characteristicWriteType = BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT
        mtuPayload = 20
        pending = ByteArray(0)
        readWakeup.signal(cause)

        connectResult = null
        writeResult = null
        mtuResult = null

        try { failedGatt?.disconnect() } catch (_: Exception) {}
        try { failedGatt?.close() } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    /**
     * Android before API 33 has no value parameter on onCharacteristicChanged,
     * so the deprecated getter is required only for that legacy callback.
     */
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun readLegacyNotificationValue(characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic): ByteArray? =
        characteristic.value?.copyOf()

    /** Isolates deprecated characteristic setters used only by Android before API 33. */
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun writeLegacyCharacteristic(
        bluetoothGatt: BluetoothGatt,
        characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic,
        chunk: ByteArray
    ): Boolean {
        characteristic.writeType = characteristicWriteType
        characteristic.value = chunk
        return bluetoothGatt.writeCharacteristic(characteristic)
    }

    suspend fun read(buffer: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Int): Int = readMutex.withLock {
        connectionFailure?.let { throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE disconnected while reading", it) }
        val readSession = gatt
            ?: throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE is not connected", connectionFailure)
        if (pending.isEmpty()) {
            val wakeup = readWakeup.beginWait()
            try {
                // close() can run after readSession is captured but before beginWait().
                // In that ordering its one-shot wakeup has no waiter to signal, so
                // verify the GATT identity again before entering the suspending select.
                if (gatt !== readSession) {
                    throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException(
                        "OBDLink BLE session changed before reading",
                        connectionFailure
                    )
                }
                // Recheck after registering to close the race with a disconnect callback.
                connectionFailure?.let(wakeup::complete)
                val packet = withTimeoutOrNull(timeoutMs.toLong()) {
                    select<ByteArray> {
                        // select is biased: prefer the close signal if both clauses are ready.
                        wakeup.onAwait { cause ->
                            throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException(
                                "OBDLink BLE disconnected while reading",
                                cause
                            )
                        }
                        incoming.onReceive { it }
                    }
                } ?: run {
                    if (gatt !== readSession) {
                        throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException(
                            "OBDLink BLE session changed while reading",
                            connectionFailure
                        )
                    }
                    connectionFailure?.let {
                        throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE disconnected while reading", it)
                    }
                    return@withLock 0
                }
                connectionFailure?.let {
                    throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE disconnected while reading", it)
                }
                if (gatt !== readSession) {
                    throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException(
                        "OBDLink BLE session changed while reading",
                        connectionFailure
                    )
                }
                pending = packet
            } finally {
                readWakeup.endWait(wakeup)
            }
        }
        val count = minOf(buffer.size, pending.size)
        pending.copyInto(buffer, 0, 0, count)
        pending = pending.copyOfRange(count, pending.size)
        if (gatt !== readSession) {
            pending = ByteArray(0)
            throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException(
                "OBDLink BLE session changed while reading",
                connectionFailure
            )
        }
        count
    }

    fun close() {
        // Wake readers without enqueuing a fake packet that a new session could consume.
        val closed = ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBDLink BLE session was closed")
        readWakeup.signal(closed)
        connectResult?.completeExceptionally(closed)
        writeResult?.completeExceptionally(closed)
        mtuResult?.completeExceptionally(closed)
        try { gatt?.disconnect() } catch (_: Exception) {}
        try { gatt?.close() } catch (_: Exception) {}
        gatt = null
        writeCharacteristic = null
        characteristicWriteType = BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT
        // A new GATT session starts at the default ATT MTU until negotiation succeeds.
        mtuPayload = 20
        pending = ByteArray(0)
        while (incoming.tryReceive().isSuccess) { }
        connectResult = null
        writeResult = null
        connectionFailure = null
        mtuResult = null
    }
}


/** One-shot wakeup for the single active BLE reader; signals are never queued across sessions. */
internal class ObdReadWakeup {
    @Volatile private var waiting: CompletableDeferred<Throwable>? = null

    fun beginWait(): CompletableDeferred<Throwable> =
        CompletableDeferred<Throwable>().also { waiting = it }

    fun signal(cause: Throwable) {
        waiting?.complete(cause)
    }

    fun endWait(candidate: CompletableDeferred<Throwable>) {
        if (waiting === candidate) waiting = null
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/** Pure availability policy shared by the OBD manager and its unit tests. */
internal object ObdTransportConnectionState {
    fun isCommandChannelAvailable(
        isDemoMode: Boolean,
        isSimulationActive: Boolean,
        activeTransport: String,
        classicSocketConnected: Boolean = false,
        classicSocketClosed: Boolean = true,
        bleConnected: Boolean = false,
        usbConnected: Boolean = false,
        wifiConnected: Boolean = false
    ): Boolean {
        if (isDemoMode || isSimulationActive) return false
        return when (activeTransport) {
            "BLUETOOTH" -> classicSocketConnected && !classicSocketClosed
            "BLE" -> bleConnected
            "USB" -> usbConnected
            "WIFI" -> wifiConnected
            else -> false
        }
    }
}


/** Signals a physical adapter disconnect to the app-level connection monitor. */
class ObdTransportDisconnectedException(message: String, cause: Throwable? = null) :
    java.io.IOException(message, cause)

/**
 * Invalidates work started by an older transport session, including a rapid
 * disconnect/reconnect where both sessions use the same transport family.
 */
internal class ObdTransportSessionEpoch {
    private val value = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong(0L)

    fun capture(): Long = value.get()

    fun invalidate(): Long = value.incrementAndGet()

    fun isCurrent(captured: Long): Boolean = value.get() == captured

    /** Queued work from an old adapter must not report the new adapter as lost. */
    fun requireQueuedCurrent(captured: Long) {
        if (!isCurrent(captured)) {
            throw ObdSupersededSessionException(
                ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBD session replaced while waiting")
            )
        }
    }

    fun requireCurrent(captured: Long) {
        if (value.get() != captured) {
            throw ObdTransportDisconnectedException("OBD connection changed during command")
        }
    }
}

/** A response from a replaced connection must never disconnect its successor. */
class ObdSupersededSessionException(cause: Throwable) :
    java.io.IOException("An earlier OBD connection was replaced", cause)

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.io.IOException
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException
import java.util.Collections
import java.util.IdentityHashMap

/**
 * Distinguishes a broken transport from an incomplete command response.
 *
 * ELM prompt timeouts can occur while the adapter remains connected, so they
 * must not trigger the app-wide physical disconnect flow. Timeout causes may
 * be wrapped by transport implementations, therefore inspect the full cause chain.
 */
object ObdTransportFailurePolicy {
    fun isConnectionLoss(error: Throwable): Boolean {
        val visited = Collections.newSetFromMap(IdentityHashMap<Throwable, Boolean>())
        var current: Throwable? = error
        var hasIoFailure = false
        while (current != null && visited.add(current)) {
            // A late failure from an already replaced connection is not a
            // failure of the currently connected physical adapter.
            if (current is ObdSupersededSessionException) return false
            if (current is SocketTimeoutException) return false
            if (current is IOException) hasIoFailure = true
            current = current.cause
        }
        return hasIoFailure
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Base64

/**
 * Crash-auditable, append-only journal for an eventual hardware-validated ECU write.
 *
 * The caller must place [file] in app-private persistent storage (not Downloads
 * or the cache). Each record is physically flushed with FileDescriptor.sync()
 * BEFORE the engine is allowed to erase a sector. A new file is required for
 * every programming attempt: an old or tampered journal is never overwritten.
 *
 * A valid audit is evidence about the transaction log, not proof of a correct
 * ECU flash, OEM checksum, or recoverability.
 */
class PersistentEcuWriteJournal(
    private val file: File,
    target: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.FirmwareTarget,
    expectedVin: String
) : EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {
    data class Audit(
        val valid: Boolean,
        val records: Int,
        val lastStage: EcuWriteTransaction.Stage? = null
    )

    private val guard = Any()
    private val shaPattern = Regex("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}")
    private val header = listOf(
        "CAMARODIAG-ECU-JOURNAL-V1",
        encoded(target.controllerFamily),
        encoded(target.controllerId),
        encoded(target.firmwareId),
        expectedVin
    ).joinToString("\t")

    init {
        require(target.controllerFamily.isNotBlank() &&
            target.controllerId.isNotBlank() && target.firmwareId.isNotBlank()
        ) { "An identified ECU target is required." }
        require(expectedVin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}"))) {
            "A verified, 17-character VIN is required for a write journal."
        }
        require(file.parentFile?.isDirectory == true) {
            "The persistent journal directory must already exist."
        }
        check(file.createNewFile()) {
            "Refusing to overwrite or append to an earlier ECU write journal."
        }
        durableAppend((header + "\n").toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
    }

    override suspend fun append(record: EcuWriteTransaction.Record) {
        require(record.address >= 0L)
        require(shaPattern.matches(record.originalSha256) &&
            shaPattern.matches(record.updatedSha256)) {
            "Only complete SHA-256 image digests may be recorded."
        }
        synchronized(guard) {
            val audit = inspectLocked()
            check(audit.valid) { "The ECU write journal is missing, damaged, or has been modified." }
            val lines = file.readLines(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
            val lastHash = if (audit.records == 0) sha256(header) else lines.last().substringAfterLast('\t')
            val payload = listOf(
                audit.records + 1,
                System.currentTimeMillis(),
                record.stage.name,
                record.region.name,
                record.address,
                record.originalSha256.lowercase(),
                record.updatedSha256.lowercase()
            ).joinToString("\t")
            val checksum = sha256("$lastHash\t$payload")
            val bytes = ("$payload\t$checksum\n").toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
            check(file.length() + bytes.size <= MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES) {
                "Journal size limit reached; unsafe to continue ECU write."
            }
            durableAppend(bytes)
        }
    }

    /** Detects truncated records and alterations, including changes to earlier entries. */
    fun inspect(): Audit = synchronized(guard) { inspectLocked() }

    private fun inspectLocked(): Audit {
        if (!file.isFile || file.length() !in 1..MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES) return Audit(false, 0)
        val raw = file.readBytes()
        if (raw.isEmpty() || raw.last() != '\n'.code.toByte()) return Audit(false, 0)
        val lines = raw.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).dropLast(1).split('\n')
        if (lines.firstOrNull() != header) return Audit(false, 0)
        var previousHash = sha256(header)
        var count = 0
        var lastStage: EcuWriteTransaction.Stage? = null
        for (line in lines.drop(1)) {
            val parts = line.split('\t')
            if (parts.size != 8 || parts[0].toIntOrNull() != count + 1 ||
                parts[1].toLongOrNull() == null || parts[4].toLongOrNull() == null ||
                parts[4].toLong() < 0 ||
                !shaPattern.matches(parts[5]) || !shaPattern.matches(parts[6])
            ) return Audit(false, count, lastStage)
            val stage = runCatching { EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.valueOf(parts[2]) }.getOrNull()
                ?: return Audit(false, count, lastStage)
            if (runCatching { EcuBackupCoverage.Region.valueOf(parts[3]) }.isFailure) {
                return Audit(false, count, lastStage)
            }
            val expected = sha256(previousHash + "\t" + parts.take(7).joinToString("\t"))
            if (parts[7] != expected) return Audit(false, count, lastStage)
            previousHash = expected
            count++
            lastStage = stage
        }
        return Audit(true, count, lastStage)
    }

    private fun durableAppend(bytes: ByteArray) {
        FileOutputStream(file, true).use { stream ->
            stream.write(bytes)
            // If fsync fails, the caller MUST stop before erasing the next sector.
            stream.fd.sync()
        }
    }

    private fun encoded(text: String): String =
        Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(
            text.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        )

    private fun sha256(text: String): String =
        MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(text.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES = 8L * 1024 * 1024
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/** A validated single Classical CAN data frame entered in the unified console. */
data class RawCanFrame(
    val canId: Long,
    val isExtended: Boolean,
    val data: ByteArray
)

/**
 * Parses console input in the form "7E0 02 01 0C" or
 * "18DAF110 03 22 F1 90". Whitespace and optional 0x prefixes are accepted.
 */
object RawCanFrameParser {
    fun parseReceivedFrames(adapterOutput: String): List<RawCanFrame> =
        adapterOutput.lineSequence()
            .mapNotNull(::parseAdapterFrameLine)
            .toList()

    /**
     * ELM raw-CAN output includes a DLC after the arbitration ID. ELM/STN
     * adapters may print that hexadecimal nibble as either "8" or "08".
     * Validate it and remove it: DLC is framing metadata, not ECU payload.
     * Lines such as SEARCHING, OK, NO DATA and the ELM prompt are ignored.
     */
    private fun parseAdapterFrameLine(line: String): RawCanFrame? {
        val tokens = line.trim()
            .removeSuffix(">")
            .trim()
            .split(Regex("\\s+"))
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (tokens.size < 2) return null
        val dlcToken = tokens[1]
        if (dlcToken.length !in 1..2 || !dlcToken.all { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) != null }) return null
        val declaredLength = dlcToken.toInt(16)
        if (declaredLength !in 0..8) return null
        // CAN data frames may carry zero bytes. Validate the ID using the same
        // parser as nonempty frames, but never invent a payload byte for DLC 0.
        if (declaredLength == 0) {
            if (tokens.size != 2) return null
            return parse(tokens.first() + " 00")?.copy(data = byteArrayOf())
        }
        if (tokens.size < 3) return null
        val frame = parse(tokens.first() + " " + tokens.drop(2).joinToString(" ")) ?: return null
        if (frame.data.size != declaredLength) return null
        return frame
    }

    fun parse(input: String): RawCanFrame? {
        val tokens = input.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (tokens.size < 2) return null
        val idToken = tokens.first().removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X")
        if (idToken.length !in setOf(3, 8) || !idToken.all { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) != null }) return null
        val id = idToken.toLongOrNull(16) ?: return null
        val extended = idToken.length > 3
        if ((!extended && id > 0x7FFL) || (extended && id > 0x1FFFFFFFL)) return null
        val byteTokens = tokens.drop(1)
        if (byteTokens.size !in 1..8 || byteTokens.any {
            val token = it.removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X")
            token.length != 2 || !token.all { char -> char.digitToIntOrNull(16) != null }
        }) return null
        val bytes = byteTokens.map { it.removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X").toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
        return RawCanFrame(id, extended, bytes)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Restores the standard functional OBD session after a physically addressed STPX
 * diagnostic transaction. Without this, ATCRA and STCFCPA may leave subsequent
 * Mode 01/09 traffic restricted to the preceding ECU response address.
 *
 * The commands follow ScanTool/OBDLink Family Reference and Programming Manual:
 * ATCRA (without argument), STCFCPC, STCSEGR, STCSEGT and STFA.
 * This restores CamaroDiag's normal 11-bit HS-CAN mode, not arbitrary pre-app
 * user settings. No destructive ECU service is sent.
 */
internal object StnUdsAdapterRestoration {
    val commands = listOf(
        "STCFCPC", // Clear physical-response ISO-TP flow-control address pairs.
        "ATCRA",   // Reset CAN receive address mask/filter.
        "STCSEGR 0", // Disable STN receive ISO-TP reassembly.
        "STCSEGT 0", // Disable STN transmit ISO-TP segmentation.
        "STFA",    // Restore automatic OBD response filtering.
        "ATSP6",   // CamaroDiag standard 11-bit, 500 kbit/s HS-CAN mode.
        "ATSH 7DF", // Standard functional powertrain request header.
        "ATCAF1",  // ELM-compatible automatic CAN formatting.
        "ATH1",    // Preserve headers for real ECU responder attribution.
        "ATS0"     // Restore compact responses expected by the OBD parser.
    )

    data class Result(val failedCommands: List<String>) {
        val succeeded: Boolean get() = failedCommands.isEmpty()
    }

    /** Always attempt every cleanup command, even when an earlier one fails. */
    suspend fun restore(send: suspend (String) -> String): Result {
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (command in commands) {
            val response = runCatching { send(command) }.getOrNull()
            val acknowledged = response?.replace('\r', '\n')?.lines()?.any {
                it.trim().equals("OK", ignoreCase = true)
            } == true
            if (!acknowledged) failures += command
        }
        return Result(failures)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * UDS payload transport for documented STN/OBDLink adapters using STPX.
 *
 * STPX and STCSEGR/STCSEGT are implemented by the adapter firmware: it performs ISO-TP
 * segmentation and reassembly internally. This is deliberately not exposed as raw CAN.
 */
class StnUdsPayloadTransport(
    private val requestCanId: Int,
    private val responseCanId: Int,
    private val protocolNumber: Int = 33,
    private val sendCommand: suspend (String, Long) -> String
) : UdsPayloadTransport {
    private val mutex = Mutex()
    private var configured = false

    init {
        val extended = protocolNumber in setOf(34, 36, 64)
        val maxId = if (extended) 0x1FFFFFFF else 0x7FF
        require(requestCanId in 0..maxId && responseCanId in 0..maxId && requestCanId != responseCanId)
        require(protocolNumber in setOf(33, 34, 35, 36, 63, 64)) {
            "STN protocol must be 33/34 (HS-CAN 500 kbit/s), 35/36 (HS-CAN 250 kbit/s), or 63/64 (SW-CAN 33.3 kbit/s)."
        }
        require(extended == (requestCanId > 0x7FF && responseCanId > 0x7FF)) {
            "CAN identifier format does not match the selected STN protocol."
        }
    }

    override suspend fun exchange(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray = mutex.withLock {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty() && payload.size <= 4095)
        ensureConfigured(timeoutMs)
        val command = "STPX h:${formatId(requestCanId)}, d:${payload.toHex()}, t:${timeoutMs.coerceIn(1L, 65535L)}, r:1"
        var response = parseResponse(sendCommand(command, timeoutMs), responseCanId)
        check(isMatchingUdsService(response, payload[0])) {
            "STN received a response to a different UDS service."
        }
        var pendingCount = 0
        while (isResponsePending(response, payload[0])) {
            if (++pendingCount > 5) error("UDS ResponsePending limit exceeded.")
            val monitor = sendCommand("STMA 1", maxOf(timeoutMs, 10_000L))
            response = parseResponse(monitor, responseCanId)
            check(isMatchingUdsService(response, payload[0])) {
                "STN received a pending response for a different UDS request."
            }
        }
        response
    }

    override suspend fun sendOnly(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long) = mutex.withLock {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty() && payload.size <= 4095)
        ensureConfigured(timeoutMs)
        val command = "STPX h:${formatId(requestCanId)}, d:${payload.toHex()}, t:${timeoutMs.coerceIn(1L, 65535L)}, r:0"
        val result = sendCommand(command, timeoutMs)
        check(result.lines().any { it.trim().equals("OK", ignoreCase = true) }) {
            "STN did not acknowledge the UDS no-response transmission: $result"
        }
    }

    private suspend fun ensureConfigured(timeoutMs: Long) {
        if (configured) return
        val firmware = sendCommand("STI", timeoutMs)
        val hardware = sendCommand("STDI", timeoutMs)
        // STPX/ISO-TP is a family feature, not an MX+-only feature.
        // Detect documented OBDLink models by complete token so e.g. an
        // "OBDLink MX+ clone" cannot be mistaken for an unrelated model.
        // These identifiers are sufficient for the diagnostic transport only;
        // an adapter string can NEVER authorize ECU erasure/programming.
        val model = Regex("""(?i)\bOBDLink\s+(MX\+|MX|EX|CX|LX|SX)(?=\s|$)""")
            .find(hardware)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        require(firmware.contains("STN", true) && model != null) {
            "An identified OBDLink STN adapter is required for STPX diagnostics. Detected: $hardware / $firmware"
        }
        // Only the MX / MX+ families expose GM single-wire CAN in the
        // published manufacturer compatibility matrix. EX has Ford MS-CAN,
        // which is a different bus and must not be confused with GM SW-CAN.
        if (protocolNumber == 63 || protocolNumber == 64) {
            require(model == "MX+" || model == "MX") {
                "GM SW-CAN cannot be selected on OBDLink $model; use supported hardware."
            }
        }
        requireOk(sendCommand("STP $protocolNumber", timeoutMs), "select CAN protocol")
        requireOk(sendCommand("ATH1", timeoutMs), "enable CAN headers")
        requireOk(sendCommand("ATS1", timeoutMs), "enable separated output")
        requireOk(sendCommand("ATD0", timeoutMs), "disable DLC output")
        requireOk(sendCommand("STCAF 0", timeoutMs), "select normal CAN addressing")
        requireOk(sendCommand("STCSEGR 1", timeoutMs), "enable ISO-TP receive reassembly")
        requireOk(sendCommand("STCSEGT 1", timeoutMs), "enable ISO-TP transmit segmentation")
        requireOk(
            sendCommand("STCFCPA ${formatId(requestCanId)}, ${formatId(responseCanId)}", timeoutMs),
            "configure ISO-TP flow-control address pair"
        )
        requireOk(sendCommand("ATCRA ${formatId(responseCanId)}", timeoutMs), "filter ECU response CAN ID")
        configured = true
    }

    private fun requireOk(response: String, operation: String) {
        require(response.replace('\r', '\n').lines().any { it.trim().equals("OK", ignoreCase = true) }) {
            "STN adapter failed to $operation: $response"
        }
    }

    private fun isMatchingUdsService(response: ByteArray, requestedService: Byte): Boolean {
        val requestSid = requestedService.toInt() and 0xFF
        val positiveSid = (requestSid + 0x40) and 0xFF
        return (response.isNotEmpty() && (response[0].toInt() and 0xFF) == positiveSid) ||
            (response.size >= 3 && (response[0].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x7F &&
                response[1] == requestedService)
    }

    private fun isResponsePending(response: ByteArray, requestedService: Byte): Boolean =
        response.size >= 3 &&
            (response[0].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x7F &&
            (response[1] == requestedService) &&
            (response[2].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x78

    /**
     * Parse an STN ISO-TP payload, not raw CAN frames.
     * ATH1 is enabled during configuration: accept ONLY matching responder IDs,
     * including continuations of long STPX responses. Never take two-byte
     * fragments from command echoes, other ECUs, or adapter status lines.
     */
    private fun parseResponse(output: String, expectedCanId: Int): ByteArray {
        require(!output.contains("NO DATA", true)) { "No UDS response from CAN ID " + formatId(expectedCanId) }
        require(!output.contains("CAN ERROR", true) && !output.contains("BUS ERROR", true)) {
            "STN adapter reported a CAN bus error: " + output
        }
        val buffer = ArrayList<Byte>()
        var accepting = false
        var matched = false
        for (line in output.replace('\r', '\n').lines()) {
            val tokens = line.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).filter(String::isNotBlank)
            if (tokens.isEmpty()) continue
            val normalizedFirst = tokens.first().removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X")
            val hasHeader = (normalizedFirst.length == 3 || normalizedFirst.length == 8) &&
                normalizedFirst.all { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) != null }
            if (hasHeader) {
                val id = normalizedFirst.toLongOrNull(16)?.toInt()
                accepting = id == expectedCanId
                if (!accepting) continue
                matched = true
            } else if (!accepting) {
                continue
            }
            val data = if (hasHeader) tokens.drop(1) else tokens
            if (data.isEmpty()) continue
            // End a payload on adapter messages; never parse arbitrary hex-like
            // fragments mixed with a status/error or a new command echo.
            if (data.any { token ->
                token.length % 2 != 0 || token.isEmpty() ||
                    token.any { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) == null }
            }) {
                accepting = false
                continue
            }
            for (token in data) {
                for (offset in token.indices step 2) {
                    check(buffer.size < 4095) { "Oversize ISO-TP payload from STN adapter." }
                    buffer.add(token.substring(offset, offset + 2).toInt(16).toByte())
                }
            }
        }
        require(matched && buffer.isNotEmpty()) {
            "No complete UDS payload for CAN ID " + formatId(expectedCanId)
        }
        return buffer.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun formatId(id: Int): String =
        if (id > 0x7FF) id.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT).padStart(8, '0')
        else id.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT).padStart(3, '0')

    private fun ByteArray.toHex(): String =
        joinToString("") { "%02X".format(Locale.ROOT, it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * Shared admission gate for a real STPX/ISO-TP diagnostic session.
 *
 * Manufacturer models and service-part references are NOT protocol drivers:
 * probe the connected STN firmware and verify a real OBD response instead.
 * The transport performs its own STI/STDI model verification before sending UDS.
 */
internal object StnUdsSessionAdmission {
    fun allowsRead(adapter: AdapterCapabilities?, physicalCommandChannel: Boolean): Boolean =
        physicalCommandChannel && adapter != null &&
            adapter.tier == AdapterTier.PRO_STN &&
            adapter.firmwareId.contains("STN", ignoreCase = true) &&
            adapter.supportsCanHeaders &&
            adapter.supportsCanTransmit
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/** VXDIAG hardware family supported by CamaroDiag's connection layer. */
enum class VxdiagModel { VCX_SE, VCX_NANO }
enum class VxdiagLink { USB, WIFI }
enum class VxdiagProtocol { J2534, ISO22900_PDU, VENDOR_NATIVE }
enum class VxdiagReadiness { READY_WITH_VENDOR_PROVIDER, PC_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTED_REQUIRES_VENDOR_DRIVER, DEVICE_DISCOVERY_ONLY, UNSUPPORTED_LINK }

data class VxdiagDeviceProfile(
    val model: VxdiagModel,
    val link: VxdiagLink,
    val label: String,
    val protocols: Set<VxdiagProtocol>,
    val readiness: VxdiagReadiness,
    val noteFr: String
)

/**
 * Capability matrix based on published VXDIAG product specifications.
 * VCX-NANO USB and Wi-Fi are separate hardware variants. VCX-SE supports USB-C and Wi-Fi.
 * The Windows PC bridge is implemented; a registered vendor J2534 provider is still required.
 */
object VxdiagProfiles {
    fun all(): List<VxdiagDeviceProfile> = listOf(
        VxdiagDeviceProfile(VxdiagModel.VCX_SE, VxdiagLink.USB, "VCX SE USB-C", setOf(VxdiagProtocol.J2534, VxdiagProtocol.ISO22900_PDU), VxdiagReadiness.PC_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTED_REQUIRES_VENDOR_DRIVER, "Pont PC J2534 disponible ; pilote VXDIAG Windows enregistré requis. HS-CAN et SW-ISO15765 si J2534-2 exposé par le pilote."),
        VxdiagDeviceProfile(VxdiagModel.VCX_SE, VxdiagLink.WIFI, "VCX SE Wi-Fi", setOf(VxdiagProtocol.J2534, VxdiagProtocol.ISO22900_PDU), VxdiagReadiness.PC_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTED_REQUIRES_VENDOR_DRIVER, "Pont PC J2534 disponible ; pilote VXDIAG Windows et accès réseau du modèle exact requis."),
        VxdiagDeviceProfile(VxdiagModel.VCX_NANO, VxdiagLink.USB, "VCX NANO USB", setOf(VxdiagProtocol.J2534, VxdiagProtocol.ISO22900_PDU), VxdiagReadiness.PC_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTED_REQUIRES_VENDOR_DRIVER, "Pont PC J2534 disponible ; pilote Windows VXDIAG ou fournisseur J2534 compatible requis pour cette révision Nano USB. SW-CAN non garanti."),
        VxdiagDeviceProfile(VxdiagModel.VCX_NANO, VxdiagLink.WIFI, "VCX NANO Wi-Fi", setOf(VxdiagProtocol.J2534, VxdiagProtocol.ISO22900_PDU), VxdiagReadiness.PC_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTED_REQUIRES_VENDOR_DRIVER, "Pont PC J2534 disponible si le pilote Windows de cette variante Wi-Fi enregistre un fournisseur PassThru. SW-CAN dépend du support J2534-2.")
    )
}

/**
 * Adapter boundary for an official/vendor-supplied Android SDK or a documented bridge.
 * Implementations must preserve J2534 status/errors and must not translate arbitrary
 * diagnostic requests into undocumented CAN frames.
 */
interface VxdiagProvider {
    val providerName: String
    suspend fun open(profile: VxdiagDeviceProfile): Result<Unit>
    suspend fun readVersion(): Result<String>
    suspend fun passThruConnect(protocol: VxdiagProtocol, baudRate: Int = 500_000): Result<Unit>
    suspend fun passThruWrite(message: ByteArray): Result<Unit>
    suspend fun passThruRead(timeoutMs: Int = 1000): Result<ByteArray>
    suspend fun close()
}

/** No provider is bundled until VXDIAG supplies a redistributable Android SDK/API. */
class MissingVxdiagProvider : VxdiagProvider {
    override val providerName = "VXDIAG SDK not installed"
    override suspend fun open(profile: VxdiagDeviceProfile) = Result.failure<Unit>(UnsupportedOperationException("SDK Android VXDIAG absent : ${profile.label}"))
    override suspend fun readVersion() = Result.failure<String>(UnsupportedOperationException("VXDIAG SDK Android requis"))
    override suspend fun passThruConnect(protocol: VxdiagProtocol, baudRate: Int) = Result.failure<Unit>(UnsupportedOperationException("J2534 Android provider requis"))
    override suspend fun passThruWrite(message: ByteArray) = Result.failure<Unit>(UnsupportedOperationException("J2534 Android provider requis"))
    override suspend fun passThruRead(timeoutMs: Int) = Result.failure<ByteArray>(UnsupportedOperationException("J2534 Android provider requis"))
    override suspend fun close() = Unit
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class CanCaptureTextBufferTest {
    @Test fun retainsOrderedChunksUntilFull() {
        val buffer = CanCaptureTextBuffer(maxChars = 8)
        buffer.append("AA")
        buffer.append("BB")
        assertEquals("AABB", buffer.snapshot())
        buffer.append("CCDD")
        assertEquals("AABBCCDD", buffer.snapshot())
    }

    @Test fun longCaptureKeepsRecentTailInsteadOfStopping() {
        val buffer = CanCaptureTextBuffer(maxChars = 8)
        buffer.append("12345678")
        buffer.append("90")
        buffer.append("ABC")
        assertEquals("67890ABC", buffer.snapshot())
    }

    @Test fun oversizedChunkKeepsTail() {
        val buffer = CanCaptureTextBuffer(maxChars = 5)
        buffer.append("abc")
        buffer.append("0123456789")
        assertEquals("56789", buffer.snapshot())
    }

    @Test fun zeroCapacityIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CanCaptureTextBuffer(maxChars = 0)
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CanConsoleRecordParserTest {
    @Test
    fun classifiesOnlyValidatedCanFramesAsReceivedTraffic() {
        val records = CanConsoleRecordParser.parse(
            "OK\r\n7E8 05 41 0C 1A F8 00\r\n18DAF110 03 7F 22 31"
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("SYSTEM", "RX", "RX"), records.map { it.direction })
        assertEquals("OK", records.first().content)
        assertEquals("CAN ID=7E8 DLC=5 DATA=41 0C 1A F8 00", records[1].content)
        assertEquals("CAN ID=18DAF110 DLC=3 DATA=7F 22 31", records[2].content)
    }

    @Test
    fun zeroLengthCanFramesAreReceivedRatherThanSystemMessages() {
        val records = CanConsoleRecordParser.parse(
            "7E8 00\r\n18DAF110 0\r\n7E8 00 FF"
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("RX", "RX", "SYSTEM"), records.map { it.direction })
        assertEquals("CAN ID=7E8 DLC=0 DATA=(empty)", records[0].content)
        assertEquals("CAN ID=18DAF110 DLC=0 DATA=(empty)", records[1].content)
    }

    @Test
    fun adapterErrorsRemainSystemEventsAndAreMarkedFailed() {
        val records = CanConsoleRecordParser.parse(
            "NO DATA\r\nCAN ERROR\r\nBUFFER FULL\r\nSEARCHING..."
        )

        assertTrue(records.all { it.direction == "SYSTEM" })
        assertFalse(records[0].succeeded)
        assertFalse(records[1].succeeded)
        assertFalse(records[2].succeeded)
        assertTrue(records[3].succeeded)
    }

    @Test
    fun ignoresEmptyLinesAndStripsMonitorPrompt() {
        val records = CanConsoleRecordParser.parse("\r\n7E8 02 41 0C>\r\n")

        assertEquals(1, records.size)
        assertEquals("RX", records.single().direction)
        assertEquals("CAN ID=7E8 DLC=2 DATA=41 0C", records.single().content)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals

class EcuBackupArchiveTest {
    private fun capture() = EcuBackupManifest.Capture(
        EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION, 0x1000, 4,
        byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4), byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4),
        EcuBackupManifest.Origin.IMPORTED_FILE
    )

    @Test fun exportAndImportPreserveBytesAndCoverage() {
        val archive = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        EcuBackupArchive.export(archive, listOf(capture()), setOf(capture().region), "LFX offline")
        val result = EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(archive.toByteArray()))
        assertTrue(result.verification.consistent)
        assertEquals("LFX offline", result.manifest.controllerLabel)
        assertEquals(null, result.manifest.vehicleVin)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.COMPLETE, result.manifest.coverage.status)
        assertArrayEquals(capture().firstRead, result.captures.single().firstRead)
        assertArrayEquals(capture().independentRead, result.captures.single().independentRead)
    }

    @Test fun malformedVinIsRejectedBeforeCreatingArchive() {
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val failure = runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.export(output, listOf(capture()), setOf(capture().region), vehicleVin = "unknown")
        }
        assertTrue(failure.isFailure)
        assertEquals(0, output.size())
    }

    @Test fun missingIndependentReadIsRejected() {
        val archive = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val failure = runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.export(archive, listOf(capture().copy(independentRead = null)),
                setOf(EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION))
        }
        assertTrue(failure.isFailure)
        assertEquals(0, archive.size())
    }

    @Test fun conflictingIndependentReadIsRejected() {
        val archive = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val failure = runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.export(
                archive,
                listOf(capture().copy(independentRead = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 9))),
                setOf(EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION)
            )
        }
        assertTrue(failure.isFailure)
        assertEquals(0, archive.size())
    }

    @Test fun unexpectedArchiveEntryIsRejected() {
        val archive = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        ZipOutputStream(archive).use { zip ->
            zip.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("../unexpected.bin"))
            zip.write(byteArrayOf(1))
            zip.closeEntry()
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(archive.toByteArray()))
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun oversizedOrMissingRegionsRemainPartial() {
        val archive = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        EcuBackupArchive.export(archive, listOf(capture()),
            setOf(EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION, EcuBackupCoverage.Region.EXTERNAL_EEPROM))
        val result = EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(archive.toByteArray()))
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, result.manifest.coverage.status)
        assertTrue(EcuBackupCoverage.Region.EXTERNAL_EEPROM in result.manifest.coverage.missingRegions)
    }
    @Test fun malformedAndOverlappingSegmentsAreRejectedBeforeExport() {
        val first = capture()
        val overlap = first.copy(startAddress = first.startAddress + 2L)
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()

            EcuBackupArchive.export(output, listOf(first, overlap), setOf(first.region))
        }
        assertTrue(failure.isFailure)
        assertEquals(0, output.size())
    }

    @Test fun importedArchiveRejectsAlteredPrimaryBytes() {
        val original = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        EcuBackupArchive.export(original, listOf(capture()), setOf(capture().region))
        val altered = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(original.toByteArray())).use { source ->
            ZipOutputStream(altered).use { target ->
                while (true) {
                    val entry = source.nextEntry ?: break
                    target.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entry.name))
                    val bytes = source.readBytes()
                    if (entry.name.endsWith("first.bin")) bytes[0] = (bytes[0].toInt() xor 0x01).toByte()
                    target.write(bytes)
                    target.closeEntry()
                    source.closeEntry()
                }
            }
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(altered.toByteArray()))
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun emptyBackupIsRejectedBeforeWritingOutput() {

            EcuBackupArchive.export(output, emptyList(), emptySet())
        }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(0, output.size())
    }

    @Test fun unknownManifestMetadataIsRejected() {
        val original = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        EcuBackupArchive.export(original, listOf(capture()), setOf(capture().region))
        val altered = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(original.toByteArray())).use { source ->
            ZipOutputStream(altered).use { target ->
                while (true) {
                    val entry = source.nextEntry ?: break
                    target.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entry.name))

            }

        }.isFailure)

        val altered = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(original.toByteArray())).use { source ->
            ZipOutputStream(altered).use { target ->
                while (true) {
                    val entry = source.nextEntry ?: break
                    target.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entry.name))
                    target.write(source.readBytes())
                    if (entry.name == "manifest.properties") {
                        target.write("\ncount=1\n".toByteArray())
                    }
                    target.closeEntry()
                    source.closeEntry()
                }
            }
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(altered.toByteArray()))
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun exportUsesFrozenBytesWhenCallerMutatesBufferDuringZipWrite() {
        val initial = capture()
        val destination = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        var mutated = false
        val interceptingOutput = object : java.io.FilterOutputStream(destination) {
            override fun write(b: Int) {
                if (!mutated) {
                    initial.firstRead[0] = 99
                    initial.independentRead!![0] = 99
                    mutated = true
                }
                out.write(b)
            }
            override fun write(b: ByteArray, off: Int, len: Int) {
                if (!mutated) {
                    initial.firstRead[0] = 99
                    initial.independentRead!![0] = 99
                    mutated = true
                }
                out.write(b, off, len)
            }
        }
        EcuBackupArchive.export(interceptingOutput, listOf(initial), setOf(initial.region))
        assertTrue(mutated)
        val restored = EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(destination.toByteArray()))
        assertTrue(restored.verification.consistent)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4), restored.captures.single().firstRead)
    }

    @Test fun importRejectsEmptyPrimaryReadEvenWithMatchingChecksum() {
        val original = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        EcuBackupArchive.export(original, listOf(capture()), setOf(capture().region))
        val altered = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(original.toByteArray())).use { source ->
            ZipOutputStream(altered).use { target ->
                while (true) {
                    val entry = source.nextEntry ?: break
                    target.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entry.name))
                    val bytes = source.readBytes()
                    if (entry.name == "manifest.properties") {
                        val text = String(bytes, Charsets.ISO_8859_1)
                        val originalHash = EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(capture().firstRead)
                        val emptyHash = EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(byteArrayOf())
                        target.write(text.replace(originalHash, emptyHash).toByteArray(Charsets.ISO_8859_1))
                    } else if (entry.name != "capture/0/first.bin") {
                        target.write(bytes)
                    }
                    target.closeEntry()
                    source.closeEntry()
                }
            }
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(altered.toByteArray()))
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun importRejectsMissingSecondReadEvenIfManifestSaysAbsent() {
        val original = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        EcuBackupArchive.export(original, listOf(capture()), setOf(capture().region))
        val altered = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(original.toByteArray())).use { source ->
            ZipOutputStream(altered).use { target ->
                while (true) {
                    val entry = source.nextEntry ?: break
                    val bytes = source.readBytes()
                    if (entry.name != "capture/0/second.bin") {
                        target.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entry.name))
                        if (entry.name == "manifest.properties") {
                            target.write(String(bytes, Charsets.ISO_8859_1)
                                .replace("capture.0.second=true", "capture.0.second=false")
                                .toByteArray(Charsets.ISO_8859_1))
                        } else {
                            target.write(bytes)
                        }
                        target.closeEntry()
                    }
                    source.closeEntry()
                }
            }
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(altered.toByteArray()))
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun mobileImportBudgetCountsTheManifestAndBothReads() {
        val source = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        EcuBackupArchive.export(source, listOf(capture()), setOf(capture().region))
        val archive = source.toByteArray()
        val size = java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(archive.inputStream()).use { zip ->
            var total = 0L
            while (zip.nextEntry != null) total += zip.readBytes().size
            total
        }
        assertTrue(EcuBackupArchive.import(archive.inputStream(), size).verification.consistent)
        assertTrue(runCatching { EcuBackupArchive.import(archive.inputStream(), size - 1) }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun archiveSizeIncludesManifestAndCannotCrossImportLimit() {
        val limit = 256L * 1024 * 1024
        assertTrue(EcuBackupArchive.fitsUncompressedLimit(limit - 64L, 64L))
        assertTrue(!EcuBackupArchive.fitsUncompressedLimit(limit - 64L, 65L))
        assertTrue(!EcuBackupArchive.fitsUncompressedLimit(limit, 1L))
        assertTrue(!EcuBackupArchive.fitsUncompressedLimit(-1L, 0L))
        assertTrue(!EcuBackupArchive.fitsUncompressedLimit(0L, -1L))
        assertTrue(!EcuBackupArchive.fitsUncompressedLimit(Long.MAX_VALUE, 1L))
    }

}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class EcuBackupCoverageTest {
    private val digest = "ab".repeat(32)
    private fun segment(start: Long, expected: Long, captured: Long = expected,
                        verified: Boolean = true) = EcuBackupCoverage.Segment(
        EcuBackupCoverage.Region.PROGRAM_FLASH, start, expected, captured, digest, verified
    )

    @Test fun completeRequiresAllBytesAndIndependentVerification() {
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.COMPLETE,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(0, 1024), segment(1024, 1024))).status)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(0, 1024, verified = false))).status)
    }

    @Test fun missingBytesAndEmptyCoverageNeverClaimComplete() {
        val report = EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(0, 100, 40)))
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, report.status)
        assertEquals(40L, report.capturedBytes)
        assertEquals(60L, report.missingBytes)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(emptyList()).status)
    }

    @Test fun overlapAndInvalidRangesAreInconsistent() {
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.INCONSISTENT,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(0, 100), segment(50, 100))).status)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.INCONSISTENT,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(-1, 10))).status)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.INCONSISTENT,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(0, 10, 11))).status)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.INCONSISTENT,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(Long.MAX_VALUE, 2))).status)
    }

    @Test fun differentRegionsMayUseSameOffsets() {
        val p = segment(0, 64)
        val d = p.copy(region = EcuBackupCoverage.Region.DATA_FLASH)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.COMPLETE,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(p, d)).status)
    }

    @Test fun missingRequiredRegionPreventsMisleadingCompleteBackup() {
        val report = EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(
            segments = listOf(segment(0, 64)),
            requiredRegions = setOf(
                EcuBackupCoverage.Region.PROGRAM_FLASH,
                EcuBackupCoverage.Region.DATA_FLASH,
                EcuBackupCoverage.Region.EXTERNAL_EEPROM
            )
        )
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, report.status)
        assertEquals(
            setOf(EcuBackupCoverage.Region.DATA_FLASH, EcuBackupCoverage.Region.EXTERNAL_EEPROM),
            report.missingRegions
        )
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(emptyList(), setOf(EcuBackupCoverage.Region.PROGRAM_FLASH)).status
        )
    }

    @Test fun checksumMustBeWellFormedAndVerified() {
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL,
            EcuBackupCoverage.inspect(listOf(segment(0, 64).copy(sha256 = "unknown"))).status)
    }
}
