package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class EcuBackupIntegrityTest {
    private val region = EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION
    private val required = setOf(region)
    private fun capture(first: ByteArray = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3)) =
        EcuBackupManifest.Capture(
            region = region,
            startAddress = 0L,
            expectedBytes = 3L,
            firstRead = first,
            independentRead = first.copyOf(),
            origin = EcuBackupManifest.Origin.IMPORTED_FILE
        )

    private fun manifest(captures: List<EcuBackupManifest.Capture>) =
        EcuBackupManifest.inspect("test", 0L, captures, required)

    @Test fun consistentBytesAndManifestPassOfflineCheck() {
        val captures = listOf(capture())
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(manifest(captures), captures, required).consistent)
    }

    @Test fun tamperedBytesAreRejected() {
        val original = listOf(capture())
        val altered = listOf(capture(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 4)))
        val problems = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(manifest(original), altered, required).problems
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.DIGEST_MISMATCH in problems)
    }

    @Test fun alteredCoverageAndMetadataAreRejected() {
        val captures = listOf(capture())
        val m = manifest(captures)
        assertTrue(
            EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.METADATA_MISMATCH in
                EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(
                    m.copy(entries = m.entries.map { it.copy(startAddress = 1L) }),
                    captures, required
                ).problems
        )
        assertTrue(
            EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.COVERAGE_MISMATCH in
                EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(
                    m.copy(coverage = m.coverage.copy(capturedBytes = 999L)),
                    captures, required
                ).problems
        )
    }

    @Test fun missingIndependentReadAndExtraEntriesAreRejected() {
        val captures = listOf(capture())
        val m = manifest(captures)
        val changed = captures.map { it.copy(independentRead = null) }
        assertTrue(
            EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.INDEPENDENT_READ_MISMATCH in
                EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(m, changed, required).problems
        )
        assertTrue(
            EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.ENTRY_COUNT_MISMATCH in
                EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(
                    m.copy(entries = m.entries + m.entries.first()), captures, required
                ).problems
        )
    }

    @Test fun claimedHardwareProofIsNotAccepted() {
        val captures = listOf(capture())
        val result = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(
            manifest(captures).copy(hardwareProvenanceVerified = true), captures, required
        )
        assertFalse(result.consistent)
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.UNVERIFIABLE_HARDWARE_PROVENANCE in result.problems)
    }
    @Test fun mutationOfOriginalByteArrayAfterManifestCreationIsDetected() {
        val bytes = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3)
        val captures = listOf(capture(bytes))
        val savedManifest = manifest(captures)
        bytes[0] = 9
        val result = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(savedManifest, captures, required)
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.DIGEST_MISMATCH in result.problems)
    }

    @Test fun missingRequiredRegionCannotBePassedOffAsComplete() {
        val captures = listOf(capture())
        val savedManifest = manifest(captures)
        val expandedRequirements = required + EcuBackupCoverage.Region.DATA_FLASH
        val problems = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(
            savedManifest, captures, expandedRequirements
        ).problems
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.COVERAGE_MISMATCH in problems)
    }

    @Test fun malformedAndOverlappingCapturesAreNotRestorableProof() {
        val first = capture()
        val second = capture(byteArrayOf(4, 5, 6)).copy(startAddress = 2L)
        val captures = listOf(first, second)
        val savedManifest = manifest(captures)
        assertTrue(savedManifest.coverage.status == EcuBackupCoverage.Status.INCONSISTENT)
        val problems = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(savedManifest, captures, required).problems
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.INVALID_COVERAGE in problems)
    }

    @Test fun absentSecondReadCannotBeHiddenByAConsistentManifest() {
        val captures = listOf(capture().copy(independentRead = null))
        val generated = manifest(captures)
        assertFalse(generated.entries.single().readsIdentical)
        val problems = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(generated, captures, required).problems
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.MISSING_INDEPENDENT_READ in problems)
    }

    @Test fun twoDifferentReadsAreRejectedEvenWhenManifestAgrees() {
        val capture = capture().copy(independentRead = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 9))
        val captures = listOf(capture)
        val savedManifest = manifest(captures)
        assertFalse(savedManifest.entries.single().readsIdentical)
        val problems = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(savedManifest, captures, required).problems
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.DIVERGENT_INDEPENDENT_READ in problems)
    }

    @Test fun emptyOfflineManifestDoesNotCountAsValidBackup() {
        val captures = emptyList<EcuBackupManifest.Capture>()
        val emptyManifest = manifest(captures)
        val result = EcuBackupIntegrity.verify(emptyManifest, captures, required)
        assertFalse(result.consistent)
        assertTrue(EcuBackupIntegrity.Problem.EMPTY_BACKUP in result.problems)
    }

}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class EcuBackupManifestTest {
    private val flash = EcuBackupCoverage.Region.PROGRAM_FLASH
    private val data = EcuBackupCoverage.Region.DATA_FLASH

    private fun capture(
        region: EcuBackupCoverage.Region = flash,
        size: Int = 4,
        actual: ByteArray = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4),
        second: ByteArray? = actual.clone()
    ) = EcuBackupManifest.Capture(
        region = region,
        startAddress = 0,
        expectedBytes = size.toLong(),
        firstRead = actual,
        independentRead = second,
        origin = EcuBackupManifest.Origin.IMPORTED_FILE
    )

    @Test fun completeOfflineCopyIsNotAProvenPhysicalBackup() {
        val report = EcuBackupManifest.inspect(
            controllerLabel = "E39",
            createdAtUtcMillis = 12345L,
            captures = listOf(capture(flash), capture(data)),
            expectedRegions = setOf(flash, data)
        )
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.COMPLETE, report.coverage.status)
        assertEquals(8L, report.coverage.capturedBytes)
        assertEquals(2, report.entries.size)
        assertTrue(report.entries.all { it.readsIdentical })
        assertFalse(report.hardwareProvenanceVerified)
        assertEquals(EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4)),
            report.entries.first().sha256)
    }

    @Test fun missingRegionsAndUnknownMemoryMapAreNotComplete() {
        val missing = EcuBackupManifest.inspect("E39", 1L, listOf(capture()), setOf(flash, data))
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, missing.coverage.status)
        assertEquals(setOf(data), missing.coverage.missingRegions)

        val unknown = EcuBackupManifest.inspect("E39", 1L, listOf(capture()), emptySet())
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, unknown.coverage.status)
    }

    @Test fun independentReadbackMustMatchTheBytesExactly() {
        val altered = EcuBackupManifest.inspect("E39", 1L,
            listOf(capture(second = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 9))), setOf(flash))
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, altered.coverage.status)
        assertFalse(altered.entries.single().readsIdentical)

        val unavailable = EcuBackupManifest.inspect("E39", 1L,
            listOf(capture(second = null)), setOf(flash))
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, unavailable.coverage.status)
        assertFalse(unavailable.entries.single().readsIdentical)
    }

    @Test fun shortOrOverlongReadsCannotLookComplete() {
        val truncated = EcuBackupManifest.inspect("E39", 1L,
            listOf(capture(size = 5)), setOf(flash))
        assertEquals(1L, truncated.coverage.missingBytes)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.PARTIAL, truncated.coverage.status)

        val overflow = EcuBackupManifest.inspect("E39", 1L,
            listOf(capture(size = 2)), setOf(flash))
        assertEquals(EcuBackupCoverage.Status.INCONSISTENT, overflow.coverage.status)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class EcuBenchExpertPlanTest {
    private val target = EcuBenchExpertPlan.Target(
        controllerFamily = "E39A",
        chipMarking = "MPC5566",
        programmerName = "Verified bench adapter",
        accessMethod = EcuBenchExpertPlan.AccessMethod.NEXUS_JTAG,
        region = EcuBenchExpertPlan.MemoryRegion.PFLASH
    )

    private val image = EcuBenchExpertPlan.CandidateImage(
        fileName = "original.bin",
        format = "RAW_BINARY",
        sizeBytes = 4096L,
        sha256 = "ab".repeat(32)
    )

    @Test fun noHardwareDriverMeansNoWritesEvenWhenChecklistIsComplete() {
        val proof = EcuBenchExpertPlan.Evidence(
            originalReadbackVerified = true,
            recoveryPathVerified = true,
            memoryMapVerified = true
        )
        assertEquals(
            listOf(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.HARDWARE_PROGRAMMING_DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE),
            EcuBenchExpertPlan.blockers(target, image, proof)
        )
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.isProgrammingEnabled(target, image, proof))
    }

    @Test fun unknownControllerAndChipRequireRealIdentification() {
        val missing = EcuBenchExpertPlan.blockers(
            target.copy(controllerFamily = "E39X", chipMarking = "unknown", programmerName = ""),
            image
        )
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.CONTROLLER_NOT_IDENTIFIED in missing)
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.CHIP_NOT_IDENTIFIED in missing)
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.PROGRAMMER_NOT_IDENTIFIED in missing)
    }

    @Test fun anImageNameOrAnImportHashDoesNotBecomeABackup() {
        val missing = EcuBenchExpertPlan.blockers(
            target,
            image.copy(format = "ZIP", sha256 = "not-a-sha256")
        )
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.IMAGE_NOT_RAW_BINARY in missing)
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.IMAGE_INTEGRITY_MISSING in missing)
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.ORIGINAL_READBACK_NOT_VERIFIED in missing)
    }

    @Test fun offlineImageVerificationRequiresActualContentNotMetadataAlone() {
        val bytes = byteArrayOf(0x12, 0x34, 0x56, 0x78)
        val valid = image.copy(
            sizeBytes = bytes.size.toLong(),
            sha256 = EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(bytes)
        )
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid, bytes))
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(
            valid.copy(sha256 = valid.sha256?.uppercase()), bytes
        ))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid, null))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid, byteArrayOf()))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid, byteArrayOf(0x12, 0x34, 0x56, 0x79)))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid.copy(sizeBytes = 4096L), bytes))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid.copy(format = "ZIP"), bytes))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid.copy(fileName = ""), bytes))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifyCandidateImage(valid.copy(sha256 = "ab".repeat(32)), bytes))
        // A matching file hash must never enable a hardware write without a driver.
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.isProgrammingEnabled(target, valid))
    }

    @Test fun exactReadbackComparisonIsRequired() {
        val original = byteArrayOf(0, 1, -1, 4)
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifiedReadback(original, original.clone()))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifiedReadback(original, byteArrayOf(0, 1, -1, 5)))
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.verifiedReadback(byteArrayOf(), byteArrayOf()))
        assertEquals(
            "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
            EcuBenchExpertPlan.sha256Hex(byteArrayOf())
        )
    }

    @Test fun chipOffCannotProgramAnMcuInternalFlash() {
        val invalid = EcuBenchExpertPlan.blockers(
            target.copy(accessMethod = EcuBenchExpertPlan.AccessMethod.EXTERNAL_CHIP_OFF),
            image
        )
        assertTrue(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.ACCESS_REGION_INCOMPATIBLE in invalid)
        val valid = EcuBenchExpertPlan.blockers(
            target.copy(
                accessMethod = EcuBenchExpertPlan.AccessMethod.EXTERNAL_CHIP_OFF,
                region = EcuBenchExpertPlan.MemoryRegion.EXTERNAL_EEPROM
            ),
            image
        )
        assertFalse(EcuBenchExpertPlan.Blocker.ACCESS_REGION_INCOMPATIBLE in valid)
    }

    @Test fun accessMethodsAndMemoryRegionsAreDistinct() {
        assertEquals(5, EcuBenchExpertPlan.AccessMethod.values().size)
        assertEquals(3, EcuBenchExpertPlan.MemoryRegion.values().size)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Catalogue part numbers and calibration revisions do not define a new
 * communication protocol. These are purely offline tests: no ECU programming.
 */
class EcuFamilyCatalogCompatibilityTest {
    @Test fun e39ServiceSupersessionAndDonorLabelsShareOneProtocolFamily() {
        val current = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference("12651994").single()
        val superseded = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference("12643248").single()
        val printed = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference("12648906").single()
        val bcc = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference(" aa69 ").single()

        for (match in listOf(current, superseded, printed, bcc)) {
            assertEquals("E39", match.family)
            assertEquals("12651994", match.serviceGroup)
            assertFalse(match.authorizesProgramming)
        }
        assertEquals(
            Lfx2012ControllerReferences.CatalogReferenceKind.CURRENT_SERVICE_NUMBER,
            current.kind
        )
        assertEquals(
            Lfx2012ControllerReferences.CatalogReferenceKind.SUPERSEDED_SERVICE_NUMBER,
            superseded.kind
        )
        assertEquals(
            Lfx2012ControllerReferences.CatalogReferenceKind.PRINTED_PART_NUMBER,
            printed.kind
        )
        assertEquals(
            Lfx2012ControllerReferences.CatalogReferenceKind.BROADCAST_CODE,
            bcc.kind
        )
    }

    @Test fun independentServiceGroupsShareProtocolWithoutInventingHardwareEquivalence() {
        val other = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference("12637106").single()
        val otherBcc = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference("AAMU").single()
        assertEquals("E39", other.family)
        assertEquals("E39", otherBcc.family)
        assertEquals("12651993", other.serviceGroup)
        assertEquals(other.serviceGroup, otherBcc.serviceGroup)
        assertFalse(other.authorizesProgramming)
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference("12653998").isEmpty())
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.resolveCatalogReference("12345678").isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun oneProtocolDriverCanServeManyFirmwareVersionsButWriteApprovalIsSeparate() {
        val capabilities = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Capability.values().toSet()
        val first = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.FirmwareTarget("E39", "ECM-E39", "CAL-A")
        val second = first.copy(firmwareId = "CAL-B")
        val unknown = first.copy(firmwareId = "CAL-UNKNOWN")
        val driver = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Descriptor(
            id = "synthetic-protocol-test",
            transport = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534,
            capabilities = capabilities,
            controllerFamilies = setOf("E39"),
            physicalHardwareValidated = true,
            writeTargets = setOf(first, second)
        )
        assertTrue(driver.supportsFamilyProtocol("E39", EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534))
        assertFalse(driver.supportsFamilyProtocol("E92", EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534))
        assertFalse(driver.supportsFamilyProtocol("E39", EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.BENCH))
        assertTrue(driver.supportsWrite(first, EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534))
        assertTrue(driver.supportsWrite(second, EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534))
        assertFalse(driver.supportsWrite(unknown, EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534))

        val unvalidated = driver.copy(physicalHardwareValidated = false)
        assertTrue(unvalidated.supportsFamilyProtocol("E39", EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534))
        assertFalse(unvalidated.supportsWrite(first, EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534))
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class EcuPartialWritePlannerTest {
    private val original = ByteArray(16) { it.toByte() }
    private val layout = EcuPartialWritePlanner.Layout(
        regionStartAddress = 0x1000L,
        regionSize = 16L,
        eraseBlockBytes = 8,
        programBlockBytes = 2
    )

    @Test fun oneChangedBytePreservesEveryNeighborWithinItsEraseSector() {
        val modified = original.clone()
        modified[3] = 99
        val result = EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout, original, modified)
        assertEquals(1L, result.changedBytes)
        assertEquals(1, result.affectedSectors.size)
        val sector = result.affectedSectors.single()
        assertEquals(0x1000L, sector.absoluteAddress)
        assertEquals(1, sector.changedBytes)
        assertArrayEquals(original.copyOfRange(0, 8), sector.originalBytes)
        assertArrayEquals(modified.copyOfRange(0, 8), sector.patchedBytes)
        assertFalse(result.hardwareWritePermitted)
    }

    @Test fun twoChangesInSameEraseBlockDoNotProduceTwoErases() {
        val modified = original.clone()
        modified[1] = 101
        modified[7] = 107
        val result = EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout, original, modified)
        assertEquals(2L, result.changedBytes)
        assertEquals(1, result.affectedSectors.size)
    }

    @Test fun changesAcrossEraseBoundaryGenerateDistinctSectors() {
        val modified = original.clone()
        modified[7] = 107
        modified[8] = 108
        val result = EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout, original, modified)
        assertEquals(2L, result.changedBytes)
        assertEquals(listOf(0x1000L, 0x1008L),
            result.affectedSectors.map { it.absoluteAddress })
    }

    @Test fun unchangedImagesRequireNoSectorOperation() {
        val result = EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout, original, original.clone())
        assertEquals(0L, result.changedBytes)
        assertEquals(0, result.affectedSectors.size)
    }

    @Test fun protectedMemoryIsRejectedWithoutModifyingSourceImage() {
        val modified = original.clone()
        modified[4] = 101
        val guarded = layout.copy(protectedRanges = listOf(
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.Range(0x1004L, 0x1006L)
        ))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(guarded, original, modified)
        }
        assertEquals(4.toByte(), original[4])
    }

    @Test fun touchingAnUnprotectedByteMustNotEraseProtectedNeighborInSameSector() {
        val modified = original.clone()
        modified[1] = 100
        val guarded = layout.copy(protectedRanges = listOf(
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.Range(0x1004L, 0x1006L)
        ))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(guarded, original, modified)
        }
        assertEquals(1.toByte(), original[1])
    }

    @Test fun rejectsIncompleteOrMismatchedSectorGeometryAndImageSizes() {
        val modified = original.clone()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout, original, modified.copyOf(15))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout.copy(eraseBlockBytes = 6), original, modified)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout.copy(programBlockBytes = 3), original, modified)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout.copy(regionStartAddress = 0x1001L), original, modified)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            EcuPartialWritePlanner.preview(layout.copy(regionSize = 15L), original, modified)
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class EcuRecoveryAssessmentTest {
    private val safe = EcuRecoveryAssessment.Context(
        programmingWasInterrupted = true,
        linkStatus = EcuRecoveryAssessment.LinkStatus.COMMUNICATING,
        powerStatus = EcuRecoveryAssessment.PowerStatus.VERIFIED_STABLE,
        ecuIdentityVerified = true,
        originalBackupAvailable = true,
        validatedRecoveryDriverAvailable = true
    )

    @Test fun communicatingEcuGetsReadOnlyAssessmentNotBlindRetry() {
        val result = EcuRecoveryAssessment.assess(safe)
        assertEquals(EcuRecoveryAssessment.Disposition.CHECK_ECU_WITHOUT_WRITING, result.disposition)
        assertFalse(result.automaticRetryAllowed)
        assertFalse(result.restoreGuaranteed)
    }

    @Test fun missingCommunicationSuggestsBenchTriageNotAnAutomaticFlash() {
        val result = EcuRecoveryAssessment.assess(safe.copy(
            linkStatus = EcuRecoveryAssessment.LinkStatus.NOT_RESPONDING
        ))
        assertEquals(EcuRecoveryAssessment.Disposition.ASSESS_BENCH_RECOVERY, result.disposition)
        assertFalse(result.automaticRetryAllowed)
    }

    @Test fun missingBackupUnstablePowerOrUnknownIdentityBlocksRecovery() {
        listOf(
            safe.copy(originalBackupAvailable = false),
            safe.copy(powerStatus = EcuRecoveryAssessment.PowerStatus.UNSTABLE),
            safe.copy(ecuIdentityVerified = false),
            safe.copy(validatedRecoveryDriverAvailable = false),
            safe.copy(linkStatus = EcuRecoveryAssessment.LinkStatus.NOT_CHECKED)
        ).forEach { context ->
            val result = EcuRecoveryAssessment.assess(context)
            assertEquals(EcuRecoveryAssessment.Disposition.STOP_AND_PRESERVE_EVIDENCE, result.disposition)
            assertTrue(EcuRecoveryAssessment.Warning.INTERRUPTION_REQUIRES_REASSESSMENT in result.warnings)
            assertFalse(result.automaticRetryAllowed)
        }
    }

    @Test fun noRecordedInterruptionMustNotBecomeARecoveryOperation() {
        val result = EcuRecoveryAssessment.assess(safe.copy(programmingWasInterrupted = false))
        assertEquals(EcuRecoveryAssessment.Disposition.NOT_AN_INTERRUPTED_SESSION, result.disposition)
        assertTrue(result.warnings.isEmpty())
    }
}

FICHIER : communication/src/test/java/com/camarodiag/gen5/data/obd/EcuWriteTransactionTest.kt

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class EcuWriteTransactionTest {
    private val original = ByteArray(16) { it.toByte() }
    private val expectedIdentity = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Identity(
        controllerId = "E39-test", firmwareId = "firmware-test",
        vin = "2G1TEST0000000001"
    )
    private val originalLayout = EcuPartialWritePlanner.Layout(
        regionStartAddress = 0x1000L, regionSize = 16L,
        eraseBlockBytes = 8, programBlockBytes = 2,
        mapVerifiedForTargetEcu = true
    )

    private fun request(
        updated: ByteArray = original.copyOf().also { it[2] = 100 },
        evidence: EcuWriteTransaction.SafetyEvidence = EcuWriteTransaction.SafetyEvidence(
            oemChecksumValidated = true,
            independentHardwareBackupVerified = true,
            recoveryProcedureValidated = true
        )
    ) = EcuWriteTransaction.Request(
        controllerFamily = "E39", transport = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534,
        expectedIdentity = expectedIdentity, region = EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION,
        layout = originalLayout, originalImage = original.copyOf(),
        updatedImage = updated, evidence = evidence
    )

    private class FakeDriver(
        initial: ByteArray,
        private val identity: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Identity,
        validated: Boolean = true
    ) : EcuProgrammingDriverContract {
        val memory = initial.copyOf()
        var eraseCalls = 0
        val writes = mutableListOf<EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest>()
        val writeCalls: Int get() = writes.size
        var failWriteAt: Long? = null
        var resetCalls = 0
        var corruptAfterWrite = false
        var failOnErase = false
        override val descriptor = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Descriptor(
            id = "in-memory-test-only",
            transport = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.J2534,
            capabilities = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Capability.values().toSet(),
            controllerFamilies = setOf("E39"),
            physicalHardwareValidated = validated,
            writeTargets = setOf(
                EcuProgrammingDriverContract.FirmwareTarget("E39", "E39-test", "firmware-test"),
                EcuProgrammingDriverContract.FirmwareTarget("E39", "E39-test", "firmware-update")
            )
        )

        private fun start(request: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest): Int {
            val start = (request.address - 0x1000L).toInt()
            require(start >= 0 && request.length >= 0 && start + request.length <= memory.size)
            return start
        }

        override suspend fun identify() = identity
        override suspend fun read(request: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest): ByteArray {
            val start = start(request)
            return memory.copyOfRange(start, start + request.length.toInt())
        }
        override suspend fun erase(request: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest) {
            if (failOnErase) error("Lost connection before erasure")
            val start = start(request)
            memory.fill(0.toByte(), start, start + request.length.toInt())
            eraseCalls++
        }
        override suspend fun write(
            request: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest,
            bytes: ByteArray
        ) {
            require(bytes.size.toLong() == request.length)
            writes += request
            if (request.address == failWriteAt) error("Connection lost during write")
            bytes.copyInto(memory, destinationOffset = start(request))
        }
        override suspend fun independentReadback(
            request: EcuProgrammingDriverContract.RegionRequest
        ): ByteArray {
            val result = read(request)
            if (corruptAfterWrite && writeCalls > 0) result[0] = (result[0] + 1).toByte()
            return result
        }
        override suspend fun resetController() {
            resetCalls++
        }
    }

    private fun journal(records: MutableList<EcuWriteTransaction.Record>) =
        EcuWriteTransaction.Journal { records += it }

    @Test fun realEntryPointCannotWriteWithoutRegisteredHardwareDriver() = runBlocking {
        val records = mutableListOf<EcuWriteTransaction.Record>()
        val outcome = EcuWriteTransaction.execute(
            request(), journal(records), EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        )
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.BLOCKED, outcome.status)
        assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_DRIVER in outcome.blockers)
        assertTrue(records.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun publicWriteEntryPointRejectsUnvalidatedHardwareBeforeCreatingJournal() = runBlocking {
        val directory = java.nio.file.Files.createTempDirectory("camarodiag-ecu-write")
        try {
            val file = directory.resolve("write-journal.log").toFile()
            val outcome = EcuWriteTransaction.execute(
                request(), file, EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
            )
            assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.BLOCKED, outcome.status)
            assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_DRIVER in outcome.blockers)
            assertFalse("No journal should be created for an unvalidated driver", file.exists())
        } finally {
            java.nio.file.Files.deleteIfExists(directory)
        }
    }

    @Test fun preparationRejectsElmMissingChecksAndUnverifiedMap() {
        val invalid = request(evidence = EcuWriteTransaction.SafetyEvidence()).copy(
            transport = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.Transport.ELM_DIAGNOSTICS,
            layout = originalLayout.copy(mapVerifiedForTargetEcu = false)
        )
        val result = EcuWriteTransaction.prepare(invalid)
        assertFalse(result.canAttemptWithValidatedHardware)
        assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_TRANSPORT in result.blockers)
        assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.UNVERIFIED_MEMORY_MAP in result.blockers)
        assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.UNVERIFIED_OEM_CHECKSUM in result.blockers)
        assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.UNVERIFIED_HARDWARE_BACKUP in result.blockers)
        assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_RECOVERY in result.blockers)
    }

    @Test fun simulatedSectorSequencePreservesNeighborsAndVerifiesEveryWrittenSector() = runBlocking {
        val updated = original.copyOf().also { it[2] = 100; it[10] = 110 }
        val device = FakeDriver(original, expectedIdentity)
        val records = mutableListOf<EcuWriteTransaction.Record>()
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, journal(records), EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request(updated))
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.COMPLETED, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(2, outcome.verifiedSectors)
        assertArrayEquals(updated, device.memory)
        assertEquals(2, device.eraseCalls)
        assertEquals((0x1000L until 0x1010L step 2).toList(), device.writes.map { it.address })
        assertTrue(device.writes.all { it.length == 2L })
        assertEquals(0, device.resetCalls)
        assertEquals(4, records.count { it.stage == EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BASELINE_CHECKED ||
            it.stage == EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.VERIFIED_AFTER_WRITE })
        assertEquals(2, records.count { it.stage == EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BEFORE_ERASE })
    }

    @Test fun sameDriverAcceptsBothDocumentedFirmwareVersions() = runBlocking {
        for (firmware in listOf("firmware-test", "firmware-update")) {
            val identity = expectedIdentity.copy(firmwareId = firmware)
            val device = FakeDriver(original, identity)
            val req = request().copy(expectedIdentity = identity)
            val result = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
                device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {}, EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
            ).run(req)
            assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.COMPLETED, result.status)
            assertArrayEquals(req.updatedImage, device.memory)
        }
    }

    @Test fun matchingLiveIdentityStillRequiresACoveredControllerAndFirmwarePair() = runBlocking {
        for (identity in listOf(
            expectedIdentity.copy(firmwareId = "unlisted-firmware"),
            expectedIdentity.copy(controllerId = "other-controller")
        )) {
            val device = FakeDriver(original, identity)
            val result = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
                device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {}, EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
            ).run(request().copy(expectedIdentity = identity))
            assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.BLOCKED, result.status)
            assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.NO_VALIDATED_DRIVER in result.blockers)
            assertEquals(0, device.eraseCalls)
            assertEquals(0, device.writeCalls)
        }
    }

    @Test fun baselineMismatchStopsBeforeAnyErase() = runBlocking {
        val liveMemory = original.copyOf().also { it[5] = 42 }
        val device = FakeDriver(liveMemory, expectedIdentity)
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {},
            EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request())
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(0, device.eraseCalls)
        assertEquals(0, device.writeCalls)
    }

    @Test fun mismatchedVinOrFirmwareStopsBeforeAnyErase() = runBlocking {
        val device = FakeDriver(
            original, expectedIdentity.copy(firmwareId = "different-firmware")
        )
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {},
            EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request())
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(0, device.eraseCalls)
    }

    @Test fun lossOfPowerAfterEraseNeverCausesBlindWriteRetry() = runBlocking {
        val device = FakeDriver(original, expectedIdentity)
        var checks = 0
        val records = mutableListOf<EcuWriteTransaction.Record>()
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, journal(records),
            EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { ++checks < 3 }
        ).run(request())
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(1, device.eraseCalls)
        assertEquals(0, device.writeCalls)
        assertTrue(records.any { it.stage == EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BEFORE_ERASE })
        assertEquals(0, outcome.verifiedSectors)
    }

    @Test fun stopsAtFailedProgrammingUnitWithoutErasingTheNextSector() = runBlocking {
        val device = FakeDriver(original, expectedIdentity)
        device.failWriteAt = 0x1002L
        val records = mutableListOf<EcuWriteTransaction.Record>()
        val updated = original.copyOf().also { it[2] = 100; it[10] = 110 }
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, journal(records), EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request(updated))
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(0x1002L, outcome.failedAddress)
        assertEquals(listOf(0x1000L, 0x1002L), device.writes.map { it.address })
        assertEquals(1, device.eraseCalls)
        assertEquals(0, outcome.verifiedSectors)
        assertFalse(records.any { it.stage == EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.VERIFIED_AFTER_WRITE })
    }

    @Test fun readbackMismatchStopsWithoutProgrammingNextSector() = runBlocking {
        val device = FakeDriver(original, expectedIdentity)
        device.corruptAfterWrite = true
        val updated = original.copyOf().also { it[2] = 100; it[10] = 110 }
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {},
            EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request(updated))
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(1, device.eraseCalls)
        assertEquals(4, device.writeCalls)
        assertEquals(0, outcome.verifiedSectors)
    }

    @Test fun failingJournalBeforeErasePreventsAllDestructiveOperations() = runBlocking {
        val device = FakeDriver(original, expectedIdentity)
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal { record ->
                if (record.stage == EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BEFORE_ERASE) error("storage full")
            },
            EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request())
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.STOPPED_REQUIRES_ASSESSMENT, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(0, device.eraseCalls)
        assertEquals(0, device.writeCalls)
    }

    @Test fun unvalidatedFakeDriverIsBlockedByInternalEngineAsWell() = runBlocking {
        val device = FakeDriver(original, expectedIdentity, validated = false)
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {},
            EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request())
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.BLOCKED, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(0, device.eraseCalls)
    }

    @Test fun invalidLayoutAndNoChangeNeverAttemptAnErase() = runBlocking {
        val invalid = EcuWriteTransaction.prepare(
            request().copy(layout = originalLayout.copy(eraseBlockBytes = 3))
        )
        assertTrue(EcuWriteTransaction.Blocker.INVALID_IMAGE_OR_LAYOUT in invalid.blockers)
        val device = FakeDriver(original, expectedIdentity)
        val outcome = EcuWriteExecutionEngine(
            device, EcuWriteTransaction.Journal {},
            EcuWriteTransaction.PowerMonitor { true }
        ).run(request(original.copyOf()))
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Status.NO_CHANGE, outcome.status)
        assertEquals(0, device.eraseCalls)
    }

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

class EthanolContentPidDecoderTest {
    @Test fun decodesValidMode01Pid52Only() {
        assertEquals(0.0, EthanolContentPidDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x52, 0x00))!!, 0.001)
        assertEquals(100.0, EthanolContentPidDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x52, 0xFF.toByte()))!!, 0.001)
        assertEquals(50.196, EthanolContentPidDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x52, 0x80.toByte()))!!, 0.01)
        assertNull(EthanolContentPidDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x53, 0x80.toByte())))
        assertNull(EthanolContentPidDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf(0x7F, 0x01, 0x12)))
        assertNull(EthanolContentPidDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x52)))
        assertNull(EthanolContentPidDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x52, 0x80.toByte(), 0x00)))
    }

    @Test fun checksSupportedPidBitWithoutAssumingFlexFuelCapability() {
        assertTrue(EthanolContentPidDecoder.isSupported(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x40, 0, 0, 0x40, 0)))
        assertFalse(EthanolContentPidDecoder.isSupported(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x40, 0, 0, 0, 0)))
        assertFalse(EthanolContentPidDecoder.isSupported(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x20, 0, 0, 0x40, 0)))
        assertFalse(EthanolContentPidDecoder.isSupported(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x40, 0x40, 0)))
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.StringReader

class J2534BridgeProtocolTest {
    @Test
    fun readsOneJsonLineAndLeavesFollowingResponseAvailable() {
        val input = BufferedReader(StringReader("{\"ok\":true}\n{\"ok\":false}\n"))

        assertEquals("{\"ok\":true}", J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
        assertEquals("{\"ok\":false}", J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
        assertNull(J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
    }

    @Test
    fun returnsFinalLineWhenPeerClosesWithoutNewline() {
        val input = BufferedReader(StringReader("{\"ok\":true}"))

        assertEquals("{\"ok\":true}", J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
        assertNull(J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsOversizedBridgeResponseLine() {
        val input = BufferedReader(StringReader("x".repeat(32 * 1024 + 1) + "\n"))

        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun acceptsMaximumAllowedResponseLineAndHandlesCrLf() {
        val maximum = "x".repeat(32 * 1024)
        val input = BufferedReader(StringReader(maximum + "\r\nnext\r\n"))

        assertEquals(maximum, J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
        assertEquals("next", J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
        assertNull(J2534BridgeProtocol.readBoundedLine(input))
    }


    @Test
    fun clampsBridgeOperationTimeoutToSafeBounds() {
        assertEquals(100, J2534BridgeProtocol.boundedTimeoutMs(0))
        assertEquals(100, J2534BridgeProtocol.boundedTimeoutMs(25))
        assertEquals(750, J2534BridgeProtocol.boundedTimeoutMs(750))
        assertEquals(10_000, J2534BridgeProtocol.boundedTimeoutMs(30_000))
    }

}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class J2534LiveMemoryBackupTest {
    private val vin = "1G1FA1RXXR0123456"
    private val baseline = ByteArray(300) { (it and 0xFF).toByte() }

    private fun request(
        vinOverride: String = vin,
        session: Int = 1,
        length: Int = baseline.size
    ) = J2534LiveMemoryBackup.Request(
        expectedVin = vinOverride,
        region = EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION,
        address = 0x1000L,
        lengthBytes = length,
        chunkBytes = 128,
        diagnosticSession = session,
        controllerLabel = "Unit-test ECU"
    )

    private class ScriptedEcu(
        private val memory: ByteArray,
        private val vin: String,
        private val alterSecondPass: Boolean = false
    ) : UdsPayloadTransport {
        var reads = 0
        val sent = mutableListOf<ByteArray>()
        override suspend fun exchange(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray {
            sent += payload.copyOf()
            return when (payload[0].toInt() and 0xFF) {
                0x22 -> byteArrayOf(0x62, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()) +
                    vin.toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
                0x10 -> byteArrayOf(0x50, payload[1])
                0x3E -> byteArrayOf(0x7E, 0x00)
                0x23 -> {
                    require(payload.size == 8 && payload[1] == 0x24.toByte())
                    val address = ((payload[2].toLong() and 0xFF) shl 24) or
                        ((payload[3].toLong() and 0xFF) shl 16) or
                        ((payload[4].toLong() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                        (payload[5].toLong() and 0xFF)
                    val offset = (address - 0x1000L).toInt()
                    val length = ((payload[6].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                        (payload[7].toInt() and 0xFF)
                    require(offset >= 0 && offset + length <= memory.size)
                    val body = memory.copyOfRange(offset, offset + length)
                    if (alterSecondPass && reads >= 3) body[0] = (body[0] + 1).toByte()
                    reads++
                    byteArrayOf(0x63) + body
                }
                else -> error("Unexpected UDS service")
            }
        }
        override suspend fun sendOnly(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long) =
            error("Unexpected sendOnly")
    }

    @Test fun twoIndependentReadPassesBecomeAConsistentOfflineArchive() = runBlocking {
        val fake = ScriptedEcu(baseline, vin)
        val result = J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(fake, request())
        assertArrayEquals(baseline, result.capture.firstRead)
        assertArrayEquals(baseline, result.capture.independentRead)
        assertTrue(result.verification.consistent)
        assertFalse(result.manifest.hardwareProvenanceVerified)
        assertEquals(EcuBackupManifest.Origin.SIMULATION, result.capture.origin)
        assertEquals(6, fake.reads)
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        result.export(output)
        val imported = EcuBackupArchive.import(ByteArrayInputStream(output.toByteArray()))
        assertTrue(imported.verification.consistent)
        assertEquals(vin, imported.manifest.vehicleVin)
        assertEquals(result.manifest, imported.manifest)
    }

    @Test fun aDifferentLiveVinStopsBeforeAnyMemoryRequest() = runBlocking {
        val fake = ScriptedEcu(baseline, vin)
        val invalid = request("1G1FA1RXXR0123457")
        assertTrue(runCatching { J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(fake, invalid) }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(0, fake.reads)
    }

    @Test fun aDifferentVinAfterBothPassesRejectsTheCapture() = runBlocking {
        val ecu = ScriptedEcu(baseline, vin)
        val replacement = ScriptedEcu(baseline, "1G1FA1RXXR0123457")
        val transport = object : UdsPayloadTransport by ecu {
            override suspend fun exchange(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray =
                if (payload[0] == 0x22.toByte() && ecu.reads > 0) replacement.exchange(payload, timeoutMs)
                else ecu.exchange(payload, timeoutMs)
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching { J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(transport, request()) }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(6, ecu.reads)
    }

    @Test fun divergentSecondPassRejectsTheEntireCapture() = runBlocking {
        val fake = ScriptedEcu(baseline, vin, alterSecondPass = true)
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(fake, request())
        }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(6, fake.reads)
    }

    @Test fun reportsMonotonicProgressAcrossTwoActualReadPasses() = runBlocking {
        val snapshots = mutableListOf<J2534LiveMemoryBackup.CaptureProgress>()
        val fake = ScriptedEcu(baseline, vin)
        val result = J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(fake, request()) { snapshots += it }
        assertTrue(result.verification.consistent)
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 1, 2, 2), snapshots.map { it.pass })
        assertEquals(listOf(0L, 300L, 300L, 600L), snapshots.map { it.totalBytesRead })
        assertTrue(snapshots.all { it.requiredBytesRead == 600L })
    }

    @Test fun extendedReadSessionIsClosedAfterDoubleCapture() = runBlocking {
        val fake = ScriptedEcu(baseline, vin)
        J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(fake, request(session = 3))
        val sessions = fake.sent.filter { it[0] == 0x10.toByte() }.map { it[1].toInt() and 0xFF }
        assertEquals(listOf(3, 1), sessions)
        assertEquals(6, fake.reads)
    }

    @Test fun illegalMemoryRangesFailBeforeSendingAnyHardwareCommand() = runBlocking {
        val fake = ScriptedEcu(baseline, vin)
        assertTrue(runCatching { J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(
            fake, request().copy(address = 0xFFFFFFFFL)
        ) }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching { J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(
            fake, request().copy(chunkBytes = 512)
        ) }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching { J2534LiveMemoryBackup.captureForTest(
            fake, request().copy(diagnosticSession = 2)
        ) }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(fake.sent.isEmpty())
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse

class Lfx2012ControllerReferencesTest {
    @Test fun referencesAreListedWithoutImplyingFirmwareCompatibility() {
        assertEquals("E39", Lfx2012ControllerReferences.controllerFamily)
        assertEquals(
            listOf("12651994", "12643248", "12651993", "12637106", "12642665", "12650256", "12616889"),
            Lfx2012ControllerReferences.describedServiceParts()
        )
        val groups = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.servicePartGroups.associateBy { it.servicePart }
        assertEquals("12632286", groups.getValue("12651994").catalogBootFile)
        assertEquals(null, groups.getValue("12651993").catalogBootFile)
        assertFalse("12653998" in Lfx2012ControllerReferences.describedServiceParts())
    }

    @Test fun lookupHandlesMultipleLabelsOnTheSameServiceNumber() {
        val expected = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.Label("12643248", "12648906", "AA69")
        assertEquals(listOf(expected), Lfx2012ControllerReferences.findLabels(" aa69 "))
        assertEquals(listOf(expected), Lfx2012ControllerReferences.findLabels("12648906"))
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.findLabels("12643248").containsAll(listOf(
            expected, Lfx2012ControllerReferences.Label("12643248", "12648432", "AA6L")
        )))
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.findLabels("12653998").isEmpty())
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.findLabels("1264").isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun fingerprintRequiresEcuNameCalIdAndCvn() {
        val complete = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ObservedIdentity(
            ecuName = "ECM E39",
            calibrationIds = listOf("12345678"),
            calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf("FABC")
        )
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(complete))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
            complete.copy(calibrationVerificationNumbers = emptyList())
        ))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
            complete.copy(ecuName = null)
        ))
    }

    @Test fun placeholdersCannotMasqueradeAsACompleteEcuFingerprint() {
        val identity = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ObservedIdentity(
            ecuName = "ECM E39",
            calibrationIds = listOf("12612345"),
            calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf("FABC")
        )
        listOf("unknown", "DEMO E39", "simulated ECU", "N/A", "00000000", "FFFFFFFF").forEach { fake ->
            assertFalse("ECU name: $fake", Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(identity.copy(ecuName = fake)))
            assertFalse("CAL ID: $fake", Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(identity.copy(calibrationIds = listOf(fake))))
            assertFalse("CVN: $fake", Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(identity.copy(calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf(fake))))
        }
    }

    @Test fun anyValidEntryIsEnoughWhenOtherEcusReturnPlaceholders() {
        val identity = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ObservedIdentity(
            ecuName = "ECM E39",
            calibrationIds = listOf("N/A", "12612345"),
            calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf("00000000", "12A4")
        )
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(identity))
    }

    @Test fun multilinePlaceholderResponsesDoNotFormACompleteFingerprint() {
        val valid = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ObservedIdentity(
            ecuName = "ECM E39",
            calibrationIds = listOf("12612345"),
            calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf("12A4")
        )
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
            valid.copy(ecuName = "UNKNOWN\nSIMULATED")
        ))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
            valid.copy(calibrationIds = listOf("N/A\n00000000"))
        ))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
            valid.copy(calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf("FFFFFFFF\nTBD"))
        ))
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
            valid.copy(calibrationIds = listOf("N/A\n12612345"))
        ))
    }

    @Test fun elmErrorsAndFormattedPlaceholdersNeverValidateAnEcuFingerprint() {
        val base = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ObservedIdentity(
            ecuName = "ACDelco E39",
            calibrationIds = listOf("12612345"),
            calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf("1234ABCD")
        )
        val invalid = listOf(
            "NO DATA", "NO RESPONSE", "ERROR", "UNAVAILABLE", "ECU: UNKNOWN",
            "ECU: DEMO E39", "SIMULATED E39", "0x00 00 00", "0xFF FF FF",
            "00:00:00", "FF-FF-FF"
        )
        invalid.forEach { value ->
            assertFalse("ECU name $value", Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
                base.copy(ecuName = value)
            ))
            assertFalse("Calibration ID $value", Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
                base.copy(calibrationIds = listOf(value))
            ))
            assertFalse("CVN $value", Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(
                base.copy(calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf(value))
            ))
        }
    }

    @Test fun e39FamilyMatchingAvoidsSubstringFalsePositives() {
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCandidateE39FamilyLabel("ACDelco E39 ECM"))
        assertTrue(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCandidateE39FamilyLabel("E39A / ECM"))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCandidateE39FamilyLabel("E390"))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCandidateE39FamilyLabel("XXE39"))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCandidateE39FamilyLabel("DEMO E39"))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCandidateE39FamilyLabel(null))
    }

    @Test fun ecuResponderProvenanceRequiresReadableCanAddresses() {
        val classify = Lfx2012ControllerReferences::classifyResponderAttribution
        val none = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ResponderAttribution.NO_VALID_CAN_ADDRESS
        val one = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ResponderAttribution.SINGLE_ADDRESS_OBSERVED
        val multiple = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ResponderAttribution.MULTIPLE_ADDRESSES_OBSERVED
        assertEquals(none, classify(emptyList()))
        assertEquals(none, classify(listOf("unknown", "7E8")))
        assertEquals(none, classify(listOf("7E8", "NO DATA")))
        assertEquals(one, classify(listOf("7e8", "0x7E8", "7E8")))
        assertEquals(one, classify(listOf("18daf110")))
        assertEquals(multiple, classify(listOf("7E8", "7E9")))
        assertEquals(multiple, classify(listOf("18DAF110", "18DAF118")))
    }

    @Test fun syntheticEcuResponsesNeverCountAsCompleteIdentity() {
        val fields = Lfx2012ControllerReferences.ObservedIdentity(
            ecuName = "ACDelco E39",
            calibrationIds = listOf("12612345"),
            calibrationVerificationNumbers = listOf("1234ABCD")

        assertFalse(
            Lfx2012ControllerReferences.hasCompleteReadOnlyFingerprint(

            )
        )
    }

    @Test fun aCompleteReadOnlyFingerprintNeverAuthorizesAWrite() {
        val vehicle = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Vehicle(

            controllerId = "E39",

            verifiedFirmware = false,

    }

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue

class Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflightTest {
    private val vehicle = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Vehicle(
        modelYear = 2012,
        engineCode = "LFX",
        generation = 5,
        selectedVin = "2G1FF3D36C9104199",
        ecuVin = "2G1FF3D36C9104199"
    )
    private val evidence = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Evidence(
        controllerId = "unknown-controller",
        firmwareId = "unknown-firmware",
        verifiedFirmware = true,
        originalBackupVerified = true,
        recoveryVerified = true
    )

    @Test fun refusesWritingEvenWithEveryReportedPrerequisite() {
        val problems = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.missingPreconditions(vehicle, evidence)
        assertTrue(problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.WRITE_NOT_VALIDATED))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.canWriteCalibration(vehicle, evidence))
    }

    @Test fun blocksVinMismatchAndUnidentifiedFirmware() {
        val mismatched = vehicle.copy(ecuVin = "1G1FF3D36C9104199")
        val unknown = evidence.copy(controllerId = null, verifiedFirmware = false)
        val problems = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.missingPreconditions(mismatched, unknown)
        assertTrue(problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.VIN_MISMATCH))
        assertTrue(problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.ECU_IDENTITY_MISSING))
        assertTrue(problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.FIRMWARE_NOT_VERIFIED))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.canWriteCalibration(mismatched, unknown))
    }

    @Test fun placeholderControllerAndFirmwareNeverCountAsIdentity() {
        val problems = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.missingPreconditions(vehicle, evidence)
        assertTrue(problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.ECU_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.canWriteCalibration(vehicle, evidence))
    }

    @Test fun concreteNonPlaceholderIdsDoNotTriggerPlaceholderWarning() {
        val identified = evidence.copy(controllerId = "12600001", firmwareId = "CAL-12345")
        val problems = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.missingPreconditions(vehicle, identified)
        assertFalse(problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.ECU_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED))
        assertTrue(problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.WRITE_NOT_VALIDATED))
        assertFalse(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.canWriteCalibration(vehicle, identified))
    }

    @Test fun refusesOtherEnginesAndYears() {
        assertTrue(
            Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.missingPreconditions(
                vehicle.copy(modelYear = 2013), evidence
            ).contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.WRONG_VEHICLE)
        )
    }
    @Test fun zeroFilledAndUnavailableIdentitiesAreRejected() {
        val invalidIds = listOf("00000000", "0x000000", "FFFFFFFF", "0xFFFFFF", "N/A", "TBD", "pending", "not supported", "test")
        invalidIds.forEach { invalid ->
            val problems = Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.missingPreconditions(
                vehicle,
                evidence.copy(controllerId = invalid, firmwareId = invalid)
            )
            assertTrue("Must reject placeholder: $invalid", problems.contains(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.Status.ECU_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED))
            assertFalse(Lfx2012FlexFuelPreflight.canWriteCalibration(vehicle, evidence.copy(controllerId = invalid, firmwareId = invalid)))
        }
    }

}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue

class Lfx2012ProgrammingAuditTest {
    private val before = Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.Snapshot(
        vin = "2G1FF3D36C9104199", ecuName = "E39",
        calibrationIds = listOf("12612345"), verificationNumbers = listOf("1234ABCD"),
        dtcs = emptyList(), voltage = 12.6, communicationConfirmed = true,
        functionalCheckPassed = true, oemRelearnReviewed = true, capturedAtUtcMillis = 1L
    )

    @Test fun absentPostProgrammingCaptureIsAlwaysNotPerformed() {
        val report = Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.review(before, null)
        assertEquals(Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.Overall.NOT_PERFORMED, report.overall)
        assertEquals(9, report.before.size)
        assertTrue(report.after.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(report.physicalValidationComplete)
    }

    @Test fun completeInputsOnlyQualifyForManualReviewNotVehicleApproval() {
        val report = Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.review(before, before.copy(capturedAtUtcMillis = 2L))
        assertEquals(Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.Overall.READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW, report.overall)
        assertFalse(report.physicalValidationComplete)
    }

    @Test fun changedVinOrNonchronologicalEvidenceRequiresReview() {
        assertEquals(Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.Overall.REQUIRES_REVIEW,
            Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.review(before,
                before.copy(vin = "1G1FF3D36C9104199", capturedAtUtcMillis = 2L)).overall)
        assertEquals(Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.Overall.REQUIRES_REVIEW,
            Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.review(before, before.copy(capturedAtUtcMillis = 1L)).overall)
    }

    @Test fun unavailableDtcOrSkippedFunctionalChecksDoNotCountAsComplete() {
        val report = Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.review(
            before,
            before.copy(dtcs = null, functionalCheckPassed = null,
                oemRelearnReviewed = false, capturedAtUtcMillis = 2L)
        )
        assertEquals(Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.Overall.INCOMPLETE, report.overall)
    }

    @Test fun failedCommunicationCannotBeReportedAsPassing() {
        val report = Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.review(
            before, before.copy(communicationConfirmed = false, capturedAtUtcMillis = 2L))
        assertEquals(Lfx2012ProgrammingAudit.Overall.REQUIRES_REVIEW, report.overall)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ObdReadWakeupTest {
    @Test
    fun disconnectWakesOnlyTheReaderCurrentlyWaiting() = runBlocking {
        val wakeup = ObdReadWakeup()
        val firstWaiter = wakeup.beginWait()
        val failure = IllegalStateException("BLE disconnected")

        wakeup.signal(failure)

        assertTrue(firstWaiter.isCompleted)
        assertSame(failure, firstWaiter.await())
        wakeup.endWait(firstWaiter)

        val nextWaiter = wakeup.beginWait()
        assertFalse(nextWaiter.isCompleted)
        wakeup.endWait(nextWaiter)
    }

    @Test
    fun endingAnOlderWaitDoesNotClearAReplacementWaiter() = runBlocking {
        val wakeup = ObdReadWakeup()
        val olderWaiter = wakeup.beginWait()
        val currentWaiter = wakeup.beginWait()
        val failure = IllegalStateException("Current BLE session disconnected")

        wakeup.endWait(olderWaiter)
        wakeup.signal(failure)

        assertFalse(olderWaiter.isCompleted)
        assertTrue(currentWaiter.isCompleted)
        assertSame(failure, currentWaiter.await())
        wakeup.endWait(currentWaiter)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ObdTransportConnectionStateTest {
    @Test
    fun bleDisconnectIsReportedAsIoFailureToConnectionMonitor() {
        val error = ObdTransportDisconnectedException("BLE disconnected")
        assertTrue(java.io.IOException::class.java.isAssignableFrom(error.javaClass))
    }

    @Test
    fun classicBluetoothRequiresAnOpenConnectedSocket() {
        assertTrue(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "BLUETOOTH", classicSocketConnected = true, classicSocketClosed = false
        ))
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "BLUETOOTH", classicSocketConnected = true, classicSocketClosed = true
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun bleAvailabilityFollowsCurrentGattSession() {
        assertTrue(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "BLE", bleConnected = true
        ))
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "BLE", bleConnected = false
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun usbAndWifiRequireTheirOwnLiveConnectionState() {
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "USB"
        ))
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "WIFI"
        ))
        assertTrue(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "USB", usbConnected = true
        ))
        assertTrue(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "WIFI", wifiConnected = true
        ))
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, true, "USB", usbConnected = true
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun demoAndSimulationNeverExposePhysicalCommandChannel() {
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            true, false, "USB"
        ))
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, true, "WIFI"
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun sessionInvalidationRejectsPendingWorkAfterReconnect() {
        val epoch = ObdTransportSessionEpoch()
        val original = epoch.capture()
        epoch.requireCurrent(original)

        epoch.invalidate()
        val replacement = epoch.capture()
        assertTrue(replacement != original)

        val failure = org.junit.Assert.assertThrows(
            ObdTransportDisconnectedException::class.java
        ) { epoch.requireCurrent(original) }
        assertTrue(failure.message.orEmpty().contains("changed"))
        epoch.requireCurrent(replacement)
    }

    @Test
    fun queuedWorkFromReplacedSessionIsNotReportedAsCurrentConnectionLoss() {
        val epoch = ObdTransportSessionEpoch()
        val pendingRequest = epoch.capture()
        epoch.invalidate()
        val currentRequest = epoch.capture()

        val stale = org.junit.Assert.assertThrows(
            ObdSupersededSessionException::class.java
        ) { epoch.requireQueuedCurrent(pendingRequest) }
        assertFalse(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(stale))
        epoch.requireQueuedCurrent(currentRequest)
    }

    @Test
    fun repeatedDisconnectsAdvanceEpochWithoutReusingOldSession() {
        val epoch = ObdTransportSessionEpoch()
        val first = epoch.capture()
        epoch.invalidate()
        val second = epoch.capture()
        epoch.invalidate()
        val third = epoch.capture()

        assertTrue(first < second)
        assertTrue(second < third)
        org.junit.Assert.assertThrows(ObdTransportDisconnectedException::class.java) {
            epoch.requireCurrent(first)
        }
        org.junit.Assert.assertThrows(ObdTransportDisconnectedException::class.java) {
            epoch.requireCurrent(second)
        }
        epoch.requireCurrent(third)
    }

    @Test
    fun unsupportedTransportIsUnavailable() {
        assertFalse(ObdTransportConnectionState.isCommandChannelAvailable(
            false, false, "J2534_BRIDGE"
        ))
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.EOFException
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException

class ObdTransportFailurePolicyTest {
    @Test
    fun explicitTransportDisconnectIsAConnectionLoss() {
        assertTrue(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(
            ObdTransportDisconnectedException("BLE disconnected")
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun endOfStreamIsAConnectionLoss() {
        assertTrue(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(EOFException("USB disconnected")))
    }

    @Test
    fun commandResponseTimeoutDoesNotImplyPhysicalDisconnect() {
        assertFalse(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(
            SocketTimeoutException("ELM prompt not received")
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun wrappedSocketTimeoutDoesNotImplyPhysicalDisconnect() {
        assertFalse(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(
            IOException("command read failed", SocketTimeoutException("prompt timeout"))
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun wrappedIoFailureStillReportsPhysicalDisconnect() {
        assertTrue(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(
            IllegalStateException("transport operation failed", EOFException("peer closed"))
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun staleSessionIoFailureDoesNotDisconnectNewAdapter() {
        val oldFailure = ObdSupersededSessionException(
            EOFException("Old adapter closed after reconnect")
        )
        assertFalse(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(oldFailure))
        assertFalse(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(
            IOException("wrapped stale operation", oldFailure)
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun nonIoFailureDoesNotImplyPhysicalDisconnect() {
        assertFalse(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(IllegalStateException("bad command")))
    }

    @Test
    fun genericIoFailureIsTreatedAsTransportLoss() {
        assertTrue(ObdTransportFailurePolicy.isConnectionLoss(IOException("socket closed")))
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

class PersistentEcuWriteJournalTest {
    @get:Rule val temporaryFolder = TemporaryFolder()

    private val target = EcuProgrammingDriverContract.FirmwareTarget("E39", "test-ecu", "test-fw")
    private val vin = "2G1FF3D36C9104199"
    private val record = EcuWriteTransaction.Record(
        stage = EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BASELINE_CHECKED,
        region = EcuBackupCoverage.Region.CALIBRATION,
        address = 0x1000,
        originalSha256 = "a".repeat(64),
        updatedSha256 = "b".repeat(64)
    )

    private fun newJournal(): Pair<File, PersistentEcuWriteJournal> {
        val file = File(temporaryFolder.root, "ecu-write-journal.txt")
        return file to PersistentEcuWriteJournal(file, target, vin)
    }

    @Test fun recordsAreDurableAndHashChainedAcrossEraseBoundary() = runBlocking {
        val (file, journal) = newJournal()
        assertTrue(journal.inspect().valid)
        assertEquals(0, journal.inspect().records)
        journal.append(record)
        journal.append(record.copy(stage = EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BEFORE_ERASE))
        journal.append(record.copy(stage = EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.VERIFIED_AFTER_WRITE))
        val audit = journal.inspect()
        assertTrue(audit.valid)
        assertEquals(3, audit.records)
        assertEquals(EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.VERIFIED_AFTER_WRITE, audit.lastStage)
        assertEquals(4, file.readLines().size)
        assertTrue(file.readText().contains(vin))
    }

    @Test fun anyRecordMutationMakesJournalInvalidAndPreventsFurtherWrites() = runBlocking {
        val (file, journal) = newJournal()
        journal.append(record)
        journal.append(record.copy(stage = EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BEFORE_ERASE))
        file.writeText(file.readText().replace("BEFORE_ERASE", "BASELINE_CHECKED"))
        assertFalse(journal.inspect().valid)
        assertTrue(runCatching { journal.append(record) }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun truncatedLastRecordIsDetectedBeforeNextErase() = runBlocking {
        val (file, journal) = newJournal()
        journal.append(record)
        file.writeText(file.readText().dropLast(1))
        assertFalse(journal.inspect().valid)
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            journal.append(record.copy(stage = EcuWriteTransaction.Stage.BEFORE_ERASE))
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun existingTransactionLogCannotBeOverwritten() {
        val (file, _) = newJournal()
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            PersistentEcuWriteJournal(file, target, vin)
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun invalidSha256OrVinIsRejected() = runBlocking {
        val (_, journal) = newJournal()
        assertTrue(runCatching { journal.append(record.copy(updatedSha256 = "NOT_SHA256")) }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(0, journal.inspect().records)
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            PersistentEcuWriteJournal(
                File(temporaryFolder.root, "invalid-vin.txt"), target, "INVALIDVIN"
            )
        }.isFailure)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RawCanFrameParserTest {
    @Test fun parsesElevenBitFrame() {
        val frame = RawCanFrameParser.parse("7E0 02 01 0C")!!
        assertEquals(0x7E0L, frame.canId)
        assertFalse(frame.isExtended)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x02, 0x01, 0x0C), frame.data)
    }

    @Test fun parsesTwentyNineBitFrameAndPrefix() {
        val frame = RawCanFrameParser.parse("0x18DAF110 03 22 F1 90")!!
        assertEquals(0x18DAF110L, frame.canId)
        assertTrue(frame.isExtended)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x03, 0x22, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()), frame.data)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsInvalidIdentifiersAndPayloads() {
        assertNull(RawCanFrameParser.parse("800 01"))
        assertNull(RawCanFrameParser.parse("20000000 01"))
        assertNull(RawCanFrameParser.parse("7E00 01"))
        assertNull(RawCanFrameParser.parse("18DAF11 01"))
        assertNull(RawCanFrameParser.parse("7E0"))
        assertNull(RawCanFrameParser.parse("7E0 GG"))
        assertNull(RawCanFrameParser.parse("7E0 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09"))
    }

    @Test fun acceptsWhitespaceAndLowercaseHex() {
        val frame = RawCanFrameParser.parse("  7e0   0a   ff  ")!!
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x0A, 0xFF.toByte()), frame.data)
    }

    @Test fun stripsDlcWhenDecodingReceivedAdapterFrames() {
        val frames = RawCanFrameParser.parseReceivedFrames(
            "SEARCHING...\r\n7E8 05 41 0C 1A F8 00\r\n18DAF110 03 7F 22 31"
        )
        assertEquals(2, frames.size)
        assertEquals(0x7E8L, frames[0].canId)
        assertFalse(frames[0].isExtended)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x0C, 0x1A, 0xF8.toByte(), 0x00), frames[0].data)
        assertEquals(0x18DAF110L, frames[1].canId)
        assertTrue(frames[1].isExtended)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x7F, 0x22, 0x31), frames[1].data)
    }

    @Test fun acceptsSingleDigitElmDlcForStandardAndExtendedIdentifiers() {
        val frames = RawCanFrameParser.parseReceivedFrames(
            "7E8 8 07 62 F1 90 31 47 30 31\r\n18DAF110 3 7F 22 31"
        )
        assertEquals(2, frames.size)
        assertEquals(0x7E8L, frames[0].canId)
        assertArrayEquals(
            byteArrayOf(0x07, 0x62, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte(), 0x31, 0x47, 0x30, 0x31),
            frames[0].data
        )
        assertEquals(0x18DAF110L, frames[1].canId)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x7F, 0x22, 0x31), frames[1].data)
    }

    @Test fun ignoresAdapterStatusAndMalformedReceivedLines() {
        val frames = RawCanFrameParser.parseReceivedFrames(
            "OK\r\nNO DATA\r\n7E8 03 41 0C\r\n7E8 04 41 0C\r\n7E8 09 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09\r\nNOT A FRAME"
        )
        assertTrue(frames.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun receivesZeroLengthFramesWithoutAllowingMalformedPayloads() {
        val frames = RawCanFrameParser.parseReceivedFrames(
            "7E8 00\r\n18DAF110 0\r\n7E8 00 FF\r\n7E8 09\r\n800 00"
        )
        assertEquals(2, frames.size)
        assertFalse(frames[0].isExtended)
        assertTrue(frames[1].isExtended)
        assertTrue(frames.all { it.data.isEmpty() })
    }

    @Test fun keepsOnlyFramesWhoseDlcMatchesPayloadLength() {
        val frames = RawCanFrameParser.parseReceivedFrames(
            "7E8 03 41 0C 1A\r\n7E8 02 41 0C 1A\r\n7E8 00"
        )
        assertEquals(2, frames.size)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x0C, 0x1A), frames[0].data)
        assertEquals(0x7E8L, frames[1].canId)
        assertTrue(frames[1].data.isEmpty())
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class StnUdsAdapterRestorationTest {
    @Test fun restoresFunctionalObdAfterAPhysicalStnSession() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val result = StnUdsAdapterRestoration.restore { command ->
            commands += command
            "OK\r\n>"
        }
        assertTrue(result.succeeded)
        assertEquals(StnUdsAdapterRestoration.commands, commands)
        assertTrue(commands.indexOf("STCFCPC") < commands.indexOf("ATSP6"))
        assertTrue(commands.indexOf("ATCRA") < commands.indexOf("ATSH 7DF"))
        assertTrue(commands.contains("ATCAF1"))
    }

    @Test fun failedFilterResetIsNotHiddenByLaterSuccessfulCommands() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val result = StnUdsAdapterRestoration.restore { command ->
            commands += command
            if (command == "ATCRA") "NOT OK" else "OK"
        }
        assertFalse(result.succeeded)
        assertEquals(listOf("ATCRA"), result.failedCommands)
        assertEquals(StnUdsAdapterRestoration.commands, commands)
    }

    @Test fun transportExceptionsStillAttemptAllCleanupCommands() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val result = StnUdsAdapterRestoration.restore { command ->
            commands += command
            if (command == "STCSEGR 0") error("Link lost")
            if (command == "STCSEGT 0") "?" else "OK"
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("STCSEGR 0", "STCSEGT 0"), result.failedCommands)
        assertEquals(StnUdsAdapterRestoration.commands, commands)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsEmptyOrAmbiguousAcknowledgements() = runBlocking {
        for (reply in listOf("", "OKAY", "NOT OK", "NO DATA", "?")) {
            val result = StnUdsAdapterRestoration.restore { reply }
            assertFalse(reply, result.succeeded)
            assertEquals(StnUdsAdapterRestoration.commands, result.failedCommands)
        }
    }
}
