package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class StnUdsPayloadTransportTest {
    private val vin = "1G1FA1RXXR0123456"

    @Test fun configuresVerifiedMxPlusAndExchangesCompleteUdsPayload() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") -> "7E8 62 F1 90 " + vin.toByteArray().joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }

        val response = transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()), 3000)

        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x62, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()) + vin.toByteArray(), response)
        assertTrue(commands.contains("STP 33"))
        assertTrue(commands.contains("STCSEGR 1"))
        assertTrue(commands.contains("STCSEGT 1"))
        assertTrue(commands.contains("STCFCPA 7E0, 7E8"))
        assertTrue(commands.any { it.startsWith("STPX h:7E0, d:22F190") })
    }

    @Test fun collectsFinalUdsResponseAfterResponsePending() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") -> "7E8 7F 22 78"
                command == "STMA 1" -> "7E8 62 12 34 AB"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }

        assertArrayEquals(
            byteArrayOf(0x62, 0x12, 0x34, 0xAB.toByte()),
            transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0x12, 0x34), 1000)
        )
        assertTrue(commands.contains("STMA 1"))
    }

    @Test fun rejectsNonMxPlusHardwareBeforeSendingAnyUdsRequest() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when (command) {
                "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                "STDI" -> "Generic STN adapter"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }

        assertTrue(runCatching { transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0x12, 0x34), 1000) }.isFailure)
        assertFalse(commands.any { it.startsWith("STPX") })
    }

    @Test fun sendsSuppressedTesterPresentWithoutWaitingForEcuReply() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }

        transport.sendOnly(byteArrayOf(0x3E, 0x80.toByte()), 1000)

        assertTrue(commands.any { it.startsWith("STPX") && it.endsWith("r:0") })
    }

    @Test fun selectsSingleWireCanIso15765PresetWhenRequested() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 63) { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") -> "7E8 62 F1 90 01"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }

        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x62, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte(), 0x01), transport.exchange(
            byteArrayOf(0x22, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()), 1000
        ))
        assertTrue(commands.contains("STP 63"))
    }

    @Test fun documentedObdLinkModelsUseIsoTpForHsCanDiagnostics() = runBlocking {
        for (model in listOf("EX", "CX", "LX", "SX", "MX")) {
            val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
            val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
                commands += command
                when {
                    command == "STI" -> "STN2100 v5.10.3"
                    command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink $model r3.2.1"
                    command.startsWith("STPX") -> "7E8 62 12 34"
                    else -> "OK"
                }
            }
            assertArrayEquals(
                "HS-CAN UDS must work for OBDLink $model",
                byteArrayOf(0x62, 0x12, 0x34),
                transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0x12, 0x34), 1000)
            )
            assertTrue("Expected ISO-TP on $model", commands.contains("STP 33"))
            assertTrue("Expected actual UDS transaction on $model",
                commands.any { it.startsWith("STPX h:7E0, d:221234") })
        }
    }

    @Test fun swCanIsRejectedBeforeProtocolSelectionOnUnsupportedObdLinkModels() = runBlocking {
        for (model in listOf("EX", "CX", "LX", "SX")) {
            val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
            val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 63) { command, _ ->
                commands += command
                when (command) {
                    "STI" -> "STN2100 v5.10.3"
                    "STDI" -> "OBDLink $model r3.2.1"
                    else -> "OK"
                }
            }
            val result = runCatching {
                transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0x12, 0x34), 1000)
            }
            assertTrue("GM SW-CAN must fail on $model", result.isFailure)
            assertFalse("Unsupported SW-CAN must not be selected on $model",
                commands.any { it.startsWith("STP ") || it.startsWith("STPX") })
        }
    }

    @Test fun assemblesLongStpxPayloadFromMatchingResponderAndContinuationOnly() = runBlocking {
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") ->
                    "STPX h:7E0, d:22F190\n" +
                        "7E9 62 00 00\n" +
                        "7E8 62F190 31 47 31\n" +
                        "32 33 34 35 36\n" +
                        "7E9 DE AD BE EF\n" +
                        "7E8 37 38 39\n" +
                        ">"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }
        assertArrayEquals(
            byteArrayOf(0x62, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()) +
                "1G123456789".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII),
            transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()), 1500)
        )
    }

    @Test fun rejectsUnattributedStpxTextInsteadOfTreatingItAsEcuBytes() = runBlocking {
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") -> "62 F1 90 01\n7E9 62 F1 90 02\nOK"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()), 1000)
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun parsesExtendedCanResponderWithCompactHexPayload() = runBlocking {
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x18DA10F1, 0x18DAF110, 34) { command, _ ->
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") ->
                    "18DAF111 62F190AAAA\n18DAF110 621234AB\n>"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }
        assertArrayEquals(
            byteArrayOf(0x62, 0x12, 0x34, 0xAB.toByte()),
            transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0x12, 0x34), 1000)
        )
    }

    @Test fun rejectsAResponseForAnotherUdsServiceOnTheCorrectCanId() = runBlocking {
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") -> "7E8 59 02 FF"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0xF1.toByte(), 0x90.toByte()), 1000)
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsResponsePendingThatBelongsToAnotherService() = runBlocking {
        val commands = mutableListOf<String>()
        val transport = StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 33) { command, _ ->
            commands += command
            when {
                command == "STI" -> "STN2255 v5.10.3"
                command == "STDI" -> "OBDLink MX+ r3.2.1"
                command.startsWith("STPX") -> "7E8 7F 19 78"
                else -> "OK"
            }
        }
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            transport.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x22, 0x12, 0x34), 1000)
        }.isFailure)
        assertFalse(commands.contains("STMA 1"))

    @Test fun ignoresFalseOkSubstringsDuringStnConfiguration() = runBlocking {

            }

        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsCanIdentifierAndProtocolFormatMismatch() {
        assertTrue(runCatching { StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 34) { _, _ -> "OK" } }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching { StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x18DA10F1, 0x18DAF110, 34) { _, _ -> "OK" } }.isSuccess)
        assertTrue(runCatching { StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x7E0, 0x7E8, 63) { _, _ -> "OK" } }.isSuccess)
        assertTrue(runCatching { StnUdsPayloadTransport(0x18DA10F1, 0x18DAF110, 63) { _, _ -> "OK" } }.isFailure)

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.AdapterCapabilities
import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.AdapterTier
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class StnUdsSessionAdmissionTest {
    private fun adapter(name: String) = AdapterCapabilities(
        deviceName = name,
        tier = AdapterTier.PRO_STN,
        firmwareId = "STN2255 v5.10.3",
        supportsCanHeaders = true,
        supportsCanTransmit = true
    )

    @Test fun everyProbedStnModelUsesOneSharedReadOnlySessionGate() {
        for (name in listOf("OBDLink MX+", "OBDLink MX", "OBDLink EX",
                "OBDLink CX", "OBDLink LX", "OBDLink SX")) {
            assertTrue(name, StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(adapter(name), true))
        }
    }

    @Test fun nameAloneCannotAuthorizePhysicalUds() {
        val forged = adapter("OBDLink MX+")
        assertFalse(StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(forged.copy(
            tier = AdapterTier.CLONE_ELM
        ), true))
        assertFalse(StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(forged.copy(
            firmwareId = "ELM327 v2.1"
        ), true))
        assertFalse(StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(forged.copy(
            supportsCanHeaders = false
        ), true))
        assertFalse(StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(forged.copy(
            supportsCanTransmit = false
        ), true))
        assertFalse(StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(forged, false))
        assertFalse(StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(null, true))
    }

    @Test fun sourceModelDoesNotMatterOncePhysicalEvidenceIsEstablished() {
        assertTrue(StnUdsSessionAdmission.allowsRead(
            adapter("Generic Bluetooth label"), true
        ))
        // Actual hardware model recognition is repeated via STI/STDI by
        // StnUdsPayloadTransport before any UDS request can be transmitted.
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.control

/** Live status must come from verified GM PIDs/ECU data; unknown is never treated as safe. */
enum class VehicleGear { PARK, NEUTRAL, DRIVE, REVERSE, UNKNOWN }
enum class VehicleSignal { TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN }

data class RemoteStartConditions(
    val gear: VehicleGear,
    val hoodClosed: VehicleSignal,
    val doorsLocked: VehicleSignal,
    val hazardsOff: VehicleSignal,
    val theftSystemReady: VehicleSignal,
    val criticalFaultsAbsent: VehicleSignal,
    val vehicleStationary: VehicleSignal,
    val oemRemoteStartEquipped: VehicleSignal
)

data class RemoteStartAssessment(
    val allowedToRequestOemProcedure: Boolean,
    val blockersFr: List<String>,
    val blockersEn: List<String>
)

/** This is a safety assessment only. It does not crank the engine or bypass OEM immobilizer logic. */
object RemoteStartSafetyGate {
    fun assess(c: RemoteStartConditions): RemoteStartAssessment {
        val blockersFr = mutableListOf<String>()
        val blockersEn = mutableListOf<String>()

        fun block(fr: String, en: String) {
            blockersFr += fr
            blockersEn += en
        }

        if (c.gear != VehicleGear.PARK) block("Boîte non confirmée en position P.", "Transmission is not confirmed in Park.")
        if (c.hoodClosed != VehicleSignal.TRUE) block("Capot fermé non confirmé.", "Hood closure is not confirmed.")
        if (c.doorsLocked != VehicleSignal.TRUE) block("Verrouillage des portes non confirmé.", "Door locks are not confirmed.")
        if (c.hazardsOff != VehicleSignal.TRUE) block("Feux de détresse éteints non confirmés.", "Hazard lights being off is not confirmed.")
        if (c.theftSystemReady != VehicleSignal.TRUE) block("Antidémarrage / antivol non confirmé prêt.", "The theft-deterrent system is not confirmed ready.")
        if (c.criticalFaultsAbsent != VehicleSignal.TRUE) block("Absence de défaut critique non confirmée.", "Absence of critical faults is not confirmed.")
        if (c.vehicleStationary != VehicleSignal.TRUE) block("Immobilité du véhicule non confirmée.", "Vehicle stationary status is not confirmed.")
        if (c.oemRemoteStartEquipped != VehicleSignal.TRUE) block("Option de démarrage à distance OEM non confirmée.", "OEM remote-start equipment is not confirmed.")

        return RemoteStartAssessment(
            allowedToRequestOemProcedure = blockersFr.isEmpty(),
            blockersFr = blockersFr,
            blockersEn = blockersEn
        )
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.control

import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.VehicleProfile

/**
 * GM body controls are deliberately capability-gated. No undocumented CAN/UDS
 * frames are sent: an action becomes executable only after a VIN/year/module-specific
 * command definition has been verified and supplied by a validated profile.
 */
enum class VehicleControlId { WINDOWS, SUNROOF, DOOR_LOCKS, LIGHTS, HORN, MIRRORS, TRUNK, REMOTE_START }
enum class ControlAvailability { NOT_IMPLEMENTED, NOT_VERIFIED, AVAILABLE, NOT_EQUIPPED }

data class VehicleControlCapability(
    val id: VehicleControlId,
    val titleFr: String,
    val titleEn: String,
    val availability: ControlAvailability = ControlAvailability.NOT_IMPLEMENTED,
    val explanationFr: String,
    val explanationEn: String,
    val vehicleContext: String = ""
)

class VehicleControlCatalog {
    fun forVehicle(vehicle: VehicleProfile): List<VehicleControlCapability> {
        val vehicleContext = "Camaro " + vehicle.modelYear + " • " + vehicle.engine.rpo + " • " + vehicle.market.code
        return listOf(
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.WINDOWS, "Vitres", "Windows", explanationFr = "Commande GM à identifier et valider pour le BCM de ce VIN. Aucune trame universelle n'est supposée.", explanationEn = "GM command must be identified and validated for this VIN's BCM. No universal frame is assumed."),
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.SUNROOF, "Toit ouvrant", "Sunroof", explanationFr = "Disponible uniquement si le véhicule en est équipé et si le BCM expose une commande validée.", explanationEn = "Only if equipped and a validated BCM command is available."),
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.DOOR_LOCKS, "Verrouillage", "Door locks", explanationFr = "Commande de carrosserie protégée : adressage, sécurité et conditions véhicule à vérifier.", explanationEn = "Protected body command: addressing, security and vehicle conditions must be verified."),
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.LIGHTS, "Éclairage", "Lights", explanationFr = "Les fonctions d'éclairage dépendent du BCM, de la finition et du marché.", explanationEn = "Lighting functions depend on BCM, trim and market."),
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.HORN, "Klaxon", "Horn", explanationFr = "Action sonore non activable sans procédure GM vérifiée et confirmation utilisateur.", explanationEn = "Audible action stays disabled without a verified GM procedure and user confirmation."),
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.MIRRORS, "Rétroviseurs", "Mirrors", explanationFr = "Commande à valider selon équipement et version BCM.", explanationEn = "Command must be validated for equipment and BCM version."),
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.TRUNK, "Coffre", "Trunk", explanationFr = "Commande à valider selon carrosserie, BCM et état du véhicule.", explanationEn = "Command must be validated for body style, BCM and vehicle state."),
        VehicleControlCapability(VehicleControlId.REMOTE_START, "Démarrage à distance", "Remote start", explanationFr = "Non commandable par une trame OBD générique. Utiliser uniquement le système OEM homologué et ses interverrouillages (boîte en P, frein de stationnement, capot fermé, absence de défaut critique). CamaroDiag n'envoie aucune commande de démarrage.", explanationEn = "Not safely commandable with a generic OBD frame. Use only the OEM-approved remote-start system and its interlocks (Park, parking brake, hood closed, no critical faults). CamaroDiag does not send an engine-start command.")
        ).map { it.copy(vehicleContext = vehicleContext) }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.control

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class RemoteStartSafetyGateTest {
    @Test fun unknownSignalsBlockRemoteStart() {
        val result = RemoteStartSafetyGate.assess(RemoteStartConditions(
            VehicleGear.UNKNOWN, VehicleSignal.UNKNOWN, VehicleSignal.UNKNOWN,
            VehicleSignal.UNKNOWN, VehicleSignal.UNKNOWN, VehicleSignal.UNKNOWN,
            VehicleSignal.UNKNOWN, VehicleSignal.UNKNOWN
        ))
        assertFalse(result.allowedToRequestOemProcedure)
        assertTrue(result.blockersFr.isNotEmpty())
        assertEquals(result.blockersFr.size, result.blockersEn.size)
        assertTrue(result.blockersEn.all { it.isNotBlank() })
    }

    @Test fun allVerifiedOemInterlocksAreRequired() {
        val result = RemoteStartSafetyGate.assess(RemoteStartConditions(
            VehicleGear.PARK, VehicleSignal.TRUE, VehicleSignal.TRUE,
            VehicleSignal.TRUE, VehicleSignal.TRUE, VehicleSignal.TRUE,
            VehicleSignal.TRUE, VehicleSignal.TRUE
        ))
        assertTrue(result.allowedToRequestOemProcedure)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.control

import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.VehicleProfile
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class VehicleControlCatalogAvailabilityTest {
    @Test fun allPresentControlsAreExplicitlyUnimplemented() {
        val controls = VehicleControlCatalog().forVehicle(VehicleProfile())
        assertEquals(VehicleControlId.entries.size, controls.size)
        assertEquals(VehicleControlId.entries.toSet(), controls.map { it.id }.toSet())
        assertTrue(controls.all { it.availability == ControlAvailability.NOT_IMPLEMENTED })
        assertFalse(controls.any { it.availability == ControlAvailability.AVAILABLE })
    }
}

    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): DtcVehicleExplanation? {
        if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LLT) return CamaroLltDtcCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
        if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.L99 || vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LS3) return CamaroV8DtcCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
        if (vehicle.engine != CamaroEngine.LFX || vehicle.modelYear !in 2012..2015) return null
        val normalizedCode = code.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        if (normalizedCode == "P00C6" && vehicle.modelYear != 2012) return null
        return lfxGen5[normalizedCode]
    }

    fun isKnownLfxProfile(vehicle: VehicleProfile): Boolean =
        vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LFX && vehicle.modelYear in 2012..2015

    fun isKnownLltProfile(vehicle: VehicleProfile): Boolean =
        vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LLT && vehicle.modelYear in 2010..2011

    fun isKnownV8Profile(vehicle: VehicleProfile): Boolean =
        CamaroV8DtcCatalog.isKnownProfile(vehicle)

    /**
     * Returns a configuration sanity warning only where the engine architecture
     * makes the reported generic DTC impossible on a stock, correctly identified car.
     * This is not an OEM diagnostic definition.
     */
    fun applicabilityNotice(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): Pair<String, String>? {
        val normalized = code.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val engineProfile = DtcCatalogRegistry.engineProfile(vehicle.engine) ?: return null
        val cylinderCount = engineProfile.cylinderCount
        val forcedInduction = engineProfile.induction != EngineInductionType.NATURALLY_ASPIRATED
        return when {
            normalized == "P0307" && cylinderCount < 7 ->
                "P0307 cible le cylindre 7, absent du moteur ${vehicle.engine.rpo} à $cylinderCount cylindres. Vérifier le code brut, le calculateur répondant, le VIN et le RPO avant toute interprétation." to
                    "P0307 targets cylinder 7, which does not exist on the ${vehicle.engine.rpo} $cylinderCount-cylinder engine. Verify raw bytes, reporting ECU, VIN and RPO before interpreting the code."
            normalized == "P0308" && cylinderCount < 8 ->
                "P0308 cible le cylindre 8, absent du moteur ${vehicle.engine.rpo} à $cylinderCount cylindres. Vérifier le code brut, le calculateur répondant, le VIN et le RPO avant toute interprétation." to
                    "P0308 targets cylinder 8, which does not exist on the ${vehicle.engine.rpo} $cylinderCount-cylinder engine. Verify raw bytes, reporting ECU, VIN and RPO before interpreting the code."
            normalized == "P0299" && !forcedInduction ->
                "P0299 indique une sous-pression de suralimentation. Le moteur ${vehicle.engine.rpo} est atmosphérique en configuration d'origine : vérifier une éventuelle conversion, le code brut et l'identification véhicule." to
                    "P0299 indicates underboost. The factory ${vehicle.engine.rpo} configuration is naturally aspirated: verify any aftermarket conversion, raw DTC bytes and vehicle identity."
            else -> null
        }
    }

    /** Explicitly states the evidence level available for the selected engine. */
    fun coverageNotice(vehicle: VehicleProfile): Pair<String, String> =
        when {
            vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LFX && vehicle.modelYear == 2015 ->
                "Catalogue d'interprétations détaillées disponible pour LFX Gen 5 (2012–2015), en français et anglais. Le groupe de certification GM 15OBDG06 est identifié pour 2015, mais ses critères de surveillance détaillés ne sont pas encore extraits." to
                    "Detailed interpretation catalogue available for Gen 5 LFX (2012–2015), in French and English. GM certification group 15OBDG06 is identified for 2015, but its detailed monitor criteria have not yet been extracted."
            isKnownLfxProfile(vehicle) ->
                "Catalogue d'interprétations détaillées disponible pour LFX Gen 5 (2012–2015), en français et anglais. Les autres calculateurs et codes non répertoriés restent à documenter." to
                    "Detailed interpretation catalogue available for Gen 5 LFX (2012–2015), in French and English. Other ECUs and unlisted codes remain to be documented."
            isKnownLltProfile(vehicle) ->
                "Catalogue d'interprétations détaillées disponible pour LLT Gen 5 (2010–2011), en français et anglais, avec moniteurs GM propres à chaque millésime." to
                    "Detailed interpretation catalogue available for Gen 5 LLT (2010–2011), in French and English, with year-specific GM monitor evidence."
            vehicle.modelYear == 2012 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA
            ) ->
                "Catalogue DTC V8 Gen 5 2012 disponible pour L99, LS3 et LSA, avec interprétations bilingues et moniteurs GM propres à chaque architecture. Les codes non répertoriés restent à documenter." to
                    "Gen 5 2012 V8 DTC catalogue available for L99, LS3 and LSA, with bilingual interpretations and GM monitors scoped to each architecture. Unlisted codes remain to be documented."
            isKnownV8Profile(vehicle) ->
                "Catalogue d'interprétations détaillées disponible pour L99/LS3 Gen 5 (2010–2011). Les défauts VVT sont réservés au L99 ; le LS3 d'origine n'a pas de VVT." to
                    "Detailed interpretation catalogue available for Gen 5 L99/LS3 (2010–2011). VVT faults apply to L99 only; the factory LS3 has no VVT."
            vehicle.modelYear == 2013 && vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3) &&
                Gm2013V8MonitorCatalog.find("P0101", vehicle) != null ->
                "Référence GM ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identifiée ; P0101/P0102/P0103 et les moniteurs de chauffage O2 sont documentés pour les V8 atmosphériques L99/LS3 2013. Les moniteurs propres au compresseur et à l'IAT2 ne s'appliquent pas à ces moteurs. Les autres moniteurs restent à extraire et vérifier." to
                    "GM reference ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identified; P0101/P0102/P0103 and oxygen-sensor heater monitors are documented for the 2013 naturally aspirated L99/LS3 V8 engines. Supercharger- and IAT2-specific monitors do not apply to these engines. Other monitors still need extraction and verification."
            vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LT4 && vehicle.modelYear == 2019 ->
                "Données de surveillance GM disponibles pour le LT4 2019 sur P0196, P0197 et P0198 uniquement. Elles décrivent les critères OBD de certification et ne constituent pas un arbre de réparation complet." to
                    "GM monitor evidence is available for the 2019 LT4 for P0196, P0197 and P0198 only. It describes OBD certification criteria and is not a complete service repair diagnostic tree."
            vehicle.modelYear == 2013 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LSA &&
                GmEngineMonitorCatalog.find("P0033", vehicle) != null ->
                "Référence GM ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identifiée ; P0101/P0102/P0103, les moniteurs de chauffage O2, le circuit de dérivation du compresseur P0033, la corrélation de pression P006D et les circuits IAT2 P0097/P0098 sont documentés pour le LSA. Les autres moniteurs restent à extraire et vérifier." to
                    "GM reference ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identified; P0101/P0102/P0103, oxygen-sensor heater monitors, the LSA supercharger bypass circuit P0033, supercharger pressure correlation P006D and IAT2 circuits P0097/P0098 are documented. Other monitors still need extraction and verification."
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.find("P0101", vehicle) != null ->
                "Référence GM ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identifiée ; P0101/P0103 et les moniteurs de chauffage O2 sont documentés pour cette motorisation. Les autres moniteurs restent à extraire et vérifier." to
                    "GM reference ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identified; P0101/P0102/P0103 and oxygen-sensor heater monitors are documented for this engine. Other monitors still need extraction and verification."
            GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle) != null ->
                "Référence de certification GM ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identifiée pour ce profil. Les définitions et seuils de surveillance détaillés restent à extraire et valider pour cette calibration." to
                    "GM certification reference ${GmEngineMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)} identified for this profile. Detailed monitor definitions and thresholds still need extraction and validation for this calibration."
            else ->
            "Pour ${vehicle.engine.rpo} (${vehicle.modelYear}), les libellés SAE génériques sont disponibles, mais aucune interprétation GM détaillée validée par calibration n'est encore chargée. Ne pas transposer les causes d'une autre motorisation." to
                "For ${vehicle.engine.rpo} (${vehicle.modelYear}), generic SAE descriptions are available, but no calibration-validated detailed GM interpretation is loaded yet. Do not reuse another engine's causes."
        }
}

        "P0014" to lltPerformanceExplanation(1, "exhaust", "échappement"),

    )

enum class AppLanguage(val code: String, val label: String) {
    EN("en", "English"),
    FR("fr", "Français"),
    DE("de", "Deutsch"),
    IT("it", "Italiano"),
    ES("es", "Español"),
    HE("he", "עברית"),
    RU("ru", "Русский"),
    ZH("zh", "简体中文"),
    JA("ja", "日本語"),
    KO("ko", "한국어"),
    AR("ar", "العربية"),
    PT("pt", "Português"),
    NL("nl", "Nederlands"),
    EL("el", "Ελληνικά"),
    BG("bg", "Български"),
    HR("hr", "Hrvatski"),
    CS("cs", "Čeština"),
    DA("da", "Dansk"),
    ET("et", "Eesti"),
    FI("fi", "Suomi"),
    HU("hu", "Magyar"),
    GA("ga", "Gaeilge"),
    LV("lv", "Latviešu"),
    LT("lt", "Lietuvių"),
    MT("mt", "Malti"),
    PL("pl", "Polski"),
    RO("ro", "Română"),
    SK("sk", "Slovenčina"),
    SL("sl", "Slovenščina"),
    SV("sv", "Svenska");

    companion object {
        fun fromLocale(locale: Locale): AppLanguage {
            val language = locale.language.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            // Only Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) has a bundled translation.
            if (language == "zh" && !locale.country.equals("CN", ignoreCase = true)) return EN
            return entries.firstOrNull { it.code == language } ?: EN
        }
    }
}

object CamaroV8DtcCatalog {
    private val l99 = mapOf(
        "P0010" to v8CircuitDtc("intake", "admission"),
        "P0011" to v8PerformanceDtc("intake", "admission"),
        "P0013" to v8CircuitDtc("exhaust", "échappement"),
        "P0014" to v8PerformanceDtc("exhaust", "échappement"),
        "P0016" to v8CorrelationDtc("A", "intake", "admission")
    )
    private val ls3 = mapOf(
        "P0016" to v8CorrelationDtc("A", "intake", "admission")
    )
    private val common2012O2 = mapOf(
        "P0030" to v8O2ControlDtc(1, 1),
        "P0036" to v8O2ControlDtc(1, 2),
        "P0050" to v8O2ControlDtc(2, 1),
        "P0056" to v8O2ControlDtc(2, 2),
        "P0053" to v8O2ResistanceDtc(1, 1, "2.8", "9.5"),
        "P0054" to v8O2ResistanceDtc(1, 2, "4.1", "10.8"),
        "P0059" to v8O2ResistanceDtc(2, 1, "2.8", "9.5"),
        "P0060" to v8O2ResistanceDtc(2, 2, "4.1", "10.8")
    )
    private val l99_2012 = l99 + common2012O2 + ("P0101" to v8MafDtc(false))
    private val ls3_2012 = ls3 + common2012O2 + ("P0101" to v8MafDtc(false))
    private val lsa_2012 = ls3 + common2012O2 + ("P0101" to v8MafDtc(true))

    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): DtcVehicleExplanation? {
        val normalized = code.trim().uppercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)
        return when (vehicle.modelYear) {
            2010, 2011 -> when (vehicle.engine) {
                CamaroEngine.L99 -> l99[normalized]
                CamaroEngine.LS3 -> ls3[normalized]
                else -> null
            }
            2012 -> when (vehicle.engine) {
                CamaroEngine.L99 -> l99_2012[normalized]
                CamaroEngine.LS3 -> ls3_2012[normalized]
                CamaroEngine.LSA -> lsa_2012[normalized]
                else -> null
            }
            else -> null
        }
    }

    fun isKnownProfile(vehicle: VehicleProfile): Boolean =
        vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA) &&
            vehicle.modelYear in 2010..2012 &&
            vehicle.modelYear in vehicle.engine.years
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Evidence levels are intentionally explicit: a normalized SAE label is not an
 * OEM repair definition, and a GM definition is not portable across calibrations.
 */
enum class DtcDefinitionSource {
    SAE_J2012_GENERIC,
    GM_SERVICE_INFORMATION,
    GM_BULLETIN,
    INDEPENDENT_TECHNICAL_PUBLICATION,
    SPECIALIST_REPAIR_DATABASE,
    COMMUNITY_DATABASE,
    TECHNICAL_FORUM,
    OWNER_REPAIR_REPORT,
    VEHICLE_VALIDATED_CAPTURE,
    UNVERIFIED
}

enum class DtcEvidenceStatus {
    DOCUMENTED,
    VALIDATED_ON_VEHICLE,
    GENERIC_ONLY,
    DISCOVERY_REQUIRED
}

data class DtcDefinitionEvidence(
    val source: DtcDefinitionSource,
    val status: DtcEvidenceStatus,
    val modelYears: IntRange?,
    val engineRpos: Set<String>,
    val transmission: TransmissionType?,
    val moduleId: String,
    val hardwarePartNumber: String?,
    val operatingSystemId: String?,
    val calibrationId: String?,
    val calibrationVerificationNumber: String?,
    val vin: String?,
    val reference: String
) {
    fun validationIssues(vehicle: VehicleProfile, respondingModuleId: String): List<String> = buildList {
        if (moduleId.isBlank() || !moduleId.equals(respondingModuleId, ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("The reporting ECU does not match the DTC definition.")
        }
        if (modelYears == null) add("A documented model-year range is missing.")
        else if (vehicle.modelYear !in modelYears) add("Model year is outside the documented range.")
        if (engineRpos.isEmpty()) add("Documented engine RPO coverage is missing.")
        else if (vehicle.engine.rpo !in engineRpos) add("Engine RPO is not covered.")
        if (transmission == null) add("A validated transmission applicability is missing.")
        else if (vehicle.transmission != transmission) add("Transmission does not match.")
        if (hardwarePartNumber.isNullOrBlank()) add("ECU hardware part number is missing.")
        if (operatingSystemId.isNullOrBlank()) add("ECU operating-system identifier is missing.")
        if (calibrationId.isNullOrBlank()) add("ECU calibration ID is missing.")
        if (calibrationVerificationNumber.isNullOrBlank()) add("ECU CVN is missing.")
        val vinPattern = Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}")
        if (vin.isNullOrBlank() || !vin.uppercase(Locale.ROOT).matches(vinPattern)) {
            add("A validated 17-character VIN is missing.")
        } else if (vehicle.vin.uppercase(Locale.ROOT) != vin.uppercase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            add("VIN does not match the selected vehicle.")
        }
        if (reference.isBlank()) add("A traceable technical source reference is missing.")
        if (status == DtcEvidenceStatus.DISCOVERY_REQUIRED) add("This definition is not approved for diagnostic interpretation.")
    }

    fun isUsableForOemInterpretation(
        vehicle: VehicleProfile,
        respondingModuleId: String
    ): Boolean =
        source in setOf(
            DtcDefinitionSource.GM_SERVICE_INFORMATION,
            DtcDefinitionSource.GM_BULLETIN,
            DtcDefinitionSource.VEHICLE_VALIDATED_CAPTURE
        ) &&
            status in setOf(DtcEvidenceStatus.DOCUMENTED, DtcEvidenceStatus.VALIDATED_ON_VEHICLE) &&
            validationIssues(vehicle, respondingModuleId).isEmpty()
}

/**
 * Confidence assigned to independent/community evidence. These levels are deliberately
 * separate from OEM evidence and must never be rendered as GM-confirmed information.
 */
enum class DtcCommunityConfidence {
    INSUFFICIENT,
    SINGLE_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE,
    CORROBORATED_INDEPENDENT_SOURCES,
    VALIDATED_ON_THIS_VEHICLE
}

/**
 * A traceable public Internet reference for a community-derived DTC explanation.
 * independenceGroup identifies the publisher/original investigation, so reposts of
 * the same material cannot be counted as independent corroboration.
 */
data class DtcCommunityEvidenceReference(
    val source: DtcDefinitionSource,
    val reference: String,
    val publisher: String,
    val independenceGroup: String,
    val modelYears: IntRange?,
    val engineRpos: Set<String>,
    val moduleId: String,
    val validatedVin: String? = null
) {
    fun isApplicableTo(vehicle: VehicleProfile, respondingModuleId: String): Boolean {
        val isIndependentSource = source in setOf(
            DtcDefinitionSource.INDEPENDENT_TECHNICAL_PUBLICATION,
            DtcDefinitionSource.SPECIALIST_REPAIR_DATABASE,
            DtcDefinitionSource.COMMUNITY_DATABASE,
            DtcDefinitionSource.TECHNICAL_FORUM,
            DtcDefinitionSource.OWNER_REPAIR_REPORT
        )
        val hasTraceableWebReference = reference.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true) ||
            reference.startsWith("http://", ignoreCase = true)
        return isIndependentSource &&
            hasTraceableWebReference &&
            publisher.isNotBlank() &&
            independenceGroup.isNotBlank() &&
            modelYears != null &&
            vehicle.modelYear in modelYears &&
            engineRpos.isNotEmpty() &&
            vehicle.engine.rpo in engineRpos &&
            moduleId.isNotBlank() &&
            moduleId.equals(respondingModuleId, ignoreCase = true)
    }

    fun validatesCurrentVehicle(vehicle: VehicleProfile): Boolean {
        val vinPattern = Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}")
        return !validatedVin.isNullOrBlank() &&
            validatedVin.uppercase(Locale.ROOT).matches(vinPattern) &&
            vehicle.vin.uppercase(Locale.ROOT) == validatedVin.uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
    }
}

data class DtcCommunityEvidenceAssessment(
    val confidence: DtcCommunityConfidence,
    val applicableReferences: List<DtcCommunityEvidenceReference>,
    val independentPublisherCount: Int
) {
    /** Community evidence may be shown with its confidence label, never as OEM confirmation. */
    val mayShowCommunityExplanation: Boolean
        get() = confidence != DtcCommunityConfidence.INSUFFICIENT
}

/** Module inventory is a discovery plan, never a claim that every trim has every ECU. */
data class DtcModuleFamily(
    val id: String,
    val nameEn: String,
    val nameFr: String,
    val optionalEquipment: Boolean,
    val discoveryRequired: Boolean = true
)

enum class EngineInductionType { NATURALLY_ASPIRATED, TURBOCHARGED, SUPERCHARGED }
enum class EngineFuelSystemType { PORT_INJECTION, DIRECT_INJECTION }

)

data class DtcModuleCatalogue(
    val moduleId: String,
    val evidenceStatus: DtcEvidenceStatus,
    val hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions: Boolean,
    val noteEn: String,
    val noteFr: String
)

    fun genericDescription(code: String): Pair<String, String>? =
        saeGenericDescriptions[code.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)]

    /**
     * Qualify public Internet evidence without upgrading it to OEM evidence.
     * Reposts sharing an independenceGroup count as one source.
     */
    fun assessCommunityEvidence(
        references: List<DtcCommunityEvidenceReference>,
        vehicle: VehicleProfile,
        respondingModuleId: String
    ): DtcCommunityEvidenceAssessment {
        val applicable = references.filter { it.isApplicableTo(vehicle, respondingModuleId) }
        // Reposts of one investigation count once, and multiple investigations
        // published by the same organization do not create independent corroboration.
        // A repost may carry a different publisher label while retaining the same
        // original-investigation group. Such an ambiguous group must not be allowed
        // to make the result depend on input order or inflate independent corroboration.
        // Count only groups that resolve to exactly one publisher, then deduplicate
        // those publishers across their separate investigations.
        val publisherGroups = applicable
            .groupBy { it.independenceGroup.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
            .values
            .map { groupReferences ->
                groupReferences
                    .map { it.publisher.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
                    .toSet()
            }

        // A single investigation can be cross-posted under different publisher
        // labels. Treat those labels as aliases of one evidence lineage rather
        // than discarding the investigation or counting every label separately.
        // Merge overlapping publisher sets transitively: if two investigations
        // share a publisher identity, they cannot provide independent corroboration.
        val publisherLineages = mutableListOf<MutableSet<String>>()
        publisherGroups.forEach { publishers ->
            val mergedLineage = publishers.toMutableSet()
            var index = 0
            while (index < publisherLineages.size) {
                val existingLineage = publisherLineages[index]
                if (existingLineage.any { it in mergedLineage }) {
                    mergedLineage.addAll(existingLineage)
                    publisherLineages.removeAt(index)
                    index = 0
                } else {
                    index++
                }
            }
            publisherLineages.add(mergedLineage)
        }
        val independentPublisherCount = publisherLineages.size
        val confidence = when {
            applicable.any { it.validatesCurrentVehicle(vehicle) } ->
                DtcCommunityConfidence.VALIDATED_ON_THIS_VEHICLE
            independentPublisherCount >= 2 ->
                DtcCommunityConfidence.CORROBORATED_INDEPENDENT_SOURCES
            independentPublisherCount == 1 ->
                DtcCommunityConfidence.SINGLE_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE
            else -> DtcCommunityConfidence.INSUFFICIENT
        }
        return DtcCommunityEvidenceAssessment(
            confidence = confidence,
            applicableReferences = applicable,
            independentPublisherCount = independentPublisherCount
        )
    }

    /**
     * Keep the summary status in sync with the exact per-module catalogue
     * routing. Previously this method reported every non-LFX ECM as generic,
     * even when LLT, V8 or the 2019 LT4 had dedicated evidence entries.
     */
    fun evidenceStatus(vehicle: VehicleProfile, moduleId: String): DtcEvidenceStatus =
        catalogueFor(moduleId, vehicle).evidenceStatus

    /**
     * Vehicle-specific explanations are withheld until the VIN read from the
     * connected ECU matches the selected vehicle profile. A missing VIN is
     * unknown, not a match. CAL ID/CVN and hardware/software compatibility are
     * still shown as unverified until exact source mappings are available.
     */
    fun mayApplyVehicleSpecificDefinitions(
        vehicle: VehicleProfile,
        moduleId: String,
        ecuVinComparison: VehicleVinComparison?
    ): Boolean {
        if (!catalogueFor(moduleId, vehicle).hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions) return false
        val comparison = ecuVinComparison ?: return false
        val selectedVin = VehicleVinMatcher.normalize(vehicle.vin) ?: return false
        return comparison.matches == true &&
            comparison.selectedVehicleVin == selectedVin &&
            comparison.ecuVin == selectedVin
    }


    fun catalogueFor(moduleId: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): DtcModuleCatalogue {
        val id = moduleId.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val known = moduleFamilies.any { it.id == id }
        val detailed = id == "ECM" && (
            CamaroDtcCatalog.isKnownLfxProfile(vehicle) ||
                CamaroDtcCatalog.isKnownLltProfile(vehicle) ||
                CamaroDtcCatalog.isKnownV8Profile(vehicle) ||
                Gm2013V8MonitorCatalog.supportedCodes(vehicle).isNotEmpty() ||
                (vehicle.modelYear == 2019 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LT4)
            )
        return DtcModuleCatalogue(
            moduleId = id,
            evidenceStatus = when {
                !known -> DtcEvidenceStatus.DISCOVERY_REQUIRED
                detailed -> DtcEvidenceStatus.DOCUMENTED
                else -> DtcEvidenceStatus.GENERIC_ONLY
            },
            hasVehicleSpecificDefinitions = detailed,
            noteEn = when {
                !known -> "Unknown ECU identity: show the raw DTC and generic SAE description only until the responding module is identified."
                detailed -> "Partial vehicle-specific ECM explanations or GM monitor evidence are available for this documented engine/model-year profile; unlisted DTCs remain generic."
                else -> "Only normalized SAE descriptions are available for this ECU/vehicle combination; no GM module-specific definition is loaded."
            },
            noteFr = when {
                !known -> "Calculateur non identifié : afficher uniquement le DTC brut et sa description SAE générique jusqu'à identification du module répondant."
                detailed -> "Des interprétations ECM spécifiques ou des données de surveillance GM partielles sont disponibles pour ce profil moteur/millésime ; les DTC non répertoriés restent génériques."
                else -> "Seuls les libellés SAE normalisés sont disponibles pour cette combinaison calculateur/véhicule ; aucune définition GM propre au module n'est chargée."
            }
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Publicly documented GM OBD monitor data. This is certification-monitor
 * evidence, not a complete service diagnostic tree or a parts-replacement rule.
 */
data class GmDtcMonitorEvidence(
    val code: String,
    val componentEn: String,
    val componentFr: String,
    val strategyEn: String,
    val strategyFr: String,
    val malfunctionCriteriaEn: String,
    val malfunctionCriteriaFr: String,
    val enableConditionsEn: String,
    val enableConditionsFr: String,
    val failureCriteriaEn: String,
    val failureCriteriaFr: String,
    val milClassification: String,
    val sourcePage: Int
)

    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? {
        if (vehicle.modelYear != 2012 || vehicle.engine != CamaroEngine.LFX) return null
        return evidence[code.trim().uppercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)]
    }

    fun supportedCodes(): Set<String> = evidence.keys
}

object GmLfxMonitorCatalog {
    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? =
        when (vehicle.modelYear) {

            2013, 2014 -> Gm2013And2014LfxMonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)

            2012 -> "12OBDG05B"
            2013 -> "13OBDG05A"
            2014 -> "14OBDG06A"
            2015 -> "15OBDG06"
            else -> null
        }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model

/**
 * GM OBD certification-group provenance for sixth-generation Camaro engines.
 *
 * A source label identifies the certification document to consult. The
 * source label alone does not imply that detailed monitor thresholds or service
 * diagnostic procedures have been imported; those are exposed only by a
 * separately scoped evidence catalogue when its exact profile is supported.
 */
object GmGen6MonitorCatalog {
    fun sourceLabel(vehicle: VehicleProfile): String? =
        when {
            vehicle.modelYear == 2016 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LTG -> "16OBDG03"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2016 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LGX -> "16OBDG05"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2016 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LT1 -> "16OBDG07A"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2017 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LTG,
                CamaroEngine.LGX,
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "17OBDG03"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2018 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LTG,
                CamaroEngine.LGX,
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "18OBDG03A"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2019 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LTG,
                CamaroEngine.LGX
            ) -> "19OBDG03B"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2019 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "19OBDG03A"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2020 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LTG,
                CamaroEngine.LGX,
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "20OBDG03A"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2021 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LTG -> "21OBDG03A"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2021 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LGX,
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "21OBDG03B"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2022 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LTG -> "22OBDG03A"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2022 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LGX,
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "22OBDG03B"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2023 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LTG -> "23OBDG03A Part2"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2023 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LGX,
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "23OBDG03B"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2024 && vehicle.engine in setOf(
                CamaroEngine.LGX,
                CamaroEngine.LT1,
                CamaroEngine.LT4
            ) -> "24OBDG03B Part 2"
            else -> null
        }

    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? =
        when {
            vehicle.modelYear == 2019 && vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LT4 ->
                Gm2019Lt4MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            else -> null
        }
}

    }

    fun supportedCodes(): Set<String> = evidence.keys
}

object GmLltMonitorCatalog {
    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? =
        when (vehicle.modelYear) {
            2010 -> Gm2010LltMonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            2011 -> Gm2011LltMonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            else -> null
        }

    fun sourceLabel(vehicle: VehicleProfile): String? =
        when {
            vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LLT && vehicle.modelYear == 2010 -> "10OBDG02"
            vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LLT && vehicle.modelYear == 2011 -> "11OBDG06"
            else -> null
        }
}

object GmEngineMonitorCatalog {
    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? =
        when (vehicle.engine) {
            CamaroEngine.LLT -> GmLltMonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            CamaroEngine.LFX -> GmLfxMonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA, CamaroEngine.LS7 -> GmV8MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            CamaroEngine.LTG, CamaroEngine.LGX, CamaroEngine.LT1, CamaroEngine.LT4 ->
                GmGen6MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            else -> null
        }

    fun sourceLabel(vehicle: VehicleProfile): String? =
        when (vehicle.engine) {
            CamaroEngine.LLT -> GmLltMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)
            CamaroEngine.LFX -> GmLfxMonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)
            CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA, CamaroEngine.LS7 -> GmV8MonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)
            CamaroEngine.LTG, CamaroEngine.LGX, CamaroEngine.LT1, CamaroEngine.LT4 -> GmGen6MonitorCatalog.sourceLabel(vehicle)
            else -> null
        }
}

    )

object GmL99MonitorCatalog {
    const val SOURCE_2010 =
        "https://gsitlc.ext.gm.com/gmspo/mode6/pdf/2010/10OBDG12%20Engine%20Diagnostics.pdf"
    const val SOURCE_2011 =
        "https://gsitlc.ext.gm.com/gmspo/mode6/pdf/2011/11OBDG07%20Engine%20Diagnostics.pdf"

    private fun evidence(year: Int) = listOf(
        v8ElectricalMonitor("P0010", "Intake", "admission", year),
        v8PerformanceMonitor("P0011", "Intake", "admission", year),
        v8ElectricalMonitor("P0013", "Exhaust", "échappement", year),
        v8PerformanceMonitor("P0014", "Exhaust", "échappement", year),
        v8CorrelationMonitor("P0016", "A", "Intake", "admission", year),
    ).associateBy { it.code }

    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? {
        if (vehicle.engine != CamaroEngine.L99 || vehicle.modelYear !in 2010..2011) return null
        return evidence(vehicle.modelYear)[code.trim().uppercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)]
    }

    fun supportedCodes(): Set<String> = evidence(2010).keys
}

object GmLs3MonitorCatalog {

        ).associateBy { it.code }[code.trim().uppercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)]
    }

    fun supportedCodes(): Set<String> = setOf("P0016")
}

private fun v8MafMonitor(supercharged: Boolean, modelYear: Int = 2012): GmDtcMonitorEvidence {
    val page = when (modelYear) {
        2013 -> if (supercharged) 10 else 9
        else -> if (supercharged) 11 else 10
    }
    val rpmMaximum = if (supercharged) "6,200" else if (modelYear == 2013) "5,750" else "6,700"
    val naturallyAspiratedThreshold = if (modelYear == 2013) "16" else "12"
    val criteriaEn = if (supercharged) {
        "MAF residual above 21 g/s, MAP1/MAP2 residual above 22.0 kPa, throttle-model residual above 400 kPa*(g/s), and supporting SCIAP residual above 14.0 kPa."
    } else {
        "MAF residual above $naturallyAspiratedThreshold g/s, MAP2 residual above 15.0 kPa, throttle-model error threshold 250 kPa*(g/s), and minimum combined weighting factor at least 0.00."
    }
    val criteriaFr = if (supercharged) {
        "Résidu MAF supérieur à 21 g/s, résidu MAP1/MAP2 supérieur à 22,0 kPa, résidu du modèle papillon supérieur à 400 kPa*(g/s), et résidu SCIAP de support supérieur à 14,0 kPa."
    } else {
        "Résidu MAF supérieur à $naturallyAspiratedThreshold g/s, résidu MAP2 supérieur à 15,0 kPa, seuil d'erreur du modèle papillon de 250 kPa*(g/s), et facteur de pondération combiné minimal d'au moins 0,00."
    }
    return GmDtcMonitorEvidence(
        "P0101",
        if (supercharged) "Mass airflow system performance (supercharged)" else "Mass airflow system performance (naturally aspirated)",
        if (supercharged) "Performance du système de débit d'air (moteur suralimenté)" else "Performance du système de débit d'air (moteur atmosphérique)",
        "The ECM checks whether measured MAF and MAP values are plausible against the throttle-based airflow model.",
        "Le calculateur vérifie la cohérence des valeurs MAF et MAP mesurées par rapport au modèle de débit d'air basé sur le papillon.",
        criteriaEn,
        criteriaFr,
        "Engine speed 450–$rpmMaximum RPM; coolant temperature above −7 °C and below 125 °C; intake-air temperature above −20 °C and below 125 °C; relevant MAF/MAP/throttle faults must not be active.",
        "Régime moteur de 450 à $rpmMaximum tr/min ; liquide entre −7 et 125 °C ; air d'admission entre −20 et 125 °C ; aucun défaut inhibiteur MAF/MAP/papillon actif.",
        "Continuous monitor; calculations every 12.5 ms; Type B, 2 trips.",
        "Surveillance continue ; calculs toutes les 12,5 ms ; Type B, 2 trajets.",
        "Type B – 2 trips", page
    )
}

object Gm2013V8MonitorCatalog {
    private val naturallyAspiratedEvidence = v8MafMonitor(supercharged = false, modelYear = 2013)
    private val superchargedEvidence = v8MafMonitor(supercharged = true, modelYear = 2013)
    private val superchargerBypassEvidence = v8SuperchargerBypassMonitor2013()
    private val superchargerBaroEvidence = v8SuperchargerBaroCorrelationMonitor2013()
    private val iat2LowEvidence = v8Iat2CircuitMonitor2013("P0097", highTemperature = true)
    private val iat2HighEvidence = v8Iat2CircuitMonitor2013("P0098", highTemperature = false)
    private val mafLowFrequencyEvidence = v8MafLowFrequencyMonitor2013()
    private val mafHighFrequencyEvidence = v8MafHighFrequencyMonitor2013()
    private val oxygenEvidence = v8O2Evidence(modelYear = 2013).associateBy { it.code }

    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? {
        if (vehicle.modelYear != 2013) return null
        if (vehicle.engine !in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA)) return null
        val normalizedCode = code.trim().uppercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)
        return when (normalizedCode) {
            "P0101" -> if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LSA) superchargedEvidence else naturallyAspiratedEvidence
            "P0033" -> if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LSA) superchargerBypassEvidence else null
            "P006D" -> if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LSA) superchargerBaroEvidence else null
            "P0097" -> if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LSA) iat2LowEvidence else null
            "P0098" -> if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LSA) iat2HighEvidence else null
            "P0102" -> mafLowFrequencyEvidence
            "P0103" -> mafHighFrequencyEvidence
            else -> oxygenEvidence[normalizedCode]
        }
    }

    fun supportedCodes(vehicle: VehicleProfile): Set<String> =
        if (vehicle.modelYear == 2013 && vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA)) {
            oxygenEvidence.keys + setOf("P0101", "P0102", "P0103") + (if (vehicle.engine == CamaroEngine.LSA) setOf("P0033", "P006D", "P0097", "P0098") else emptySet())
        } else {
            emptySet()
        }
}

object GmV8MonitorCatalog {
    fun find(code: String, vehicle: VehicleProfile): GmDtcMonitorEvidence? =
        when {
            vehicle.modelYear == 2013 -> Gm2013V8MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
            vehicle.modelYear == 2012 -> when (vehicle.engine) {
                CamaroEngine.L99 -> Gm2012L99MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
                CamaroEngine.LS3 -> Gm2012Ls3MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
                CamaroEngine.LSA -> Gm2012LsaMonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
                else -> null
            }
            else -> when (vehicle.engine) {
                CamaroEngine.L99 -> GmL99MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
                CamaroEngine.LS3 -> GmLs3MonitorCatalog.find(code, vehicle)
                else -> null
            }
        }

    fun sourceLabel(vehicle: VehicleProfile): String? =
        when {
            vehicle.modelYear == 2012 && vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA) -> "12OBDG07"
            vehicle.modelYear in 2010..2011 && vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3) ->
                if (vehicle.modelYear == 2010) "10OBDG12" else "11OBDG07"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2013 && vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA) -> "13OBDG07"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2014 && vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA, CamaroEngine.LS7) -> "14OBDG07"
            vehicle.modelYear == 2015 && vehicle.engine in setOf(CamaroEngine.L99, CamaroEngine.LS3, CamaroEngine.LSA, CamaroEngine.LS7) -> "15OBDG07"
            else -> null
        }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model

/**
 * Comparison between the VIN stored in the selected vehicle profile and the VIN
 * actually returned by the OBD-accessible ECU.
 *
 * [matches] is null when the selected profile has no valid VIN yet.
 */
data class VehicleVinComparison(
    val selectedVehicleVin: String?,
    val ecuVin: String,
    val matches: Boolean?
)

object VehicleVinMatcher {
    private val vinPattern = Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}")

    fun normalize(vin: String?): String? {
        val normalized = vin
            ?.uppercase()
            ?.filter(Char::isLetterOrDigit)
            ?: return null
        return normalized.takeIf(vinPattern::matches)
    }

    fun compare(selectedVehicleVin: String?, ecuVin: String?): VehicleVinComparison? {
        val normalizedEcuVin = normalize(ecuVin) ?: return null
        val normalizedSelectedVin = normalize(selectedVehicleVin)
        return VehicleVinComparison(
            selectedVehicleVin = normalizedSelectedVin,
            ecuVin = normalizedEcuVin,
            matches = normalizedSelectedVin?.let { it == normalizedEcuVin }
        )
    }

    /**
     * Decodes the VIN model-year character for the Camaro Gen 5/Gen 6 model-year
     * range supported by this app. It does not infer RPO, transmission or market.
     */
    fun modelYearFromVin(vin: String?): Int? {
        val normalized = normalize(vin) ?: return null
        val yearIndex = CAMARO_MODEL_YEAR_CODES.indexOf(normalized[9])
        return yearIndex.takeIf { it >= 0 }?.let { 2010 + it }
    }

    private const val CAMARO_MODEL_YEAR_CODES = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPR"
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * User-selected filters for an already captured CAN trace.
 *
 * Filtering is deliberately offline: it never changes adapter state or bus traffic.
 * A null criterion means "do not filter on this field".
 */
data class CanTraceFilter(
    val canId: Int? = null,
    val direction: CanTraceDirection? = null,
    val dataPrefix: List<Int> = emptyList(),
    val searchText: String = "",
    val fromTimestampSeconds: Double? = null,
    val toTimestampSeconds: Double? = null
) {
    init {
        require(canId == null || canId in 0..0x1FFFFFFF) {
            "CAN ID must be a valid 11-bit or 29-bit identifier."
        }
        require(dataPrefix.all { it in 0..0xFF }) {
            "Every data-prefix value must be a byte."
        }
        require(fromTimestampSeconds == null || fromTimestampSeconds.isFinite())
        require(toTimestampSeconds == null || toTimestampSeconds.isFinite())
        require(
            fromTimestampSeconds == null || toTimestampSeconds == null ||
                fromTimestampSeconds <= toTimestampSeconds
        ) { "The start timestamp must not be after the end timestamp." }
    }

    fun matches(frame: CanTraceFrame): Boolean {
        if (canId != null && frame.canId != canId) return false
        if (direction != null && frame.direction != direction) return false
        if (dataPrefix.size > frame.data.size) return false
        if (dataPrefix.isNotEmpty() && frame.data.take(dataPrefix.size) != dataPrefix) return false

        if (fromTimestampSeconds != null || toTimestampSeconds != null) {
            val timestamp = frame.timestampSeconds ?: return false
            // NaN compares false against both bounds, so reject non-finite trace
            // timestamps explicitly instead of allowing them through a bounded filter.
            if (!timestamp.isFinite()) return false
            if (fromTimestampSeconds != null && timestamp < fromTimestampSeconds) return false
            if (toTimestampSeconds != null && timestamp > toTimestampSeconds) return false
        }

        val query = searchText.trim()
        if (query.isEmpty()) return true

        val normalizedQuery = query.uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
            .removePrefix("0X")
            .replace(Regex("[\\s:_-]+"), "")
        val idHex = frame.canId.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val paddedIdHex = idHex.padStart(if (frame.canId <= 0x7FF) 3 else 8, '0')
        val dataHex = frame.data.joinToString("") {
            it.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT).padStart(2, '0')
        }
        val rawHex = frame.data.joinToString(" ") {
            it.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT).padStart(2, '0')
        }
        val searchable = buildString {
            append(idHex)
            append(' ')
            append(paddedIdHex)
            append(' ')
            append(rawHex)
            append(' ')
            append(dataHex)
            append(' ')
            append(frame.direction.name)
            append(' ')
            append(frame.lineNumber)
        }.uppercase(Locale.ROOT).replace(Regex("[\\s:_-]+"), "")

        return searchable.contains(normalizedQuery)
    }

    companion object {
        /** Parse a user-entered CAN identifier without silently truncating it. */
        fun parseCanId(value: String): Int? {
            val normalized = value.trim().removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X")
            if (normalized.isEmpty() || normalized.length > 8 ||
                normalized.any { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) == null }
            ) return null
            return normalized.toLongOrNull(16)
                ?.takeIf { it in 0L..0x1FFFFFFFL }
                ?.toInt()
        }

        /** Parse a byte-prefix such as "03 22 F1" or "0x03,0x22,0xF1". */
        fun parseDataPrefix(value: String): List<Int>? {
            val normalized = value.trim()
            if (normalized.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
            val tokens = normalized.split(Regex("[\\s,;:]+"))
                .filter(String::isNotBlank)
            val bytes = mutableListOf<Int>()
            for (token in tokens) {
                val hex = token.removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X")
                if (hex.length != 2 || hex.any { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) == null }) {
                    return null
                }
                bytes += hex.toInt(16)
            }
            return bytes
        }
    }
}

/** Apply a filter while preserving capture order. A non-positive limit returns no rows. */
fun List<CanTraceFrame>.filterCanTrace(
    filter: CanTraceFilter,
    maxResults: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE
): List<CanTraceFrame> {
    if (maxResults <= 0) return emptyList()
    return asSequence()
        .filter(filter::matches)
        .take(maxResults)
        .toList()
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

data class CalibrationDiffRange(
    val startOffset: Long,
    val endOffsetInclusive: Long
) {
    val changedBytes: Long get() = endOffsetInclusive - startOffset + 1
}

data class CalibrationComparison(
    val referenceSize: Long,
    val modifiedSize: Long,
    val comparedBytes: Long,
    val changedBytes: Long,
    val appendedBytes: Long,
    val missingBytes: Long,
    val changedRanges: List<CalibrationDiffRange>,
    val omittedRangeCount: Int
) {
    val identical: Boolean get() = changedBytes == 0L && appendedBytes == 0L && missingBytes == 0L
}

/**
 * Compares two local binary images. It reports byte offsets only and never
 * modifies either file or claims that a changed image is safe to flash.
 */
object CalibrationBinaryComparer {

    private const val MAX_REPORTED_RANGES = 500

    fun compare(reference: ByteArray, modified: ByteArray): CalibrationComparison {
        val compared = minOf(reference.size, modified.size)
        var changedBytes = 0L
        val ranges = mutableListOf<CalibrationDiffRange>()
        var activeStart = -1

        for (index in 0 until compared) {
            val changed = reference[index] != modified[index]
            if (changed) {
                changedBytes++
                if (activeStart < 0) activeStart = index
            } else if (activeStart >= 0) {
                ranges += CalibrationDiffRange(activeStart.toLong(), index.toLong() - 1)
                activeStart = -1
            }
        }
        if (activeStart >= 0) {
            ranges += CalibrationDiffRange(activeStart.toLong(), compared.toLong() - 1)
        }

        val appended = (modified.size - compared).coerceAtLeast(0).toLong()
        val missing = (reference.size - compared).coerceAtLeast(0).toLong()
        return CalibrationComparison(
            referenceSize = reference.size.toLong(),
            modifiedSize = modified.size.toLong(),
            comparedBytes = compared.toLong(),
            changedBytes = changedBytes,
            appendedBytes = appended,
            missingBytes = missing,
            changedRanges = ranges.take(MAX_REPORTED_RANGES),
            omittedRangeCount = (ranges.size - MAX_REPORTED_RANGES).coerceAtLeast(0)
        )
    }
}
