package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream
import java.util.Locale

enum class CalibrationFileFormat(val label: String) {
    RAW_BINARY("BIN / raw binary"),
    INTEL_HEX("Intel HEX"),
    MOTOROLA_S_RECORD("Motorola S-record"),
    ZIP_ARCHIVE("Archive de cartographie (ZIP)"),
    EXTERNAL_DEFINITION("Définition de tables externe"),
    EXTERNAL_TUNE_PROJECT("Projet de cartographie externe (conservé tel quel)"),
    UNKNOWN("Fichier externe non reconnu")
}

data class CalibrationAddressRange(val start: Long, val endInclusive: Long) {
    val length: Long get() = endInclusive - start + 1
}

data class CalibrationFileInspection(
    val format: CalibrationFileFormat,
    val valid: Boolean,
    val summary: String,
    val payloadBytes: Long,
    val recordCount: Int,
    val addressRanges: List<CalibrationAddressRange>,
    val checksumValidation: String,
    val warnings: List<String>
)

/**
 * Read-only structural inspection for common calibration dump formats.
 *
 * This class never changes a file, infers ECU compatibility, fixes checksums or
 * creates a flash image. CRC32/SHA-256 are file-integrity hashes, not GM ECU
 * calibration checksums.
 */
object CalibrationFileInspector {

    private const val MAX_RECORDS = 2_000_000
    private const val MAX_ADDRESS_SPAN = 64L * 1024L * 1024L
    private const val MAX_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES = 1_000
    private const val MAX_ARCHIVE_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES = 128L * 1024L * 1024L
    private const val MAX_ARCHIVE_DISPLAY_ENTRIES = 30
    private val externalTuneProjectExtensions = setOf(
        "ctz", "coz", "ols", "olsx", "ptm", "ptx", "xpr", "7z", "rar"
    )

    fun inspect(fileName: String, content: ByteArray): CalibrationFileInspection {
        if (content.isEmpty()) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.UNKNOWN, "Fichier vide.", "Empty file.")
        val extension = fileName.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        return when {
            isZipArchive(content) -> inspectZipArchive(content)
            extension in externalTuneProjectExtensions -> externalTuneProjectInspection(content.size.toLong(), extension)
            extension in setOf("xdf", "a2l", "xml", "mapdef", "dam", "dcm") -> externalDefinitionInspection(content.size.toLong(), extension)
            extension in setOf("hex", "ihx") -> inspectIntelHex(content)
            extension in setOf("s19", "srec", "s28", "s37", "mot") -> inspectSRecord(content)
            extension in setOf("bin", "rom", "ori", "mod", "cal", "img") ->
                CalibrationFileInspection(
                    CalibrationFileFormat.RAW_BINARY, true,
                    "Fichier binaire brut : structure interne non interprétée.",
                    content.size.toLong(), 0, emptyList(), "Sans checksum de format",
                    listOf("Le SHA-256/CRC32 ne valide ni la compatibilité ECU ni le checksum GM.")
                )
            else -> {
                val text = content.toString(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII).trimStart()
                when {
                    text.startsWith(":") -> inspectIntelHex(content)
                    text.startsWith("S0") || text.startsWith("S1") || text.startsWith("S2") || text.startsWith("S3") ->
                        inspectSRecord(content)
                    else -> CalibrationFileInspection(
                        CalibrationFileFormat.UNKNOWN, false,
                        "Format de fichier non reconnu ; données conservées sans interprétation.",
                        content.size.toLong(), 0, emptyList(), "Non vérifié",
                        listOf("Importer un BIN, Intel HEX (.hex) ou Motorola S-record (.s19/.srec) pour une inspection structurelle.")
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isZipArchive(content: ByteArray): Boolean =
        content.size >= 4 &&
            content[0] == 0x50.toByte() &&
            content[1] == 0x4B.toByte() &&
            (
                (content[2] == 0x03.toByte() && content[3] == 0x04.toByte()) ||
                (content[2] == 0x05.toByte() && content[3] == 0x06.toByte()) ||
                (content[2] == 0x07.toByte() && content[3] == 0x08.toByte())
            )

    /**
     * Archives are imported byte-for-byte. Inspection lists a bounded set of
     * members but does not extract or decode vendor-specific binary payloads.
     */
    private fun inspectZipArchive(content: ByteArray): CalibrationFileInspection {
        val entries = mutableListOf<String>()
        val suffixes = linkedSetOf<String>()
        var entryCount = 0
        var uncompressedBytes = 0L
        return try {
            ZipInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(content)).use { zip ->
                val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
                while (true) {
                    val entry = zip.nextEntry ?: break
                    if (!entry.isDirectory) {
                        entryCount++
                        if (entryCount > MAX_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES) {
                            return CalibrationFileInspection(
                                CalibrationFileFormat.ZIP_ARCHIVE, false,
                                "Archive détectée, mais nombre de fichiers internes supérieur à la limite d'inspection.",
                                content.size.toLong(), entryCount, emptyList(), "Inspection interrompue",
                                listOf("L'archive originale reste importée sans extraction.")
                            )
                        }
                        val name = entry.name.replace('\\', '/').take(160)
                        if (entries.size < MAX_ARCHIVE_DISPLAY_ENTRIES) entries += name
                        name.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                            .takeIf(String::isNotBlank)?.let(suffixes::add)
                        while (true) {
                            val read = zip.read(buffer)
                            if (read < 0) break
                            uncompressedBytes += read
                            if (uncompressedBytes > MAX_ARCHIVE_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES) {
                                return CalibrationFileInspection(
                                    CalibrationFileFormat.ZIP_ARCHIVE, false,
                                    "Archive détectée ; limite de décompression d'inspection atteinte.",
                                    content.size.toLong(), entryCount, emptyList(), "Inspection interrompue",
                                    listOf("Archive conservée telle quelle ; aucun fichier interne n'a été extrait.")
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    zip.closeEntry()
                }
            }
            val details = buildList {
                add("Archive conservée telle quelle ; aucune cartographie interne n'est extraite ou décodée automatiquement.")
                if (entries.isNotEmpty()) add("Fichiers détectés : " + entries.joinToString(", "))
                if (entryCount > entries.size) add("${entryCount - entries.size} autre(s) entrée(s) non affichée(s).")
                if (suffixes.isNotEmpty()) add("Extensions internes : " + suffixes.take(20).joinToString(", "))
            }
            CalibrationFileInspection(
                CalibrationFileFormat.ZIP_ARCHIVE,
                valid = entryCount > 0,
                summary = "Archive de cartographie importable : $entryCount fichier(s), $uncompressedBytes octets décompressés inspectés.",
                payloadBytes = uncompressedBytes,
                recordCount = entryCount,
                addressRanges = emptyList(),
                checksumValidation = "Conteneur ZIP lisible ; contenu ECU non vérifié",
                warnings = details
            )
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            CalibrationFileInspection(
                CalibrationFileFormat.ZIP_ARCHIVE, false,
                "Archive reconnue mais impossible à inspecter entièrement : ${error.localizedMessage ?: "contenu protégé ou invalide"}.",
                content.size.toLong(), entryCount, emptyList(), "Non vérifié",
                listOf("Le fichier original est conservé sans extraction ni interprétation.")
            )
        }
    }

    private fun externalTuneProjectInspection(size: Long, extension: String) =
        CalibrationFileInspection(
            CalibrationFileFormat.EXTERNAL_TUNE_PROJECT,
            valid = false,
            summary = "Projet de cartographie externe détecté (.$extension) ; format interne non décodé.",
            payloadBytes = size,
            recordCount = 0,
            addressRanges = emptyList(),
            checksumValidation = "Non vérifié",
            warnings = listOf(
                "Le fichier original est conservé octet par octet et peut être exporté.",
                "Pour éditer les tables dans CamaroDiag, exporte depuis le logiciel source une image BIN/ORI/MOD brute et importe une définition de tables vérifiée pour le CAL ID et l'OS exacts.",
                "La détection du conteneur ne valide ni son contenu, ni sa compatibilité ECU, ni sa possibilité de programmation."
            )
        )

    private fun externalDefinitionInspection(size: Long, extension: String) =
        CalibrationFileInspection(
            CalibrationFileFormat.EXTERNAL_DEFINITION, false,
            "Fichier de définition externe .$extension importable et conservé, mais non encore converti en tables CamaroDiag.",
            size, 0, emptyList(), "Non vérifié",
            listOf(
                "Le contenu est conservé à l'identique mais ses adresses, axes, types numériques et facteurs d'échelle ne sont pas appliqués.",
                "Pour modifier les tables hors ligne, convertir la définition vers le modèle TSV documenté puis vérifier chaque offset et chaque facteur sur le CAL ID/OS exact."
            )
        )

    private fun inspectIntelHex(content: ByteArray): CalibrationFileInspection {
        val lines = content.toString(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
            .replace("\r", "")
            .split("\n")
            .map(String::trim)
            .filter(String::isNotEmpty)
        if (lines.isEmpty() || lines.size > MAX_RECORDS) {
            return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Aucun enregistrement ou fichier trop complexe.", "No records or file too complex.")
        }
        var baseAddress = 0L
        var recordCount = 0
        var dataBytes = 0L
        var minAddress = Long.MAX_VALUE
        var maxAddress = -1L
        var eofSeen = false
        val ranges = mutableListOf<CalibrationAddressRange>()
        val warnings = mutableListOf<String>()

        for ((lineIndex, line) in lines.withIndex()) {
            if (eofSeen) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Donnée présente après l'enregistrement EOF.", "Data found after EOF record.")
            if (!line.startsWith(":")) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Ligne HEX invalide à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Invalid HEX line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            val encoded = line.substring(1)
            if (encoded.length < 10 || encoded.length % 2 != 0) {
                return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Longueur d'enregistrement invalide à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Invalid record length at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            }
            val record = decodeHex(encoded) ?: return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Caractère HEX invalide à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Invalid HEX character at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            val count = record[0]
            if (record.size != count + 5) {
                return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Longueur incohérente à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Record byte count mismatch at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            }
            if ((record.sum() and 0xFF) != 0) {
                return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Checksum Intel HEX incorrect à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Intel HEX checksum mismatch at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            }
            val address = (record[1] shl 8) or record[2]
            val type = record[3]
            val data = record.copyOfRange(4, 4 + count)
            recordCount++

            when (type) {
                0x00 -> if (count > 0) {
                    val start = baseAddress + address
                    val end = start + count - 1
                    if (end < start || end > 0xFFFFFFFFL || end - start > MAX_ADDRESS_SPAN) {
                        return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Adresse hors limite.", "Address is out of range.")
                    }
                    ranges += CalibrationAddressRange(start, end)
                    minAddress = minOf(minAddress, start)
                    maxAddress = maxOf(maxAddress, end)
                    dataBytes += count
                }
                0x01 -> {
                    if (count != 0 || address != 0) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Enregistrement EOF invalide.", "Invalid EOF record.")
                    eofSeen = true
                }
                0x02 -> {
                    if (count != 2) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Enregistrement segment étendu invalide.", "Invalid extended segment record.")
                    baseAddress = ((data[0] shl 8) or data[1]).toLong() shl 4
                }
                0x04 -> {
                    if (count != 2) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Enregistrement adresse linéaire étendue invalide.", "Invalid extended linear address record.")
                    baseAddress = ((data[0] shl 8) or data[1]).toLong() shl 16
                }
                0x03, 0x05 -> if (count != 4) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Enregistrement d'adresse de départ invalide.", "Invalid start-address record.")
                else -> return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Type d'enregistrement Intel HEX inconnu : $type.", "Unknown Intel HEX record type: $type.")
            }
        }
        if (!eofSeen) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Enregistrement EOF absent.", "Missing EOF record.")
        if (ranges.isEmpty()) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Aucune donnée dans le fichier HEX.", "No data records in HEX file.")
        val sorted = ranges.sortedBy { it.start }
        for (i in 1 until sorted.size) {
            if (sorted[i].start <= sorted[i - 1].endInclusive) {
                return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, "Chevauchement d'adresses dans les enregistrements.", "Overlapping data addresses in records.")
            }
        }
        if (maxAddress - minAddress > MAX_ADDRESS_SPAN) warnings += "Plage d'adresses très étendue ; aucune image mémoire dense n'est construite."
        return CalibrationFileInspection(
            CalibrationFileFormat.INTEL_HEX, true,
            "Intel HEX valide : $recordCount enregistrements, $dataBytes octets de données.",
            dataBytes, recordCount, sorted, "Tous les checksums d'enregistrement sont valides", warnings
        )
    }

    private fun inspectSRecord(content: ByteArray): CalibrationFileInspection {
        val lines = content.toString(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
            .replace("\r", "")
            .split("\n")
            .map(String::trim)
            .filter(String::isNotEmpty)
        if (lines.isEmpty() || lines.size > MAX_RECORDS) {
            return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Aucun enregistrement ou fichier trop complexe.", "No records or file too complex.")
        }
        var dataBytes = 0L
        var recordCount = 0
        var terminationSeen = false
        val ranges = mutableListOf<CalibrationAddressRange>()
        val warnings = mutableListOf<String>()
        for ((lineIndex, line) in lines.withIndex()) {
            if (terminationSeen) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Donnée après enregistrement de terminaison.", "Data after termination record.")
            if (line.length < 4 || line[0] != 'S' || line[1] !in '0'..'9') {
                return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Enregistrement S invalide à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Invalid S-record at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            }
            val type = line[1].digitToInt()
            val encoded = line.substring(2)
            if (encoded.length % 2 != 0) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Longueur HEX invalide à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Odd HEX length at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            val bytes = decodeHex(encoded) ?: return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Caractère HEX invalide à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Invalid HEX character at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            if (bytes.isEmpty() || bytes.size != bytes[0] + 1) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Champ count incohérent à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Count field mismatch at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            if ((bytes.sum() and 0xFF) != 0xFF) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Checksum S-record incorrect à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "S-record checksum mismatch at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            val addressWidth = when (type) {
                0, 1, 5, 9 -> 2
                2, 6, 8 -> 3
                3, 7 -> 4
                4 -> return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Type S4 réservé.", "S4 record type is reserved.")
                else -> return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Type S-record inconnu : S$type.", "Unknown S-record type: S$type.")
            }
            val count = bytes[0]
            if (count < addressWidth + 1) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Enregistrement trop court à la ligne ${lineIndex + 1}.", "Record too short at line ${lineIndex + 1}.")
            var address = 0L
            for (i in 0 until addressWidth) address = (address shl 8) or bytes[1 + i].toLong()
            val dataLength = count - addressWidth - 1
            recordCount++
            if (type in 1..3 && dataLength > 0) {
                val end = address + dataLength - 1
                if (end < address || end > 0xFFFFFFFFL) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Adresse S-record hors limite.", "S-record address out of range.")
                ranges += CalibrationAddressRange(address, end)
                dataBytes += dataLength
            }
            if (type in setOf(7, 8, 9)) terminationSeen = true
        }
        if (!terminationSeen) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Enregistrement de terminaison absent.", "Missing termination record.")
        if (ranges.isEmpty()) return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Aucune donnée dans le fichier S-record.", "No data records in S-record file.")
        val sorted = ranges.sortedBy { it.start }
        for (i in 1 until sorted.size) {
            if (sorted[i].start <= sorted[i - 1].endInclusive) {
                return invalid(CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, "Chevauchement d'adresses dans les enregistrements.", "Overlapping data addresses in records.")
            }
        }
        return CalibrationFileInspection(
            CalibrationFileFormat.MOTOROLA_S_RECORD, true,
            "Motorola S-record valide : $recordCount enregistrements, $dataBytes octets de données.",
            dataBytes, recordCount, sorted, "Tous les checksums d'enregistrement sont valides", warnings
        )
    }

    private fun decodeHex(value: String): IntArray? {
        if (value.length % 2 != 0) return null
        return runCatching { value.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16) }.toIntArray() }.getOrNull()
    }

    private fun invalid(format: CalibrationFileFormat, fr: String, en: String) =
        CalibrationFileInspection(format, false, fr, 0, 0, emptyList(), en, listOf(en))
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.roundToLong

enum class CalibrationValueType(val byteWidth: Int) {
    U8(1), S8(1), U16(2), S16(2), U32(4), S32(4), F32(4)
}

enum class CalibrationEndian {
    LITTLE, BIG
}

data class CalibrationAxisDefinition(
    val fileOffset: Long,
    val count: Int,
    val valueType: CalibrationValueType,
    val endian: CalibrationEndian,
    val scale: Double,
    val bias: Double,
    val unit: String
) {
    val byteLength: Long get() = count.toLong() * valueType.byteWidth
    val endExclusive: Long
        get() = if (fileOffset < 0 || byteLength < 0 || fileOffset > Long.MAX_VALUE - byteLength) -1L
        else fileOffset + byteLength
}

data class CalibrationMapDefinition(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val fileOffset: Long,
    val rows: Int,
    val columns: Int,
    val valueType: CalibrationValueType,
    val endian: CalibrationEndian,
    val scale: Double,
    val bias: Double,
    val unit: String,
    val minimum: Double? = null,
    val maximum: Double? = null,
    val xAxis: CalibrationAxisDefinition? = null,
    val yAxis: CalibrationAxisDefinition? = null
) {
    val cellCount: Long get() = rows.toLong() * columns
    val byteLength: Long get() = cellCount * valueType.byteWidth
    val endExclusive: Long
        get() = if (fileOffset < 0 || byteLength < 0 || fileOffset > Long.MAX_VALUE - byteLength) -1L
        else fileOffset + byteLength
}

data class CalibrationTable(
    val definition: CalibrationMapDefinition,
    val values: List<List<Double>>,
    val xAxisValues: List<Double> = emptyList(),
    val yAxisValues: List<Double> = emptyList()
)

data class CalibrationDefinitionMetadata(
    val vin: String,
    val calibrationId: String,
    val cvn: String,
    val operatingSystemId: String,
    val hardwarePartNumber: String,
    val sourceSha256: String
)

data class CalibrationDefinitionParseResult(
    val definitions: List<CalibrationMapDefinition>,
    val warnings: List<String>,
    val metadata: CalibrationDefinitionMetadata? = null
)

/**
 * Offline table codec for explicitly supplied and verified binary definitions.
 *
 * No Camaro table offsets, axes, scaling or checksums are guessed or bundled.
 * Definitions may include separate X/Y axis arrays. The original binary is never
 * modified in place; applyEdits returns a new image.
 */
object CalibrationTableCodec {

    private const val MAX_TABLE_CELLS = 4096
    private const val MAX_DEFINITIONS = 500
    private const val REQUIRED_COLUMNS = 10

    private val baseColumns = listOf(
        "id", "name", "offset", "rows", "columns", "type", "endian", "scale", "bias", "unit"
    )
    private val xAxisColumns = listOf(
        "x_offset", "x_type", "x_endian", "x_scale", "x_bias", "x_unit"
    )
    private val yAxisColumns = listOf(
        "y_offset", "y_type", "y_endian", "y_scale", "y_bias", "y_unit"
    )

    val template: String = listOf(
        "#VIN=1G1FA1RXXR0123456",
        "#CAL_ID=EXAMPLE_CAL_ID",
        "#CVN=00000000",
        "#OS_ID=EXAMPLE_OS",
        "#HARDWARE_PART_NUMBER=EXAMPLE_HW",
        "#SOURCE_SHA256=" + "0".repeat(64),
        (baseColumns + listOf("minimum", "maximum") + xAxisColumns + yAxisColumns).joinToString("\t"),
        listOf(
            "example_fuel", "Example fuel table", "0x1000", "16", "16", "U16", "LE",
            "0.01", "0", "mg/stroke", "0", "1000",
            "", "", "", "", "", "",
            "", "", "", "", "", ""
        ).joinToString("\t")
    ).joinToString("\n")

    fun parseDefinitions(content: String): CalibrationDefinitionParseResult {
        val normalized = content.removePrefix("\uFEFF").replace("\r", "")
        val metadata = parseMetadata(normalized)
        // Keep trailing delimiters: they represent optional empty CSV/TSV columns.
        val lines = normalized.split("\n")
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() && !it.trimStart().startsWith("#") }
        require(lines.size >= 2) { "Le fichier de définitions doit contenir un en-tête et au moins une table." }
        require(lines.size <= MAX_DEFINITIONS + 1) {
            "Le fichier dépasse la limite de " + MAX_DEFINITIONS + " tables."
        }

        val delimiter = detectDelimiter(lines.first())
        val header = parseDelimitedLine(lines.first(), delimiter)
            .map { it.trim().removePrefix("\uFEFF").lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        require(header.take(REQUIRED_COLUMNS) == baseColumns) {
            "En-tête invalide. Les dix premières colonnes attendues sont : " + baseColumns.joinToString(delimiter.toString())
        }
        require(header.size in REQUIRED_COLUMNS..(REQUIRED_COLUMNS + 2 + xAxisColumns.size + yAxisColumns.size)) {
            "Nombre de colonnes invalide."
        }
        require(header.distinct().size == header.size) { "L'en-tête contient des noms de colonnes dupliqués." }

        val optionalColumns = header.drop(REQUIRED_COLUMNS)
        val allowedOptional = setOf("minimum", "maximum") + xAxisColumns + yAxisColumns
        require(optionalColumns.all { it in allowedOptional }) {
            "Une colonne optionnelle n'est pas reconnue."
        }
        if (xAxisColumns.any { it in header }) {
            require(xAxisColumns.all { it in header }) {
                "La définition de l'axe X doit fournir les six colonnes x_offset, x_type, x_endian, x_scale, x_bias et x_unit."
            }
        }
        if (yAxisColumns.any { it in header }) {
            require(yAxisColumns.all { it in header }) {
                "La définition de l'axe Y doit fournir les six colonnes y_offset, y_type, y_endian, y_scale, y_bias et y_unit."
            }
        }

        val definitions = mutableListOf<CalibrationMapDefinition>()
        val warnings = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (metadata == null) {
            warnings += "Métadonnées de calibration absentes : l'import ne peut pas être lié à un VIN, CAL ID, CVN, OS, matériel et binaire source exacts."
        } else {
            warnings += "OS et référence matérielle saisis dans les métadonnées : ils doivent être vérifiés indépendamment dans la documentation de service du calculateur."
        }
        for ((lineIndex, line) in lines.drop(1).withIndex()) {
            val cells = parseDelimitedLine(line, delimiter).map(String::trim)
            require(cells.size == header.size) {
                "Ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + " : nombre de colonnes incorrect."
            }
            val fields = header.zip(cells).toMap()
            val id = fields.getValue("id")
            require(id.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}"))) {
                "Ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + " : identifiant invalide."
            }
            require(definitions.none { it.id == id }) { "Identifiant de table dupliqué : " + id + "." }
            val name = fields.getValue("name")
            require(name.isNotBlank() && name.length <= 120) {
                "Ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + " : nom de table invalide."
            }

            val offset = parseAddress(fields.getValue("offset"))
            val rows = fields.getValue("rows").toInt()
            val columns = fields.getValue("columns").toInt()
            require(rows in 1..256 && columns in 1..256 && rows.toLong() * columns <= MAX_TABLE_CELLS) {
                "Ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + " : dimensions de table hors limites (max. " + MAX_TABLE_CELLS + " cellules)."
            }
            val type = parseValueType(fields.getValue("type"))
            val endian = parseEndian(fields.getValue("endian"))
            val scale = fields.getValue("scale").toDouble()
            val bias = fields.getValue("bias").toDouble()
            require(scale.isFinite() && scale != 0.0 && bias.isFinite()) {
                "Ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + " : scale/bias invalide."
            }
            val unit = fields.getValue("unit")
            val minimum = fields["minimum"]?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank)?.toDouble()
            val maximum = fields["maximum"]?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank)?.toDouble()
            require(minimum == null || minimum.isFinite()) { "Minimum invalide à la ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + "." }
            require(maximum == null || maximum.isFinite()) { "Maximum invalide à la ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + "." }
            require(minimum == null || maximum == null || minimum <= maximum) {
                "Ligne " + (lineIndex + 2) + " : minimum supérieur au maximum."
            }

            val xAxis = parseAxis(fields, xAxisColumns, columns, lineIndex + 2)
            val yAxis = parseAxis(fields, yAxisColumns, rows, lineIndex + 2)
            val definition = CalibrationMapDefinition(
                id = id,
                name = name,
                fileOffset = offset,
                rows = rows,
                columns = columns,
                valueType = type,
                endian = endian,
                scale = scale,
                bias = bias,
                unit = unit,
                minimum = minimum,
                maximum = maximum,
                xAxis = xAxis,
                yAxis = yAxis
            )
            validateDefinition(definition)
            definitions += definition
        }

        require(definitions.isNotEmpty()) { "Aucune définition de table valide." }
        val ranges = definitions.flatMap { definition ->
            buildList {
                add(definition.fileOffset to definition.endExclusive)
                definition.xAxis?.let { add(it.fileOffset to it.endExclusive) }
                definition.yAxis?.let { add(it.fileOffset to it.endExclusive) }
            }
        }.sortedBy { it.first }
        for (index in 1 until ranges.size) {
            if (ranges[index].first < ranges[index - 1].second) {
                warnings += "Des zones de tables ou d'axes se chevauchent ; vérifie que ce recouvrement est volontaire."
                break
            }
        }
        return CalibrationDefinitionParseResult(definitions, warnings, metadata)
    }

    /**
     * Validates that a supplied definition file belongs to the selected vehicle,
     * the exact binary image, and the CAL ID/CVN read from the connected ECU.
     * OS and hardware are deliberately not inferred from standard Mode 09 data.
     */
    fun validateMetadataForImage(
        metadata: CalibrationDefinitionMetadata,
        selectedVin: String,
        ecuVin: String,
        binary: ByteArray,
        ecuCalibrationIds: Collection<String>,
        ecuCvns: Collection<String>
    ): List<String> = buildList {
        val normalizedVin = selectedVin.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val normalizedEcuVin = ecuVin.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        if (!normalizedVin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}")) || metadata.vin != normalizedVin) {
            add("Le VIN des définitions ne correspond pas au VIN du véhicule sélectionné.")
        }
        if (!normalizedEcuVin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}")) || metadata.vin != normalizedEcuVin) {
            add("Le VIN des définitions ne correspond pas au VIN réellement lu sur l'ECU.")
        }

        val imageSha256 = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(binary)
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(Locale.ROOT, it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
        if (!metadata.sourceSha256.equals(imageSha256, ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("L'empreinte SHA-256 des définitions ne correspond pas à l'image BIN active.")
        }

        val knownCalibrationIds = ecuCalibrationIds.map { it.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        val knownCvns = ecuCvns.map { it.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        val calibrationIdIndex = knownCalibrationIds.indexOf(metadata.calibrationId.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT))
        if (calibrationIdIndex < 0) {
            add("Le CAL ID des définitions ne correspond à aucun CAL ID lu sur le calculateur.")
            if (knownCvns.none { it == metadata.cvn.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT) }) {
                add("Le CVN des définitions ne correspond à aucun CVN lu sur le calculateur.")
            }
        } else if (calibrationIdIndex >= knownCvns.size ||
            knownCvns[calibrationIdIndex] != metadata.cvn.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        ) {
            add("Le CVN des définitions n'est pas associé au CAL ID correspondant dans les réponses Mode 09.")
        }
    }

    private fun parseMetadata(content: String): CalibrationDefinitionMetadata? {
        val recognized = setOf(
            "vin", "cal_id", "cvn", "os_id", "hardware_part_number", "source_sha256"
        )
        val entries = content.lineSequence()
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.startsWith("#") && it.drop(1).contains("=") }
            .mapNotNull { line ->
                val entry = line.drop(1).trim()
                val separator = entry.indexOf('=')
                val key = entry.substring(0, separator).trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                if (key in recognized) key to entry.substring(separator + 1).trim() else null
            }
            .toList()
        if (entries.isEmpty()) return null
        require(entries.map { it.first }.distinct().size == entries.size) {
            "Les métadonnées contiennent une clé en double."
        }
        val values = entries.toMap()
        val missing = recognized.filter { values[it].isNullOrBlank() }
        require(missing.isEmpty()) {
            "Métadonnées incomplètes : " + missing.joinToString(", ") + "."
        }
        val vin = values.getValue("vin").uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val cvn = values.getValue("cvn").uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val sourceSha256 = values.getValue("source_sha256").lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        require(vin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}"))) {
            "La métadonnée VIN doit contenir 17 caractères valides."
        }
        require(values.getValue("cal_id").length <= 128) { "CAL ID trop long." }
        require(cvn.matches(Regex("[0-9A-F]{8}"))) { "CVN doit contenir exactement 8 caractères hexadécimaux." }
        require(values.getValue("os_id").length <= 128) { "OS ID trop long." }
        require(values.getValue("hardware_part_number").length <= 128) { "Référence matérielle trop longue." }
        require(sourceSha256.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}"))) {
            "SOURCE_SHA256 doit contenir une empreinte SHA-256 de 64 caractères hexadécimaux."
        }
        return CalibrationDefinitionMetadata(
            vin = vin,
            calibrationId = values.getValue("cal_id"),
            cvn = cvn,
            operatingSystemId = values.getValue("os_id"),
            hardwarePartNumber = values.getValue("hardware_part_number"),
            sourceSha256 = sourceSha256
        )
    }

    fun decode(binary: ByteArray, definition: CalibrationMapDefinition): CalibrationTable {
        validateBounds(binary.size, definition)
        val values = List(definition.rows) { row ->
            List(definition.columns) { column ->
                val index = row * definition.columns + column
                val offset = safeByteOffset(definition.fileOffset, index, definition.valueType.byteWidth)
                readEngineeringValue(binary, offset, definition.valueType, definition.endian, definition.scale, definition.bias)
            }
        }
        val xValues = definition.xAxis?.let { decodeAxis(binary, it) }.orEmpty()
        val yValues = definition.yAxis?.let { decodeAxis(binary, it) }.orEmpty()
        return CalibrationTable(definition, values, xValues, yValues)
    }

    /** Returns a new byte array; original image is never modified in place. */
    fun applyEdits(
        binary: ByteArray,
        definition: CalibrationMapDefinition,
        values: List<List<Double>>
    ): ByteArray {
        validateBounds(binary.size, definition)
        require(values.size == definition.rows && values.all { it.size == definition.columns }) {
            "La matrice fournie ne correspond pas aux dimensions de la table."
        }
        val edited = binary.copyOf()
        values.forEachIndexed { row, rowValues ->
            rowValues.forEachIndexed { column, engineeringValue ->
                require(engineeringValue.isFinite()) { "Une cellule contient une valeur non numérique." }
                definition.minimum?.let {
                    require(engineeringValue >= it) { "Valeur inférieure à la limite de la table." }
                }
                definition.maximum?.let {
                    require(engineeringValue <= it) { "Valeur supérieure à la limite de la table." }
                }
                val cellIndex = row * definition.columns + column
                val byteOffset = safeByteOffset(definition.fileOffset, cellIndex, definition.valueType.byteWidth)
                writeEngineeringValue(
                    edited,
                    byteOffset,
                    definition.valueType,
                    definition.endian,
                    definition.scale,
                    definition.bias,
                    engineeringValue
                )
            }
        }
        return edited
    }

    /** Round-trip-safe text representation: edited cells must not lose hidden precision. */
    fun formatEngineeringValue(value: Double): String = value.toString()

    private fun detectDelimiter(header: String): Char {
        val candidates = listOf(';', '\t', ',')
        return candidates.maxByOrNull { delimiter -> header.count { it == delimiter } }
            ?.takeIf { delimiter -> header.contains(delimiter) }
            ?: error("Séparateur de fichier non reconnu : utiliser CSV, TSV ou point-virgule.")
    }

    /** Parses one CSV/TSV record, including doubled quotes and delimiters inside quoted fields. */
    private fun parseDelimitedLine(line: String, delimiter: Char): List<String> {
        val fields = mutableListOf<String>()
        val field = StringBuilder()
        var quoted = false
        var index = 0
        while (index < line.length) {
            val character = line[index]
            when {
                character == '"' && quoted && index + 1 < line.length && line[index + 1] == '"' -> {
                    field.append('"')
                    index++
                }
                character == '"' -> quoted = !quoted
                character == delimiter && !quoted -> {
                    fields += field.toString()
                    field.setLength(0)
                }
                else -> field.append(character)
            }
            index++
        }
        require(!quoted) { "Champ entre guillemets non terminé dans une ligne CSV/TSV." }
        fields += field.toString()
        return fields
    }

    private fun parseAxis(
        fields: Map<String, String>,
        columns: List<String>,
        count: Int,
        lineNumber: Int
    ): CalibrationAxisDefinition? {
        val axisValues = columns.map { fields[it] }
        if (axisValues.all { it.isNullOrBlank() }) return null
        require(axisValues.all { !it.isNullOrBlank() }) {
            "Ligne " + lineNumber + " : une définition d'axe doit renseigner toutes ses colonnes."
        }
        val offset = parseAddress(fields.getValue(columns[0]))
        val type = parseValueType(fields.getValue(columns[1]))
        val endian = parseEndian(fields.getValue(columns[2]))
        val scale = fields.getValue(columns[3]).toDouble()
        val bias = fields.getValue(columns[4]).toDouble()
        require(scale.isFinite() && scale != 0.0 && bias.isFinite()) {
            "Ligne " + lineNumber + " : scale/bias de l'axe invalide."
        }
        return CalibrationAxisDefinition(
            fileOffset = offset,
            count = count,
            valueType = type,
            endian = endian,
            scale = scale,
            bias = bias,
            unit = fields.getValue(columns[5])
        ).also(::validateAxisDefinition)
    }

    private fun parseValueType(value: String): CalibrationValueType =
        CalibrationValueType.valueOf(value.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT))

    private fun parseEndian(value: String): CalibrationEndian =
        when (value.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            "LE", "LITTLE" -> CalibrationEndian.LITTLE
            "BE", "BIG" -> CalibrationEndian.BIG
            else -> error("endian doit être LE ou BE.")
        }

    private fun parseAddress(value: String): Long {
        val address = value.trim()
        return when {
            address.startsWith("0x", true) -> address.substring(2).toLong(16)
            else -> address.toLong()
        }.also { require(it >= 0) { "L'adresse de table ne peut pas être négative." } }
    }

    private fun validateDefinition(definition: CalibrationMapDefinition) {
        require(definition.id.isNotBlank() && definition.name.isNotBlank()) { "Identifiant ou nom de table manquant." }
        require(definition.rows in 1..256 && definition.columns in 1..256) { "Dimensions de table hors limites." }
        require(definition.cellCount <= MAX_TABLE_CELLS) { "La table dépasse la limite de " + MAX_TABLE_CELLS + " cellules." }
        require(definition.scale.isFinite() && definition.scale != 0.0 && definition.bias.isFinite()) {
            "Scale/bias de table invalide."
        }
        require(definition.minimum == null || definition.minimum.isFinite()) { "Minimum de table invalide." }
        require(definition.maximum == null || definition.maximum.isFinite()) { "Maximum de table invalide." }
        require(definition.minimum == null || definition.maximum == null || definition.minimum <= definition.maximum) {
            "Minimum de table supérieur au maximum."
        }
        require(definition.fileOffset >= 0 && definition.endExclusive >= definition.fileOffset) {
            "Offset ou longueur de table invalide."
        }
        definition.xAxis?.let(::validateAxisDefinition)
        definition.yAxis?.let(::validateAxisDefinition)
    }

    private fun validateAxisDefinition(axis: CalibrationAxisDefinition) {
        require(axis.count in 1..256) { "Nombre de valeurs de l'axe hors limites." }
        require(axis.fileOffset >= 0 && axis.endExclusive >= axis.fileOffset) { "Offset ou longueur d'axe invalide." }
        require(axis.scale.isFinite() && axis.scale != 0.0 && axis.bias.isFinite()) { "Scale/bias d'axe invalide." }
    }

    private fun validateBounds(binarySize: Int, definition: CalibrationMapDefinition) {
        validateDefinition(definition)
        require(definition.endExclusive <= binarySize.toLong()) {
            "La table " + definition.name + " dépasse les limites du fichier (offset 0x" +
                definition.fileOffset.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT) + ")."
        }
        definition.xAxis?.let {
            require(it.endExclusive <= binarySize.toLong()) { "L'axe X dépasse les limites de l'image binaire." }
        }
        definition.yAxis?.let {
            require(it.endExclusive <= binarySize.toLong()) { "L'axe Y dépasse les limites de l'image binaire." }
        }
    }

    private fun decodeAxis(binary: ByteArray, axis: CalibrationAxisDefinition): List<Double> =
        List(axis.count) { index ->
            val offset = safeByteOffset(axis.fileOffset, index, axis.valueType.byteWidth)
            readEngineeringValue(binary, offset, axis.valueType, axis.endian, axis.scale, axis.bias)
        }

    private fun safeByteOffset(base: Long, index: Int, width: Int): Int {
        val offset = base + index.toLong() * width
        require(offset in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong()) { "Offset de table hors de la plage adressable." }
        return offset.toInt()
    }

    private fun buffer(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int, type: CalibrationValueType, endian: CalibrationEndian): ByteBuffer =
        ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes, offset, type.byteWidth).order(
            if (endian == CalibrationEndian.LITTLE) ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN else ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN
        )

    private fun readEngineeringValue(
        bytes: ByteArray,
        offset: Int,
        type: CalibrationValueType,
        endian: CalibrationEndian,
        scale: Double,
        bias: Double
    ): Double {
        val input = buffer(bytes, offset, type, endian)
        val raw = when (type) {
            CalibrationValueType.U8 -> bytes[offset].toInt() and 0xFF
            CalibrationValueType.S8 -> bytes[offset].toInt()
            CalibrationValueType.U16 -> input.short.toInt() and 0xFFFF
            CalibrationValueType.S16 -> input.short.toInt()
            CalibrationValueType.U32 -> input.int.toLong() and 0xFFFFFFFFL
            CalibrationValueType.S32 -> input.int.toLong()
            CalibrationValueType.F32 -> input.float.toDouble()
        }
        val engineering = raw.toDouble() * scale + bias
        require(engineering.isFinite()) { "La valeur binaire décodée n'est pas finie." }
        return engineering
    }

    private fun writeEngineeringValue(
        bytes: ByteArray,
        offset: Int,
        type: CalibrationValueType,
        endian: CalibrationEndian,
        scale: Double,
        bias: Double,
        value: Double
    ) {
        val raw = (value - bias) / scale
        require(raw.isFinite()) { "Valeur brute invalide." }
        val output = buffer(bytes, offset, type, endian)
        when (type) {
            CalibrationValueType.U8 -> {
                val n = raw.roundToLong()
                require(n in 0L..0xFFL) { "Valeur U8 hors limites." }
                bytes[offset] = n.toByte()
            }
            CalibrationValueType.S8 -> {
                val n = raw.roundToLong()
                require(n in -128L..127L) { "Valeur S8 hors limites." }
                bytes[offset] = n.toByte()
            }
            CalibrationValueType.U16 -> {
                val n = raw.roundToLong()
                require(n in 0L..0xFFFFL) { "Valeur U16 hors limites." }
                output.putShort(n.toShort())
            }
            CalibrationValueType.S16 -> {
                val n = raw.roundToLong()
                require(n in Short.MIN_VALUE.toLong()..Short.MAX_VALUE.toLong()) { "Valeur S16 hors limites." }
                output.putShort(n.toShort())
            }
            CalibrationValueType.U32 -> {
                val n = raw.roundToLong()
                require(n in 0L..0xFFFFFFFFL) { "Valeur U32 hors limites." }
                output.putInt(n.toInt())
            }
            CalibrationValueType.S32 -> {
                val n = raw.roundToLong()
                require(n in Int.MIN_VALUE.toLong()..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong()) { "Valeur S32 hors limites." }
                output.putInt(n.toInt())
            }
            CalibrationValueType.F32 -> {
                require(raw in -Float.MAX_VALUE.toDouble()..Float.MAX_VALUE.toDouble()) { "Valeur F32 hors limites." }
                output.putFloat(raw.toFloat())
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Deterministic SAE J1979 responses for UI and regression testing without a vehicle.
 *
 * Every response is synthetic. This simulator must never be used as evidence of a
 * real Camaro's equipment, calibration, mileage, faults, or ECU identity.
 */
object CamaroLfxObdSimulator {

    private val supportedPids = setOf(
        0x05, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0F, 0x11, 0x1F, 0x20,
        0x22, 0x24, 0x2D, 0x2E, 0x2F, 0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x3C, 0x3E, 0x40,
        0x42, 0x44, 0x46, 0x49, 0x4A, 0x4C, 0x4D, 0x4E, 0x52, 0x59, 0x5A, 0x5C, 0x5E
    )

    private const val SIMULATED_VIN = "1G1TEST0000000001"
    private const val SIMULATED_CAL_ID = "LFX12SIM00000001"
    private const val SIMULATED_CVN = "12345678"
    private val simulatedEcuName = "CAMARODIAG LFX SIM".padEnd(20, ' ')

    fun createEngine(): Obd2FeatureEngine = Obd2FeatureEngine(
        ObdCommandChannel { command, _ -> response(command) }
    )

    fun response(command: String): String {
        val normalized = command.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT).replace(" ", "")
        return when (normalized) {
            "ATZ" -> "ELM327 v1.5"
            "ATI" -> "ELM327 v1.5 SIMULATED"
            "AT@1" -> "CamaroDiag LFX Offline Simulator"
            "ATDP" -> "ISO 15765-4 CAN (11 bit ID, 500 kbaud)"
            "ATRV" -> "12.4V"
            "ATE0", "ATL0", "ATS0", "ATS1", "ATH0", "ATH1", "ATSP6" -> "OK"
            "0100" -> bitmapResponse(0x00)
            "0120" -> bitmapResponse(0x20)
            "0140" -> bitmapResponse(0x40)
            // Two confirmed DTCs are returned by Mode 03 below; keep the PID 01
            // DTC count consistent while leaving the MIL bit clear.
            "0101" -> "410102000000"
            "0105" -> "41057F"
            "010C" -> "410C0BB8"
            "010D" -> "410D00"
            "010F" -> "410F3C"
            "0111" -> "411114"
            "011F" -> "411F003C"
            "0122" -> "412203E8"
            "0124" -> "412480004000"
            "012D" -> "412D80"
            "012E" -> "412E40"
            "012F" -> "412F80"
            "0131" -> "41310064"
            "0132" -> "41328000"
            "0133" -> "413364"
            "013C" -> "413C0320"
            "013E" -> "413E0330"
            "0142" -> "414236B0"
            "0144" -> "41448000"
            "0146" -> "41464B"
            "0149" -> "414980"
            "014A" -> "414A80"
            "014C" -> "414C10"
            "014D" -> "414D0001"
            "014E" -> "414E0002"
            "0152" -> "415280"
            "0159" -> "415903E8"
            "015A" -> "415A80"
            "015C" -> "415C64"
            "015E" -> "415E0014"
            "020000" -> "7E8 07 42 00 00 08 1A 80 00"
            "020200" -> "4202000171"
            "020500" -> "4205007F"
            "020C00" -> "420C000BB8"
            "020D00" -> "420D0000"
            "020F00" -> "420F003C"
            "021100" -> "42110014"
            "024200" -> "42420036B0"
            "03" -> "4301330171"
            "07" -> "470000"
            "0A" -> "4A0000"
            "0902" -> asciiRecord(0x02, SIMULATED_VIN)
            "0904" -> asciiRecord(0x04, SIMULATED_CAL_ID)
            "0906" -> "490601" + SIMULATED_CVN
            "090A" -> asciiRecord(0x0A, simulatedEcuName)
            "0600" -> "NO DATA"
            else -> if (normalized.startsWith("02")) "NO DATA" else "NO DATA"
        }
    }

    private fun bitmapResponse(basePid: Int): String {
        val bytes = IntArray(4)
        supportedPids.filter { it in (basePid + 1)..(basePid + 0x20) }.forEach { pid ->
            val bit = pid - basePid - 1
            val byteIndex = bit / 8
            val mask = 1 shl (7 - bit % 8)
            bytes[byteIndex] = bytes[byteIndex] or mask
        }
        return buildString {
            append("7E8 06 41 ")
            append("%02X".format(Locale.US, basePid))
            bytes.forEach { append(" %02X".format(Locale.US, it)) }
        }
    }

    private fun asciiRecord(pid: Int, value: String): String =
        "49%02X01".format(Locale.US, pid) +
            value.toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
                .joinToString("") { "%02X".format(Locale.US, it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.math.BigInteger
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * First-party diagnostic signal model.
 *
 * Definitions are authored and maintained by CamaroDiag. This model deliberately
 * does not parse community signal-set formats or import their records.
 */
enum class SignalVerification {
    PROPOSED,
    DOCUMENTED,
    VEHICLE_VERIFIED
}

data class SignalYearFilter(
    val from: Int? = null,
    val to: Int? = null,
    val years: Set<Int> = emptySet()
) {
    fun matches(year: Int): Boolean {
        val hasRange = from != null || to != null
        val inRange = hasRange && (from == null || year >= from) && (to == null || year <= to)
        return if (years.isEmpty()) !hasRange || inRange else inRange || year in years
    }
}

data class CamaroSignalFormat(
    val bitOffset: Int = 0,
    val bitLength: Int,
    val littleEndian: Boolean = false,
    val signed: Boolean = false,
    val minimum: Double? = null,
    val maximum: Double? = null,
    val add: Double = 0.0,
    val multiply: Double = 1.0,
    val divide: Double = 1.0,
    val unit: String,
    val nullMinimum: Double? = null,
    val nullMaximum: Double? = null,
    val valueMap: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()
) {
    init {
        require(bitOffset >= 0) { "Signal bit offset cannot be negative." }
        require(bitLength in 1..256) { "Signal bit length must be between 1 and 256." }
        require(divide.isFinite() && divide != 0.0) { "Signal divisor must be finite and non-zero." }
        require(multiply.isFinite() && add.isFinite()) { "Signal scale must be finite." }
        require(minimum == null || minimum.isFinite())
        require(maximum == null || maximum.isFinite())
    }

    fun decode(payload: ByteArray): CamaroDecodedSignalValue {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty()) { "Empty ECU response payload." }
        val ordered = if (littleEndian) payload.reversedArray() else payload
        val totalBits = ordered.size * 8
        require(bitOffset + bitLength <= totalBits) {
            "Signal requires ${bitOffset + bitLength} bits; ECU returned $totalBits bits."
        }

        val packed = BigInteger(1, ordered)
        val shift = totalBits - bitOffset - bitLength
        val mask = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(bitLength).subtract(BigInteger.ONE)
        val unsigned = packed.shiftRight(shift).and(mask)
        val raw = if (signed && unsigned.testBit(bitLength - 1)) {
            unsigned.subtract(BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(bitLength))
        } else {
            unsigned
        }
        val rawText = raw.toString()
        val rawDouble = raw.toDouble()
        if (nullMinimum?.let { rawDouble <= it } == true ||
            nullMaximum?.let { rawDouble >= it } == true
        ) {
            return CamaroDecodedSignalValue(rawText, null, unit, null, unavailable = true)
        }

        val scaled = rawDouble * multiply / divide + add
        val boundedMinimum = minimum?.let { maxOf(scaled, it) } ?: scaled
        val bounded = maximum?.let { minOf(boundedMinimum, it) } ?: boundedMinimum
        return CamaroDecodedSignalValue(
            raw = rawText,
            value = bounded,
            unit = unit,
            mappedLabel = valueMap[rawText],
            unavailable = false
        )
    }
}

data class CamaroDecodedSignalValue(
    val raw: String,
    val value: Double?,
    val unit: String,
    val mappedLabel: String?,
    val unavailable: Boolean
)

data class CamaroSignalDefinition(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val category: String,
    val service: Int,
    val identifierHex: String,
    val requestAddress: String,
    val responseAddress: String?,
    val protocol: String?,
    val extendedAddressHex: String?,
    val frequencySeconds: Double,
    val flowControlRequired: Boolean,
    val debugOnly: Boolean,
    val hidden: Boolean,
    val description: String?,
    val yearFilter: SignalYearFilter?,
    val format: CamaroSignalFormat,
    val verification: SignalVerification,
    val evidenceReferences: List<String>,
    val verifiedVehicleConfigurations: Set<String>
) {
    val requestCanId: Int? get() = requestAddress.toCan11BitId()
    val responseCanId: Int? get() = responseAddress?.toCan11BitId()

    val isVehicleExecutable: Boolean
        get() = verification == SignalVerification.VEHICLE_VERIFIED &&
            service == 0x22 &&
            identifierHex.length == 4 &&
            identifierHex.isHex() &&
            requestCanId != null &&
            responseCanId != null &&
            requestCanId != responseCanId &&
            extendedAddressHex == null &&
            (protocol == null || protocol == "15765-4-11bit") &&
            evidenceReferences.isNotEmpty() &&
            verifiedVehicleConfigurations.isNotEmpty()

    fun isAvailableForYear(year: Int): Boolean =
        !hidden && !debugOnly && (yearFilter?.matches(year) != false)
}

data class CamaroSignalCatalog(
    val schemaVersion: Int,
    val signals: List<CamaroSignalDefinition>
) {
    fun forYear(year: Int): List<CamaroSignalDefinition> =
        signals.filter { it.isAvailableForYear(year) }

    fun executableFor(year: Int, vehicleConfiguration: String): List<CamaroSignalDefinition> =
        forYear(year).filter {
            it.isVehicleExecutable &&
                vehicleConfiguration in it.verifiedVehicleConfigurations
        }

    fun find(id: String): CamaroSignalDefinition? =
        signals.firstOrNull { it.id.equals(id, ignoreCase = true) }

    fun categories(year: Int): List<String> =
        forYear(year).map { it.category }.distinct().sorted()

    companion object {
        const val ASSET_NAME = "camaro-native-signalset-v1.json"
        private const val SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1

        fun fromJson(json: String): CamaroSignalCatalog {
            val root = JSONObject(json)
            val version = root.optInt("schemaVersion", 0)
            require(version == SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
                "Unsupported Camaro signal schema version: $version"
            }

            val signalArray = root.optJSONArray("signals")
                ?: error("Native Camaro catalogue must contain a signals array.")
            val definitions = signalArray.objects().map { item ->
                val filter = item.optJSONObject("yearFilter")?.let {
                    SignalYearFilter(
                        from = it.optNullableInt("from"),
                        to = it.optNullableInt("to"),
                        years = it.optJSONArray("years").ints()
                    )
                }
                val format = item.optJSONObject("format")
                    ?: error("Signal ${item.optString("id")} has no format definition.")
                val mapObject = format.optJSONObject("valueMap")
                val valueMap = mapObject?.keys()?.asSequence()
                    ?.associateWith { mapObject.optString(it) }.orEmpty()

                CamaroSignalDefinition(
                    id = item.optString("id"),
                    name = item.optString("name"),
                    category = item.optString("category", "Other"),
                    service = item.optString("service").removePrefix("0x").toIntOrNull(16) ?: 0,
                    identifierHex = item.optString("identifier").normalizedHex(),
                    requestAddress = item.optString("requestAddress").normalizedHex(),
                    responseAddress = item.optString("responseAddress").normalizedHex()
                        .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                    protocol = item.optString("protocol").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                    extendedAddressHex = item.optString("extendedAddress").normalizedHex()
                        .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                    frequencySeconds = item.optDouble("frequencySeconds", 1.0),
                    flowControlRequired = item.optBoolean("flowControlRequired", false),
                    debugOnly = item.optBoolean("debugOnly", false),
                    hidden = item.optBoolean("hidden", false),
                    description = item.optString("description").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                    yearFilter = filter,
                    format = CamaroSignalFormat(
                        bitOffset = format.optInt("bitOffset", 0),
                        bitLength = format.optInt("bitLength", 0),
                        littleEndian = format.optBoolean("littleEndian", false),
                        signed = format.optBoolean("signed", false),
                        minimum = format.optNullableDouble("minimum"),
                        maximum = format.optNullableDouble("maximum"),
                        add = format.optDouble("add", 0.0),
                        multiply = format.optDouble("multiply", 1.0),
                        divide = format.optDouble("divide", 1.0),
                        unit = format.optString("unit", "unknown"),
                        nullMinimum = format.optNullableDouble("nullMinimum"),
                        nullMaximum = format.optNullableDouble("nullMaximum"),
                        valueMap = valueMap
                    ),
                    verification = runCatching {
                        SignalVerification.valueOf(
                            item.optString("verification", "PROPOSED").uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
                        )
                    }.getOrElse { error("Unknown verification status for ${item.optString("id")}.") },
                    evidenceReferences = item.optJSONArray("evidenceReferences").strings(),
                    verifiedVehicleConfigurations = item.optJSONArray("verifiedVehicleConfigurations")
                        .strings().toSet()
                ).also { signal ->
                    require(signal.id.isNotBlank() && signal.name.isNotBlank()) {
                        "Signal id and name are required."
                    }
                    require(signal.identifierHex.isNotBlank() && signal.identifierHex.isHex()) {
                        "Signal ${signal.id} has an invalid identifier."
                    }
                    require(signal.requestAddress.toCan11BitId() != null) {
                        "Signal ${signal.id} must use a valid 11-bit physical request CAN address."
                    }
                    require(signal.responseAddress == null || signal.responseAddress.toCan11BitId() != null) {
                        "Signal ${signal.id} has an invalid 11-bit physical response CAN address."
                    }
                    require(signal.frequencySeconds.isFinite() && signal.frequencySeconds > 0.0) {
                        "Signal ${signal.id} has an invalid polling frequency."
                    }
                    if (signal.verification == SignalVerification.VEHICLE_VERIFIED) {
                        require(signal.evidenceReferences.isNotEmpty()) {
                            "Vehicle-verified signal ${signal.id} requires evidence references."
                        }
                        require(signal.verifiedVehicleConfigurations.isNotEmpty()) {
                            "Vehicle-verified signal ${signal.id} requires a verified vehicle configuration."
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            require(definitions.map { it.id.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }.distinct().size == definitions.size) {
                "Duplicate Camaro signal identifiers."
            }
            return CamaroSignalCatalog(version, definitions)
        }
    }
}

private fun JSONArray?.objects(): List<JSONObject> =
    if (this == null) emptyList() else (0 until length()).mapNotNull { optJSONObject(it) }

private fun JSONArray?.strings(): List<String> =
    if (this == null) emptyList() else (0 until length())
        .mapNotNull { optString(it).takeIf(String::isNotBlank) }

private fun JSONArray?.ints(): Set<Int> =
    if (this == null) emptySet() else (0 until length())
        .mapNotNull { optInt(it).takeIf { value -> value > 0 } }.toSet()

private fun JSONObject.optNullableInt(key: String): Int? =
    if (has(key) && !isNull(key)) optInt(key) else null

private fun JSONObject.optNullableDouble(key: String): Double? =
    if (has(key) && !isNull(key)) optDouble(key) else null

private fun String.normalizedHex(): String =
    trim().removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X").uppercase(Locale.ROOT)

private fun String.isHex(): Boolean =
    isNotEmpty() && all { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) != null }

private fun String.toCan11BitId(): Int? =
    uppercase(Locale.ROOT).takeIf { it.length == 3 && it.isHex() }
        ?.toIntOrNull(16)?.takeIf { it in 0x000..0x7FF }

    fun evaluateAdapterProbe(
        deviceName: String,
        macAddress: String,
        atzResp: String,
        stiResp: String,
        atalResp: String,
        stp61Resp: String,
        headersResp: String = "OK",
        protocolResp: String = "OK",
        swCanWiringVerified: Boolean = false,
        transmitProbeResp: String = ""
    ): AdapterCapabilities {
        val logs = listOf(
            "> ATZ  -> $atzResp",
            "> STI  -> $stiResp",
            "> ATAL -> $atalResp",
            "> STP 61 -> $stp61Resp",
            "> ATH1 -> $headersResp",
            "> ATSP 6 -> $protocolResp",
            "> 0100 (physical TX verification) -> $transmitProbeResp"
        )

        // Select STN-only monitor commands only when the adapter's firmware response
        // identifies an STN chipset. A Bluetooth name or the OBDLink product banner is
        // not sufficient: some adapters expose ELM-compatible firmware instead.
        val isStn = stiResp.contains("STN", ignoreCase = true) ||
            atzResp.contains("STN", ignoreCase = true)

        // STP 61 alone is not proof of DLC pin-1 wiring. MX/MX+ are explicitly listed by the adapter maker as SW-CAN capable.
        val normalizedDeviceName = deviceName.uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val verifiedObdLinkMxHardware = normalizedDeviceName.contains("OBDLINK MX+") ||
            Regex("\\bOBDLINK MX\\b").containsMatchIn(normalizedDeviceName)
        val supportsSwCan = (swCanWiringVerified || verifiedObdLinkMxHardware) && isStn &&
            stp61Resp.contains("OK", ignoreCase = true)
        val supportsLong = atalResp.contains("OK", ignoreCase = true)

        val tier = when {
            isStn -> AdapterTier.PRO_STN
            supportsLong && !atzResp.contains("v2.1", ignoreCase = true) -> AdapterTier.GENUINE_ELM
            else -> AdapterTier.CLONE_ELM
        }

        return AdapterCapabilities(
            deviceName = deviceName,
            macAddress = macAddress,
            tier = tier,
            firmwareId = if (stiResp.isNotBlank() && !stiResp.contains("?")) stiResp else atzResp,
            supportsLongFrames = supportsLong,
            supportsSwCan = supportsSwCan,
            supportsCanHeaders = headersResp.contains("OK", ignoreCase = true) &&
                protocolResp.contains("OK", ignoreCase = true),
            rawProbeLog = logs,
            supportsCanTransmit = hasPositiveMode01Pid00Response(transmitProbeResp)
        )
    }

    /**
     * Accept only a complete positive Mode 01 PID 00 ECU response. A substring
     * match is unsafe here: adapter banners, command echoes or diagnostic chatter
     * must never enable raw CAN transmission.
     */
    private fun hasPositiveMode01Pid00Response(response: String): Boolean {
        val responseLine = Regex(
            "^(?:(?:[0-9A-F]{3}|[0-9A-F]{8}))?(?:06)?4100[0-9A-F]{8}$"
        )
        return response.lineSequence().any { line ->
            val compact = line.uppercase(Locale.ROOT).replace(Regex("[^0-9A-F]"), "")
            responseLine.matches(compact)
        }
    }

    /**
     * A connected adapter is not proof that an ECU responded. Only mark the standard
     * OBD powertrain responder as accessible after observing 7E8 in a real 0100 scan.
     * This does not identify any GM enhanced physical address or other module.
     */
    fun applyStandardObdDiscovery(
        topology: List<EcuModule>,
        respondingAddresses: Collection<String>
    ): List<EcuModule> {
        val observedEcmResponse = respondingAddresses.any { it.trim().equals("7E8", ignoreCase = true) }
        return topology.map { module ->
            if (module.id != "ECM") return@map module
            if (observedEcmResponse) {
                module.copy(
                    status = ModuleStatus.ACCESSIBLE,
                    rxHeader = "7E8",
                    notesEn = "Observed 7E8 response to standard OBD functional request 0100. This confirms standard powertrain OBD access only; it does not authorize GM enhanced services.",
                    notesFr = "Réponse 7E8 observée à la requête OBD fonctionnelle standard 0100. Cela confirme uniquement l'accès OBD groupe motopropulseur ; aucun service GM étendu n'est autorisé."
                )
            } else {
                module.copy(
                    status = ModuleStatus.DISCOVERY_REQUIRED,
                    rxHeader = "",
                    notesEn = "No standard OBD 7E8 response was observed. Keep the ECM unverified until a real functional scan confirms it.",
                    notesFr = "Aucune réponse OBD standard 7E8 observée. Le calculateur moteur reste non confirmé jusqu'à une réponse réelle au scan fonctionnel."
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun parsePidBytes(response: String, pid: String): IntArray? {
        val cleaned = response.uppercase().replace(Regex("[^0-9A-F]"), "")
        val marker = "41${pid.uppercase().padStart(2, '0')}"
        val index = cleaned.indexOf(marker)
        if (index < 0) return null
        val payload = cleaned.substring(index + marker.length)
        if (payload.length < 2 || payload.length % 2 != 0) return null
        return runCatching { payload.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16) }.toIntArray() }.getOrNull()
    }

    fun parseOdometerPidA6(response: String): Double? = parseOdometerPid(response, "A6")

    fun parseOdometerPidD3(response: String): Double? = parseOdometerPid(response, "D3")

    private fun parseOdometerPid(response: String, pid: String): Double? {
        val cleaned = response.uppercase().replace(Regex("[^0-9A-F]"), "")
        val marker = cleaned.indexOf("41$pid")
        if (marker < 0 || cleaned.length < marker + 12) return null
        return runCatching {
            val raw = cleaned.substring(marker + 4, marker + 12).toLong(16)
            raw / 10.0
        }.getOrNull()
    }


}
