package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import android.content.Context
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.math.BigInteger
import java.util.Locale

data class ObdbEcuDefinition(
    val headerHex: String,
    val responseHex: String?,
    val type: String
) {
    val requestCanId: Int? = headerHex.toCan11BitId()
    val responseCanId: Int? = responseHex?.toCan11BitId()
}

data class ObdbYearFilter(
    val from: Int? = null,
    val to: Int? = null,
    val years: Set<Int> = emptySet()
) {
    fun matches(year: Int): Boolean {
        val hasRange = from != null || to != null
        val inRange = hasRange && (from == null || year >= from) && (to == null || year <= to)
        return if (years.isEmpty()) !hasRange || inRange else inRange || year in years
    }
}

data class ObdbSignalFormat(
    val bitIndex: Int = 0,
    val bitLength: Int,
    val leastSignificantByteFirst: Boolean = false,
    val signed: Boolean = false,
    val minimum: Double? = null,
    val maximum: Double? = null,
    val add: Double = 0.0,
    val multiply: Double = 1.0,
    val divide: Double = 1.0,
    val unit: String,
    val nullMinimum: Double? = null,
    val nullMaximum: Double? = null,
    val optimalMinimum: Double? = null,
    val optimalMaximum: Double? = null,
    val optimalValue: Double? = null,
    val valueMap: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()
) {
    init {
        require(bitIndex >= 0)
        require(bitLength in 1..256)
        require(divide != 0.0)
    }

    fun decode(payload: ByteArray): ObdbDecodedValue {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty()) { "Empty UDS DID payload." }
        val ordered = if (leastSignificantByteFirst) payload.reversedArray() else payload
        val bits = BigInteger(1, ordered)
        val totalBits = ordered.size * 8
        require(bitIndex + bitLength <= totalBits) {
            "Signal needs ${bitIndex + bitLength} bits but the ECU returned only $totalBits bits."
        }
        val shift = totalBits - bitIndex - bitLength
        val mask = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(bitLength).subtract(BigInteger.ONE)
        val unsigned = bits.shiftRight(shift).and(mask)
        val raw = if (signed && unsigned.testBit(bitLength - 1)) {
            unsigned.subtract(BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(bitLength))
        } else unsigned
        val rawDouble = raw.toDouble()
        if (nullMinimum?.let { rawDouble <= it } == true ||
            nullMaximum?.let { rawDouble >= it } == true) {
            return ObdbDecodedValue(raw.toString(), null, unit, null, true)
        }
        val scaled = rawDouble * multiply / divide + add
        val bounded = minimum?.let { maxOf(scaled, it) } ?: scaled
        val clamped = maximum?.let { minOf(bounded, it) } ?: bounded
        val mapped = valueMap[raw.toString()]
        return ObdbDecodedValue(raw.toString(), clamped, unit, mapped, false)
    }
}

data class ObdbDecodedValue(
    val raw: String,
    val value: Double?,
    val unit: String,
    val mappedLabel: String?,
    val unavailable: Boolean
)

data class ObdbCamaroSignal(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val path: String,
    val service: Int,
    val identifierHex: String,
    val requestHeaderHex: String,
    val responseHeaderHex: String?,
    val extendedAddressHex: String?,
    val canPriorityHex: String?,
    val testerAddressHex: String?,
    val timeoutHex: String?,
    val diagnosticLevelIn: String?,
    val diagnosticLevelOut: String?,
    val protocol: String?,
    val requestCanId: Int?,
    val responseCanId: Int?,
    val frequencySeconds: Double,
    val flowControlRequired: Boolean,
    val debugSignal: Boolean,
    val hidden: Boolean,
    val description: String?,
    val filter: ObdbYearFilter?,
    val debugFilter: ObdbYearFilter?,
    val format: ObdbSignalFormat,
    val suggestedMetric: String?
) {
    val hasSupportedPhysicalCanAddressing: Boolean
        get() = requestCanId != null && responseCanId != null &&
            extendedAddressHex == null && canPriorityHex == null && testerAddressHex == null &&
            timeoutHex == null && diagnosticLevelIn == null && diagnosticLevelOut == null &&
            (protocol == null || protocol == "15765-4-11bit")

    fun isAvailableForYear(modelYear: Int): Boolean =
        (filter?.matches(modelYear) != false) &&
            (debugFilter?.matches(modelYear) != false)

    fun requestPayload(): ByteArray {
        val identifier = identifierHex.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }
        return byteArrayOf(service.toByte()) + identifier
    }

    fun decode(udsDidData: ByteArray): ObdbDecodedValue = format.decode(udsDidData)
}

data class ObdbCamaroSignalSet(
    val ecus: List<ObdbEcuDefinition>,
    val signals: List<ObdbCamaroSignal>,
    val source: String = SOURCE_URL
) {
    fun forYear(modelYear: Int): List<ObdbCamaroSignal> =
        signals.filter { !it.hidden && it.isAvailableForYear(modelYear) }

    fun find(id: String): ObdbCamaroSignal? =
        signals.firstOrNull { it.id.equals(id, ignoreCase = true) }

    fun categories(modelYear: Int): List<String> =
        forYear(modelYear).map { it.path }.distinct().sorted()

    companion object {
        const val SOURCE_URL = "https://github.com/OBDb/Chevrolet-Camaro"
        const val ASSET_NAME = "camaro-obdb-signalset-v3.json"

        fun load(context: Context): ObdbCamaroSignalSet =
            context.assets.open(ASSET_NAME).bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use {
                fromJson(it.readText())
            }

        fun fromJson(json: String): ObdbCamaroSignalSet {
            val root = JSONObject(json)
            val ecus = root.optJSONArray("ecu").toObjectList().mapNotNull { ecu ->
                val header = ecu.optString("hdr").normalizedHex()
                if (header.isBlank()) null else ObdbEcuDefinition(
                    headerHex = header,
                    responseHex = ecu.optString("rax").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                    type = ecu.optString("type", "unknown")
                )
            }
            val commands = root.optJSONArray("commands").toObjectList()
            val signals = commands.flatMap { command ->
                val commandObject = command.optJSONObject("cmd") ?: return@flatMap emptyList()
                val serviceKey = commandObject.keys().asSequence().firstOrNull()
                    ?: return@flatMap emptyList()
                val service = serviceKey.toIntOrNull(16) ?: return@flatMap emptyList()
                val identifier = commandObject.optString(serviceKey).normalizedHex()
                if (identifier.isBlank() || identifier.length % 2 != 0) return@flatMap emptyList()
                val requestHeader = command.optString("hdr").normalizedHex()
                val responseHeader = command.optString("rax").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                val formatFilter = command.optJSONObject("filter")?.toYearFilter()
                val debugFilter = command.optJSONObject("dbgfilter")?.toYearFilter()
                val frequency = command.optDouble("freq", 1.0).takeIf { it > 0.0 } ?: 1.0
                val formatSignals = command.optJSONArray("signals").toObjectList()
                formatSignals.mapNotNull { signal ->
                    val formatObject = signal.optJSONObject("fmt") ?: return@mapNotNull null
                    val length = formatObject.optInt("len", 0)
                    if (length !in 1..256) return@mapNotNull null
                    val divisor = formatObject.optDouble("div", 1.0)
                    if (divisor == 0.0) return@mapNotNull null
                    val mapObject = formatObject.optJSONObject("map")
                    val map = if (mapObject == null) emptyMap() else
                        mapObject.keys().asSequence().associateWith { key -> mapObject.optString(key) }
                    val format = ObdbSignalFormat(
                        bitIndex = formatObject.optInt("bix", 0),
                        bitLength = length,
                        leastSignificantByteFirst = formatObject.optBoolean("blsb", false),
                        signed = formatObject.optBoolean("sign", false),
                        minimum = formatObject.optNullableDouble("min"),
                        maximum = formatObject.optNullableDouble("max"),
                        add = formatObject.optDouble("add", 0.0),
                        multiply = formatObject.optDouble("mul", 1.0),
                        divide = divisor,
                        unit = formatObject.optString("unit", "unknown"),
                        nullMinimum = formatObject.optNullableDouble("nullmin"),
                        nullMaximum = formatObject.optNullableDouble("nullmax"),
                        optimalMinimum = formatObject.optNullableDouble("omin"),
                        optimalMaximum = formatObject.optNullableDouble("omax"),
                        optimalValue = formatObject.optNullableDouble("oval"),
                        valueMap = map
                    )
                    ObdbCamaroSignal(
                        id = signal.optString("id"),
                        name = signal.optString("name"),
                        path = signal.optString("path", "OBD"),
                        service = service,
                        identifierHex = identifier,
                        requestHeaderHex = requestHeader,
                        responseHeaderHex = responseHeader,
                        extendedAddressHex = command.optString("eax").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        canPriorityHex = command.optString("pri").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        testerAddressHex = command.optString("tst").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        timeoutHex = command.optString("tmo").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        diagnosticLevelIn = command.optString("din").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        diagnosticLevelOut = command.optString("dout").normalizedHex().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        protocol = command.optString("proto").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        requestCanId = requestHeader.toCan11BitId(),
                        responseCanId = responseHeader?.toCan11BitId(),
                        frequencySeconds = frequency,
                        flowControlRequired = command.optBoolean("fcm1", false),
                        debugSignal = command.optBoolean("dbg", false),
                        hidden = signal.optBoolean("hidden", false),
                        description = signal.optString("description").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        filter = formatFilter,
                        debugFilter = debugFilter,
                        format = format,
                        suggestedMetric = signal.optString("suggestedMetric").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                    ).takeIf { it.id.isNotBlank() && it.name.isNotBlank() }
                }
            }
            return ObdbCamaroSignalSet(ecus, signals)
        }
    }
}

private fun JSONArray?.toObjectList(): List<JSONObject> {
    if (this == null) return emptyList()
    return (0 until length()).mapNotNull { optJSONObject(it) }
}

private fun JSONObject.toYearFilter(): ObdbYearFilter = ObdbYearFilter(
    from = optNullableInt("from"),
    to = optNullableInt("to"),
    years = optJSONArray("years").let { years ->
        if (years == null) emptySet() else (0 until years.length()).mapNotNull { years.optInt(it).takeIf { value -> value > 0 } }.toSet()
    }
)

private fun JSONObject.optNullableInt(key: String): Int? =
    if (has(key) && !isNull(key)) optInt(key) else null

private fun JSONObject.optNullableDouble(key: String): Double? =
    if (has(key) && !isNull(key)) optDouble(key) else null

private fun String.normalizedHex(): String =
    trim().removePrefix("0x").removePrefix("0X").uppercase(Locale.ROOT)

private fun String.toCan11BitId(): Int? {
    if (length != 3 || any { it.digitToIntOrNull(16) == null }) return null
    return toIntOrNull(16)?.takeIf { it in 0..0x7FF }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.CamaroGeneration
import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.DiagnosticDtc

import java.util.Locale

data class CanFrame(
    val arbitrationId: Int,
    val data: ByteArray,
    val extendedId: Boolean = false
) {
    init {
        val maxId = if (extendedId) 0x1FFFFFFF else 0x7FF
        require(arbitrationId in 0..maxId) { "CAN identifier is outside the selected ID format." }
        require(data.size in 1..8) { "Classical CAN payload must contain 1 to 8 bytes." }
    }
}

/** Raw CAN transport contract. Implementations must preserve CAN IDs and frame boundaries. */
interface RawCanFrameTransport {
    suspend fun send(frame: CanFrame)
    suspend fun receive(timeoutMs: Long): CanFrame?
}

/** Complete UDS payload transport. The provider may perform ISO-TP itself (e.g. STPX). */
interface UdsPayloadTransport {
    suspend fun exchange(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray
    suspend fun sendOnly(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long)
}

/** Adapts a raw Classical CAN provider to complete UDS payload exchanges using ISO-TP. */
class IsoTpUdsPayloadTransport(
    transport: RawCanFrameTransport,
    requestCanId: Int,
    responseCanId: Int,
    extendedCanId: Boolean = false
) : UdsPayloadTransport {
    private val channel = IsoTpChannel(transport, requestCanId, responseCanId, extendedCanId)
    override suspend fun exchange(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray =
        channel.exchange(payload, timeoutMs)
    override suspend fun sendOnly(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long) =
        channel.sendOnly(payload, timeoutMs)
}

class IsoTpException(message: String) : IllegalStateException(message)

/** Classical CAN ISO-TP normal-addressing channel. */
internal class IsoTpChannel(
    private val transport: RawCanFrameTransport,
    private val requestCanId: Int,
    private val responseCanId: Int,
    private val extendedCanId: Boolean = false
) {
    suspend fun exchange(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty()) { "ISO-TP payload cannot be empty." }
        require(payload.size <= MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) { "ISO-TP payload exceeds the supported 12-bit length." }
        sendPayload(payload, timeoutMs)
        var response = receivePayload(timeoutMs)
        if (response.size >= 3 &&
            (response[0].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x7F &&
            (response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) == (payload[0].toInt() and 0xFF) &&
            (response[2].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x78) {
            val pendingTimeoutMs = maxOf(timeoutMs, 10_000L)
            val deadline = System.nanoTime() + pendingTimeoutMs * NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND
            do {
                val remaining = deadline - System.nanoTime()
                if (remaining <= 0L) throw IsoTpException("Timed out waiting for UDS ResponsePending completion.")
                val remainingMs = ((remaining + NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND - 1) / NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND).coerceAtLeast(1L)
                response = receivePayload(remainingMs)
            } while (response.size >= 3 &&
                (response[0].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x7F &&
                (response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) == (payload[0].toInt() and 0xFF) &&
                (response[2].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x78)
        }
        return response
    }

    suspend fun sendOnly(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long) {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty()) { "ISO-TP payload cannot be empty." }
        require(payload.size <= MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) { "ISO-TP payload exceeds the supported 12-bit length." }
        sendPayload(payload, timeoutMs)
    }

    private suspend fun sendPayload(payload: ByteArray, timeoutMs: Long) {
        if (payload.size <= SINGLE_FRAME_MAX_BYTES) {
            val frame = ByteArray(payload.size + 1)
            frame[0] = payload.size.toByte()
            payload.copyInto(frame, destinationOffset = 1)
            transport.send(CanFrame(requestCanId, frame, extendedCanId))
            return
        }

        val firstFrame = ByteArray(8)
        firstFrame[0] = (0x10 or ((payload.size shr 8) and 0x0F)).toByte()
        firstFrame[1] = (payload.size and 0xFF).toByte()
        payload.copyInto(firstFrame, destinationOffset = 2, startIndex = 0, endIndex = 6)
        transport.send(CanFrame(requestCanId, firstFrame, extendedCanId))

        var offset = 6
        var sequence = 1
        var sentInBlock = 0
        var blockSize = -1
        var separationMs = 0L

        while (offset < payload.size) {
            if (blockSize < 0 || (blockSize > 0 && sentInBlock >= blockSize)) {
                val flowControl = awaitFlowControl(timeoutMs)
                blockSize = flowControl.first
                separationMs = flowControl.second
                sentInBlock = 0
            }
            if (separationMs > 0) delay(separationMs)

            val count = minOf(7, payload.size - offset)
            val consecutiveFrame = ByteArray(8)
            consecutiveFrame[0] = (0x20 or (sequence and 0x0F)).toByte()
            payload.copyInto(
                consecutiveFrame,
                destinationOffset = 1,
                startIndex = offset,
                endIndex = offset + count
            )
            transport.send(CanFrame(requestCanId, consecutiveFrame, extendedCanId))
            offset += count
            sequence = (sequence + 1) and 0x0F
            sentInBlock++
        }
    }

    private suspend fun awaitFlowControl(timeoutMs: Long): Pair<Int, Long> {
        var waits = 0
        while (true) {
            val frame = awaitFrame(timeoutMs)
            requireFrameLength(frame, 3, "Flow-control frame")
            if ((frame.data[0].toInt() and 0xF0) != 0x30) continue

            when (frame.data[0].toInt() and 0x0F) {
                0x00 -> return (frame.data[1].toInt() and 0xFF) to decodeSeparationTime(frame.data[2].toInt() and 0xFF)
                0x01 -> {
                    waits++
                    if (waits > MAX_FLOW_CONTROL_WAIT_FRAMES) {
                        throw IsoTpException("ISO-TP flow-control wait limit exceeded.")
                    }
                }
                0x02 -> throw IsoTpException("Remote ECU reported ISO-TP flow-control overflow.")
                else -> throw IsoTpException("Remote ECU returned an invalid ISO-TP flow-control status.")
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun receivePayload(timeoutMs: Long): ByteArray {
        val first = awaitFrame(timeoutMs)
        requireFrameLength(first, 2, "First ISO-TP response")
        val frameType = (first.data[0].toInt() and 0xF0) shr 4

        if (frameType == 0x0) {
            val length = first.data[0].toInt() and 0x0F
            require(length in 1..SINGLE_FRAME_MAX_BYTES && first.data.size >= length + 1) {
                "Invalid ISO-TP single-frame length."
            }
            return first.data.copyOfRange(1, length + 1)
        }

        if (frameType != 0x1) throw IsoTpException("Expected an ISO-TP single or first frame.")
        val length = ((first.data[0].toInt() and 0x0F) shl 8) or (first.data[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
        require(length in 8..MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) { "Invalid or unsupported ISO-TP first-frame length." }
        requireFrameLength(first, 8, "ISO-TP first response")

        val output = ByteArray(length)
        val initialCount = minOf(6, length)
        first.data.copyInto(output, destinationOffset = 0, startIndex = 2, endIndex = 2 + initialCount)
        var copied = initialCount
        sendReceiveFlowControl()

        var expectedSequence = 1
        while (copied < length) {
            val frame = awaitFrame(timeoutMs)
            requireFrameLength(frame, 2, "ISO-TP consecutive response")
            if ((frame.data[0].toInt() and 0xF0) != 0x20) {
                throw IsoTpException("Expected ISO-TP consecutive frame.")
            }
            val sequence = frame.data[0].toInt() and 0x0F
            if (sequence != expectedSequence) {
                throw IsoTpException("ISO-TP sequence mismatch: expected " + expectedSequence + ", received " + sequence + ".")
            }
            expectedSequence = (expectedSequence + 1) and 0x0F
            val count = minOf(7, length - copied)
            requireFrameLength(frame, count + 1, "ISO-TP consecutive response")
            frame.data.copyInto(output, destinationOffset = copied, startIndex = 1, endIndex = 1 + count)
            copied += count
        }
        return output
    }

    private suspend fun sendReceiveFlowControl() {
        val frame = ByteArray(8)
        frame[0] = 0x30
        frame[1] = 0x00 // unlimited block size for the response
        frame[2] = 0x00 // no requested separation time
        transport.send(CanFrame(requestCanId, frame, extendedCanId))
    }

    private suspend fun awaitFrame(timeoutMs: Long): CanFrame {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + timeoutMs.coerceAtLeast(1L) * NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND
        while (true) {
            val remainingNanos = deadline - System.nanoTime()
            if (remainingNanos <= 0L) {
                throw IsoTpException("Timed out waiting for CAN response 0x" + responseCanId.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT) + ".")
            }
            val remainingMs = ((remainingNanos + NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND - 1) / NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND).coerceAtLeast(1L)
            val frame = transport.receive(remainingMs) ?: throw IsoTpException("Timed out waiting for ISO-TP response.")
            if (frame.arbitrationId == responseCanId && frame.extendedId == extendedCanId) return frame
        }
    }

    private fun requireFrameLength(frame: CanFrame, minimum: Int, label: String) {
        if (frame.data.size < minimum) throw IsoTpException(label + " is shorter than " + minimum + " bytes.")
    }

    private fun decodeSeparationTime(value: Int): Long = when (value) {
        in 0x00..0x7F -> value.toLong()
        in 0xF1..0xF9 -> 1L
        else -> throw IsoTpException("Unsupported ISO-TP separation-time value 0x" + value.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT) + ".")
    }

    private companion object {
        const val SINGLE_FRAME_MAX_BYTES = 7
        const val MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 0x0FFF
        const val MAX_FLOW_CONTROL_WAIT_FRAMES = 5
        const val NANOS_PER_MILLISECOND = 1_000_000L
    }
}

class UdsNegativeResponseException(
    val requestedService: Int,
    val negativeResponseCode: Int
) : IllegalStateException(
    "UDS service 0x" + requestedService.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT).padStart(2, '0') +
        " rejected with NRC 0x" + negativeResponseCode.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT).padStart(2, '0') + "."
)

/**
 * Read-only UDS client. Only ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) and
 * ReadDTCInformation (0x19/0x02) are exposed. It has no session-change,
 * security-access, actuator, memory-write or download API.
 */
class UdsReadOnlyClient(
    transport: RawCanFrameTransport,
    requestCanId: Int,
    responseCanId: Int,
    extendedCanId: Boolean = false,
    private val timeoutMs: Long = 3000L
) {
    private val channel = IsoTpChannel(transport, requestCanId, responseCanId, extendedCanId)

    suspend fun readDataByIdentifier(did: Int): ByteArray {
        require(did in 0..0xFFFF) { "DID must be a 16-bit value." }
        val request = byteArrayOf(0x22, (did shr 8).toByte(), did.toByte())
        val response = channel.exchange(request, timeoutMs)
        verifyPositiveResponse(response, 0x22)
        require(response.size >= 3) { "UDS ReadDataByIdentifier response is incomplete." }
        val returnedDid = ((response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (response[2].toInt() and 0xFF)
        require(returnedDid == did) {
            "ECU returned DID 0x" + returnedDid.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT) +
                " instead of 0x" + did.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT) + "."
        }
        return response.copyOfRange(3, response.size)
    }

    suspend fun readVin(): String {
        val data = readDataByIdentifier(0xF190)
        val vin = data.toString(Charsets.US_ASCII).trim()
        require(vin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}"))) {
            "ECU did not return a valid 17-character VIN in DID F190."
        }
        return vin
    }

    suspend fun readDtcInformation(statusMask: Int = 0xFF): ByteArray {
        require(statusMask in 0..0xFF) { "DTC status mask must be one byte." }
        val response = channel.exchange(byteArrayOf(0x19, 0x02, statusMask.toByte()), timeoutMs)
        verifyPositiveResponse(response, 0x19)
        require(response.size >= 3 && (response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x02) {
            "UDS ReadDTCInformation response did not echo subfunction 0x02."
        }
        return response.copyOfRange(2, response.size)
    }

    /** Reads and decodes the ECU's declared DTC format without guessing OEM definitions. */
    suspend fun readDtcReport(statusMask: Int = 0xFF): UdsDtcReport =
        UdsDtcDecoder.decodeReadDtcInformation(readDtcInformation(statusMask))

    private fun verifyPositiveResponse(response: ByteArray, requestedService: Int) {
        require(response.isNotEmpty()) { "ECU returned an empty UDS response." }
        val service = response[0].toInt() and 0xFF
        if (service == 0x7F) {
            require(response.size >= 3) { "ECU returned an incomplete UDS negative response." }
            val rejectedService = response[1].toInt() and 0xFF
            val nrc = response[2].toInt() and 0xFF
            throw UdsNegativeResponseException(rejectedService, nrc)
        }
        require(service == requestedService + 0x40) {
            "Unexpected UDS positive service 0x" + service.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT) + "."
        }
    }
}

enum class UdsIdentityField {
    CONTROLLER_FAMILY,
    HARDWARE_PART_NUMBER,
    OPERATING_SYSTEM_ID,
    CALIBRATION_ID,
    CALIBRATION_VERIFICATION_NUMBER,
    VIN
}

enum class UdsIdentityEncoding {
    ASCII,
    HEX
}

data class UdsIdentityDidDefinition(
    val field: UdsIdentityField,
    val did: Int,
    val encoding: UdsIdentityEncoding
)

/**
 * A profile becomes usable only when exact module, vehicle, hardware, operating-system,
 * calibration, CVN and VIN values match and a traceable evidence reference is present.
 */
data class DocumentedUdsReadProfile(
    val profileId: String,
    val moduleId: String,
    val generation: CamaroGeneration,
    val modelYears: IntRange,
    val engineRpo: String,
    val controllerFamily: String,
    val requestCanId: Int,
    val responseCanId: Int,
    val extendedCanId: Boolean,
    val hardwarePartNumber: String,
    val operatingSystemId: String,
    val calibrationId: String,
    val calibrationVerificationNumber: String,
    val readableDids: Set<Int>,
    val identityDids: List<UdsIdentityDidDefinition>,
    val verifiedVin: String,
    val evidenceReference: String
) {
    fun compatibilityDefinitionIssues(vehicle: VehicleProfile): List<String> = buildList {
        if (profileId.isBlank()) add("Profile ID is missing.")
        if (moduleId.isBlank()) add("Module ID is missing.")
        if (controllerFamily.isBlank()) add("Controller family is missing.")
        if (vehicle.generation != generation || vehicle.modelYear !in modelYears) add("Model year/generation does not match.")
        if (!vehicle.engine.rpo.equals(engineRpo, ignoreCase = true)) add("Engine RPO does not match.")

        val vinPattern = Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}")
        val selectedVin = vehicle.vin.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val profileVin = verifiedVin.trim().uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        if (!selectedVin.matches(vinPattern)) add("Selected vehicle must have a valid 17-character VIN.")
        if (!profileVin.matches(vinPattern)) add("The verified profile VIN must be a valid 17-character VIN.")
        if (selectedVin != profileVin) add("Selected vehicle VIN does not match the VIN validated for this profile.")

        if (hardwarePartNumber.isBlank() || operatingSystemId.isBlank() || calibrationId.isBlank() ||
            calibrationVerificationNumber.isBlank()) add("Exact hardware, OS, calibration and CVN values are required.")

        val maxCanId = if (extendedCanId) 0x1FFFFFFF else 0x7FF
        if (requestCanId !in 0..maxCanId || responseCanId !in 0..maxCanId || requestCanId == responseCanId) {
            add("CAN addressing is invalid.")
        }
        if (readableDids.isEmpty() || readableDids.any { it !in 0..0xFFFF }) {
            add("No valid read-only DID allowlist is defined.")
        }
        val requiredIdentityFields = UdsIdentityField.entries.toSet()
        if (identityDids.size != requiredIdentityFields.size ||
            identityDids.map { it.field }.toSet() != requiredIdentityFields) {
            add("Identity DID definitions must cover all six identity fields exactly once.")
        }
        if (identityDids.any { it.did !in 0..0xFFFF || it.did !in readableDids }) {
            add("Identity DIDs must be included in the read-only allowlist.")
        }
        if (identityDids.map { it.did }.distinct().size != identityDids.size) {
            add("Identity DID definitions must not repeat a DID.")
        }
        if (evidenceReference.isBlank()) add("A traceable service-information reference is required.")
    }

    fun compatibilityIssues(vehicle: VehicleProfile, identity: UdsEcuIdentity): List<String> = buildList {
        addAll(compatibilityDefinitionIssues(vehicle))
        if (!identity.controllerFamily.equals(controllerFamily, ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("Controller family does not match.")
        }
        if (identity.hardwarePartNumber.isNullOrBlank() ||
            !identity.hardwarePartNumber.equals(hardwarePartNumber, ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("Hardware part number does not match.")
        }
        if (identity.operatingSystemId.isNullOrBlank() ||
            !identity.operatingSystemId.equals(operatingSystemId, ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("Operating-system ID does not match.")
        }
        if (identity.calibrationId.isNullOrBlank() ||
            !identity.calibrationId.equals(calibrationId, ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("Calibration ID does not match.")
        }
        if (identity.calibrationVerificationNumber.isNullOrBlank() ||
            !identity.calibrationVerificationNumber.equals(calibrationVerificationNumber, ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("CVN does not match.")
        }
        if (identity.vin.isNullOrBlank() ||
            !identity.vin.equals(verifiedVin.trim(), ignoreCase = true)) {
            add("ECU VIN does not match the VIN validated for this profile.")
        }
    }

    fun allowsDid(did: Int): Boolean = did in readableDids
}

/**
 * A verified, read-only UDS session. It is created only after the profile has
 * read back every identity DID and matched exact vehicle/controller identifiers.
 */
class ProfiledUdsReadSession private constructor(
    val profile: DocumentedUdsReadProfile,
    val identity: UdsEcuIdentity,
    private val client: UdsReadOnlyClient
) {
    suspend fun readDid(did: Int): ByteArray {
        require(profile.allowsDid(did)) {
            "DID 0x" + did.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT) + " is not in this profile's read-only allowlist."
        }
        return client.readDataByIdentifier(did)
    }

    suspend fun readDtcInformation(statusMask: Int = 0xFF): ByteArray =
        client.readDtcInformation(statusMask)

    suspend fun readDtcReport(statusMask: Int = 0xFF): UdsDtcReport =
        client.readDtcReport(statusMask)

    /** Returns ECU-tagged records compatible with the shared diagnostics presentation model. */
    suspend fun readDiagnosticDtcs(statusMask: Int = 0xFF): List<DiagnosticDtc> =
        readDtcReport(statusMask).records.map { it.toDiagnosticDtc(profile.moduleId) }

    companion object {
        suspend fun open(
            transport: RawCanFrameTransport,
            vehicle: VehicleProfile,
            profile: DocumentedUdsReadProfile,
            timeoutMs: Long = 3000L
        ): ProfiledUdsReadSession {
            val issuesBeforeReading = profile.compatibilityDefinitionIssues(vehicle)
            require(issuesBeforeReading.isEmpty()) {
                "UDS read profile rejected: " + issuesBeforeReading.joinToString("; ")
            }
            val client = UdsReadOnlyClient(
                transport = transport,
                requestCanId = profile.requestCanId,
                responseCanId = profile.responseCanId,
                extendedCanId = profile.extendedCanId,
                timeoutMs = timeoutMs
            )
            val rawIdentity = profile.identityDids.associate { definition ->
                definition.field to client.readDataByIdentifier(definition.did)
            }
            val identity = UdsEcuIdentity(
                controllerFamily = rawIdentity[UdsIdentityField.CONTROLLER_FAMILY]?.let {
                    decodeIdentity(it, profile.identityDids, UdsIdentityField.CONTROLLER_FAMILY)
                }.orEmpty(),
                hardwarePartNumber = rawIdentity[UdsIdentityField.HARDWARE_PART_NUMBER]?.let {
                    decodeIdentity(it, profile.identityDids, UdsIdentityField.HARDWARE_PART_NUMBER)
                },
                operatingSystemId = rawIdentity[UdsIdentityField.OPERATING_SYSTEM_ID]?.let {
                    decodeIdentity(it, profile.identityDids, UdsIdentityField.OPERATING_SYSTEM_ID)
                },
                calibrationId = rawIdentity[UdsIdentityField.CALIBRATION_ID]?.let {
                    decodeIdentity(it, profile.identityDids, UdsIdentityField.CALIBRATION_ID)
                },
                calibrationVerificationNumber = rawIdentity[UdsIdentityField.CALIBRATION_VERIFICATION_NUMBER]?.let {
                    decodeIdentity(it, profile.identityDids, UdsIdentityField.CALIBRATION_VERIFICATION_NUMBER)
                },
                vin = rawIdentity[UdsIdentityField.VIN]?.let {
                    decodeIdentity(it, profile.identityDids, UdsIdentityField.VIN)
                }
            )
            val issues = profile.compatibilityIssues(vehicle, identity)
            require(issues.isEmpty()) {
                "UDS module identity rejected: " + issues.joinToString("; ")
            }
            return ProfiledUdsReadSession(profile, identity, client)
        }

        private fun decodeIdentity(
            bytes: ByteArray,
            definitions: List<UdsIdentityDidDefinition>,
            field: UdsIdentityField
        ): String {
            val encoding = definitions.single { it.field == field }.encoding
            return when (encoding) {
                UdsIdentityEncoding.ASCII -> bytes.toString(Charsets.US_ASCII)
                    .trim()
                    .trim('\u0000')
                    .uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
                UdsIdentityEncoding.HEX -> bytes.joinToString("") {
                    "%02X".format(Locale.ROOT, it.toInt() and 0xFF)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

data class UdsEcuIdentity(
    val controllerFamily: String,
    val hardwarePartNumber: String?,
    val operatingSystemId: String?,
    val calibrationId: String?,
    val calibrationVerificationNumber: String?,
    val vin: String?
)

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

/**
 * A deliberately narrow command accepted by CamaroDiag's live CAN console.
 *
 * Only standard, read-only OBD-II requests are admitted. This policy does not
 * accept CAN identifiers, arbitrary payload bytes, UDS write services or ELM
 * adapter commands.
 */
data class SafeObdRequest(
    val service: Int,
    val parameter: Int?,
    val elmCommand: String
)

object SafeObdRequestPolicy {
    // Accepted commands are tiny; reject oversized text before allocating token lists.
    private const val MAX_INPUT_LENGTH = 32

    private val allowedParametersByService = mapOf(
        // SAE J1979 current data and supported-PID bitmap requests.
        0x01 to setOf(
            0x00, 0x01, 0x04, 0x05, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0F, 0x10, 0x11,
            0x1F, 0x20, 0x40, 0x60, 0x80, 0xA0, 0xC0
        ),
        // SAE J1979 vehicle information: VIN, calibration IDs and CVNs.
        0x09 to setOf(0x02, 0x04, 0x06)
    )
    // Standard diagnostic trouble-code retrieval modes; these have no PID parameter.
    private val parameterlessReadOnlyServices = setOf(0x03, 0x07, 0x0A)

    /**
     * Accepts one whitelisted read-only request: a service/PID pair such as "010C"
     * or "01 0C", or a parameterless DTC read such as "03", "07" or "0A".
     * Explicit byte prefixes are supported; extra tokens and misplaced prefixes are rejected.
     */
    fun parse(input: String): SafeObdRequest? {
        if (input.length > MAX_INPUT_LENGTH) return null
        val tokens = input.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).filter(String::isNotEmpty)
        val compact = when (tokens.size) {
            1 -> {
                val token = tokens[0]
                when {
                    normalizeHexToken(token, 2) != null -> normalizeHexToken(token, 2)!!
                    normalizeHexToken(token, 4) != null -> normalizeHexToken(token, 4)!!
                    else -> return null
                }
            }
            2 -> {
                val service = normalizeHexToken(tokens[0], 2) ?: return null
                val parameter = normalizeHexToken(tokens[1], 2) ?: return null
                service + parameter
            }
            else -> return null
        }.uppercase()

        val service = compact.substring(0, 2).toIntOrNull(16) ?: return null
        if (service in parameterlessReadOnlyServices) {
            if (compact.length != 2) return null
            return SafeObdRequest(service, null, compact)
        }
        if (compact.length != 4) return null

        val parameter = compact.substring(2, 4).toIntOrNull(16) ?: return null
        if (parameter !in allowedParametersByService[service].orEmpty()) return null

        return SafeObdRequest(service, parameter, compact)
    }

    private fun normalizeHexToken(token: String, expectedLength: Int): String? {
        val value = if (token.startsWith("0x", ignoreCase = true)) token.substring(2) else token
        return value.takeIf {
            it.length == expectedLength && it.all { character ->
                character in '0'..'9' || character in 'A'..'F' || character in 'a'..'f'
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Explicit UDS permissions. The default policy is read-only.
 *
 * A write/programming grant must be created by the trusted profile-validation path after
 * vehicle VIN, ECU identity, CAL ID/CVN and documentary evidence have been checked.
 * No GM write profile is bundled until those values and procedures are documented.
 */
@ConsistentCopyVisibility
data class UdsAccessPolicy internal constructor(
    val readDids: Set<Int>,
    val writeDids: Set<Int>,
    val allowedSessions: Set<Int>,
    val routineControlPermissions: Map<Int, Set<Int>>,
    val ioControlPermissions: Map<Int, Set<Int>>,
    val allowedSecurityLevels: Set<Int>,
    val allowedCommunicationControls: Set<Pair<Int, Int>>,
    val allowedDtcSettingTypes: Set<Int>,
    val allowedDtcGroups: Set<Int>,
    val allowedEcuResetTypes: Set<Int>,
    val readableMemoryRegions: List<UdsMemoryRegion>,
    val writableMemoryRegions: List<UdsMemoryRegion>,
    val maxTransferBytes: Int,
    val requireSecurityAccess: Boolean,
    val evidenceReference: String
) {
    companion object {
        fun readOnly(readDids: Set<Int> = emptySet()) = UdsAccessPolicy(
            readDids = readDids,
            writeDids = emptySet(),
            allowedSessions = setOf(0x01),
            routineControlPermissions = emptyMap(),
            ioControlPermissions = emptyMap(),
            allowedSecurityLevels = emptySet(),
            allowedCommunicationControls = emptySet(),
            allowedDtcSettingTypes = emptySet(),
            allowedDtcGroups = emptySet(),
            allowedEcuResetTypes = emptySet(),
            readableMemoryRegions = emptyList(),
            writableMemoryRegions = emptyList(),
            maxTransferBytes = 0,
            requireSecurityAccess = true,
            evidenceReference = "Built-in read-only policy"
        )

        internal fun verified(
            vehicleVin: String,
            identity: UdsEcuIdentity,
            expectedVin: String,
            expectedCalId: String,
            expectedCvn: String,
            expectedControllerFamily: String,
            expectedHardwarePartNumber: String,
            expectedOperatingSystemId: String,
            readDids: Set<Int>,
            writeDids: Set<Int>,
            allowedSessions: Set<Int>,
            routineControlPermissions: Map<Int, Set<Int>>,
            ioControlPermissions: Map<Int, Set<Int>> = emptyMap(),
            allowedSecurityLevels: Set<Int> = emptySet(),
            allowedCommunicationControls: Set<Pair<Int, Int>> = emptySet(),
            allowedDtcSettingTypes: Set<Int> = emptySet(),
            allowedDtcGroups: Set<Int> = emptySet(),
            allowedEcuResetTypes: Set<Int> = emptySet(),
            readableMemoryRegions: List<UdsMemoryRegion>,
            writableMemoryRegions: List<UdsMemoryRegion>,
            maxTransferBytes: Int,
            requireSecurityAccess: Boolean,
            evidenceReference: String
        ): UdsAccessPolicy {
            require(vehicleVin.matches(Regex("[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}")) &&
                vehicleVin.equals(expectedVin, true) &&
                identity.vin.equals(expectedVin, true)) { "VIN verification failed." }
            require(identity.calibrationId.equals(expectedCalId, true)) { "CAL ID verification failed." }
            require(identity.calibrationVerificationNumber.equals(expectedCvn, true)) { "CVN verification failed." }
            require(identity.controllerFamily.equals(expectedControllerFamily, true)) { "Controller family verification failed." }
            require(identity.hardwarePartNumber.equals(expectedHardwarePartNumber, true)) { "Hardware part number verification failed." }
            require(identity.operatingSystemId.equals(expectedOperatingSystemId, true)) { "Operating-system verification failed." }
            require(evidenceReference.isNotBlank()) { "Traceable OEM evidence is required." }
            require(readDids.all { it in 0..0xFFFF } && writeDids.all { it in 0..0xFFFF })
            require(allowedSessions.isNotEmpty() && allowedSessions.all { it in 1..0x7F })
            require(routineControlPermissions.all { (id, types) -> id in 0..0xFFFF && types.isNotEmpty() && types.all { it in 1..3 } })
            require(ioControlPermissions.all { (id, types) -> id in 0..0xFFFF && types.isNotEmpty() && types.all { it in 0..0xFF } })
            require(allowedSecurityLevels.all { it in 1..0x7D && it % 2 == 1 })
            require(allowedCommunicationControls.all { (type, communication) -> type in 0..3 && communication in 0..0xFF })
            require(allowedDtcSettingTypes.all { it in 1..2 })
            require(allowedDtcGroups.all { it in 0..0xFFFFFF })
            require(allowedEcuResetTypes.all { it in 1..0x7F })
            require(maxTransferBytes >= 0)
            return UdsAccessPolicy(
                readDids, writeDids, allowedSessions, routineControlPermissions, ioControlPermissions,
                allowedSecurityLevels, allowedCommunicationControls, allowedDtcSettingTypes,
                allowedDtcGroups, allowedEcuResetTypes, readableMemoryRegions, writableMemoryRegions,
                maxTransferBytes, requireSecurityAccess, evidenceReference
            )
        }
    }
}

data class UdsMemoryRegion(val startAddress: Long, val length: Long) {
    init {
        require(startAddress >= 0 && length > 0 && startAddress <= 0xFFFFFFFFL)
        require(length <= 0x1_0000_0000L - startAddress)
    }

    fun contains(address: Long, size: Long): Boolean =
        address >= startAddress && size > 0 && address <= startAddress + length - size
}

data class UdsDtcRecord(
    val dtc: Int,
    val status: Int,
    val raw: ByteArray
)

/**
 * ISO 14229-1 client over ISO 15765-2 / Classical CAN.
 * Read services are available by default. Any state-changing service requires an
 * explicit, identity-bound policy; no seed/key algorithm or GM address is guessed.
 */
class UdsClient private constructor(
    private val channel: UdsPayloadTransport,
    private val policy: UdsAccessPolicy,
    private val timeoutMs: Long,
    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") marker: Boolean
) {
    constructor(
        transport: RawCanFrameTransport,
        requestCanId: Int,
        responseCanId: Int,
        extendedCanId: Boolean = false,
        policy: UdsAccessPolicy = UdsAccessPolicy.readOnly(),
        timeoutMs: Long = 3000L
    ) : this(IsoTpUdsPayloadTransport(transport, requestCanId, responseCanId, extendedCanId), policy, timeoutMs, true)

    constructor(
        payloadTransport: UdsPayloadTransport,
        policy: UdsAccessPolicy = UdsAccessPolicy.readOnly(),
        timeoutMs: Long = 3000L
    ) : this(payloadTransport, policy, timeoutMs, true)

    private var activeSession = 0x01
    private val requestedSecuritySeeds = mutableSetOf<Int>()
    private var securityUnlocked = false
    private var downloadMaxBlockLength = 0
    private var transferSequence = 1
    private var downloadActive = false
    private var transferredBytes = 0
    private var expectedTransferBytes = 0L
    private var uploadActive = false

    suspend fun diagnosticSessionControl(session: Int): ByteArray {
        require(session in policy.allowedSessions) { "Diagnostic session is not allowed by the verified ECU profile." }
        val response = request(0x10, byteArrayOf(session.toByte()))
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == session) {
            "ECU did not echo the requested diagnostic session."
        }
        activeSession = session
        securityUnlocked = false
        requestedSecuritySeeds.clear()
        return response.copyOfRange(2, response.size)
    }

    suspend fun testerPresent(suppressPositiveResponse: Boolean = false) {
        val subFunction = if (suppressPositiveResponse) 0x80 else 0x00
        if (suppressPositiveResponse) {
            channel.sendOnly(byteArrayOf(0x3E, subFunction.toByte()), timeoutMs)
        } else {
            val response = request(0x3E, byteArrayOf(subFunction.toByte()))
            require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == 0)
        }
    }

    suspend fun readDataByIdentifier(did: Int): ByteArray {
        require(did in 0..0xFFFF)
        require(policy.readDids.isEmpty() || did in policy.readDids) { "DID is not in the read allowlist." }
        val response = request(0x22, byteArrayOf((did shr 8).toByte(), did.toByte()))
        require(response.size >= 3 && readU16(response, 1) == did) { "ECU returned a different DID." }
        return response.copyOfRange(3, response.size)
    }

    suspend fun writeDataByIdentifier(did: Int, data: ByteArray) {
        require(did in policy.writeDids) { "DID write is not allowed by the verified ECU profile." }
        require(data.isNotEmpty() && data.size <= 0x0FFF - 3)
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        val response = request(0x2E, byteArrayOf((did shr 8).toByte(), did.toByte()) + data)
        require(response.size >= 3 && readU16(response, 1) == did) { "ECU did not confirm the written DID." }
    }

    suspend fun readDtcInformation(subFunction: Int, parameters: ByteArray = byteArrayOf()): ByteArray {
        require(subFunction in 0..0x7F)
        val response = request(0x19, byteArrayOf(subFunction.toByte()) + parameters)
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == subFunction) {
            "ECU did not echo the requested DTC subfunction."
        }
        return response.copyOfRange(2, response.size)
    }

    suspend fun readDtcReport(statusMask: Int = 0xFF): UdsDtcReport {
        require(statusMask in 0..0xFF)
        val data = readDtcInformation(0x02, byteArrayOf(statusMask.toByte()))
        return UdsDtcDecoder.decodeReadDtcInformation(data)
    }

    suspend fun readDtcByStatusMask(statusMask: Int = 0xFF): List<UdsDtcRecord> {
        val report = readDtcReport(statusMask)
        return report.records.map { record ->
            val rawBytes = byteArrayOf(
                record.rawDtc.ushr(16).toByte(),
                record.rawDtc.ushr(8).toByte(),
                record.rawDtc.toByte(),
                record.statusByte.toByte()
            )
            UdsDtcRecord(
                dtc = record.rawDtc,
                status = record.statusByte,
                raw = byteArrayOf(
                    report.statusAvailabilityMask.toByte(),
                    report.formatIdentifier.toByte()
                ) + rawBytes
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearDiagnosticInformation(groupOfDtc: Int = 0xFFFFFF) {
        require(groupOfDtc in policy.allowedDtcGroups) { "DTC group is not allowlisted for this ECU." }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        request(0x14, byteArrayOf(
            (groupOfDtc shr 16).toByte(), (groupOfDtc shr 8).toByte(), groupOfDtc.toByte()
        ))
    }

    suspend fun ecuReset(resetType: Int) {
        require(resetType in policy.allowedEcuResetTypes) { "ECU reset type is not allowlisted for this ECU." }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        val response = request(0x11, byteArrayOf(resetType.toByte()))
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == resetType) { "ECU did not echo reset type." }
        activeSession = 0x01
        securityUnlocked = false
        downloadActive = false
    }

    /** Requests a seed. The app deliberately does not implement or guess OEM key algorithms. */
    suspend fun requestSecuritySeed(level: Int): ByteArray {
        require(level in policy.allowedSecurityLevels) { "Security level is not allowlisted for this ECU." }
        require(level in 1..0x7D && level % 2 == 1)
        require(activeSession != 0x01) { "Security access requires a non-default diagnostic session." }
        val response = request(0x27, byteArrayOf(level.toByte()))
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == level)
        requestedSecuritySeeds += level
        return response.copyOfRange(2, response.size)
    }

    /** Sends a key generated by an authorized OEM algorithm supplied outside this project. */
    suspend fun submitSecurityKey(level: Int, key: ByteArray) {
        require(level in 2..0x7E && level % 2 == 0 && level - 1 in policy.allowedSecurityLevels)
        require(level - 1 in requestedSecuritySeeds) { "A matching security seed has not been requested." }
        require(key.isNotEmpty() && key.size <= 0x0FFF - 2)
        val response = request(0x27, byteArrayOf(level.toByte()) + key)
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == level)
        securityUnlocked = true
        requestedSecuritySeeds.remove(level - 1)
    }

    suspend fun routineControl(controlType: Int, routineId: Int, parameters: ByteArray = byteArrayOf()): ByteArray {
        require(controlType in 1..3)
        require(controlType in policy.routineControlPermissions[routineId].orEmpty()) {
            "Routine/control-type pair is not allowlisted for this ECU."
        }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        val requestData = byteArrayOf(
            controlType.toByte(), (routineId shr 8).toByte(), routineId.toByte()
        ) + parameters
        val response = request(0x31, requestData)
        require(response.size >= 4 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == controlType && readU16(response, 2) == routineId)
        return response.copyOfRange(4, response.size)
    }

    suspend fun readMemoryByAddressAndLength(address: Long, size: Int, addressLength: Int = 4, sizeLength: Int = 2): ByteArray {
        requireAllowedMemory(address, size.toLong(), policy.readableMemoryRegions)
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        require(size in 1..4092 && size <= policy.maxTransferBytes) {
            "Memory read length exceeds the verified profile limit."
        }
        // ISO 14229 ALFI: upper nibble = memory size width, lower nibble = address width.
        val format = sizeLength shl 4 or addressLength
        val requestData = byteArrayOf(format.toByte()) + encodeUnsigned(address, addressLength) + encodeUnsigned(size.toLong(), sizeLength)
        val response = request(0x23, requestData)
        require(response.size == size + 1) { "ECU memory read is incomplete or longer than requested." }
        return response.copyOfRange(1, response.size)
    }

    suspend fun writeMemoryByAddressAndLength(address: Long, data: ByteArray, addressLength: Int = 4, sizeLength: Int = 2) {
        requireAllowedMemory(address, data.size.toLong(), policy.writableMemoryRegions)
        require(data.isNotEmpty() && data.size <= policy.maxTransferBytes &&
            data.size + 2 + addressLength + sizeLength <= 4095)
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        // ISO 14229 ALFI: upper nibble = memory size width, lower nibble = address width.
        val format = sizeLength shl 4 or addressLength
        val requestData = byteArrayOf(format.toByte()) + encodeUnsigned(address, addressLength) +
            encodeUnsigned(data.size.toLong(), sizeLength) + data
        request(0x3D, requestData)
    }

    suspend fun requestDownload(address: Long, size: Long, dataFormatIdentifier: Int = 0, addressLength: Int = 4, sizeLength: Int = 4) {
        require(!downloadActive && !uploadActive) { "A data transfer is already active." }
        requireAllowedMemory(address, size, policy.writableMemoryRegions)
        require(size <= policy.maxTransferBytes.toLong()) { "Transfer exceeds the verified profile limit." }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        require(dataFormatIdentifier in 0..0xFF)
        // ISO 14229 ALFI: upper nibble = memory size width, lower nibble = address width.
        val format = sizeLength shl 4 or addressLength
        val response = request(
            0x34,
            byteArrayOf(dataFormatIdentifier.toByte(), format.toByte()) +
                encodeUnsigned(address, addressLength) + encodeUnsigned(size, sizeLength)
        )
        require(response.size >= 3) { "Incomplete RequestDownload response." }
        val lengthFormat = response[1].toInt() and 0xFF
        // ISO 14229 lengthFormatIdentifier: upper nibble declares block-length bytes.
        val lengthBytes = lengthFormat ushr 4
        require(lengthFormat and 0x0F == 0) { "Reserved LFI bits must be zero." }
        require(lengthBytes in 1..4 && response.size >= 2 + lengthBytes)
        val maxBlockLength = readUnsigned(response, 2, lengthBytes)
        require(maxBlockLength in 3L..4095L) { "ECU block length exceeds supported UDS framing." }
        downloadMaxBlockLength = maxBlockLength.toInt()
        require(downloadMaxBlockLength > 2) { "ECU returned an invalid maximum block length." }
        transferSequence = 1
        transferredBytes = 0
        expectedTransferBytes = size
        downloadActive = true
    }

    suspend fun transferData(block: ByteArray) {
        require(downloadActive) { "No RequestDownload is active." }
        require(block.isNotEmpty() && block.size <= downloadMaxBlockLength - 2)
        require(transferredBytes.toLong() + block.size <= expectedTransferBytes) { "Transfer exceeds the requested ECU range length." }
        require(transferredBytes.toLong() + block.size <= policy.maxTransferBytes.toLong())
        val response = request(0x36, byteArrayOf(transferSequence.toByte()) + block)
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) == transferSequence) {
            "ECU did not acknowledge the transfer block sequence."
        }
        transferredBytes += block.size
        transferSequence = (transferSequence + 1) and 0xFF
    }

    suspend fun requestUpload(address: Long, size: Long, dataFormatIdentifier: Int = 0, addressLength: Int = 4, sizeLength: Int = 4) {
        require(!downloadActive && !uploadActive) { "A data transfer is already active." }
        requireAllowedMemory(address, size, policy.readableMemoryRegions)
        require(size <= policy.maxTransferBytes.toLong()) { "Transfer exceeds the verified profile limit." }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        require(dataFormatIdentifier in 0..0xFF)
        // ISO 14229 ALFI: upper nibble = memory size width, lower nibble = address width.
        val format = sizeLength shl 4 or addressLength
        val response = request(0x35, byteArrayOf(dataFormatIdentifier.toByte(), format.toByte()) +
            encodeUnsigned(address, addressLength) + encodeUnsigned(size, sizeLength))
        require(response.size >= 3) { "Incomplete RequestUpload response." }
        val lengthFormat = response[1].toInt() and 0xFF
        val lengthBytes = lengthFormat ushr 4
        require(lengthFormat and 0x0F == 0) { "Reserved LFI bits must be zero." }
        require(lengthBytes in 1..4 && response.size >= 2 + lengthBytes)
        val maxBlockLength = readUnsigned(response, 2, lengthBytes)
        require(maxBlockLength in 3L..4095L) { "ECU block length exceeds supported UDS framing." }
        downloadMaxBlockLength = maxBlockLength.toInt()
        require(downloadMaxBlockLength > 2) { "ECU returned an invalid maximum upload block length." }
        transferSequence = 1
        transferredBytes = 0
        expectedTransferBytes = size
        uploadActive = true
    }

    suspend fun requestUploadData(): ByteArray {
        require(uploadActive) { "No RequestUpload is active." }
        require(transferredBytes.toLong() < expectedTransferBytes) { "The requested upload range is already complete." }
        val response = request(0x36, byteArrayOf(transferSequence.toByte()))
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0xFF) == transferSequence) {
            "ECU did not acknowledge the upload block sequence."
        }
        val data = response.copyOfRange(2, response.size)
        require(data.isNotEmpty() && data.size <= downloadMaxBlockLength - 2)
        require(transferredBytes.toLong() + data.size <= expectedTransferBytes)
        transferredBytes += data.size
        transferSequence = (transferSequence + 1) and 0xFF
        return data
    }

    suspend fun inputOutputControlByIdentifier(did: Int, controlParameter: Int, data: ByteArray = byteArrayOf()): ByteArray {
        require(controlParameter in policy.ioControlPermissions[did].orEmpty()) {
            "I/O control DID/parameter pair is not allowlisted for this ECU."
        }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        val response = request(0x2F, byteArrayOf((did shr 8).toByte(), did.toByte(), controlParameter.toByte()) + data)
        require(response.size >= 4 && readU16(response, 1) == did &&
            (response[3].toInt() and 0xFF) == controlParameter) { "ECU did not confirm I/O control." }
        return response.copyOfRange(4, response.size)
    }

    suspend fun communicationControl(controlType: Int, communicationType: Int) {
        require((controlType to communicationType) in policy.allowedCommunicationControls) {
            "Communication control type is not allowlisted for this ECU."
        }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        val response = request(0x28, byteArrayOf(controlType.toByte(), communicationType.toByte()))
        require(response.size >= 3 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == controlType &&
            (response[2].toInt() and 0xFF) == communicationType)
    }

    suspend fun controlDtcSetting(settingType: Int, record: ByteArray = byteArrayOf()) {
        require(settingType in policy.allowedDtcSettingTypes) { "DTC setting type is not allowlisted for this ECU." }
        requireProgrammingSession()
        requireSecurityIfConfigured()
        val response = request(0x85, byteArrayOf(settingType.toByte()) + record)
        require(response.size >= 2 && (response[1].toInt() and 0x7F) == settingType)
    }

    suspend fun requestTransferExit(parameters: ByteArray = byteArrayOf()) {
        require(downloadActive || uploadActive) { "No data transfer is active." }
        if (downloadActive) require(transferredBytes.toLong() == expectedTransferBytes) { "Transferred byte count does not match the requested download length." }
        if (uploadActive) require(transferredBytes.toLong() == expectedTransferBytes) { "Uploaded byte count does not match the requested upload length." }
        request(0x37, parameters)
        downloadActive = false
        uploadActive = false
        downloadMaxBlockLength = 0
        expectedTransferBytes = 0
    }

    fun isDownloadActive(): Boolean = downloadActive
    fun isUploadActive(): Boolean = uploadActive
    fun isSecurityUnlocked(): Boolean = securityUnlocked
    fun activeDiagnosticSession(): Int = activeSession

    private suspend fun request(service: Int, data: ByteArray): ByteArray {
        val response = channel.exchange(byteArrayOf(service.toByte()) + data, timeoutMs)
        require(response.isNotEmpty()) { "ECU returned an empty UDS response." }
        val responseService = response[0].toInt() and 0xFF
        if (responseService == 0x7F) {
            require(response.size >= 3) { "Incomplete UDS negative response." }
            throw UdsNegativeResponseException(response[1].toInt() and 0xFF, response[2].toInt() and 0xFF)
        }
        require(responseService == (service + 0x40)) {
            "Unexpected UDS response service 0x" + responseService.toString(16).uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        }
        return response
    }

    private fun requireProgrammingSession() {
        require(activeSession != 0x01 && activeSession in policy.allowedSessions) {
            "A verified non-default diagnostic session is required for this operation."
        }
    }

    private fun requireSecurityIfConfigured() {
        if (policy.requireSecurityAccess) require(securityUnlocked) {
            "This operation requires an accepted SecurityAccess exchange."
        }
    }

    private fun requireAllowedMemory(address: Long, size: Long, regions: List<UdsMemoryRegion>) {
        require(regions.any { it.contains(address, size) }) {
            "Memory range is outside the verified ECU profile."
        }
    }

    private fun encodeUnsigned(value: Long, bytes: Int): ByteArray {
        require(bytes in 1..4 && value >= 0)
        val max = (1L shl (bytes * 8)) - 1L
        require(value <= max)
        return ByteArray(bytes) { index ->
            (value shr ((bytes - index - 1) * 8)).toByte()
        }
    }

    private fun readUnsigned(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int, count: Int): Long {
        require(count in 1..4 && offset >= 0 && offset + count <= bytes.size)
        var result = 0L
        repeat(count) { result = (result shl 8) or (bytes[offset + it].toLong() and 0xFF) }
        return result
    }

    private fun readU16(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int): Int =
        ((bytes[offset].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (bytes[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import com.camarodiag.gen5.domain.model.DiagnosticDtc

/**
 * DTC format identifiers returned by UDS ReadDTCInformation (ISO 14229).
 * Unknown identifiers are preserved as raw 24-bit values, never guessed.
 */
enum class UdsDtcFormat(val identifier: Int) {
    SAE_J2012_DA_FORMAT_00(0x00),
    ISO_14229_1(0x01),
    SAE_J1939_73(0x02),
    ISO_11992_4(0x03),
    SAE_J2012_DA_FORMAT_04(0x04);

    companion object {
        fun from(identifier: Int): UdsDtcFormat? = entries.firstOrNull { it.identifier == identifier }
    }
}

data class DecodedUdsDtcRecord(
    val rawDtc: Int,
    val code: String,
    val statusByte: Int,
    val status: UdsDtcStatus
)

data class UdsDtcStatus(
    val testFailed: Boolean,
    val testFailedThisOperationCycle: Boolean,
    val pending: Boolean,
    val confirmed: Boolean,
    val testNotCompletedSinceLastClear: Boolean,
    val testFailedSinceLastClear: Boolean,
    val testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle: Boolean,
    val warningIndicatorRequested: Boolean
)

/** Maps a decoded UDS record into the application's shared DTC presentation model. */
fun DecodedUdsDtcRecord.toDiagnosticDtc(moduleId: String): DiagnosticDtc {
    require(moduleId.isNotBlank()) { "The responding ECU module ID is required." }
    val stateEn = buildList {
        if (status.testFailed) add("failed")
        if (status.testFailedThisOperationCycle) add("failed this operation cycle")
        if (status.pending) add("pending")
        if (status.confirmed) add("confirmed")
        if (status.testNotCompletedSinceLastClear) add("test not completed since last clear")
        if (status.testFailedSinceLastClear) add("failed since last clear")
        if (status.testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle) add("test not completed this operation cycle")
        if (status.warningIndicatorRequested) add("warning indicator requested")
    }.ifEmpty { listOf("status not asserted") }.joinToString(", ")
    val stateFr = buildList {
        if (status.testFailed) add("défaut présent")
        if (status.testFailedThisOperationCycle) add("défaut présent pendant ce cycle de fonctionnement")
        if (status.pending) add("en attente")
        if (status.confirmed) add("confirmé")
        if (status.testNotCompletedSinceLastClear) add("test non terminé depuis le dernier effacement")
        if (status.testFailedSinceLastClear) add("défaut détecté depuis le dernier effacement")
        if (status.testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle) add("test non terminé pendant ce cycle de fonctionnement")
        if (status.warningIndicatorRequested) add("voyant demandé")
    }.ifEmpty { listOf("aucun état de défaut actif") }.joinToString(", ")
    return DiagnosticDtc(
        code = code,
        module = moduleId,
        statusEn = stateEn,
        statusFr = stateFr,
        descEn = "Raw UDS DTC 0x" + rawDtc.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(6, '0') +
            ". A verified OEM definition for module $moduleId and this ECU calibration is not loaded.",
        descFr = "DTC UDS brut 0x" + rawDtc.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(6, '0') +
            ". Aucune définition constructeur vérifiée n'est chargée pour le calculateur $moduleId et cette calibration.",
        isPending = status.pending
    )
}

data class UdsDtcReport(
    val statusAvailabilityMask: Int,
    val formatIdentifier: Int,
    val format: UdsDtcFormat?,
    val records: List<DecodedUdsDtcRecord>
)

object UdsDtcDecoder {
    /**
     * Input is the payload returned by UdsReadOnlyClient.readDtcInformation():
     * DTCStatusAvailabilityMask, DTCFormatIdentifier, then 4-byte records
     * (3-byte DTC + 1-byte status).
     */
    fun decodeReadDtcInformation(payload: ByteArray): UdsDtcReport {
        require(payload.size >= 2) {
            "UDS DTC payload must include the status availability mask and DTC format identifier."
        }
        require((payload.size - 2) % 4 == 0) {
            "UDS DTC payload has a truncated DTCAndStatusRecord."
        }

        val availability = payload[0].toInt() and 0xFF
        val formatIdentifier = payload[1].toInt() and 0xFF
        val format = UdsDtcFormat.from(formatIdentifier)
        val records = payload.drop(2).chunked(4).map { bytes ->
            val b0 = bytes[0].toInt() and 0xFF
            val b1 = bytes[1].toInt() and 0xFF
            val b2 = bytes[2].toInt() and 0xFF
            val status = bytes[3].toInt() and 0xFF
            // Only status bits advertised by DTCStatusAvailabilityMask are meaningful.
            // Keep the raw byte intact in statusByte for diagnostics and evidence.
            val availableStatus = status and availability
            val raw = (b0 shl 16) or (b1 shl 8) or b2
            DecodedUdsDtcRecord(
                rawDtc = raw,
                code = formatDisplayCode(format, b0, b1, b2),
                statusByte = status,
                status = UdsDtcStatus(
                    testFailed = availableStatus and 0x01 != 0,
                    testFailedThisOperationCycle = availableStatus and 0x02 != 0,
                    pending = availableStatus and 0x04 != 0,
                    confirmed = availableStatus and 0x08 != 0,
                    testNotCompletedSinceLastClear = availableStatus and 0x10 != 0,
                    testFailedSinceLastClear = availableStatus and 0x20 != 0,
                    testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle = availableStatus and 0x40 != 0,
                    warningIndicatorRequested = availableStatus and 0x80 != 0
                )
            )
        }
        return UdsDtcReport(availability, formatIdentifier, format, records)
    }

    private fun formatDisplayCode(format: UdsDtcFormat?, b0: Int, b1: Int, b2: Int): String =
        when (format) {
            UdsDtcFormat.SAE_J2012_DA_FORMAT_00 -> formatJ2012Dtc(b0, b1, b2)
            // Format 0x04 uses a distinct SAE J2012-DA base-code list (ISO 27145).
            // Keep it raw until that separate table is implemented; never decode it as format 0x00.
            else -> "0x" + ((b0 shl 16) or (b1 shl 8) or b2)
                .toString(16).uppercase().padStart(6, '0')
        }

    /** SAE J2012 3-byte representation: five-character DTC plus failure-type byte. */
    private fun formatJ2012Dtc(b0: Int, b1: Int, failureType: Int): String {
        val family = when (b0 ushr 6) {
            0 -> 'P'
            1 -> 'C'
            2 -> 'B'
            else -> 'U'
        }
        val firstDigit = (b0 ushr 4) and 0x03
        val secondDigit = b0 and 0x0F
        return "$family$firstDigit" +
            secondDigit.toString(16).uppercase() +
            (b1 ushr 4).toString(16).uppercase() +
            (b1 and 0x0F).toString(16).uppercase() +
            "-" + failureType.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(2, '0')
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CanTraceFilterTest {
    private val rxFrame = CanTraceFrame(
        lineNumber = 12,
        timestampSeconds = 1.25,
        canId = 0x7E8,
        direction = CanTraceDirection.RX,
        data = listOf(0x03, 0x41, 0x0C, 0x1A, 0xF8)
    )

    private val txFrame = CanTraceFrame(
        lineNumber = 13,
        timestampSeconds = 1.50,
        canId = 0x7E0,
        direction = CanTraceDirection.TX,
        data = listOf(0x02, 0x01, 0x0C)
    )

    @Test
    fun filtersByIdentifierDirectionAndDataPrefix() {
        val filter = CanTraceFilter(
            canId = 0x7E8,
            direction = CanTraceDirection.RX,
            dataPrefix = listOf(0x03, 0x41)
        )

        assertTrue(filter.matches(rxFrame))
        assertFalse(filter.matches(txFrame))
    }

    @Test
    fun searchesIdentifierPayloadAndDirection() {
        assertTrue(CanTraceFilter(searchText = "7E8").matches(rxFrame))
        assertTrue(CanTraceFilter(searchText = "03 41 0C").matches(rxFrame))
        assertTrue(CanTraceFilter(searchText = "RX").matches(rxFrame))
        assertFalse(CanTraceFilter(searchText = "DE AD").matches(rxFrame))
    }

    @Test
    fun appliesTimestampBoundsAndRejectsUnknownTimestampWhenBounded() {
        assertTrue(
            CanTraceFilter(fromTimestampSeconds = 1.0, toTimestampSeconds = 1.5)
                .matches(rxFrame)
        )
        assertFalse(
            CanTraceFilter(fromTimestampSeconds = 1.3).matches(rxFrame)
        )
        val unknownTime = rxFrame.copy(timestampSeconds = null)
        assertFalse(
            CanTraceFilter(fromTimestampSeconds = 0.0).matches(unknownTime)
        )
        val notANumber = rxFrame.copy(timestampSeconds = Double.NaN)
        assertFalse(
            CanTraceFilter(fromTimestampSeconds = 0.0).matches(notANumber)
        )
        val infiniteTime = rxFrame.copy(timestampSeconds = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
        assertFalse(
            CanTraceFilter(toTimestampSeconds = 2.0).matches(infiniteTime)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun parsesCanIdentifiersAndRejectsInvalidInput() {
        assertEquals(0x7E8, CanTraceFilter.parseCanId("0x7E8"))
        assertEquals(0x18DAF110, CanTraceFilter.parseCanId("18DAF110"))
        assertNull(CanTraceFilter.parseCanId("7G8"))
        assertNull(CanTraceFilter.parseCanId("123456789"))
    }

    @Test
    fun parsesBytePrefixesAndRejectsMalformedBytes() {
        assertEquals(
            listOf(0x03, 0x22, 0xF1),
            CanTraceFilter.parseDataPrefix("0x03, 22 F1")
        )
        assertEquals(emptyList<Int>(), CanTraceFilter.parseDataPrefix(""))
        assertNull(CanTraceFilter.parseDataPrefix("03 2  F1"))
        assertNull(CanTraceFilter.parseDataPrefix("GG"))
    }

    @Test
    fun preservesCaptureOrderAndHonorsResultLimit() {
        val filtered = listOf(txFrame, rxFrame).filterCanTrace(
            CanTraceFilter(direction = CanTraceDirection.RX),
            maxResults = 1
        )

        assertEquals(listOf(rxFrame), filtered)
        assertTrue(listOf(rxFrame).filterCanTrace(CanTraceFilter(), 0).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException::class)
    fun rejectsInvertedTimestampRange() {
        CanTraceFilter(fromTimestampSeconds = 2.0, toTimestampSeconds = 1.0)
    }
}

package com.camarodiag.gen5.data.obd

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CamaroLfxObdSimulatorTest {

    @Test
    fun fullScanReturnsClearlySyntheticLfxDataWithoutHardware() = runBlocking {
        val report = CamaroLfxObdSimulator.createEngine().fullReadOnlyScan()

        assertTrue(report.supportedPids.containsAll(setOf(0x0C, 0x22, 0x24, 0x59, 0x5A)))
        assertTrue(0x20 !in report.supportedPids)
        assertTrue(0x40 !in report.supportedPids)
        assertTrue(report.respondingEcuAddresses.contains("7E8"))
        assertEquals("1G1TEST0000000001", report.vin)
        assertEquals(listOf("LFX12SIM00000001"), report.calibrationIds)
        assertEquals(listOf("12345678"), report.calibrationVerificationNumbers)
        assertEquals(listOf("CAMARODIAG LFX SIM"), report.ecuNames)
        assertTrue(report.adapterInfo["IDENTIFICATION"].orEmpty().contains("SIMULATED"))
        assertTrue(report.adapterInfo["DESCRIPTION"].orEmpty().contains("Offline Simulator"))
        assertTrue(report.readiness.orEmpty().contains("MIL=OFF"))
        assertTrue(report.readiness.orEmpty().contains("DTC_COUNT=2"))
        assertTrue(report.liveData.any { it.pid == 0x0C && it.value == "750.00" })
        assertTrue(report.liveData.any { it.pid == 0x22 && it.value == "79.00" })
        assertTrue(report.liveData.any { it.pid == 0x24 && it.name.contains("Bank 1 sensor 1") })
        assertEquals("P0171", report.freezeFrameDtc?.code)
        assertEquals(listOf(0x0B, 0xB8), report.freezeFrame[0x0C])
        assertEquals(listOf(0x7F), report.freezeFrame[0x05])
        assertEquals(setOf("P0133", "P0171"), report.confirmedDtcs.map { it.code }.toSet())
        assertTrue(report.rawLog.any { it.contains("ATZ") })
    }

    @Test
    fun everyAdvertisedDataPidHasAValidPositiveResponse() = runBlocking {
        val supported = CamaroLfxObdSimulator.createEngine().discoverSupportedPids()
        val expected = setOf(
            0x05, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0F, 0x11, 0x1F,
            0x22, 0x24, 0x2D, 0x2E, 0x2F, 0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x3C, 0x3E,
            0x42, 0x44, 0x46, 0x49, 0x4A, 0x4C, 0x4D, 0x4E, 0x52, 0x59,
            0x5A, 0x5C, 0x5E
        )

        assertEquals(expected, supported)
        supported.forEach { pid ->
            val marker = "41%02X".format(java.util.Locale.US, pid)
            val response = CamaroLfxObdSimulator.response("01%02X".format(java.util.Locale.US, pid))
            val normalized = response.uppercase().replace(Regex("[^0-9A-F]"), "")
            assertTrue("PID %02X is advertised but has no positive response: %s".format(
                java.util.Locale.US, pid, response
            ), normalized.contains(marker))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun simulatorNeverAnswersUnknownOrWriteCommandsAsSuccessful() {
        assertEquals("NO DATA", CamaroLfxObdSimulator.response("01AA"))
        assertEquals("NO DATA", CamaroLfxObdSimulator.response("04"))
        assertEquals("NO DATA", CamaroLfxObdSimulator.response("2E F190 00"))
    }

    @Test
    fun supportedPidBitmapsAdvertiseOnlyConfiguredPages() {
        val first = CamaroLfxObdSimulator.response("0100")
        val second = CamaroLfxObdSimulator.response("0120")
        val third = CamaroLfxObdSimulator.response("0140")

        assertTrue(first.contains("41 00"))
        assertTrue(second.contains("41 20"))
        assertTrue(third.contains("41 40"))
    }
}
